Absolutely horrendous app on Android. Used this app for years to track my weight and food intake, I came back to it again recently to start being more serious about tracking my food again and they have taken away the scan bar code on the free version and the yearly subscription is a rip off just so I can scan bar codes. Love my fitness pal! Been using it for years but unfortunately I cannot recommend this without the ability to barcode scan! No barcode scanner anymore as it wants you to pay for it. Doesn't have netball as an exercise, which is bizarre as it is a massive sport so that is inaccurate. Finally, I upgraded to Pro. 😆 I'm convinced with the help of this app that I will be back in shape by the end of this year. Lost 10 lbs thanks to tracking and adjusting. Truly this used to be a great app. Now upon reinstalling it I've come to find they've removed the barcode scanner for free users and you now have to pay. Would be Great if it Worked! Unfortunately, even in the Premium+ Subscription at its absolutely PREMIUM (EXPENSIVE!) price, does not work. I love the app, it helps me track my daily calories and helps me achieve my goals, however it seems to have an issue with the exercise tab. The lack of even email support is very frustrating. I pay for this app. It has a cool feature that shows macros right on my Android home screen. MFP really helps with mindful eating. At the start, it takes some time to get used to tracking your intake, but the habit builds healthy intuitive eating. Love it and highly recommend! Generally an excellent app I've been using this app for nearly 10yrs and I've never really had any major issues. I used to love this app. but nothing works on it. I have paid for premium for years. I still get ads. Now buttons aren't working and I can't log in even though I've updated my phone multiple times. Seems solid, haven't used it much yet. The first thing that happened was that I changed my intake units for fluids to millilitres but on the watch it's still set to cups. This is a great app as a free option to log and track calorie intake. It does feel like that is where it stops though. Missing basic features It's a great idea to offer a database full of foods but when there is no option to correct nutritional values, it undermines the entire system. The log in problem has been fixed. I like the app and how it can track stuff even if you're not using the premium version. The only actual critique I can give is if only there was a way to implement measurements in grams for ALL food types. very glitchy app. I have trouble signing in. the dashboard is blank if I go to diary and then want to return to dashboard. This used to be more convenient. A lot of the great features that once were free and made using this app worth it is no longer free. I used to use this all the time but has become a hassle without being able to scan the barcode to add it to my log.

Nice app to track calories. Lots of food in their database with complete information. However I have the premium version and some things are just lacking or not working well. I've been using MFP on and off for over 8 years now. It's very easy to use, I love being able to see all nutrition (especially now that I have high cholesterol). Large database of items, but incredibly buggy. The update dialog is constantly bugging out, you can't close it and it covers everything. Closing and reopening the app doesn't solve it either. Random errors whenever you try to do things like update your goal as well.

It's good for calorie tracking and the scan option is a timesaver with a lot recognised OOTB. However, every time I open it, it asks me half a dozen times to review my goals! I am loving everything except for the search aspect. Too many discrepancies between similar items as to the amount of calories per serving. I'm not sure if it is available in the premium version of the application. Love it though,it is very user friendly. I love the reminders, the challenges, the new board, the blogs featured, restaurant menu items, barcode reader

It's a good app to track your calories and meals for free. I just personally wish they have more generic Asian foods in their repetour, haha! Anyway, they also have an exercise tracking thing. Great app for calorie tracking! However I'm annoyed that they made barcode scanning a premium feature last October. Very useful app. Have experienced some technical difficulties though. I've had this app since 2015. Used it on and off over the years, and was always fantastic. Honestly, started out as a good app, good way to track macros and calories. Everything was fine until I started linking apps (google health connect apecifically), then it was nothing but problems. Helpful but sometimes inaccurate and buggy. Currently I'm doing a cut and tracking calories is very important for that. This App definitely helps with that. Loved MyFitnessPal. However, since a month or two ago, it simply wouldn't open. Upon opening the app, it'd stay indefinitely on the blue loading screen. Helping count the calories, and keep track of weight loss. Easy to use any time, any where.....love it!! Using it couldn't be any easier. I love this app. However, my exercise calories keep disappearing (linked to Samsung Health), and I keep having to uninstall and reinstall the app to get it to work. I've been using the app for 11 years and loved it. Recently, it no longer syncs correctly with fitbit. I've tried uninstalling both, reinstalling both, then reconnecting both, and still not working. Love this app! I have been using it on and off for about 5 years. It keeps me on track and has a massive database of food, I can always find what I'm looking for. When it works, it works well. BUT it's best to cross-reference with product packaging as some products are listed multiple times, all with different calorie counts. More and more problems arise with your app over time: - Very slow starting. - Copying and Paste problems: items arise from nowhere. - Your add in My Meals is covering the lowest item! It has a great database, which is accurate for the most part. I'm growing less pleased with it and have looking at other apps. I had rated three stars but dropped one for poor support. Everything says 'reach out to our website' - no, I reached out to you here/Twitter. I used to love this app but recently its keeps having a pop up to take the 30day free trial of an upgrade and anytime i say no and click off of it, it comes up again with the same thing. I dont want an upgrade I want to log what I've eaten but keep getting the same continuous pop up. I thought the app was great because I can also match it with my walk but now I feel there must be a glitch or something and I may have to just delete it.

the app is brilliant, other than that I wish you could share meals with others. my husband also has MFP and we eat the same meals, so if I could share meals with him or vise versa, would save a lot of time adding things in individually. the barcode scan isn't always accurate either. what the packet says the call are and what MFP says it is csn sometimes be different, but it may have been changed/updated since the nutrition info was first put in.

The app is helping me lose weight fantastically. However, it has countless super annoying bugs which can be very frustrating if you use it daily (which you have to if you want to do track your macros/caloric intake). Example: most of the time the app cannot connect to the servers, and does not tell you for example how much weight you will have in 5 weeks if you ate everyday like that day (aka the complete diary feature). There are many other bugs. I'll update this once most of bugs are solved.

I've used this app for years but it's now so frustrating! You can't find the correct foods and then are asked to measure in 'cups', it's all guess work. However the worst point is that you only get half a screen with the rest taken up by the constant asking you to go premium, I want to see my daily diary not this so I'm now using an alternative where I can see all the data I need.

I really liked this because it was helpful in keeping track of everything i was eating. but after 7 days of using it, it suddenly logged me out and i couldn't log back in - it said "login error". i left it for that night and tried again the next morning; it finally let me log back in, except all my progress, foods, recipes and goals were all deleted and it was like starting all over again. So i am really disappointed.

I went through the sign up process, verified my email and encountered a problem with it finalising in creating my account, it kept saying, "cannot create account, check you have an internet connection". very much connected. Wouldn't work via WiFi or my mobile data. Thought I'd just give signing in a go anyway. It recognised my details and I thought, awesome it worked, but no, a pop up message said that it was unable to connect me to the server. Could be a great app if I could sign in and try it.

excellent app which I use daily to monitor weight and track what I eat. very flexible to track calories, carbs or other. Extensive and growing database of foods. Newsfeed with articles and tips. I mark it down one star because the database has a lot of duplication and junk (common with databases where users can add any rubbish but it should be reviewed).

I have loved this app for years. But now, I don't know what has happened, opening the app is slow, trying to input food is so difficult that it's even causing my phone to freeze and its adding 20,000 times the amount that I'm inputting or it's not even adding it to my calories! What has happened? Think you need to look into this problem as I don't think I'm the only one experiencing this. In the mean time does anyone know of another decent calorie counting app that won't do this to my phone?

Does the job. I really like the massive database of foods, much better than any other food tracking app I've used. However for me there is too little information about calorie balance and the numbers involved. I would prefer a more thorough insight of calories burned v's consumed. No favourites list in the food diary is also a bummer.

This was truly one of the best apps ever made, however, due to the overwhelming amount of ads, it has become unusable. I cannot even put what I have eaten for lunch without getting bombarded with at least 3 ads. Despite of this, they were still bearable. However, the last straw was changing the barcode scanning option so it is now a premium subscription tool. The worst parts are that it is not a one-time purchase, it is overpriced, and many people would not make use of all features.

Signed up for free trial and didn't get notified of trial ending so got charged for a full year at $65. Not impressed. It's a handy all to learn from and now I'm far more aware of what I'm consuming. Would be good if you got promoted to use the features you're paying for. Free version is enough for most people I'd say.

Deleted this app after years and years of using it. Just like everyone else, I was shocked to see that the barcode scanner was now hidden behind an extortionate pay wall. The usual "oh you can log by searching the name anyway" excuse is getting tiring. Like most people, I left and discovered "Loseit!". It actually turned out to be a much better app. Your loss guys, you destroyed your platform. I reccomend you reverse this decision before everyone jumps ship.

I had to edit the review. Great App for calculating daily calories, especially when tracking progress in the gym bulking/shredding. A little bit hard to find some ingredients but with a little patience is doable and keep a long memory of ingredients previously used. Great feature of creating your own recipes which makes everything hell a lot easier. The barcode scanner hasn't failed me ones (guess very large database). All in all a clear recommendation, just super convenient for me!

MyFitnessPal is one of the best, but it could be THE BEST with a few changes.  Firstly, for staple whole foods like veges, fruits & cuts of meat, there are hundreds of selections available. Many of them are incorrect. Why not have one selection for each whole food item which is correct and verified? Secondly, why hasn't the developer added the ability to carb cycle? Devs if you're reading this, please consider these changes!

Having used mfp for years, I'm finding the latest update v user-unfriendly! I don't want to jump straight to macros from the home screen, quickly accessing my diary was much more useful! I can also no longer edit meals, meaning that rather than simply adjusting the quantities of a meal that I make regularly, I now have to create a new meal every time. Unimpressed. I'm awaiting the launch of Layne Norton's new app, and I'm afraid I'll be off to join him if mfp continues to disappoint...

So far was good for tracking calories and workout adjustments, but now every time it syncs with Samsung Health, I get crazy number of duplicate workouts entered, even though I do them once, so every day I have like 2000 calories adjustments. When I try to delete them, they appear again after a few seconds of refreshing. Can you please fix it?

Some things are good, however almost all the features are there simply to say they are there, incomplete, half-finished, and ineffective. For example, A workout routine with 10 exercises, and a tutorial for only 3, leaving you to stop and find another source to learn the workout often requires a subscription to another app, after paying premium expecting that feature on this app.

I used this app almost daily to log my food and make sure I'm on track. It has always had it's bugs, but I've been able to manage despite frustrations when it either logs a food multiple times, or the scanner gives you a completely different item. I went on the app yesterday to scan a barcode but couldn't. What a disappointment they have taken this feature away for long standing customers. Why would I upgrade when the basic version is sub-par.

I hated this app, it was not for me at all. There's no way simply to enter calories either in food or from exercise, instead you need to rely entirely on their preconstructed categories. For some people that might work fine but I found it incredibly frustrating (I can see the calories on my food or on my exercise machine why can't I enter those directly!).

Loved this app a few years ago when it was all free, used it to lose 50lbs! Recently I came back to it as I had gained back a bit, and was horrified to find out that almost all but the most basic features are now unavailable without a paid subscription! I can't even scan my food bar codes anymore! I'll go find a different app to use, they had a very good thing going here and ruined it. Weight loss and health should not be contingent on how much money you have in the bank.

A great app to track anything fitness-related. The greatest functionality is the food log: as easy as weighing the food and scan its barcode; it is also possible to create custom recipes for multi-ingredient foods. It is possible to track calories, macronutrients and their balance. The app keeps suggesting recipes and workouts (together with explanations and videos). Sync with other for apps and wearables; updates your calorie goals depending on your actual activity logged in a given day.

Can't believe they've let everyone use the scanner for so long, now they've stopped it and you have to pay! It literally logged me out, gave me no other option to uninstall and reinstall, then took the scanner option away and now make you pay... Wouldn't mind but it's absolutely shocking how much they're trying to charge £18+ per month... (on what planet?) Really loved this app for the barcode as it's quick, but i'll be getting rid now, I'm going to say a lot of others will too!! Bad move..

I wish it could help with calorie counts for food without bar codes because I have no idea about them. Also, it doesn't have my favorite exercises like TRX suspension training, core bags, kettle bell, battle ropes, stair climbing. Again, I have no idea on how many calories are expended when I do them. Overall, the app is quite helpful. Thank you.

Awful app. Can't log increased weight sets. Every time you try and do anything, it shows up the track food section. I had it for about 4 minutes and sacked it off. Not very user-friendly. Annoying and clunky. I dont want to add 4 different exercises in one section because I increase weights, which is the most basic and standard exercise practice. Waste of time.

Very poor data manipulation abilities, no ability to save an added food as favorite, good luck finding that sweet dish you took hours to login a month ago. Too many useless entries , many foods are either in US or metric units , but not in both , that's too much time on the calculator to convert what I had eaten into pounds instead of grams ... etc. Just give a try to carb manager and try their data organization features and you'll never turn back to this software.

Love it. So easy to navigate and connects to fitbit app! Commiting to using this app daily is the only way I have ever been successful at loosing weight. It motivates me to exercise and it's kinda fun learning new ways to cook healthy. It really puts into perspective what we should and shouldn't be putting in our bodies especially when trying to lose weight. I have tried so many delicious recipes found in the app that I will continue to use regularly. Would 100% reccomend!

This app has the potential to be so helpful, but I find it such a chore! Forever changing the measurement units (WTH is a cup?). I have set macros and calorie intake, but I have to choose 1 or the other as the free app doesn't like my number combination. The latest glitch is that it prefills my breakfast from a random day! This could be so much better than it is.

Although I'm using the free version but it still helps a lot, like with calorie counting management. The exercise part is a bit messy like it don't gives you many options except for the fixed ones. I live in Pakistan so buying this app was very expensive for me. But the way this app also works out for the free version is applaudable. I wish we can get some more asian foods. Including Pakistan, India etc so we can easily manage. Leaving a 4 star for the performance of this app, loving it!

Good but has flaws! Easy to add foods by scanning the barcode, although I'm not sure the figures are so accurate. Really convenient for tracking. Some things just will not add, even though you've scanned the barcode and clicked too add to a meal, they just won't. Sometimes they are added multiple times, so it's a bit of a lottery!

I wanted to test the premium features during the free trial, so I got a yearly subscription and would cancel if I didnt like it - if I did, I'd keep it for a year. For a few weeks now, I've been logged out of the app and then it takes me a while to be able to log back in. Today I had an update, I thought the issues would be solved but still can't see accurate information for macros

Red flags right off the bat. If you cant even see the UI before prompted for payment, that's a red flag. That means the dev's priorities are getting in your wallet before even trying to help you. Don't even get me started on how overpriced this is. 1 month free trial. Monthly - $29.99 Annually - 66% off sale: $114.99. $335.88 regular price. Makes me think the devs are a bit scummy.

Frustratingly bad nowadays! I used to love this app but recently it has been a chore to use. It is so slow and the barcode scanner is awful to use. My Wife has already binned it in favour of another app and I'll be following suit if it doesn't improve.

Better than another app I was using. Got this as a reccomendation from my nutritionist. Like the food selection and the "scan a barcode" feature for accurate food item data. I also like that I can compile food items for quicker single entry (protien shake ingeredients, soup or chile recipe etc) Ads take up too much screen space for my liking. 2+ weeks and still at it.

So I started off loving this app, it honestly helped me understand what exactly I'm doing wrong and the correct portion sizes. That does not help me at all. I refused to upgrade to premium since information from forums so far said that the error will continue. Please find a solution to this.

I used to have this app 3 years ago. Tried it today, lots of usable and useful info. I looked up egg, lots of option but also lots of user inputed foods that are totally inaccurate. Eggs for example, large egg 17 calories... right. Lol plus I went and added 4 eggs to my breakfast and went to remove them. I couldn't figure out it at all. Yea, done and un-installed. Farewell!

App works well for tracking calories. I wish the memory of selected foods was better. I can scroll down the list for ages to select chicken breast which I eat almost every day, yet the food item I had one time three weeks ago is always the first thing on the list.

You should really try to communicate more clearly the fact that you are experiencing some issues with Facebook log-in accounts. But it took three days to find the info that I needed to log in with an e-mail in order for the apps to sync.

Used to be great, happy user for years. Now suddenly very glitchy since the latest update. Searching for foods takes ages if it even loads any results at all. Very weird when it was always working fine before.

FALSE advertising. The app IS NOT free. You get one free month and are then forced into a subscription if you don't unsubscribe before the end of the free trial. Uninstalled without using as I couldn't get past the need to choose a subscription option, which I don't want. Edit:I tried the website, and adding food is complicated. Please make sure notifications actually work, and if you have options, they should do something, and not be ignored completely.

Has helped me tremendously with tracking calories towards various goals. Includes a very wide database of foods as I'm currently in Japan and use the bar code scanner to log food and it work 90 percent of the time. Sometimes the math is off on some of the food items or regarding macros. But usually the errors are small and won't affect your outcome if you're not a pro athlete and are just tracking for 'regular person' goals.

used this app for over 5 years, probably contributed loads in ad revenue over that time. they've decided to implement a £20 MONTHLY fee. During a cost of living crisis. To use the barcode scanner (NOT a new feature - they've just updated it to be behind a paywall now). This is super greedy and has ruined my faith in an app that I was really happy with for a long time. That's one way to crash and burn your customer base mfp, hats off. I'm off looking for another calorie counter. See ya!

This app used to be great until they stripped everything away for a subscription base model. I can't even see the base nutrition on the products I scan besides the calories. No protien, carbs, or fats available. Like how much of a penny pincher do you want to be? Showing ads wasn't enough? The free version of the app does what it needs to do. Count calories, and that's why it gets a 2☆. But the scummy subscription model kills every little modicum of good this app has.

This is more than just a weight loss app. Weight loss or weight gain aside, this is a great tool to take control over unhealthy diet and lifestyle habits. It helps users learn more about nutrition. It can be customised easily to fit individual goals. I have been using it for years and it has always help balance, reevaluate and improve my nutrition and exercise routine. Overall, it is great tool for anyone interested in having balanced nutrition.

I tried this app as yazio doesn't sync very well with garmin. I removed the app after few hours using it because of : 1) interface very confusing and clumsy. Adding a new entry in yazio requires a couple of taps. In my fitness pal is something mental. In particular the add entry is buried into the app instead of being available immediately. 2) food database has wrong data sometimes and the servings are limited. 3) personal food complex to use. 4) premium very expensive considering the issues

I bought the app and I really regret, sometimes I can open the app, it keeps closing automatically. Also, we can create any receipts in grams, and to add a new item new to the app is way complicated. I think for the price they charge you for the full year it should be more simple and have less issues, I wouldn't recommend it.

Moving barcode scanner to premium was simply... Low. I've been using the app for 10 years and this is only complaint I have. It's not practical to have put in information by pieces every single time I try something new, specially because I just moved to another country, so pretty much everything is new. So yeah, having everything be premium can be bad. I, for one, am not using the app I've been faithful to anymore, and that makes me sad.

I have used this app before and it worked for me, i am more aware how much i need to eat and prone to choose the healthier side, although i have also paired with a simple workout and achieved my goals. Then i stopped using and found all the weight i lost. Using it again and so far so good, however im experiencing a lot of errors such as unable to connect to internet and codes are not being read. I guess its a bug or maybe the platform are unable to handle huge amount of users at the same time.

The barcode scanner has virtually eliminated the need to do math. I like having the ability to add my own recipes. The link to Map My Walk makes tracking walks a breeze. The one thing that could make it better is to offer units in pieces as well (if you have a package of cookies, for example, it would be nice to be able to say "one cookie" instead of having to figure out how many grams are in it). But otherwise I have no complaints and for a free app it's really nice

The app was fine, but few of months ago it started showing bugs when entering meals. Now I need to enter 1 item, then the app freezes, I need to close and open it again to enter a 2nd item. Imagine if you haven't entered your lunch & dinner for the day right away and have to open & close the app for 15 items! It's a waste of time & nerves! And don't let me started on the sync issue with my fitness bracelet.The only thing stopping me to find another app is that I will lose my history & progress

The free version is very difficult to use. There is a very small portion in the diary screen that is actually scrollable to see content, the rest is occupied with ads. Even with premium, I can't even create recipes anymore. Lots of bugs and issues with sync as well, on both Android and iOS. Also most of the foods from your database are far from reality when it comes to nutrients. It should be easy enough to have some decent validations e.g. why would a food have 120g fat when it weighs 100g.

The service is great. However, the android app is buggy. Sorting foods by "Most Recent" has been broken for a couple of months, and, very annoyingly, items keep randomly duplicating! I find myself constantly checking my diary throughout the day to make sure I'm not double counting my calories. Like guys, people pay £15 a month. Get some android devs and fix the bugs!

The food side of things has vastly improved since I last used this years ago, but the exercise side of things is not great yet. For example, when Google Fit is connected, the calories burnt from your workouts does not sync properly to your daily diary. It's like MyFitnessPal converts the exercise data based on their own calculations instead of transferring it directly from Google Fit. Also, it doesn't sync all the time either so I have to manually put it in sometimes. A bit annoying.

very often glitches and won't let me create a meal. It's annoying to pay for something that doesn't work 100% of the time. It's when you select an item to add to a meal and change the quantities it doesn't add to the meal for some reason. Then, we are asked to use the Web version when the whole point of paying for a subscription is to have an easy to use app. you can guarantee I won't be renewing, and neither will the 50 odd people apart of my gym.

Regardless of the price, the premium membership has everything you would ever need to bulk up / cut down, The dashboard UI is amazing but the scrolling is laggy. The diary's UI needs a little more work. I'm currently using the free trial, but I do not think that I would buy the membership due to the extremely high price.

5 stars are back! Despite a few days (like a week 1/2) of problems of a loop that made the app unusable, the issue was addressed by app editors making this app amazing again! So thanks a lot for fixing this! . Huge food database, lots of contents available (recipes, training etc..) I use the free version and it's quite complete already but I understand why some people would like to pay to have something event more perfect. I've found this app 3 years ago and still truly recommend it!

This really helped when I started to count calories but now I spend more time shutting down other pages it automatically opens from ads I am not interested in than I finally spend inputting what I have eaten ........ Assuming the food you want is actually correctly listed. Because of this I won't use the other apps that can be linked to it and am considering looking for an alternative if anyone can recommend one. 31/8/2015. Can't believe it's got worse since I last used it but it has !! 5/6/2021

It was ok at the beggining since it gave me a starting point. I'm beggining to use this and right off the bat it doesn't allow to store my recipes or meals-shows an error on their end- but it sends reminders to log your meals. I wouldn't pay the premium version if the free version has so many problems. The workout routine doesn't pair with Fitnotes app which is the one I currenty use (this is not a CONS but it would have been nice to pair) so some time will have to be spent on this.

Keeps me on track and highlights food that is too high in sugar & fat. Without this app, weight creeps on & focus on portion control decreases. I find the app easy to use & I choose treats sensibly! I have all my recipes in the app & wouldn't be without it. Love being able to scan the bar code on food for accurate calorie information. Amazing really, little by little my weight comes off & stays off! Use this app, it will change your view on food & what you actually need to eat :)

The OG of CICO trackers. MFP is the go-to tracker for most of us trying to get a bit more detailed than "eat less, move more" (its true but hardly a step-by-step plan). MFP lets you track weight, measurements, calories, macros, workouts and can sync with most of the common apps for fitness and movement tracking. It's not suited for IF, 5:2, Fast 800 etc unless you get the paid version - having said that, the paid version is definitely worth it if you're serious about your progress tracking.

3 months had passed since the comments I made in the last review. 3 updates since then. The issue with being unable to search and input food that I've been logging for last month is truly infuriating. I have to scan the items barcode all over again and log it every day. The app simply isn't able to provide results during search input for same food items that I've been logging in for last year! Will wait for 1 more update and if not fixed will cancel my premium subscription.

Would a cool idea to implement a feature where when you're searching for a meal say for example lasagne, you can pick one of the recipes presented and have a look at the ingredients list (+ weight) to see if it somewhat resembles your own recipe. I make home-cooked meals often and it is tedious to have to manually add my recipe into the app everytime thus why I don't use the app as often anymore. Also, being able to star/favourite foods in the option list would be beneficial to being consistent.

Great app when it's working, but it's very buggy, there's lots of room for improvement. The Meal section doesn't work for me... when I try to create a meal, it says added, but then there's nothing saved. I've created a lot of workouts, which is handy. I like that you can log them in your diary but hate that it doesn't list which workout you've done... it just says 'workout' and the calories burned. Sometimes workouts don't log. It's a pity you can't track measurements with weigh-ins.

Amazing app, using it to gain weight. Can easily track exactly what i eat by just scanning the barcodes on my food. Gives all the nutritional information i could need. Can easily keep track of my weight. Immediatly by logging my food intake, i could see i had not been eating enough. My weight went up instantly. Still have to do the eating myself, but keeping track makes it a lot easier. It gives you a clear goal every day.

It's great - with its quirks. It does what it says, I can track my food by scanning the barcodes I get Calories, Macros and Micros. It's been mostly accurate to me. And one week in and I am booking results already (I started working out too, never do one or the other) Quirks: 1. it sends data to other apps but can't receive them! So I need to manually put in my exercises. 2. Some foods have odd choices of how big of increment you take. Making you do maths to get it right. Would recommend tho

Huge data base is the main pros of this app. The apps have some bugs that come up while in the middle of making you meal for example, crashing and forcing you to do it all over again. Also I've moved from IPhone to Android and what shocked me that the scanning barcodes and taking pictures of items is hidden behind the paywall while on iPhone I didn't need to pay to use it. And that's truly unfair platform favouritism

The most difficult for me was to find the discipline to count every calorie I consume. Now that I know what my caloriebomb foods are I can minimize those. That helps a great deal and after a couple of months of counting until it felt silly I managed to change my eating habits into a healthier and maintainable routine. The app helped me to be more aware of what I eat, the next step is to keep at it. Not an easy fix, but to me the best tool I have used so far.

This app is pretty good for tracking food, however there are some oversights I don't understand. You can't bookmark foods you find in searches and you can't use your recipes and custom foods as ingredients in new recipes. Its also been having problems communicating with the fitbit app. The fit bit app clearly reflects my step count (~11 000) but MyFitnessPal isn't getting that data from it (says 5 step... ). While the basic app (no subscription) is excellent. It allows you to track your food and calories and exercise well, it does cater just for the American market. If you are just using this app for measuring your food intake then it's excellent. The add-ons don't bother with.

I have just finished a week of using My Fitness Pal and I have found it a real eye opener regarding the number of calories I eat. It has shown me that although I eat the right foods I didn't realise how big the portions were I was serving myself. The barcode scanner is amazing, so easy to use and so interesting listing the items immediately. I recommend this app to anyone thinking of watching their weight, it has certainly helped me immensely.

I used this app since 2013 and very happy with it, as it helps me to balance my nutrition. The Fitbit calories adjustment is the only thing that doesn't work, as the calculation 'fitbit calories minus MFP exercise calories' isn't performed: it reports 0, even when the difference is more than 1300 calories. Given that this app is basically perfect in anything else, while the fitbit app is a much earlier stage of development and is full of flaws, I suspect that it's an issue of fitbit app, which maybe doesn't report my dailiy outwards calories that the fitbit device calculate using my hear rate per minute. With that data, it'd work I guess).

I decided to edit my review because I have found the problem. It was not with the app, it was with my age... I am 17 years old, turning 18 this year in July... İ even created entries in that database of barcodes, so make me pay to use my work and the work of other users like me, no thank you. Bye, see you never again!

This app is great and can be perfect if it can scan the barcodes on the food boxes correctly at all times; it occasionally returns with "no such entry" before I scan the barcode the second time. Beside, was the app updated recently? It keeps on logging out. This happens nearly every day recently even though I have just used it in the previous few hours. This is pretty annoying.

The app is nice and convenient for the most part. A complaint I have is I wish adding a food item through the diary section would automatically add it in the Recipes, Meals & Foods section or vice-versa. It becomes a sort of hassle to add an item (e.g. Onion) in the Diary, but I then would have to add the same item again in R,M&F. Especially when trying to create a new meal. It's like I already entered that... why again? A cross-entry solution would make it more convenient. MFP is good though.

I like how I can track and scan bar codes but this app can be inaccurate with some of the food nutrition when I am unable to scan. It's also weird with nutrition ... for instance I am apparently allowed to have saturated fat but 0 grams of beneficial fats like monounsaturated and polyunsaturated?? Why? This doesn't seem to have correct nutritional suggestions at all. It takes a loooong time to enter foods for the day. edit: app stops working all the time. searches dont work. fix please. -2 stars

After years of using this, I'm switching to MyPlate! It's pretty sad when you take away features from long time users just to try to force us to upgrade to premium. I would have understood if these features (adding foods with basic macros and setting a basic macros goal for example) were never included but now I'm either forced to pay or find a new app and lose all of my history. I'm choosing a new app rather than pay money to a company that does this.

Pretty much hit or miss if this app syncs with google fit. For the past week it's been a complete miss. After I log a meal, 10 mins later, I get a notification to say "you haven't logged your lunch do you want to do it now." or any other meal for that matter, every single time. This bug has been persistent for months. If I hadn't already paid for premium then it would be getting sacked from my phone. Edit. I already reported the non syncing issues. 3 days before this review. No reply yet.

The app has been glitchy lately, which shouldn't be a significant issue given the cost. I recent lost my entire food and meal history for some reason. It's been a bit annoying having to add them back. Also, the "All" tab when adding an existing food or meal doesn't work. I'm having to go to the Food or Meal tab to get the results.

Good app, large database, barcode scanner feature, but has a few annoying technical glitches. It is not possible to specify how often it should synch with a fitness tracking app, which causes my phone battery to drain. Some food information is incorrect or there are duplicated entries. It is not possible to import recipes from a website other than specified in the app. Not possible to send your recipes to a friend connected through the app - they have to copy your whole meal. Many more

Good for tracking your food and that's basically it. Most other features are buggy, broken and inconsistent. Looking up issues like the step counter not working you find posts from years back and it's still not fixed. Logged food vanishing. Constant client sync issues. Double logging. The list goes on. Sadly they have the biggest food database. Which is also seemingly never trimmed of duplicate entries.

The app is great. The only issue I have is the price for premium, $25.99 a month is just crazy! Or they offer a year at I believe $109, a discount from monthly, sure but I'm not sure I'll use it for a year so I'd never buy a year on any app. $25.99 a month is way too steep, I'll never buy premium, if they were to lower monthly to like $9.99 I'd be buying a subscription no problem.

Great idea but an inexcusable number of bugs, that don't seem to get fixed. The latest is that foods added to or copied within the diary keep getting duplicated. Googling I see that this seems to have been a recurring issue. Then in order to report a bug that's almost certainly MFP's, they expect you to go through a rigmarole first, including uninstalling and reinstalling the app, which means losing all your settings and connections. Finally, foods database is plagued by errors and omissions.

many things do not work as they supposed to and if they do, not always. For example, if I log a food and don't use it for sometime, all of a sudden is not logged anymore and I have to redo it. Sometimes editing a recipe is impossible. I would definitely not pay for premium as I find it waste of money. I have been using the app for over 2 years now and honestly I don't see any improvements

I've used this app loads in the past. Took a break for health realted reasons, came back and they've slashed half the features that were free and added them to the paid service. You can no longer scan barcodes on the free version, which makes the app pretty pointless now. You can never get an exact match for calories when manually adding. I think I'm going to uninstall it now and find a new one that doesn't keep taking away the free elements and forcing you to pay.

The actual app is good once it gets past the advertisement. By the way, why should I pay yearly or monthly? What happened to the one-off payment option? The app used to supply more service's, but the developers have removed those services from the free version and placed them behind the paid one (which is a strange and manipulative thing to do). Based on that reason alone, I wouldn't pay for the app. Plus, there are fitness apps out there that offer the same thing at a fraction of the price.

Love using Fitnesspal. I enjoy the different ways in which you can set out plans and goals, and how it helps you workout the breakdown of your foods. It would be good in the recipes section that you can search up a keyword eg.chicken and it brings up all recipes that have it. I like that you can enter recipes and meals etc. Will continue to use.

Super app with great stats and analysis sections on your diet. This changed the way I think about food and I feel so much more aware of what I'm eating and what a sensible target to aim for is. Only reason I dropped a star is that if you spot incorrect nutrition information on a food listing there is no easy way to update it other than submitting a report to the developers and hoping for the best.

Fantastic app to help you keep track of what you're eating. Huge database of foods, found things I didn't expect to find...and the bar code reader is very neat. Have used this in combination with exercise to drop weight in a very short window of time...it's helped me make the tough decision as to whether or not I really need that extra cookie 😀

Sync functionality with the web app and with Samsung Health is TERRIBLE. After opening the app, it takes a couple of minutes for it to arrive at the right number. In the meantime, "exercise calories" will be a random value between 0 and 2x the correct value. Anything logged on the web will be missing too. The app offers widgets too, which are useless, because they only update if you open the app. Close the app too soon (see above) and you'll be stuck on a random number. Good database otherwise.

Updating a previous review, as the app continues to have issues. When I go back over the past few days of entries, it has deleted almost all of my exercise entries that were previously saved. Now everything is inaccurate. I just deleted and reinstalled the app, and again, the exercise information I put in today was gone, but my food entries were still there. I have put in information again, and yet it disappears every time I open the app again.

I tend to prefer the website version of MFP, although the app lets me post photos. But if I get a lot of comments on my posts, I am not able to view them all on the app (only the first few). Also, when I am trying to look through the newsfeed and comment on my friends' posts, I keep being taken back to the top of the page, which is very annoying! I also really wish we could edit our posts and comments (as on Facebook) and reply to individual comments made by friends in response to our posts.

I have used this on an off for years, now at my longest login streak and I find it helps me make more informed and healthier choices. It's hard to ignore the poor nutrition content of foods when it's there in black and white. However, all of a sudden this app won't connect with Endomondo to log my exercise. Endomondo works fine in isolation. MFP won't allow me to disconnect Endomondo and try to start again. Very frustrating. Numerous resets and redownloading of both apps haven't fixed it.

I like it in general. I'd like it if when entering food data there were mandatory fields with units of measurement. if you only knew or preferred one unit, the app should calculate other units. i dont like measuring in oz. and can't estimate oz. for example. The app should present the user with his favoured units. most important is the annoyance every time i open the app i have to confirm my goals and uncheck the boxes about reminders and spam. sometimes twice during one entry. every damn meal!

It is a good app for keeping track of what goes into your body. It helps you realise how many calories are really innthe food you eat. It isn't perfect, there are the few odd mistakes but it is generally about right. I rarely have to edit a food, it is just something to bear in mind. I would however, like it to recognise the 5:2 diet as you are supposed to be limiting your intake for the day. It just thinks you are under eating.

I splurged for premium and it doesn't even work properly. Everything from Samsung Health gets added in about 20x extra, showing I've burned tens of thousands of calories in exercise daily. When I filed a ticket I was just told to "wait it out for it to be fixed in a future release". The steps sync doesn't seem to work either. This is pretty shocking behaviour for an app that costs so much per year. I expect better. Always prompts me to update or buy premium, when I'm up to date and have premium.

Finally upgraded to the paid version. Love it! I dropped the app for a while cause the free version did not count net carbs, when I started Keto. But then the other app I was using did an upgrade and I just couldn't stand the change. Tried fitness pal again and started my free trial of the upgraded version. I've finally broken my stall and have been staying within my Macros almost every day. So happy I gave it a 2nd chance.

It's a good app that I have successfully used for years, but has some annoying bugs that you have to learn to live with. Eg. It often adds a duplicate of a food item you've just added, that you have to delete yourself. Lately and more annoying, its not saving exercises. (Last week it seemed it would only add a single exercise and deleted any additional exercises added. Today it deletes even a single exercise after I've added it! Even after updating the app to the latest version.)

Used this app in 2013 and it helped me lose weight by disciplining my eating. Now in 2021 after a year of pandemic lock down eating I need to lose some weight again. The app food data is more comprehensive. Easier to log food eaten. Link to Map My Fitness gives me calorie credits for exercise done. Fantastic app. The key to success is setting realistic goals, having the discipline to log everything you eat, log everything you do and don't exceed your daily calorie allowance.

Woke up to my phone buzzing at 4:30am this morning - it was MyFitnessPal reminding me to weigh myself.. are you kidding me? Why is this notification prioritised and not a silent notification? Why is it being pushed out at that hour? Final straw. Agree with other reviews on here about the app being less intuitive than it used to be after recent updates, adding foods was quick and easy, the "yesterday's lunch" option was a quick tap but is tucked away behind extra steps now. Used to be great!

I think the app is great as it gives you lots of recipes, you can record all your meals and it calculates each item in calories for you to help keep you on track. It has a scanner so that you can scan the barcode on packets and it works on a traffic light system to show you whether it is a healthy choice. You choose your goals and off you go. You can get a free version, which is what I am using or pay a subscription which gives you extra options.

This app changed my life. Allowed me to have a better understanding of how many calories, fat, sugar and carbs are in my food and to better balance that number. Everything you can imagine is listed in their database. This app helped me lose 50lbs with no exercise. Then went on to lose another 20lbs with excersise and the help of this app. Not going to lie the app is a little glitchy right now I don't know why. But you have to give it a chance, the results speak for themselves.

Just not Working! The exercise and footsteps are no longer syncing with other under armour apps. Can't untick the count footsteps count. I have used these apps for years but have now uninstalled them! Tiresome. 2022 update. Tried this app again. Started out fine but now when adding foods it doesn't take me straight back to the diary (as someone else has said!!) and I now can't save my new recipe so I can't see what I ate and the calories. Come on get it right!!

Another long term ex user of this app. Sad to say it's now unusable. Freezes constantly, lags aggressively after being open for 10+ mins. If you open recipes/plans with view to edit the app is liable to bug out and wipe the data completely. If you're compiling daily plan you have to double check each meal multiple times in the days that follow, because the app now adds multiple versions of the same food items seemingly at random. This has happened for months. It's getting worse, not better..

Good app for tracking calories, exercise, weight etc. Could use some slight improvements. For example, naturally occurring sugars and added sugars are lumped together in one group, and so in a day where I eat slightly more whole fruit and have no other sweet food or drinks I get told I've eaten too much sugar, while I can have another day where I eat chocolate and have a sugary coffee and be fine according to the app. Would also like to see a separate "drinks" section in the diary.

I'd love to give this 5 stars, this app was perfect for me for months until randomly almost a year after using the app my phone data roller over. The next night while my phone was on 4g myfitnesspal used my ENTIRE phone data in 7 hours, it wasn't even open. I got overcharged for the data use too. Contacted mfp and was told they will look into it, but I won't hear from them unless something changes ( this was a month ago). After a quick Google it seems that this has happened to many people before

My doctor recommended the app, after one week in and I'm down 1.5 lbs, it's great for tracking each meal and then there is a daily total. It connects to my Garmin so my workouts automatically load and the calories available get clearly adjusted. It's really a great app even if you're not trying to lose weight, you can clearly see how your decisions add up for fats, sodium, sugars. Also has a separate water tracker. I'm loving it!

Not sure what happened, but the app has been incredibly slow in recent weeks. It also stops working at least a few times a day, takes forever to load any data, freezes for 1+ min at a time... it's also seemingly getting progressively worse to the point where it's becoming unusable and I had to write this review to moan about it. I used to love it...

Really enjoying tracking my protein/calories/general nutrition, but I have noticed some of the nutritional values are incorrect. For instance, if I have an egg, I have to be careful I add one with the complete breakdown of vitamins, etc as some miss out polyunsaturated and monounsaturated fats. Arla Protein yogurts contain calcium but some of the options don't mention any calcium at all. I've noticed this sort of problem with quite a few items, but other than this, I'm happy with the app. 👍

Why is premium so expensive. Come on its good service but not $100+ good. Naaa. Not when there's like a million variations of the same food and even the foods they tick green are often still not accurate. Get a team that'll review the details and remove wrong duplicates. Certainly not when the exercises are so glitchy. I open the app, my Samsung health steps and exercise calories show up one minute, next minute it's gone and deducted from my day's data, Weird.

Too expensive! I used to pay for premium, so I could track my macros, that was £35 a year, which is still expensive, but now it's shot up to £65 a year or £15.99 a month! This app is useless to me without the premium features, and I would be happy to pay if they were more reasonable with fees. Who can afford this these days with cost of living so high. I'll be looking for an alternative calorie/macro tracking app

Subscribed to the premium version of MFP nutritional breakdown (fat, protein and carbohydrates) of what I eat. Like the bar code scanner and it is rarely stumped. Entering a recipe is a little time consuming, but worth it for the things you eat daily. Was a little disappointed that my Samsung Galaxy watch won't connect directly to the app, however you can bridge it through Samsung Health. Have had a occasional issues with exercise not updating to MFP

Very goog app. The only thing I don't like is that you cannot see the macro together with the daily calories total(you have to go to a separate page for it). Also, I find it annoying that I cannot copy the meal I select from "x" day to the position I want in "y"day. It will automatically copy the meal in an empty position (dinner for example) and then I have to singularly move each food from dinner to lunch position. A functionality more like "copy&paste" PC style woul be much more handy.

Look up nutritional info for pretty much any food - and that's relatively easy to do too. Have to drop one star for a few reasons. The measures are inconsistent from "per cup", "oz", "gms", "serving" and there's a fair bit of mental math to convert to "gms", in my case. I'm pretty certain this conversion could be done for you quite easily. It would make calorie-counting hassle free. When syncing exercise info from Google fit, calories expended are mostly always wrong and you have to correct it

Nice app but there's some issues with usability: * You cannot add exercises that are not on the list * When logging repeating meals you can only choose the meals from yesterday same time. I would like to be able to choose repeated meals from other days and times. * The app could add a meal plan section where you add the meals or items recommended by you nutrition coach * When adding food the serving sizes can be confusing. I would like to see more human serving size like 1 cup, 1 spoon...

In a previous review, my only negative was a lack of proper calorie burn tracking. Since then, it's gotten slightly better at tracking workouts (still not good, but better). However, they've since walled off simple protein and carb tracking (macros) behind their paywall. I understand adding features for money, but any free app will do simple addition for you. Your built in calculator app will do that. I can't support this app until basic features are free, and added ones are what you pay for.

I use this app all the time and it's good but am getting fed up that play store keeps launching when I'm trying to use it. Please please stop this !! I would willingly pay for an ad free version!! One of the only apps that I would. Having said that the database of foods I great and the ability to put your own recipes in is great. Would like an option to share a recipe with friends. 2019 Great that I can now have a ad free experience. Still love this app.

Fantastic. It's easy and motivating. Searching foods and adding them to my daily journal makes keeping track of what I eat simple. My absolute favorite feature of the app is that once I'm done eating for the day and complete my entries the app gives me an estimated weight in 5 weeks based on my calorie intake, calories burned from exercise and current weight. It's so motivating to see that number keep dropping. It makes it easy to stay on track. It's free, just get it!

I really liked this app, ok there's parts that I couldn't access on the free part, but now they've taken away the barcode part to non paying members. Which is absolutely crazy, because now people who can't afford to pay for the app have no other choice to either pay, which isn't an option for some people, or try to use another app, and they don't compare to this app. They have just made it a lot harder for people trying to better themselves by loosing weight and getting in shape

I've used this app on and off for over four years, always had a great experience with it - went from 88kg to 63kg. Something that still bothers me however, is that any drink other than water has to be logged as breakfast/lunch/dinner or a snack, and I feel like having to do this gives a skewered perspective of the areas you should be paying attention to. Also, dessert isn't always bad (I have dozens of healthy dessert recipes) so why is there no dessert section? These updates would be perfect 5*

Since yesterday I'm having trouble with the app: some food is not found due to "network problems" (wifi is fine though), if I try "complete diary" option I get "problems with sending my request to the server" and so on. App is ok, but does not offer what I was looking for .. Tried to find a way of reversing the payment when I had connectivity again but have so far been unable to :( £40 I could have done without spending at this time of year too !!

I used to use this app frequently as it made me more conscious of my snacking habits and helped me better understand where I was getting empty calories from, and helped me get on track with nourishing myself properly. I've just started it again after upgrading my phone, and the ability to scan the barcode on foods is now being gatekept behind the premium subscription? This is really disappointing as I want to add things to my food diary quickly on the go, likely won't be using this anymore. :(

This app does a good job letting you track calories, but you might want to be cautious. A lot of entries in the app are straight up wrong. The notifications are also really annoying. The app will tell you you haven't logged something, even when you did. Some insights are locked behind a paywall. In the current state, the free version of the app leaves too much to be desired to even consider paying for the premium version.

No calorie counter app needs that many permissions, and this much unmonitored access to personal data, just to tell me how many carbs/calories/sodium is in a banana. EDIT: I have now re-installed this app, in the hopes that it has gotten better.....NOPE! Now, every page takes you to a page that demands a $30/month subscription to continue to use features that used to be included. Also, all of the help articles were completely empty. Titles only, and thumbs up/down for if it was helpful...NOT!!

So far, I find this app very helpful. There is a variety of foods added to its database and you can easily search via the bar code scan option. You can also add exercises so that it can be more personalised. What I dislike, however, is that no matter what kind of fruits you eat, the app considers the sugar intake above your daily goal. It's as if you are eating candy - the app does not distinguish between good sugar and bad sugar.

Your recent update letting me add a food to my calorie counter and quick add commonly paired foods makes tracking SO much easier. I love that it reminds me to log if I haven't yet for meals. I like if I find a recipe on Google I can add it online in just a few clicks and not have to add everything in manually. I love the ability to be paired with other apps like Fitbit so it can track calories lost through daily walking. I also like how if I eat takeout I can find it in the app.

I love this app, I'm cutrently still using the free version. It's very easy to log food and exercise one you get used to it. I enjoy saving my own recipes, makes logging meals much easier. If I want to shift a few pounds or a few stone it's very easy to pick up and get into. I have used a couple of recipes from the blog too which were nice.

Firstly, too many ads. It just covers everywhere, and subscription is so expensive. Secondly, every time when I log a meal, which includes several meal items, some of meal items are duplicated automatically. So I need to check the log again everytime after logging something to delete those duplicated items. I use this app only for integrating with Garmin connect. I wish I could have other options.

This app used to be great. Downloaded it again and it constantly takes me through the same three pages. 'Update your goals, do you want emails? and sign up to premium'. I have to go through these pages every time I open the app and it redirects me from adding items into my food diary. It also happens multiple times in a row.

I've used this app for many years and loved it. Was very easy to track my meals and scan all my food. I was on the premium subscription and found all very useful, however I can't justify the new price of the monthly subscription or even the heavily discount annual price. Why such a jump in price? I feel like you should honor all current subscription price for those who are on a subscription and use the new price for new members.

I have used my fitness pal for a few years off and on and loved it, this time I can honestly say it's a complete joke!!!!. You cant even enter into your diary without the try premium popping up at least 3 times before you can enter anything, it's frustrating and annoying to say the least. A great app now destroyed by advertising, sorry to say; but app will be deleted and never thought of again, sure I will find another calorie counting app that wont bombard me.

Lately ive been having some bugs i guess. Whenever i enter the app, "non alcoholic cocktails" keeps popping up my screen. Then i go back to the main menu cause obviously i wanna log my weight.
