They reached me and with the help of their team the problem has been solved. Thank you for your effort!

I've used this app for many many years - I even remember emailing them to ask them macronutrient breakdow before it was added to the app! I'm sadly uninstalling it because they recently decided to start charging for a feature which has been free for many years: the barcode scanner. This was my main method for adding calories - I consider it to be an essential feature. I don't think it's right to make calorie counting and healthy living more difficult for people who can't afford to pay.

You can't scan barcodes without paying now? You've just killed your app, congratulations. Edit - just seen it's not intentional. Fair enough, I've installed a different app now though. Sure a lot of users have done the same. Further edit: Just reinstalled after all this time, still can't scan. So, the app is useless. I'm not paying monthly to scan items

Its OK as a free app, tracking calories, water intake and exercise. When you pay for the premium £40 per year its brilliant. You can track macros, follow plans which sounds gimmicky, but with daily small tasks to follow you dont feel overwhelmed. It could do with being a bit more user friendly. Some of the measurements for the food are unusaul set sizes and dont allow you to add custom ones. If you are serious about losing weight, gaining muscle or improving overall fitness I would recommend.

I've been using this app since 2013, it always works with losing weight as it counts calories and let's you lose the most comfortable weight for you. There is plentiful of foods already added, so easy to use, just don't forget to log in your daily food. Love the exercise calorie count, and also enjoy seeing the end results, slow or fast. Thanks again!!!

Worst app !! Was doing really well for first week or so, but I thought I'd leave it a couple more weeks before I left a review incase it started to mess up.. lucky I did !! Been trying to open the app and doesn't work. I deleted and reinstalled and used a different email to sign up and it worked fine !! I think they're just trying to push customers to pay for premium!! And when they don't, they don't allow access to the app. Terrible !! Avoid at all costs !!!

I find that logging in food gives me some accountability for the food I take. I tend to choose food wisely while not restricting or overindulge. The thing I'm not liking that much is having to second guess the calories for some food. Without proper verification, the same food with the same amount may have very different calories. Apart from that, everything else is great.

This app has been life-changing to my weight loss plan!!! It has absolutely every kind of food possible available when filling in the diary. I have created my own recipes by weighing each ingredient and inputting the data into the app and it calculates the calories, protein content and more per meal, making it easier for me to make healthier choices. Every week I input my weight after my weigh in and can keep track of the progress I am making... I don't know how I managed without this app!!!

What's happened? 😭 I have used and loved this app for nearly a year but recently not so much. It's lagging all the time, freezing mid entry, forcing the app close, forcing my phone to restart. I updated the app to see if that solved it but I've found its doing those things even more now (pretty much every time I use it) I've lost nearly 90lbs using mfp so far and I'd love to finish my journey with it but if this carries on I'll be forced to find another app.

My colleague recommended this app to me when I told him I wanted to lose weight. I'm using the free version as I don't need the time option. Ads are very minimal and not intrusive at all. Kudos to the developers. My only problem is that even though i have input my lunch/dinner, the app sends me a notification saying that I have not done so.

Good calorie counter! No unnecesaary extras, no annoying ads. Also has a vast selection of foods to log and a good bar code reader. might consider going premium, but honestly, there isn't much I am lacking so far. I would like it to be compatible with more step counter apps and it's annoying how you cannot log the details of your strength workout at this point, but oh well

MyFitnessPal has been an extremely helpful app. It has helped keep me mindful and accountable to my goals. In the free version you can still see your macros so it helps you keep an eye on your counts. The app is easy and user-friendly. It's easy to scan foods into your diary or create recipes to add into your food diary. Personally I think I'll end up investing in the premium version in the future. I love when I complete the daily diary and it tells me where I'll be in 5 weeks!

I used to live by this app when I first started using it years ago. Sadly however, like most companies good things never last. Now the features I used the most (that were free to use back in the day) are now locked behind a premium subscription. I was okay with ads, but charging as much as they do for things I used for free ( with ads) all the way until about 6 months ago, is not acceptable. Sadly I will not be using this anymore as it's no longer worth it to me. We have enough bills to pay.

Used to love it but after years of users inputting data to make the system better the new owners have decided to try and eek out as much profit as possible by putting "barcode scan" behind a paid subscription where a prompt pops up every few minutes suggesting you go premium. I've deleted my account and won't be back. There are other calorie trackers out there people.

Previously I had a way better experience with MFP and would have opted for a higher rating, but in the past few weeks I have been battling. I cannot connect through Garmin, which I've been able to do for years, I am constantly prompted to re-enter my password, and the app constantly crashes. Can someone please explain to me how this app went from hero to inferio!!

So far so good. Finding the correct food can be a bit of a pain of you don't have a barcode but... Give it a bit of basic info and it will give you a calorie "budget" and there are plenty of options to at least give you an estimate for the calories you have consumed. It also communicates fairly well with FitBit although only pulls basic exercise info from there.

First time using this and do not like it. You can't change weights to grams for food logging. We can't even put weights in for some items. Not all apples or peaches weigh the same. The app is just too confusing. No matter how many times I've tried I cannot get it to pair with google fit to log my steps. Plus I can't log any physical activities like housework or gardening. Those use calories too! After a few recommendations its just not for me so I'm uninstalling and going back to Noom.

What is going on with this app? I've used MyFitnessPal for years and years. It's always had this annoying problem where sometimes the changes you make don't sync properly to the server, and so you get foods in your diary disappearing or being added multiple times. It's always been an occasional annoyance. But now it's happening constantly! Every time I open it up it's forgotten half of what I programmed in or it's added something 5 times for no reason. Why am I paying for this?

I downloaded it on a whim a few years ago. since then, it has helped me drop thirty pounds and keep off twenty three consistantly (146 to 116). It takes out the guesswork--honestly, I was amazed how easy it was just using logic and math. Maybe its not for everyone, but it sure worked for me, and Ive never managed to lose a pound in my life until I downloaded a damn app.

I used MyFitnessPal for about a year and was satisfied with the calorie tracking and the way it integrated with my fitness apps to calculate my calorie needs. After a while I found the recipes very limited and felt like I had my diet figured out, so I stopped using it. Recently, I started a new training program and wanted to make sure I was eating enough to keep up, so I installed the app again. Now it won't connect with my fitness apps (Garmin and Strava), which makes it kind of useless.

I used to love this app. It helped me lose 125 lbs in the past. Now, I was stupid enough to buy the year of premium, after getting screwed over by the app a few months ago. A few months ago I stopped being able to log my diary for the day, the app is slow loading, my Garmin won't connect & it has other issues. I canceled the monthly payments. I re-downloaded the app a few weeks ago. Because the free worked for me again. Doesn't work now that I paid for premium & it won't refund when I cancel.

I just want to enter the food type and amount in weight. Instead you have to endlessly scroll through entries of "1 piece" or "1 serving" and 15 types of atlantic salmon. There should be a global metric / imperial setting so you don't have to view units of measurement that aren't on the packaging. Very slow, lags when updating recipes, slow to update exercise. This app has been out for a long time, I just thought it would be more innovative by now.

Was great, now not opening. I've sent you an email hoping this can be resolved ASAP as I use it every day. Issue now resolved by uninstalling and clearing cache as recommended by developer. The logging of foods would be easier if they could be copied over for several days. Everyone has a pattern for eating, so it's a pain putting something you eat every day into the app. If there's an option of putting something for every day that would help.

It is a great app to track your calories. The app offers a premium option with a free 30day trial. I would give 5 stars if they were clear what the charge is after 30 days. I searched FAQ'S and the terms and can find no references to the monthly fee. Guess they are hoping people take advantage of the 30days and don't remember to look at it again. Would also be helpful if you could use decimal places on items consumed. E.g half a tomato or half of any serve.

I've been using this app consistently for almost the past two years and I can no longer put up with how much the user experience has deteriorated. I don't ask for much, I just want to be able to log my meals and jave the ability to adjust my calorie goals. But now this app won't even let me do that. Going to have to abandon my 700+ day streak and find an app that actually works better, which should be quite easy.

On the whole I find this a useful app, but on creating a recipe it never selects the right ingredient. I don't want 1 kg of chilli powder in a dish! Recently I found the fat quantity wrong in a recipe, edited the ingredient in the recipe and saved it, only to find it reverted to the wrong item. Edited again and still it reverted to the wrong amount - 5ml of a 'light' oil does not have 44g of fat! Getting rather tired of constant errors in products.

Holy, I thought things would improve after UA sold to this newer company but somehow it's gotten worse. Didn't think it was possible. Days worth of food entries don't sync with the MFP database so you lose everything including exercise and timestamps and recipes. Currently looking for a better app to pay my nearly 100$ a year to but pretty sure I'll just end up back with MFP because I've been using them for 12 years. How frustrating.

App gets worse with time. There's almost nothing left that they can lock behind a pay wall. You used to get free scans per month for any foods that have nebulous entries in their database, but that's gone. Manual entries? Nowhere to be found. You can quick add, but the macros are locked down to premium. Great... A genuinely miserable app to use. Navigating it is inconvenient - much like the rest of the experience. Maybe next update they'll lock the metric system to premium. Who knows...

Incredible app. Calorie counting through this app has totally changed how I see my meals, is not invasive into my life, and is extremely easy to use. If you are consistent and follow the app, it will change your diet and help guide your eating habits in the right direction. The free version of the app is fantastic, and there are few ads. The paid version is even better, and well worth the money.

Update July 2019, still using this app, it's good for adding exercise & compatable with the step counter on my phone automatically adding in exercise. 2017 review - Use this App for tracking calories, it has loads of food on it, including UK supermarkets. Haven't found anything missing yet, even able to add homemade stuff easily. Easy to use & able to add exercise done. Great for adding a target weight to reach.

Glitches when logging food items. Sometimes when trying to log an item, it doesn't show up on the logged screen. So you try logging it a couple more times until it shows up, only to realise later that you ended up logging that item multiple times. This has been happening much more frequently lately. Also, the app is incredibly slow to startup.

Been using this app for a long time but recently keep having issues. I get signed out at least twice a day and when I log back in, it's lost the data I've put in and then sometimes it comes back so things are doubled. It's has also lost my weight and measurements. I also can't use the bar code function anymore, it just comes up with the get premium options. it's becoming unusable for me.

Pricey for an app that doesn't work all the time. Trying to add stuff and there's a connection error as per usual..... I'm on a IIFYM lifestyle so it's a great to track. However, I'm extremely pissed that I had to go premium when I wanted to only adjust my macros by the gram. I dont need all the other fancy stuff about workouts. I know how to train, thanks. Before this was a paid app I was one of many users that helped scan in many items into the database before UnderArmor took over.

Used this for years. Lowering from 5 stars to 4. Barcode scanner was the difference between using your application or that of a competitor. The change made it easy to start shopping around. I'm sure this is still good but to put behind a pay wall and charge the price of a gym membership is a non-starter. Thank you for your latest response. I may be in touch. scanner is the make or break it as is for a number of others it apears.

The app is okay. The database is large which is nice, but there's a lot of features out there that are free, including entering your own meals, by weight, and getting proper servings. For example Carb Manager does this all for free. Their database isn't as large, but definitely more beneficial to tracking what you're eating then this app. If this was a paid option for this app, I would pay for the app just for the database alone.

Despite all of the AI generated 5-Star reviews they are currently using this greedy company has NOT returned barcode scanning to the free features. My fitness pal used to be an excellent app for people to become healthier, now they clearly don't care for anything except money. The entire app is useless unless you're willing to pay AU$32/month. Disgraceful. And yes, I do refuse to believe that for over 10 years you were able to have barcode scanning for free but now suddenly it's too much. Bsffr.

Great app that I've used on and off for years. Easy to navigate, accurate and useful diet tools which help you keep track of your diet, nutrition and exercise, as well as connecting you with other users to keep you motivated. Also includes recipes and macro tracking if you choose the premium subscription. Would recommend as the best diet/ exercise/ nutrition app around

This app allows me to keep track of what I eat and it has made n big positive difference to my life. I have lost some weight, feel healthier and have way more energy. What i found surprising is the fast amount of food in the data base. I find items preloaded 99% of the time even if it is items local to my country. good stuff. I should do some effort to explore the app more because i think i am only using 50% of its true potensial

I really needed some help and motivation with diet and exercise and this app has set me on the right path. It's really easy to use and I can easily keep a log of everything - which I do plus add any notes. I've never had any faults with it. I'm only 2 weeks in, but I've lost 4lbs already so I'm really pleased with that. This app is great - I highly recommend it.

I've been using this app for years. Was perfectly serviceable and I liked the large databases of food items. Today, the new updated UI is awful and unnecessary, it takes twice as long to add my items then it did before, and somehow it shows less key information at once. Pair the above that with the high yearly cost plus the database of food items seemly becoming less accurate over time and it's grounds to switch. I'll be switching to another tracker once this subscription runs out.

To people who are new to the app PLEASE make sure to check you settings before doing the free trial. Mine automatically charged me £40 for the 1 year premium without any consent! Disgustingly they didn't even give me a refund and trust me...it is really not worth the £40. There are very little changes to the free version. Although the app itself is good at acting like a diary of what food you have throughout the day, I'm still immensely disappointed with their response regarding my charge refund

I only have the app, I dont pay for the premium package but it is still really useful. I am just trying to get back on a healthier eating lifestyle . (Fell off the wagon a bit )!!! I've been reading up on macros etc. The app will count them for you as you add your daily foods. It will also scan the barcodes and give you the info. then you can just adjust quantities if necessary. Then you can build up a list for future reference. Works well for my needs. You can also pair it, eg. to a fitbit.

Was ok, now it doesn't open anymore. The database is mostly wrong - the calories are much too low. It's better to write the recipes yourself. I will change the review once the app starts working again. Edit: works again :) but still needs some TLC, sometimes the recipes don't save, or an entry doesn't show up.

Hard to use. My nutritional values are all incorrect because this app doesn't let me input the information manually. I'm forced to select something from a list, but it never has the exact nutritional values and grams I need!!!! I always end up with wrong values where it looks like I've eaten more or less than required. I'm not a paying user but, believe me, this is not how you convince a customer to purchase a subscription. Not appealing at all.

I was using this app exclusively for several months, and aside from the American bias in weights and measures, it was excellent Sadly, the app is not working properly now ... I can't save recipes etc, which for me is a deal-breaker... I need to use my own recipes due to the way I eat, and the aforementioned American bias... I need them in proper measurements! You need to fix this, ASAP.

DB is huge; and I love that I can input whatever is not in the DB. Barcode scanner is a wonderful time saver. One thing that would make it better: reminders to drink water; and/or, ability to connect to a water intake tracking app. One actual problem is that whenever I input a glass of water, it subtracts it a few seconds later; which makes it quite difficult to track actual water consumption

I have been using this app for about 6 years now. Used to be good but not anymore. Syncing between app and servers goes down every couple days and it's down for up to two days at a time. This has been going on for months now. Also scrolling your feed it will randomly scroll you back to the top, making it impossible to read your friend updates. Good food and barcode database but the servers going down all the time is enough to make me want to switch to another app. Not worth the effort anymore.

Enjoy using it very much. It's a great way to keep track of your consumption and make headway. Educate yourself to log accurately though, many inaccurate items logged by other users. Often no official "green badge" items to choose from, but that can be worked around. It is a great companion to sustained better health if, you have a knowledge of nutrition and your own body needs.

I was using this app last year for the fact that you could scan food as you went and track your meals so easily but now I've downloaded it in my new device, you have to pay for premium to be able to do this. It's disgusting that everyone is jumping on this inflation malarkey and making a profit from people when they are also trying to balance real-life problems as well as staying healthy!

this app has helped me lose 7kgs in 5 months. the only things I dislike is u cant change the weight or amount of the portion. It doesn't always say how big a portion is. it says a "tray" or a "portion" but not the weight of what that item is. It would be the best if we could also choose to put the weight in, especially if we only had a quarter of a portion.

If it ain't broke, don't fix it! I don't know about this so called new and improved look. It took my god knows how many attempts to get logged in. I changed my password, entered new password, tried to log in with said new password and it said they're was an error. I changed it again 3 times (to the same password) and it allowed me to log in. Then I tried adding food. I could search for what I'd had for breakfast but when the search function found what I'd eaten, there was no way to add it.

Please make it easier to see what items you have inputed into your diary whilst adding food!! Before the recent update, on multi-add option, the checked box would show so you could see you'd added a food whilst you put others in. Now once you have pressed to add it all looks exactly the same. When I'm adding a number of items all at once I'm forgetting what I've added and doubling up or forgetting to add it at all. Please can we have a tick or something to show we've selected that food????

MFP used to be good, it's not so much anymore. They took away the news feed and now keeping in touch and tracking what your friends are up to is so much harder. That was one of the USPs of MFP. The barcode scanner repeatedly comes up with the wrong food, or the nutritional information is inaccurate at best. Sometimes it beeps and nothing shows up. Sadly MFP is not worth paying extra for Premium anymore.

Macros calculation is buggy, it doesn't properly take into account decimals. Theres also other bugs here and there, for example I'm unable to enter meal items. I search for the item and it says food logged or whatever and it just doesn't add to the list. UX is kind of thrash. You only have like 3 meal options to log your food items under. Navigation sucks. Food entering form sucks, its annoying to use.

Pretty straightforward calorie and exercise logger. There's a barcode scan option for foods and snacks, so you know what you're actually getting. Integrates with health tracking apps too, so if you've got a fitbit you're good to go. You don't really need the premium subscription unless you're really obsessed with your health. The base package is enough for most things.

so disappointed with the constant requirement to log in, every couple of days. It is ridiculous. I keep mistypinf the password, as there is no option to see what you have typed. The voice dictate and photo of your plate don't help much, you still need to estimate portion size which determines calories and the AI takes longer than typing in the foods yourself. I will look for a better app to help me in my weight-loss journey. save your money.

This App has gone down the toilet! I have had it for many many years, corrected many wrongly input foods & recommended the app to many people but I won't be doing ever again. I returned to using the app to find a pay wall for the previously free barcode scanner & not only do you have to pay you have to pay alot! $29.99 a month! I don't want or need all your other bullocks you bundle into your extortionate premium package, you don't even offer a lower tiers & the amount of ads is obnoxious.

amazing app. takes a few days to get the hang of it, but once you start its really easy to use. I upgraded but it's not necessary. just helped me with my macros a bit more. I find it easy to log new products, create meals for items you eat regularly and the list of your items also is a great help. I would throughly recommend to anyone who wants to track their calories and macros to help them with weight management.

Good app but its stupid that they force you to put a calorie goal in. What if you just want to track how many calories you consume? My "goal" changes every day depending on my activity, now I must manually change it every day in the app instead of just looking at calories in and out on Garmin, because if I don't then "calories remaining" in this app is wrong. Just give us the option to track the calories without setting a goal amount.

Good app for food diary. Flexible as it contains most foods. Better if it could help user estimate quantity of food instead of stating only in grams or oz. Adding foods was not as smooth and there appeared to be too much going on one page. Also, before I decide to go premium, it does not tell me the price but compels me to sign up for trial period. Just give me the price and I will decide. Please don't make me jump through hoops. Overall I would recommend this app to others for the analytics.

Perfect app if you're truly looking to lose weight or even maintain your current weight. MFP has a Hugeeee selection of foods that can be logged so if you're logging foods and not using MFP are you doing it right? Probably not. Hands down best app out there! only downfall is the app can sometimes be laggy which is why I gave it 4 stars instead of 5

Been using this app for years, and have no complaints. The free version gives you all the basic options to effectively log your calories. As an everyday user, I've never needed to go premium but if you're a more regimented person who wants to go into further specifics, the premium option is always there. I also like that it syncs with Samsung health.

Review update: back using it after 4 years. It keeps crashing recently so quite annoying. Three evenings in a row where ive not been able to log a saoo wont load. Amount of products has increased. More users around the world means more product base. If only MFP had verified lists. Review 2014 It's a pretty good app.Makes it easier to keep track of what you're eating etc.if you were really counting on this for exact calories consumed and burnt it's not accurate as everything is updated by users.

The new update is super slow & can't scan any food. I find it really unfortunate that the app I've been using for so many years has changed hands and now became little bit greedy, at least this is what it looks like. I was okay with all the in-app ads. And I would not mind paying for premium membership. But ~$30 per month is lil too expensive for most people including me. So I guess it's time to say goodbye to MyFitnessPal, app I used to use and love for so many years, and suggested 2 others

Mostly it's ok, as a calorie and meal tracking app, there are others that are better in the free version like Carb Manager, which gives you more detail on individual macros. MFP is also really bad at getting your exercise data from Garmin, today I did over 22000 steps but MyFitnessPal has only recorded 192 steps! It consistently under-records steps by a large factor every day, and I don't have time to put it in manually. Sometimes I can't save meals either. Otherwise it's just ok.

Started the free version at the start of my weight loss journey 3 weeks ago. I love this app. It's so easy to use with having the barcode scanner function which literally means you can track everything you eat. I cook alot of home made food and found it so easy to add my ingredients to create a recipe which I can then log. It automatically saves your most commonly used items to your favourites too. I have lost 3.3kg and will upgrade to premium. Awesome app and encouraging for weight loss.

Amazing app. It simply works, as long as you stick to it. Update 2020: They added the feature "Workout Routines" to estimate calories burnt through resistance training. Just another brilliant addition to this app. Biggest flaw wrt the app: a lot of the nutritional values shared by the community have errors in them, some major. I've resorted to create my own personal database of food items (@ ~1500 now) which is reliable and of which %rdas are updated to the latest recommendations.

It has been a wonderful app, but I don't like the latest update and feel sad that I updated the app. I can't see the completed activities/log in recent few days in the new dashboard. The new dashboard is not user-friendly to scroll too. And I don't like it showing the meal calories only after I input all foods for the meal in the diary tap. Somehow I don't know if I have saved particular item for one meal. You can only view it when you save all.

It used to run fast but new versions are much slower, specially in older phones. They also suddenly decided to stop supporting my Android version so I was not able to use it for months until i bought a new phone. I am still using it only because of the amount of data and recipes i have stored here, but the app is not the best option if you are just starting

Generally quite happy with it, but new changes made it backwards to the good it was. I use the weight chart to track my weight since 2017. The recent change cause new entries to always now appear at the bottom of the list of data instead of the latest starting at the top. And it does not matter if you are looking at a chart for 1 or 3 months, the weight data always starts on 2017 showing ALL ENTRIES! I hope they correct this quickly (easy fix).

It's good with counting calories and all but it's been acting weird and logging me out and telling me that my email or password are invalid. So I haven't been able to use the app. I've just been able to log in through the website. ... update!! I now have been able to log back in but now a new problem appeared. The app is not connecting to the Samsung Health, therefore it's not counting my steps and exercises

Very difficult to use if you use metric measurements. Almost everything is in cups/oz/lb, if there is g, then few times the regular 100g that has printed info on the package. If you try to create a new food, it asks for serving size, we do not usually have that info on our products, how should I know. When calculating how many in one container you end up getting the whole container as serving size. I'm frustrated with this app! Easier to just write down in cal what you eat!

Functionwise the app is great. Plenty of useful features. The weakness is in the database of foods. This can be rather inaccurate and therefore misleading (especially those foods not vetted by the app). I logged in "raw spinach" and got a "high in saturated fats" warning. Really? Also, it would be nice if all food quantities would be convertible to ounces or grams. Chicken leg "1 piece" or "1 bowl" that's not saying much. Once the database gets cleaned up, I would rate it a 5 star. Easily.

I mean they used the barcode for free feature until they got data from people then turned around and made it premium only. These guys aren't good people. The problem is not that they charge for scanning, the problem is that it used to be free, then once they had the barcode database built up by users (not their Devs), they then pulled the switcheroo and made it a paid only feature. 0/10. Cronometer is an alternative which doesn't charge people for a feature based on the user-built database FYI.

I'm back, and I see the barcode scanner is back for free users? What I don't get with these food apps, fitness apps, etc, is how expensive they are... so £15.99 per month! For a few premium features. As a PC gamer, I can subscribe to an entire game such as World of Warcraft for £9.99 per month... so I do t understand how a simple app alone can have the cheek to charge so much. If it was £1 a month, sure, I'd sub, and I guess, millions of people would too. But no way am I paying for this app.

Really useful for food tracking, recently I've started using it a little deeper and getting better results. I dont use the app for weight loss but to track my macros. As a PT I recommend this app to my clients along with a few fitness apps, this helps them to understand how nutrition fits in with their training programs. The food data bank is much improved & I can simply scan foods from anywhere I happen to be.

I have mixed feelings for this app. The features are OK and the tracking. However, too many bugs. The calorie goal seem to be off, giving me +300 of any other app and website with the same info. Moreover, the steps passed by my garmin are translated to random number of calories extra. For instance, this morning 107 steps were translating to 1000 extra calories! Trying to report the error is also a nightmare. It opens a web form inside the app, then when attaching a file the form reloads.

I use it to calorie count, it's a bit fiddly and time consuming at first while you search each ingredient, but the app remembers things you use often and so becomes much easier after a few days, you can upload recipes from the internet as well, but don't forget to check/modify the ingredients list once uploaded as often it will get the calories wrong. If calorie counting is your preferred way to lose weight then this is the best app, I've lost a stone so far.

I've literally been using the app to help track calories for a long time now. But last night, I was logged out automatically, just to be told that my credentials do not exist, even though I had been using the app for years. This morning. I tried signing in again, and it created a brand new account for my SAME details. And now I find I can no longer scan the barcodes of my food because that feature has now been included in the premium plan. I will never use this app again, deleted.

Great app but sometimes a bit wonky in that it'll send me a notification that I haven't yet made a specific meal entry, but it had already been done. Perhaps there's a bug in the timer program for the app? Other than that, I'm very happy with the operation of this app; I especially like that the foods are found by brand name so it makes tracking your progress quick and easy. Great job!

App adds food to your diary without you selecting it and unless you check it often, you could really mess up your macros without even knowing it! HUGE glitch! I delete food and then minutes or even hours later I go to log something else and see the item I deleted is back, or worse it is in there twice!!! It's been like this for months and hasn't been fixed. Don't waste your money on the premium side of this app as you will be having these errors happen several times every day. Very annoying!!

I really enjoy myfitnesspal, it is really good for me to make sure I am eating enough and keeping a track of my macros. There are the odd occasion when food items are difficult to locate or find the rightoptino but majority of the time I don't have an issue. The barcode reader helps a lot and once items are inputted they are easy to find again. The only thing that takes longer is creating recipes as you have to search for every ingredient even if you have used it recently.

I was doing the same thing by myself in Excel. Never liked this kind of apps. But, nonetheless, I said, ok, I will try it and see how it works. It is very helpful because I can Instantly record my meals, scan the codebar, search for meals added by others, so on and so forth. When I was doing it manually, it was kinda hard to remember what I ate, wrote it down, and record it later -a lot of the time I forgot to add it later- and because of that, I gived up like 3 times already. Good App!!

Love the large variety of foods in the database and it even has vitamin supplements listed! I invested in paying for the premium version and well worth it if you want to create your own meal combinations to track. The app is synced with my Google Fit and tracks exercise. The only thing I'm not happy with is that it isn't syncing the steps recorded daily in Google Fit. Can this be fixed???

Its helpful for tracking food. I dislike the OPINIONS it suggests for sugar, carbs, minimum calories etc. It's not my freaking mother it's app. Just track and stfu please. Also, it's impossible to find the cost of a premium membership. Prompts constantly for a free trial, but won't tell how much it will be after 30 days. Know what that tells me? It's too much.

Amazing app. It's changed my life and helped me understand more about nutrition and calorie intake. Works really well alongside gym sessions and I can track my weight regularly. Helped me to lose 3 stone in 6 months. I'd recommend it to anyone. This is a great 5 star review and before you ask, no I don't work for them. Personally the annual 'premium' subs was definitely worth the £65 or so I paid for it. I'd spend that easily on a weekend out. This has helped to improve my health and fitness!!

Searching for new foods now only brings up basic info, no info on the drop-down breakdown of fats, carbs, sugar, fibre, protein etc so you don't know if you have the right food. This was fixed for maybe a day by reinstalling and clearing the cache but there's no way it's reasonable to expect us to do that every time we search for a new food. Please put a reliable fix in place.

Every time I get back to using this app it gets worse and worse. Trying to add food items is like pulling hen's teeth. I go through the whole rigmarole of searching and finding a food item, adjusting the servings and sizes and clicking on the tick only for the item to not be added, so I try again and still no luck. It ends up taking way longer than it should just to add one meal. Frustrating to say the least. It's a pity because I do find MyFitnessPal to have the most extensive database.

Was my go to app when I needed it. Now you can't use barcode scanner without paying the premium. Strange that I can no longer look up foods that was there previously to their "upgrade". Too hard to sync with garmin. Kicked me out of my account and had to start a whole new account, so lost all my previous data. Gone downhill, such a bummer. Will try find another app now.

I only use it to track macros, but for that it is about as easy as I could hope for. The barcode scanning, and extensive database of food items and restaraunt menus makes macro tracking about as easy as it can be. There are a lot of items and features that I don't use. I can't comment on any of them. If I had my way many of these things could be hidden to streamline the ui.

All good so far. Using to gain weight and it's interesting how much (healthy) food I actually have to eat to achieve this! Adding food is getting easier the more information I put in - recipes etc. The barcode option is awesome but I mostly cook from scratch. Also, adding water consumption helps encourage you to maintain hydration. Thank you.

Mostly good but still having issues with duplicates that have been mentioned in other reviews months ago. Already on a low calorie plan due to injury/low activity and found out I was undereating on that as it had duplicated items in my diary! I thought I was hitting my calorie goal, so was wondering why I was going to bed hungry...will definitely be checking it more closely now each day!

It is saying "we were unable to connect to the server to log you in." It has done this several times today, ive tried deleting my account and signing up again but nothing works. I can connect to the website however. I think this is quite cleary the best calorie tracker and would be happy to give it five stars if it would let me use it, but until that point i can't give it anymore than a one. As i stated when i can log into the app again i would give them 5 stars so thats what ive done. Thanks.

Pretty good app. Overall fine to understand your mistakes and balance your progress and alimentation. 4 instead of 5 because: a. In the free version, despite the possibility to upload the exercises, it doesn't calculate them in your program. b. Some of the food report unrealistic macros c. Few, and unchangeable, possibilities to manage your goals

I've used this app over three months and have found it very user friendly, a quick and hassle free way to keep account of calories consumed and burned through exercise. It has all the foods you would normally buy in supermarkets and restaurants listed and you can add how many grams you've eaten for a quick calculation of what you've had. I've lost about 10lbs so far which is good for me.

Like others, I was surprised to find the formerly free scan feature now behind a paywall. The company's response seems to be that the search function is still free, but why not use Google or another search engine instead? I only downloaded to have a place to log food and scan barcodes. They recently removed some basic features from the free service (barcode scanning for example). Was fine until it started asking for permissions to do things I didn't need EVERY TIME I opened the app to log calories and exercise! The app asks for permissions, and gives you the choices to accept (big blue) or remind me later (in small faded grey). If you don't accept, it tells you some functionality (which I don't care about) won't work. Then it repeatedly badgers you to choose again. I'm now looking for a less intrusive way to log my calories and activity. I suggest you do too.

No breakdowns, working well for me. Helps me log my food easily - it includes a lot a Indian food too.. so a simple search gets me what I'm looking for. At the end of the day, when I close my diary, it shows me my expected weight at the end of a month.. that keeps my motivation going. It's linked to my fitness app and helping me stay and eat healthy. Good app.

I have been a loyal user for probably over 5 years and this most recent update&removal of the small widget is AWFUL. You are pushing the paid app way too hard, making me want to switch. Cons: removal of old widget, having to select meal before you scan a barcode, before it defaulted to breakfast, and in reporting a food, usually the srving sz is the problem and you can't adjust that in the form. That's been an annoyance all the years I've used this.

Downloaded the app & input my goals. Started to input what I had eaten that day, only got to 3rd item when app stopped. Signed back in but could no longer find the info I had already input, no option to continue where I left off rather I was bombarded with alot of info about the app. This was very frustrating as I just wanted to get on & use the app so I could see how effective it is. Totally disappointed with trying to navigate this site. This app is not for me.

It is really good to be able to log everything you eat and do as exercise. I didn't realise how many activities are available to use in the exercise list. being able to track calorie allowances with and without daily exercise. There are not many foods I have not been able to find in the app. A great app for free use.

I used the app for quite a long time then I stopped due to the price. Now I am on it, thinking about premium, but it is even more expensive. My net diary is much cheaper and offer similar insight. It looks like Fitness pal became popular and the owner cannot get their pockets filled up. The only reason I went back to the free version is because of the tracker I use, but if they offer a different nutritional tracker, I will most likely use that on and stopp using fitness pal

Very good app so far. I'm loving having a food journal and calorie counter, and the barcode scanner is wonderful. However, I only give 3 stars because more than once a day I enter a food that does not show up right away, instead shows up later multiple times. And quite often there is a "network" issue where you can't even search for foods. Very frustrating, but overall a helpful app.

I like it, but find recipes difficult an time consuming to add. The exercise tracker leaves much to be desired. Not bad, though, overall. Update: now live in the UK and the app will not sync with my Fitbit any more, which isn't an old model. Because it is free, I appreciate using it as a food tracker, but would pay for something if I wanted more integration.

App is for the most working great for me, and is definitely super helpful. However I've noticed that whenever I try to scan an item, half of the times I'll get an error message. There also are a few other bugs here and there, like the workout videos not loading for instance. That's why I only give it 4 stars. 2021 update : the scan seems to work much better now, but the "add frequently paired foods" feature is a complete mess. Please fix

Update: the ad on the diary page takes up a fair amount of space, is aesthetically unappealing, and definitely lowers my opinion of the app. Sometimes it requires a fair bit of searching to find what you actually ate, especially the non fast food versions of things. However the barcode scanner always works. The exercise counter was hard to find the first couple of times. All in all a really good, non invasive app

but the new version needs some bug fixes, as it won't load properly. The new dashboard is great, I just hope it can be fixed soon. This app is particularly useful when combined with one of their exercise apps. Not only can you log meals, but also log workouts, even if that's just a walk. It will count the calories expended and offset that against your recommended intake. Very easy to use and just what I needed.

There's lots here that's really good, the database of foods and the integration with Garmin. But trying to charge £7.99 a month for something so bug ridden and with such a ropey interface is ridiculous. The endless 'unknown error' messages using the barcode scanner alone are enough to drive you nuts Any time you tap a notification, the app freezes. It'd all be ok for a tenner a year, but for nearly that a month you expect constant updates and improvements, not a cheap app with a good database

July 23 review. Tried the paid version for a year. Had a lot of good features and although I didn't really use any of them, they were well implemented and probably worth the annual subscription fee if you do. Back on the free version, and it still does what it says on the tin without minimum fuss. Just a small bug that has been recently introduced in the weight charts. I wish there were a reduced one-off price to remove the ads only (no extra features)

Recently encountered an error where the app doesn't register my steps for previous days diaries, even though it registered the day before. Also, entering meals via widget doesn't work most of the time. Other than that, great app. Has almost every food you can think of; and if it's not there, you can just enter it yourself. Also has a useful widget feature.

The database is pretty good for food selection and accurate. It's helping me with portion control drastically and showing me what my diet is lacking nutrition wise. However, the basic and free version doesn't have ways to edit certain meals. For example, if I entered in a veggie teriyaki combo from Edo but didn't have any soy sauce or teriyaki sauce it would still count the sodium intake. It is also a bit buggy when adding friends on the app.

Overall very good, really helped get my nutrition on track! Food scanner is very helpful! Couple of gripes: 1) The main feed page is useless to me and feels very cluttered, an option to disable would be great. 2) I weigh out all the food I make if I'm not eating a specific serving size so when you input a recipe, it only asks for servings. Weight would be useful as you would know weight/serving and thus how much of a serving you are eating. Right now I record this elsewhere. Still a good app!

I have to update my review to 3 stars. After the upgraded new UI the app is annoying to use. Most of the food logging page is covered in ads and annoying design of the bottom bar which takes up too much space. You can barely see 1-2 lines of the food logged. It used to look much better and simpler. Sometimes simpler is better. (Old) Great app. finds all types of foods which makes it easy to count calories. love the option to scan barcodes

Mixed feelings here: the app has a great catalogue to track food and breaks down nutrients nicely, which makes it easy to better understand one's diet. On the tracking side however it's appalling: I have a Mi Band and its native app is not supported (it's Xiaomi... come on), so I decided to use Google Fit as a proxy, and while I connected it apparently successfully to MyFitnessPal, the sync function does not work (and there is no way to do a manual sync either). What a let down.

I would recommend this app to anyone who is looking to watch their calories or macros. It is super easy to navigate through the app, and you can find just about every food item. You can also scan the Barcode of items to import.  Only downside is the price for the premium - wish it was one flat rate and not an annual/monthly fee. I feel although for the price of premium, you should get much more - for example, creating meal plans to match your macro goals (based on food/recipes you've input), being able to not only record weight but also other body measurements, etc.

I have come back to this app after about a year hiatus because it's easy to track food with it. Super easy to enter what I've eaten and add recipes. Takes the guesswork out of calculating my own calories. I keep getting an error when trying to connect with my step tracker (Samsung galaxy active watch/Samsung Health). My fitness pal app continues to say "unable to connect to the server to synchronize". I have allowed all the permissions. Help please?

I've been using this app for years. It's great and probably the most well known which means it connects to most other apps. It's frustrating that there are so many different results for simple things like apple, for example. There can be over a hundred options for one food and MFP rarely ever check what has been entered to ensure accuracy. Another down side is that 95% of the products are American so I find myself constantly having to add products from Australia.

The app is good enough on the basic plan. However the premium plan does not provide very much added value. I signed up for a free money back trial, and cancelled within the 30 days, (actually it was within 10 days) they had a load of requirements to cancel, all of which I fulfilled, and the money was NOT returned. I am still waiting for an answer from them. Poor experience all around. I want my money back, My Fitness Pal

It is quite different from other apps,as I can log my meals,scan barcodes and sync my exercises for the day. But I have a problem with it hanging each time I try to access my Diary. Then it takes up so much data (internet bundles) just to access my tasks for the day,As I am not subscribed to the premium version,then the basic version should be very budget friendly,free perhaps 😃

Latest update reduces from 5 stars to 3... On the free app every screen change now prompts an ad... This is too intrusive and needs to be removed. OK, I guess the idea is to encourage an upgrade to premium, but for me it is more likely to send me away (to my Fitbit app) than convince me to upgrade. Other than that, I love it... But this might be a "free" compromise too far. 😟

I use the app to track my macros. I can do most things I want to but it's more time consuming than would be ideal. I'm not clear on difference between meals, recipes and foods...e.g. i have meals I've had to save as foods for some reason. The library of foods is huge but the accuracy seems hit and miss. More hit than miss to be fair...but enough are wrong to mean that I can't relax and often have to double-check. These are my gripes - but overall it's a great app (the best for this I found yet)

Using since January again (big surprise!) and much improved experience. Some of the ads are pretty awful (products for skin problems, with unpleasant images), but that isn't their fault and if it were important enough, I could always subscribe to the paid version that is ad free. Overall I'm happy with it. Wish I had a weekly diary view summarized with calories daily, maybe I just haven't found it yet.

Edit...Not liking it anymore! I haven't used the app in a while. The newest version is very hard to navigate. I can't figure out how to add items to an existing meal. Everything is harder than it should be! OLD--- I love it. I'm not overly motivated enough to diet or exercise but this app makes it so easy to keep track of your calories. It's too overwhelming to count calories but this app does it for you. Large database of products including Canadian products. Scan function makes it so simple.

Just hard work, doesn't sync my steps from my watch even though it says its connected to samsung health. Delete it and reinstall to see if it's a glitch and asked for the email to get my password. Been waiting an hour 🤦‍♀️ and asked twice. When it asks to add weight of food, it's very limited as well. Always in grams, and I can only select from a drop down option. Had this app installed for years, and have used it on and off, but seen little to no improvements in the app itself.

I loved the app, but after the last update it's not working properly. It keeps repeating one food entry for a ridiculous amount of time (apparently yesterday I ate 8000 calories worth of ham, the app repeated my entry almost 100 times) and it doesn't recognise my fitbit anymore (never had such issue before). I tried to disconnect and reconnect the fitbit both on app and pc, but there is no way I can disconnect it, let alone reconnect it. Please fix it, I want to keep using the MFP app! Thank you

Used to love this app. Lost weight with it. Recently started to use it again to find the premium screen pops up all the time, half way through doing something. Slow to load, freezes often. Disappointed and puts me off using it as it's time consuming to enter what I've eaten in due to the freezing and pop ups. I have uninstalled and reinstalled. Its definitely not my phone as I have no issues with phone.

Such a brilliant app for tracking your eating habits and calorie intake. Makes it easy to see where hidden calories in your diet are. Update: Just started using the app again. Now feels like free version is unworkable. Cannot get back to food diary to see what I've added for the day. Keeps going back to friends page any time I do, seems like a glitch.

After using it for a about 2 weeks I can tell it's a great app and I love it. There are couple small issues though. First of all, it's not able to detect identical workouts. I had it linked with Garmin connect and Strava accounts, and as a result it showed each recorded activity twice, so I had to manually delete extra workouts every time. Unfortunately, MyFitnessPal doesn't let to unlink Strava account, so I had to disconnect Strava from Garmin connect as a workaround.

So good for helping me control calories and think about the fat to protein ratio I'm putting into my body. It didn't matter what obscure plant based thing I was eating, this app could find it and tell me its calorific value. Bar code scanner is super helpful! Synced it with my fitbit but it made calorie adjustments that weren't correct. I couldn't adjust manually or delete the entry. Even desyncing wouldn't get rid of it. I ended up setting up a new profile and putting in exercise manually.

I like this app, I mean it is time-consuming to log everything, and it is annoying that none of the strength exercises tell you how many calories they burn. But I have a new recent problem, which is the worst of all! It keeps deleting meals that I've created. These take a while to log, and if they delete themselves, it's not easy to remember all the ingredients and amounts of them, or if you've thrown the packaging out you can't rescan the barcode. Once it deleted a meal twice in a row! Grrrr!

Everytime they update, something stops working for a few days. Real problem with quality control. Most recent update caused the recipe function to stop working. spend 10min entering everything and then it gives an error code and suggests Campbell's Soup instead! Also, will not sync with Pacer on android if you have battery saver on, so you have to go into both apps and press the sync button when you want it to transfer over. This app should be great, but it ends up being annoying on a daily basis

I've been using this App for years and really enjoyed it, it actually really helped me loose weight and keep my diet balanced. However, lately each time I log my exercises, it keeps doubling the amount of the workouts I did to the point of -4,000 calories + It's really frustrating 😕 I tried to reinstall the App and edit the settings, also the settings of "Samsung Health" App and "MapMyFitness". But nothing seems to help and the amount of exercises keeps increasing on its own... Please help!

Absolutely massive database of foods, the best I've ever used. Lots of apps want you to create foods all the time - who has time for that? Unfortunately a lot of duplicate or wrong entries, but this is to be expected. Would prefer if they put the barcode scanning link next to the search box again, not sure why they moved it. Syncs with my Garmin watch which is super convenient. Love this app, been using it for years now.

I used this app a few years back to help lose s stone in weight. I'm back now due to lock down weight 'creep'... The app has changed as well, even easier to track food, drink and exercise. Great hints and tips and articles to encourage. The best improvement is the 'bar code scan for nutritional info, the final piece of the jigsaw in accuracy.

This app is just amazing for tracking everything. It really helps you to monitor what you eat and to make better decisions. Recommendation: If there was a planning feature. Meaning someone can plan out their meals in advance and on the day of, they can just check mark/crossout that they ate the foods they planned. This would be great for those trying to be consistant. Stat feature showing "you follow your meals 88% of the time" over course of month.

I'm on the free app. Great food selection to choose from and easy to add food options. great app to use with Fitbit.. Can be a bit slow to link some days. But mostly ok. some of the blogs have some off-putting pictures though (like worms around an apple) which can be off putting especially when adding your food in before you eat it. but again most of the pictures are suitable.

Almost a perfect app. Need to expand the connectivity to other apps that are better in other areas, to make a perfect group of apps that make life easier for users. MFP doesn't have a very good exercise input section. Not user friendly. Very limited exercise list, no custom/set workout planner & input is to draining. Perfect app that would work well with MFP is JEFIT. JEFIT is a perfect exercise app IMHO. These 2 apps would make for a more accurate CAL counter.

I'm using the premium version, and I have not found a way to record steps in this app. The app is "unable to connect to server to synchronize" for you to choose a step app, and you can't add steps manually. (Although the feature did work for one day before the bug, but I had to uninstall and reinstall the app etc to make it work.) So hmm.. the barcodes are handy but without steps the app can't draw an estimate of calorie consumption

Shockingly bad user experience of late! I've been using the app for 4 years, and never have I had as many issues as I do now. Not being able to scan bar codes properly, or if they do scan, the app brings up totally unrelated products. It's ridiculously slow to use, and constantly freezes or crashes. It doesn't have a history of regular foods scanned, but suggests random foods I've not had in ages. Whatever updates you've done, you've made the app totally inadequate for use. 😖 Please fix it 🙏

Great for logging food. I don't like how you can't add a workout for a certain number of calories (without having to choose from the list of exact exercises, which don't include the ones that my exercise program uses), step counter VERY dodgy. You have to manually sync it 90% of the time. However, I love that it increases the calorie intake for the day as you move around. It's easier to stick to when you know you have a few extra calories to eat! I would give it exactly 3.5 stars.

As a basic calorie tracker it works well. But when I've tried linking samsung health to this app you'd get duplicates of the exercise you do, the pedometer doesn't link up and it constantly crashes! So it's easier to just input the data yourself. Strangely enough the adverts will always come up even though nothing else will which, in my opinion, is a way if them pushing you to go premium to get rid of the ads and the frustration it causes as I'd expect the adverts take priority over the apps use

My initial review from a couple of years ago is below for posterity. This WAS a brilliant app, but it's become so slow and laggy, crashing frequently to the point where it's incredibly frustrating to use. Other users I've consulted have found the same problems. I hope the developers are able to fix these issues. "A fantastic, and very comprehensive, app for tracking your food intake and diet. The library of foods is very comprehensive and you can add your own meals and customise foods too."

Taking the free barcode scanning away was a terrible move, but with the new UI and a mountain of ads, unless you pay their extortionate premium subscription, there truly is no more reason to use this app. Shame. Honestly, what a fumble. 0 stars if I could. (Old review) One quick note I want to make a complaint about is the lack of support for Xiaomi's Mi Band fitness tracker line. They're cheap and extremely good quality, so I find it surprising that a free app wouldn't make sure to support it.

This is the tale of a fallen star. My fitness pal used to be incredible, easy to use, full featured and had a small footprint. This was almost a decade ago. Then Under Armour bought it, and locked down some useful features behind a subscription. Nothing too bad, but some useful niche features. Then Fransisco Partners bought it, and they are locking basic features behind the subscription paywall. User-submitted data and the barcode reader. Incredibly stupid.

Used this on and off for a long time. The main reason for that was the bar code scanner, which made it more convenient than some other similar apps. This feature is now behind a paywall and there are just too many apps that have similar or better features for free. They have nothing worth paying for at this stage. Save your money and get another app with the free bar ode scanner

I love the scanning option, very accurate, i have been tracking my calorie intake on each meal, with one exception, in the past month the app has found every food item I wanted to add. Very easy to use, definitetely thinking on upgrading it! I recommend this app to track your meals...excercise...water intake...and I am using the notes section to track the eating window for intermittent fasting.

Great app overall, and I personally find the reminders helpful to keep logging. BUT - add many others have mentioned, as of a can days ago, the search functionality just stopped working and returns a 'network error' pretty much 100% of the time. This means I cannot log any new foods, only stuff I already have in the history. Disappointing, hope it gets fixed soon though...

Used to be much better. Nutrients tab on Nutrition just doesn't work. It's showing wrong data. It is saying the goal is for example 242, even though my goal is 180. The funny thing is if you click on thr 242 value, it leads you to your Calorie and Macro goals with the correct amounts. This messes up display on my smart watch. There are tons of small issues like that, wiping recipes if your phone rotation chamges and so on. Terrible experience, only useful due to food scanning.

I was frustrated with the app at first as pop ups of going premium was happening every few minutes while i was trying to figure out what the app was all about. But despite the constant pop ups, i have to admit, i am really impressed. The app works perfectly fine and i highly recommend it! I did go premium after testing the app out at first. However had to cancel due to financial reasons, but i am still using the app-But the constant pop ups of going premium are just way to frequent and annoying

Really good app. The barcode scanner is very convenient, it works great in South Africa with a lot of local products. The integration of the blog is also nice, it keeps you up to date with health trends and new discoveries. The breakdown of nutrients as well as health tips that the app suggests are insightful. The main benefit of this app would be the awareness the app provides about healthy food and living. The only down side is in app purchases. But the free version is definitely worth it.

UI is terrible. So cluttered - even without the ads which it it totally full of. And they recently got rid of a quick action button, which was arguably my most used feature. Also, got the app because everyone I know says the barcode scanner is excellent. None of them are on the subscription, but they've got it. But apparently I need to subscribe to get access to this feature? If it wasn't for the integrations I'd be using something else.

Have used this for a long time but recently it tries to redirect to the app store or to a website (where it tries to download application packages) - this is without clicking on adverts. It really is starting to put me off the app. UPDATE: adverts seem to have gone, all is well again! Another Update (24th June 2021). Random advert audio playing in the background again. Not good!

All around great! I use it mainly for tracking calories so I don't know much about the other features. It has many recipes and counting calories is easy. I wish it had less ad like fitness programs on the main page though. Also it would be nice if it had more foods with European measurements because cups and oz don't really work around here. But none the less a nice app. The should consider adding icons for foods and exercise like in Lose it.

I find this app to be quite useful. I downloaded it for the calorie counting but, found myself pleasantly surprised at the additional things you can edit accordingly such as, how much protein you want to get in, how much fat, how many carbs etc. all without upgrading the app via paying. It also surpringly has foods that I didn't expect to be able to find (Perth owned takeaway business). I don't struggle at all with ads either and, you can adjust when you want to get notifs for meals. Very handy.

Really useful app to track food intake. I use it to focus on macros over calories, as I'm trying to build muscle - so have found the premium option helpful. The nutrient break down has lead me to making better choices over time. I would advise anyone to scan their food if they can as sometimes things entered by other users aren't always 100% accurate. The recipe option is great but would be made even easier if you could transfer straight from anywhere online.

Great app overall, super impressed with the amount of free features available compared to other apps. Just one issue is that a) the variety of exercises can be increased or individual strength exercises can also show calories, and b) sometimes when I'm tracking my workout routine and my screen turns off, the screen freezes and does not show my routine, and I have to track my routine all over again

Good ap, but be careful of what it does to your data. I started using it and two days later my phone alerted me my data was almost used up. When I checked this ap was after using 1.5GBs in two days. All I did was search for a few foods. 1.0 GB was just background data!! No idea how it used up so much so fast. I've disabled background data, but am unsure if it will be enough. If you don't have constant wifi access be very careful and keep an eye on it.

I paid for a subscription which hasn't really been worth it for me, but I do love the app. it has so many foods already in its database that makes it really easy to start, plus it saves all your most recently logged foods, so if you're like me and eat a lot of the same thing it's stupid easy and takes seconds to log. love love love! Edit: I am suddenly unable to edit or create any recipes in the app, which is like 90% of why I use it in the first place. Fix this issue!!

Completely unusable. This app used to be amazing but since an update it won't go beyond opening the app. As soon as I open it, it prompts me to "save my goals". I click save and it takes me back to the main page then a second later asks me to Save my Goals again and again and again. I can't do anything on it. I've tried clearing the cache, uninstalling and reinstalling... Very annoying!

Useful app, but bugs are annoying. Often, if I edit the amount of a food in my log, the entry suddenly appears double or thrice. The entry gets multiplied instead of edited. And I have to notice it, and manually delete, otherwise my count is off. (My phone is sporadically connected to the internet. Maybe it has something to do with syncing? Anyways, the app, if properly done, should also work well for people who aren't constantly connected)

Have been using it for past 3 years & it's been working okay although a bit glitchy of late after recent updates until TODAY Nov 5th 2018!! Now it's totally unusable!!! The app has logged me out & won't let me back in again saying I've entered an incorrect email or password even though I've got it right! I can't even log in via my chrome web browser it's doing exactly the same. Therefore I cannot access my account at all!!!! So much for their latest update. It looks like reading all the comments everyone running Android 8 has been locked out of their accounts. Absolutely hopeless!! Surely they'd check compatibility issues before releasing an update!! Totally frustrating!! I've been using it daily for over 3 years now so it looks like I'll loose all my data!! Very poor!!!!

A decent app but there's room for improvement. I wish there was more emphasis on daily micro nutrition and not just calorie counting. They do track some daily iron and calcium which is great but I wish they expanded this and also accounted for vitamin supplements and many other vit/min. I like that I can use both the phone app and the desktop. Although the phone app strangely seems to have more features then the desktop which I think is backwards. The whole interface needs a polish.

Pretty good, but often very slow to update steps from Fitbit. (OK at providing meal details To Fitbit, though.) The food database, however, is incorrect for many items. Too often, the portion size is just shown as 100g when a normal portion is very different, and many foods that consist almost entirely of carbohydrates are shown as containing none! Also, when the region is set outside the USA, I expect some note to be taken of this. We don't measure everything in 'cups', for example.

This is by far the best calorie counting app I have used. Scanning food is really easy, finding food is really easy, and linking to other apps to track activity and adjust your calorie amount for the day is.... Guess what... Really easy. Slick, professional app, intuitive to use and understand, good features to understand what you are eating and what you should be having more or less of. Loads of options around tracking progress and fitness. Wish I'd found it sooner and not wasted years on others

Syncs with many other apps like Fitbit. The food database is incredible. It contains all the food I know of, not only in English, but in Norwegian too. Edit: New version is slow and sluggish. If I have to wait several seconds for the app to load up. Edit2: Works now. However, I have been logging in every day for several years, but recently it just says "streak: 1".

The app is in general very good. I would recommend to the developers that they reduce the amount of steps needed to add food. For example, if I eat a protein shake and 2 slices of bread with differing condiments, I need to add each item individually even though they are all on same list of recently used items. It would be better to be able to select multiple items from the 'recently used' list, or another list, and add them all at once - similarly to how it is done in the PC version.

This app is quite a resource hog for my phone. It drains the battery surprisingly fast. The longer I leave the app open the more it slows down my phone and causes lag and crashes. Some entries get duplicated. Some entries disappear. I had to restrict the data usage to wi-fi only as it was using up a shocking amount of data. Otherwise being able to track calories and micronutrients for free is great. Just not sure if the app is worth the headache when I could just use the website instead.

Overall good user usability. The calorie counter is the strong point of this app which stands out from the rest of the calorie counter apps. Verified nutrients are important to meet the calorie goal. The only issues I had was with the input with camera which doesn't work neither does the water reminder. Intermediate fasting is not user friendly. Scheduling is difficult and I'd rather check the time I have left to end the fast than the time I'm on the fast. Will give a 5 star review after app fix

Find it really useful, I wanted to go intuitively but I was lost, now I know exactly how much I'm eating and their macros which is fantastic. Also love that it has so many brands and products added, make it so easier just to scan a product. But a really down point is that I couldn't synchronise my smart watch, not only cause it doesn't include Huawei's app but neither could with Google app or Samsung. That's why I didn't go for the premium option.

I use this & have been successful in losing weight in the past, however I find quite a few discrepancies in cals in the packaging to what MFP calculates & I'm a bit less trusting this time sadly. I sync it to my fitbit which is great. It's quite motivating to see the weight I could be in 5 weeks if similar cals were eaten. I'd like more accurate portions/serving sizes/ or the ability to flag inaccurate calculations, however I just do a quick add when it it inaccurate.

Works really well but doesn't sync properly with Fitbit, and there is no easy way to force this. if i go to Me -> Settings -> Help and press "Sync" it fails every time. Also i cant update my progile picture. it says it saves it but never updates it. Uninstalling the app and reinstalling "helps" but then i lose all the data I've collected while the sync is broken.

The free version is a good basic app, but there are some features that I miss after using Calorie King for free. Fir some reason, most food searches yield results in ounces instead of grams, even though I set preferences to metric. Charging for recipes is a bit much, since they are free on the internet! I do like the app enough to keep it, however.

Still seem to have problems with exercise from my Samsung Watch/ App deciding to load twice and you cannot delete it. Some items only have a "1 container" while others have grams

Very useful app, mostly for tracking calories and lots of products available although not always populated for other nutritional info! Till then, 4 stars..
