Used to love this app have been using it for years but since the update all my phone seems to do is crash and half the time it wont load. Might try out lose it! As that's meant to be good. Very disappointing Edit: weight hasn't been syncing with withings since about the 20th of August. All over the community boards and fitbit just don't seem to care not getting any customer support or communication. This happens at least once a year and its infuriating!!

Great for measuring calorie intake and macros. Some of the foods that you input vary widely in calories and macros so you have to make sure you pick the right one. Plenty of tips, blogs etc to give advice on achieving your specific goals, but the majority of these seem to be aimed at women. I would guess this fulfills the demographic more than anything else though. Really good app even for the free version and the ads aren't a pain like a lot of other free apps

I've been using this app on and off for several years. The last update has removed the ability for the end user to define their total calorie goal by grams in each of the macro nutrient sections in the free version. You must now only allocate your macros using a % which may or may not be accurate. Really disappointed and will be looking at alternatives on the market.

Disappointed. I've used this app since 2016 and loved it's features on the free and premium service. However, I have now returned to the free service and found that the app doesn't allow any kind of custom set calories or macros which is massively frustrating, but also incredibly irresponsible of a "fitness" app. It calculates my maintainence calories significantly higher than what they need to be, and I can't set them back to what my original custom settings were...unless I pay of course 😒

If you're happy to take the time to use it properly and monitor everything that passes you lips this is a great app to aid weight loss... I found myself getting excited about food and dieting which I never have before. actually seeing what; and more importantly how much you eat and drink helps enormously with a healthy diet and has really taken me away from the same old same old. I now look closely at what different foods have in them and read the labels. It's a shocker when you do... highly rec

Pretty much the best way to log calories, macros, micros, exercise and water intake that I've found. There are a few annoying bugs that keep it from being 5 star. Such as that it overrides portrait on android which forces autorotate, loads of false ingredients and difficult to correct them, even when green ticked. However, still possibly the best one out there.

I loved this app and I've used it on and off for years, but the new format, the once free but soon to be premium barcode scanner, and the pop up ads after Every. Single. Food. Addition... I've had to download one of the other tracker apps because this is just bonkers. I'm gutted because MyFitnessPal has been such a brilliantly user-friendly, motivating and resourceful app for tracking my physical health but I guess all good things come to an end.

Used this for many years. It used to be totally free with very little ads, and was an easy way of sharing my exercise progress.. a truly 5 star app.. alas, now it has chosen the freemium model, has many ads, nags you for ratings, and will charge ridiculous amounts for the same features it always had with the free version. The auto-sharing feature, on day completion, stopped working a few years ago with my Facebook account, and they added a restriction on completion that you must enter your diet

I'm changing my review again. Some things keep happening often, especially not getting notifications & taking several tries to post anything, whether a status or picture or a message to a friend. It's frustrsting to not being able to keep u with what's going on & to have the same things happen all the time. This is not something to be considered glitchy anymore - it's beyond that. However, it is a good way to connect with friends & to give support & to receive support.

I used to give this app 5 stars. But recently the ads are getting more frequent and annoying. Not only that, the ads actually cause glitches. When adding an item, be it exercise or food, it sometimes adds them more than once as it's trying to spawn an ad I'm not paying £65 just to remove ads when the rest of the features are useless to me. There should be a lower tier for ad removal only. If it continues I'll just switch to one of the many other tracking apps. You're pushing people away.

The app was way more stable and intuitive before the major overhaul. Now it just crashes on start and I have to clear all data for it to work again. EDIT: This app is an absolute disaster. It does nothing but crashing. Again I am blessed with the same issue I had before, after it working for a few months. Time to find a better alternative.

Loved this App. Used it for 3 years with almost zero problems. Now it is a nightmare: 1. It is not free anymore and I am paying 10 usd/month 2. Cannot save receipe anymore. 3. Very often I cannot close the diary of the day as it does not sync. 4. Now suddenly the App is completely stuck. And all my records apparently lost. I can still see my data from the browser version, but the Android App does not sync anymore. I already wrote to the help desk providing screenshots... Please fix it asap!

Edit: fixed issue really quickly after reporting, top service. Can't create an account, sign in with an old account, sign in via Facebook... When creating an account it can't verify usernames. VERY frustrating to the point that I have no option but to use a different provider's app instead 🤷🏼‍♀️

What a great app! It has just about every possible food and you can make your own if it's not listed. It tracks not just your calories and macros but also your nutrient intake. On top of all this, it's easy to use with no intrusive pop up ads. Since using this app I've been on top of my calorie intake and I've been eating much healthier and googling things like "what foods have potassium" to get my vitamins and minerals looking right!

I have used this app for ages. It's been fine until Apr. 23 2022. I can't edit my recipes anymore. Every time it try to save changes it says, "Unable to save. Please try again latter." I have tried it on wifi and data, making sure the recipes are not in my diary before editing them, force quitting the app and going back in, and checking for and installing all updates. This issue is very frustrating and takes away a large chunk of why I use this app.

I only used the calorie counter and linked Samsung Health to record my steps. The food database is extensive. I frequently found the brand I was looking for. My only complaint is the syncing of Samsung Health for the step count. It sometimes doesn't work. And to get it to import the steps I had to close and reopen the app or switch between the home screen and diary or all of the above. Even then sometimes doesn't work

This app is very helpful. I've lost weight already after a week of using it. Would have a 5-star from me except it won't let you change the portion size unless you go the long way around and enter the food in "create food" instead of picking from the existing list. I don't always have the time to enter everything just to get the correct portion/calories in my food diary.

Everything I scan comes up which is pretty good as I have tried other apps and I had to choose other products most of the time. Tells you vitamin and some mineral content of the food you log on. You can add recipes and meals to save time in the future. You can adjust your micros exactly the way you want them if you don't like their estimation. Overall I am enjoying it

Really good as linked to Garmin app to share activity/exercise information to better calculate calories burned. It's also excellent when scanning foods to add to the diary to capture calories and many other nutrients - I've not found anything as yet that hasn't scanned. Obviously some parts are limited as clearly they want you to upgrade and pay a monthly fee, which I'm sure does give many more functions, but I'm not ready for that just yet.

The app itself is good, however everytime I open the app (which is minimum 3 times a day) I get the "upgrade to pro" request, set goals page and enable notifications page. That would be acceptable if it would be once everytime I open the app, however it happens anywhere between 5 and 15 times before I can even get to the main page!That means I have to skip anywhere between 15 repeated pages to 45! Ridiculous and does not seem like an honest mistake, rather forcing users to pay for it.

I've used this app for years. the food side is great but the exercises never sync from Google fit. It's a known issue and from looking at troubleshooting sites it's been an issue since 2015/16. I'm trying another app now it's frustrating because it works with the food side so well. But it doesn't log the miles and miles of exercise or steps I do each day. Disappointing !!

I only for food tracking. Having meals & recipes as well as foods is very helpful, the database is comprehensive and I like having verified database entries. But there is now masses of clutter in the database. I'd like to pay to get rid of the ads, & maintaining the database is an ongoing job, so fair enough that it should be a subscription rather than a one off payment. But it's WAY too expensive. And clearly the database is ill-managed anyway, so definitely not worth that much.

Removing functionality and making it premium after years of free access is the worst possible business decision when it comes to user satisfaction and loyalty, especially in the current financial climate. The barcode scanner was a huge benefit, especially when making large recipes. Having to manually search for them is unnecessarily time consuming. I have used this app problem free for years but am already looking for an replacement.

Excellent until recently! Been using the app for a long time. Recently however I was having trouble being able to edit and create my recipes, I reported the issue and was told to uninstall and reinstall the app. No I have lost ALL my data, not recipes, no previous scans, all my previous logged days have disappeared also! It would be far too much effort to even think about starting from scratch on this app...it's pushed me to try another food tracking app. Disappointed.

This is the 2nd time having an a/c. 1st got hacked. I deleted the a/c & when open new a/c yrs later, it recognised my email! Since installing the app, my phone has slowed down, it freezes & drains my battery. The app should link to my activity tracker tho it's not working in either app. To use - it is easy to navigate. I can scan barcodes for foods which is 99% accurate & calculate I'm eating. I can create my own meals to save. Also there is an extensive search selection of foods & meals.

I like how this links to my fitbit, although it can take a while to update. I don't like the 'if everyday was like today you'd weigh..' statement when you submit your daily diary, because it doesn't consider the cumulative effect of your ongoing calorie control. It is not motivating when you've been carefully logging and calorie counting for a week, to see the same 5-week projection at the end as you did at the start! Otherwise, good app, good free option and lots of recognised foods. Great.

Ok but can be unresponsive. Far too many inaccurate entries and the report facility doesn't let you correct what is wrong. I really don't believe fresh pears are high in saturated fat. Far too many American entries, though there are UK ones as well. What is the obsession with cups as a unit? I know Americans use them but at least give some kind of equiva!ence. I think it would be improved if the app had a basic set of calorie values which you could select instead of multiple user entries.

I've been using MFP on and off since 2011. There are lots of good things about it, like the extensive user-submitted food database, community, social feed, Recipe Builder, etc. My main complaint is that it can be glitchy as hell. At least several times a week, it just won't load or I'll get some kind of server error. Sometimes the app works and the website doesn't, sometimes they don't sync together properly, etc. I feel that the coding could use some huge improvements.

It's a bit difficult to work out how much of a portion of something you had when everything seems to come with a standard portion weight, and none of the other options seem to match what you need... Also my pedometer app isn't listed in the apps to connect, so I can't get a proper view of how many calories I have left etc, as I'm having to look roughly at the calories burnt on that and then just add exercise until it reaches that amount... Could be better

Really easy to use and great integration of scanning to add food quickly by barcode. The free version is fine if calories is all you want to track for basic weight loss. has a easy to add recipies too for home cooked dinners that can be saved and reused. id imagine the paid version is well worth it if you are a heath buff and want to track things in more detail.

I do really like this app & use it every day. I have Premium account which costs extra but I think it's worth it. There are some things that should be improved on though: Looking up an item of food - would be nice to filter by, or choose a 'UK' option because... really , who knows how much is in a cup!? People add items but sometimes only calories which is no use to a macro tracker, so an option to search foods that have macros. Recipies should be easier to create & adjust. Saving meals is best

Have been using this App for a few years when I do my yearly 5/2 Fast Diet to knock off the kilos. It's great and I have put friends and work colleagues onto it as a means to assist and log their progress. All features are helpful and the app continues to improve and impress. I guess I should pay for it after all this time but the advertising is minimal. Highly recommended.

When I opened it today to enter my lunch diary, i seem to have lost information. I've lost friends, community and support pages. In addition, the barcode scanner will scan, but then sits and spins eternally. Everything needs to be entered manually. **From reading other reviews, it appears this is a common issue. Please fix. *****Edited to say it seems most issues are fixed and i have adjusted my rating accordingly.

I used to love the free version of this app and used it a lot a few years ago. I've recently reinstalled it and am now getting stuck in a loop with the Premium offer. When I exit the offer it asks me to reset my goals, and when I reset my goals it takes me back to the offer. This cycle then repeats. It takes 3 or 4 tries to get past the offer and add my foods, which is making using the app really frustrating. I understand the need for ads, but going to have to look for an alternative.

This has been a fantastic app which I've used for many years but just recently it's taken a turn for the worse. I'm using it on a pretty new Samsung but the performance just chuggs. I have to close the app every 5 or so minutes (this is not an exaggeration) as it's running so slow, and to pre-empt an inevitable crash. For some reason it's now intermittently remembering foods that I've scanned so having to scan them each time is a pain. Also, the "Most frequent" and "Most recent" are broken.

The free version is still good and useful for calorie counting. Has a lot more food items than other apps. There are also recipes with listed calories. You can't save them on the free version but they're still useful. A problem I've had and I know other people have had is with syncing their steps and exercise, but pretty good other than that.

Here is an update from the MFP team 3 years ago regarding an issue that repeatedly asks you to update your goals. It's still happening...! Thank you for taking the time to contact us. It appears, at some point over the last few days, log ins are not being recognized properly which is prompting the Welcome Back pop up to populate each time. If this app doesn't get fixed soon, I'm switching to another! Such a shame too, I would have rated it a 4 or 5 given how much it has helped me. -------------- UPDATE ----------- The up was down for a short time, but credit the developers for getting it back up and running. I have changed my rating to 4 stars!! I've used this app for a little while now and it has been very instrumental in my weight loss and has helped me immensely when keeping track of the calorie intake of my daily diet.

What a disappointment! I used this app many years ago and found it useful. Then I changed my phones & forgot about it. Finally bit the bullet and re-installed it only to find the page awash with adds. EVERYWHERE. ALL THE TIME. AND barcode scanner is now under premium (extortionately priced) subscription. Thank you, but no, thank you. Uninstalling.

It's great for tracking food, and the 'scan the barcode' option makes it easy to find food. The exercise section needs more work. It's good as a guide and I'm enjoying it.

In theory this app is amazing, loads of foods in the database and easy to use. However, it will not sync with my desktop app on my computer and it looks like I've not tracked any food. I will be cancelling the free trial as its just not worth paying for.

Impossibly slow to load! Would use it to track food and exercise goals every day, but now every time I open app, it keeps me waiting several minutes while it loads. Idem for each item I add. Please make it quick as it was before! Love the possibility of taking photo of barcode to get nutritional info, but need it to be quick!

Love MFP. It's helped me lose 70lbs and educated me about food and calories etc along the way. I'd have given it full marks if it didn't keep having issues syncing with my FitBit. I have to log out of the app and go online and remove my fitbit and reinstall it and it's a pain. Sometimes that doesn't even solve the issue. Happens to friends too. However, that said it's fantastic and free and I'd be lost without it so thank you.

Using this app I have managed to lose 40 kilos in about six months. It's fabulous !!! Very simple and easy to use. I haven't even thought about trying any other weightloss app as this one has everything and more than I need. It's so easy, I use it everyday. Only takes a couple of minutes to put in what I've eaten. It's great for searching food items for calorie content. Can't rate it higher !!!

Been a consistent user for almost 4 years and have seen it decline in quality and value; more ads and now has ads that are full screen and require you to wait until it finishes before you can close it. Today, I have had the same ad showing me 4 times within a minute whilst I was logging my food items. This - and the fact that they'll be removing some fundamental features (e.g. barcode scanning) from the non-premium membership - has made me move on to another app. Check out MacroFactor instead.

Great all round app, scans 90% of food barcodes and for the missing ones you can log it so ot scans next time. I am on the free account so the data doesn't drill down as much in terms of food timing macro nutients ext. But this is enough for me, as I wanted to start looking at what I was eating and if I was over eating. Down side is the weight tracking, I would like an option to add more biometrics like body fat & muscle % and chart it out in a better way. So I am logging that in a spreadsheet.

I used this app every day for 4 years. However, with recent upgrades, it no longer works. The exercise part of the diary doesn't function and the tech support is useless. As well, the scanner feature has been removed unless you become a subscriber. There are plenty of other better apps out there that work and offer more features for free access

The app has been in desperate need of a revamp for years now. While the pricing isn't outrageous, it does fall considerably short when competitors are now offering better apps at a cheaper price. I'm not sure what under armour have planned for this app, but from the looks of it, it's not going to getting much needed improvements anytime soon, if ever.

I have been using this app for years. I did stop for a while tho and have been back for the last 4-6 months. I used to love it, but something happened about 1 month ago. It glitches, freezes and annoyingly slow. I need at least 15-20 minutes to upload my calories. Addin recepies??? Joke! Froze so many times I have given up. FIX IT! Please.

The app is for sure the best way I found so far to have an idea of the amount of food I eat. Many mistakes when adding a meal

The app keeps crashing since last night every time I open it. I have reinstalled 4 times now but still having the same issue. MFP has some amazing features like adding recipes with bulk ingredients import, or scanning barcodes for adding food. My problems with it are that a. Used this app about a year or so ago and it was great. Have just installed as started a diet and it is awful. It does not register my Fitbit properly. Have installed/uninstalled but to no avail. Great app. But premium features are almost $30 CAD. A month! That's more than Netflix's. I bet the devs would see a large uptick in memberships if the premium pricing was at least cut in half. 4 stars for everything I can do with the free version.

You can monitor everything in the app, including food (nutrients), exercise, fasting, and sugar/insulin levels. I can see daily & weekly reports of food analysis too. I've lost 19kg in over a year with the help of MyFitnessPal, and continue to use it to track my food and activity. Great for weight loss, maintenance and tracking sports eating and exercise. I've been using this app for years, wouldn't use anything else. Excellent product!! 🏋💪

Nice app with insane bugs on Android. If you create a meal, no matter if on mobile data or WiFi, it will disappear, no matter how many times you'll try to create it and save it. Same if you try to edit a meal. Cannot delete an item from meal, have to put zero serving size as a workaround. List of recently used items not accurate, many items missing, no matter what filter you use. C'mon guys!!!

App is helpful in tracking the calories intake but I found several bugs in the app. I tried to create a food, however when I finished it automatically added to my daily intake. And it is not in my diary. My calories intake is over the roof now and I can't delete the food which I can't see in my diary. I added all the meals from breakfast to dinner, and the calories shown is way more than the sum of all meals. I wanted to buy the premium version but now I am looking for alternatives app.

It used to be easy to use, informative and helpful.. But not anymore. I've been using this app for years, and it was a gem. For the last few months it keeps freezing and sometimes crashes completely. It takes me up to several tries and almost 15 minutes just to log a meal. Also, still no direct sync with the Amazfit app? Don't even ask me about the ads and bunch of uninteresting blogs on the main page. It's bloated worse then I used to be. You need to clean up your act, ASAP..

This app is easy to use and i love the integration with walk mapping. DEVELOPERS: Please check the potassium levels. I've scanned oatmeal, bagels, even hot sauce that contain potassium, but it does not show up in the app. Everyday my potassium level registers low, and that may be the case, but the app is showing it far lower than my actual level by not included the complete nutritional components of scanned food items.

Excellent, keeps a tab on all your food, exercise, calories and water consumption. Also breaks down the components of what you're eating into protein carbs etc. Info on vitamins. Huge support available from friends using it which helps a lot to stay motivated. The list of how many calories in foodstuffs to choose from could be averaged out tho, as too many variables from different sources.

I've used this app on and off for about 10 years and really loved it for how easy it makes food tracking, but I'm moving on today due to the barcode scanner being put behind a paywall. Taking away features that users have been relying on for free for years, to put behind a paywall, shows lack of creativity on the part of the MFP team when it comes to finding ways to balance the experience of premium and free users. It has also clearly alienated many long time users like me.

Used to work fine, now forced to subscribe. A screen popped up offering free premium trial which a i had to accept in order to proceed past the screen. After this 'welcome back' screen popped up and every time I accept what's on it, it goes away for few seconds and then reappears again and again. Totally useless. It used to work fine maybe a year back. Now I need to find a way to cancel the subscription since I can't even use the app...

So easy to use! I've used the website before but the app is even easier! Especially like the barcode scanner for packaged foods. UPDATE Removed 1 star: Annoyingly I have found that exercise entered disappears randomly. I enter it at the start of the day and half way through it's gone, or look back at the week and notice exercise calories no longer showing. I deleted and reinstalled the app, so now waiting to see what happens....

I recently got a watch to track how much I burn when working out and how many calories extra I need to eat, when the app logs how much I've burnt it always doubles up, I try to delete the extra exercise it adds but it keeps on coming back and it gets so annoying! Like for example say I burn 100 calories in 20 minutes, it logs that on but then keeps on adding that I've worked out for 20 minutes over and over again. Great app altogether, just the exercise bit needs a bit of fixing!

I used to love my fitness pal! But ever since the update, the add in the diary just takes up too much space because it not only shows an add, it also shows the text "say goodbye to ads" and then another block for "go premium". It takes up half my screen, checking what I have logged for the day becomes so annoying. Just one bar for the add would have been enough!

Review edit: Something has seriously gone wrong. Scans and nutritional data are woefully inaccurate. The recommendations, post scan are even more frustrating and absurd. Before, scans used to remotely guide you in the right direction, however, now, scan results are no where near correct, they are not even in the right ball park. Good job I can work out macros on a piece of paper, because this mess is seriously making me consider not using this app. Shame.

I very much like this app I'm currently on a 145 days in a row streak of counting calories. But the app has some small bugs that are making me want to switch to another calories counting app. But for the convenience I like this app. I just wish that they would fix the bugs. For example I'll go on the app to count something I ate and the app will not let me add it to my total, I have to close out the app and go back on and that only sometimes fixes the problem.

The app itself is good but you have to be very careful which data you use. Usually the calories are about right but the rest of the nutritional information is either missing or wrong. I suspect that this is due to the bulk of the data being entered by users. I love the scan the barcode feature though but again you must double check that it brings up the correct data as some shops (Aldi) use the same barcode for items of the same cost. Also in the UK sodium doesn't show on products but salt does and the app doesn't cater for the calculation required.

This app is very helpful in keeping track of your daily calorie intake. You can also connect it with other apps and even a fit bit (if you have one). You can also log in your own recipes and meals, which is much easier than loging in each ingredient everything you eat. And it doesn't just stop there! If there is a specific food item you can't find, you can log it in along wuth its nutritional facts. Overall, if you are looking to lose or maintain weight, this is the app for you!

I used this app when it first came out years ago. Now that I have returned to it, I'm shocked at the monthly cost (more than Netflix and Amazon combined), the ads that take up space and features that were once free like (scan barcode) are now a paid subscription. I would tell those that are downloading the app, keep the basic/free version, don't pay.

I've had this app for years and used to love it. Now it barely functions because it's so bloated with ads for premium subscription. Bar code searches crash and the app constantly freezes to the point it's unusable. I have no problem paying a reasonable price for a good app, but you've ruined it and pricing is excessive for premium version. Getting deleted!

App used to be brilliant, used it for a number of years, however the last update has caused it to constantly freeze and crash, and on occasion even required me to restart my phone. Tried uninstalling and reinstalling and the app now freezes while logging in rendering it unusable. Don't have any issues with any other apps. Really hope this is fixed soon as when it works it's brilliant and it makes keeping on top of my nutrition so much easier.

$20 A MONTH for premium, are you kidding me!? That's more than a gym membership. It's a seriously dumb decision to put the barcode scanner behind the insanely expensive subscription. I used MyFitnessPal for years but after that news, I tried out the Lose it app and love it. Their barcode scanner is great, the app is just more fluid and easy to use. And even if you want a subscription, it is actually priced so that you can afford it. $20 PER YEAR with the current sale.

This program is just so good. So many foods, so useful. Unfortunately they put ads in your feed to keep it free. I (and probably alot of over people) would happily pay an unlock fee, say $4 to get rid of the ads. People too cheap to pay the price of a coffee can keep their ads, but there are alot of us willing to pay for good quality apps. If an app deserves it, and this one does, I'm more than happy to pay a reasonable one-time cost.

I am truly impressed with the database for calorie log. They seem to have almost every food on the planet in some form or another. Sometimes the app freezes and I have to exit also the premium screen pops up everytime you open the app. I have been using the app for abt 7 days now and I hope it doesn't get more aggressive as the days progress. The price of the premium could also be more attractive. All in all, I am happy I found this app, it has been more helpful that not helpful. Thank you.

EDIT: No more glitches so 100% recommend! Genuinely love the app, it helps track calories and is very easy to use. Good workouts and meal ideas too HOWEVER the app appears to have a glitch where it CONSTANTLY asks me to update my goals and requesting permission to send emails which can make it unbearable to use!! Would get a 5 star rating if they sorted this out which I struggle to understand why they haven't done so yet!!

The option to create your own recipes and meals, for later use, has saved me lots of time and made my calorie micromanagement much more precise. Also barcode scanner - awesome! The ads and articles only appear on the home page and to be fair they are relevant. I do learn lots of nutritional facts there. The Fitbit integration is so great, the number of calories i burn through exercise are taken into account so i know exactly how much more i can eat in a very active day, without starving myself.

This is one of the best in the market. Occasionally there are bugs with the third party integrations like watches, but they get sorted out within a day or so. I love the recipe building function and the ability to copy meals from previous days. I often have the same thing for breakfast or lunch so this makes it much easier to added foods quickly.

This app is brilliant and very easy to use. I have it synced with Google Fit so that my exercise is automatically input into the app, which recalculates my suggested daily calories. It's just become natural to log my meals (either by scanning the barcodes or searching for each item) and track my progress daily. It's motivating to see your progress recorded and in graphs. I would have given the app 5 stars, however, I had the iOS version on my last phone which had a nicer design & extra features!

Was good at first but lately I have been experiencing extreme slowness and lag when tapping the "breakfast" "lunch" "dinner" (etc) buttons in order to add foods to my calorie diary. Adding foods to your daily calorie diary is the very fundamental purpose of this app to begin with so it is disappointing that the developers have not released a remedy for this yet. Responsiveness should be put above all else so daily use becomes more efficient. There is also an issue with high mobile data usage.

I love this app, used it for over a year. But the new layout with the quick add and barcode scan in the middle instead of tiny icons j the corner are really annoying. It is now actually more time consuming to add items, not less because I mostly type items not scam (not that much in my every day diet is new so its already logged). Before I would type and the first item would be there, click, done. Now I type and can't see the item because of these huge new icons. Not pleased at all..

Extremely buggy, one of the most frustrating and unreliable calorie counting apps I've used. Nothing pisses me off more than spending the time to manually input a reciepe just to have the app crash and lose all the info when you click save reciepe. So, as a warning, it is a buggy, unreliable p.o.s. app, there are better ones out there!

Great free app for watching your calories and setting goals. For that I can't fault it. One major niggle is it keeps falling out with Samsung health. One minute the 2 communicate, the next they don't. MyFitnessPal hasn't acknowledged any of my workouts through my Samsung smart watch for days now I can't understand why. Also second niggle is the fact I'm not really a fan of the "new dashboard" Thought it was much better and professional looking before. But that's just me.

It's full of ads to the point where it's unusable. The ads fill half the screen when you're in the diary tab and now you get a full screen ad after EVERY item you log and you have to wait for at least 5 seconds before you can dismiss it. Imagine if you're logging a full meal, It's gotten to the point where it's faster to just log calories on pen and paper.

Good app; very useful for keeping track of my calories; I've lost over a stone and a half in less than two months by recording everything I consume in this app. I love that it imports exercise activies from Strava and from MapMyWalk/Ride - a real timesaver. It lets itself down with inconsistencies in the UI. Deleting food entries from the Diary is a simple matter of a standard Android long-press and select Delete from the context menu. In recipes, you have to Edit the recipe, then select check boxes for items you want to delete. It should just be a long-press again; and clicking any ingredient should take you into editing that item, when it actually does nothing. Also,, in the Diary I can enter 100 servings of 1g, which is great in some scenarios. If I do this in a recipe, when I save the recipe, it will alter it to 1 serving of 100g. This is not what I want and the app should leave it alone (!), just as it does in the Diary. "Add to Diary" from a recipe should do just that: it doesn't need yet another "Add Recipe" intermediate step which has be actioned. ps There's no E in "tomato" ! - "tomatoes", yes. "tomato", not so much.

Would have been 5 stars but I'm sick of having a massive advert in the middle of the app. It didn't used to be there, last time I used this app, so I'm pretty annoyed about it. Otherwise the app is good, it's got every food I've ever tried to enter and you can add exercise ect which is great as it removes those calories from your overall total.

It used to be amazing. Now, it's riddled with premium forced on you and location tracking prompts that don't stop with no way to say 'never show again.' it's not longer simple to use. Update: the intrusive ads are rediculous. You should not get an ad when you hit ad food, or other important actions. They are put in places to seemingly trick you into clicking them - they often appear just as you are going to naturally push a button.

Great app but it could be made a lot easier to use when it comes to entering the goods. For example, fresh foods like vegetables, meats etc should have a generic nutritional values ready to go. So you can enter 100grams of broccoli and it's there ready to go, not have a list of 15 different broccoli entries, some in cups, some in oz. And some in grams etc.

Still some room for improvement and steps no longer sync for me but great for diet tracking with a huge crowd sourced database. Lowered my rating due to syncing issues that seem to be widespread and MFP doesn't seem to be in any rush to fix. I'm also disappointed that MFP has so much potential- to add additional useful features yet it hasn't happened in the 2.5 years I've used it.

I'm really enjoying using this app. at first I found it a bit tricky to navigate, but once I got used to it, it's a breeze. love the breakdown of nutrients, olus thr barcode scanner, and the create a recipe part, where it works out calories for you. It's a shame that the strenght section doesn't calculate calories (as far as I can tell anyway) but I just goodle for estimated calories during strength training and add it under cardio instead under a created exercise. Fab for loosing weight !

I've been using the app for 3 years and it has consistently improved. The blog is interesting and useful. The core functionality for counting calories was good and has been updated with the introduction of barcode scanning proving to be really useful. Finally it links with my fitness tracker and gives me a good guide through the day as to how to manage eating and exercising. Thoroughly deserves a 5 star rating.

Been using this app for a couple of years. If you just want a basic calorie counter/food diary/weight tracker, the free version works well. The Premium version is around £40/year, but check out what you get for that price before committing, because once you're used to what you get on Premium, you might not want to go back to the free version, so make sure you can afford the subscription fee.

Thanks for fixing the issue with completing the diary. I've upgraded but now the exercise is not syncing with Google Fit. I have uninstalled/installed, disconnected/connected both apps to no avail :(. Previous review: For some time now, the app gives a message of alert when I tap complete diary and sends me to the main website, which doesn't work either. I was thinking of going for the paid option but not sure any more.

Fix the app!! Used to love this app and would regularly use it to log meals. Now, all it does it ask me if I want to upgrade to premium. I understand they need to make money but I'm willing to withstand some ads for the sake of it being free, certainly not paying 19.99 a month for extra features that are not worth it. The app is virtually unusable now with what I can only assume is a bug. Needs fixing and maybe I'll come back to it, otherwise, for now I'm deleting it and looking at other apps.

Frustrating. The app does not link reliably with the fitbit app, meaning that sometimes you will see your excercise sync to your diary, and other times you just won't. I cannot complete a diary entry, I always receive an error message. Sometimes when entering food it will just duplicate it so you end up with three lots of lunch items, three dinner items etc. I have uninstalled and reinstalled the app multiple times and this does not solve the problem. I now cannot even log into the app!

I have used this app (and website) on and off for near a decade as a calorie/nutrition counter. It does what it's meant to, and does it well. The library of foods has grown with time, most things barcode scan which is handy. But you will find whatever through a manual search for things anyway. I've never experienced things like crashing, bugs or otherwise in my time using it. In the past i did have issue with me being in a non US timezone and items getting allocated on wrong days but no more 5/5

Went back on for the first time in a while today - only to be confronted with an amazing amount of pop-up ads. Whatever. But then I heard that the barcode scanner - something so integral to the app, something you can happily use to lose weight even if you can't afford premium - is being locked behind a paywall? The barcode scanner that you've benefitted from members of the community adding to? Why not try adding better features if you want people to buy premium, instead of taking things away?

Update: Thanks for reverting back to showing brands for easier selection. Great app. Ease of use due to massive database accumulated over the years. Love the barcode scanner and ability to save homemade recipes and download internet recipes. ------------------------------- I prefer the app before the update, where the brand of food is visible for selection. After the update one is forced to click through all the selections to find the item one needs eg brand of soup. This makes it cumbersome.

Money money money.... disabling the barcode scanner just means you have gone against what this app was meant to do - make food logging easy. Even with all your ads and toxic reminders of ads and upgrades, i still had results and was willing to use it. You have completely made it useless unless someone pays for it. Absolutely appalling to have used it for over 10 years and thats how you say "Thanks" for my loyalty! 🤦🏻‍♂️ You forgot about when you started and what you were!

I am using this app for a week now and it seems great. It is easy and user friendly but there are few problems that I have faced are: 1) It is not interacting with Samsung Health the way I've selected options. It is not sharing exercise and diet data from/to Samsung Health. 2) Too many different nutrition values make it difficult to select as there is gross variation in calorie and also micro nutrition values are missing in most of entries Overall a good app.

User-friendly. Useful for losing weight. I've learnt a lot about how foods are made up and what I should be eating. Would be useful if it could remember more of my common items. It remembers my protein powder as a recent item but if I try to add my protein powder when I create a recipe, it doesn't remember it and I have to scan the barcode. It's not a big deal but annoying.

Overall I love this app. It's easy to use and has decent functionality within the free version. Things I would like to see improved are more monitoring and editing of the food database - some conflicting info there due to multiple user submissions - the ability to copy individual food entries (not just meals ) to other days or meals, and visible integration of tracking net carbs. But on the whole the app is awesome and extremely useful.

Its pretty good. The best I've seen so far. It just feels a little clunky sometimes, the interface is not as smooth or efficient as I think it could be. But like I said, no else is better and they get the job done. Update: I won't change the rating, but I find it clunker now, with the introduction of the homepage tab that defaults as the startup. I really want to head straight to the diary and log - now there is an extra step. I would prefer an option of where to start.

Used to love the ease of this app, but since updating it during the week, it's a fight to enter any details as it keeps changing the screen asking me to take the premium trial, hit back out of it only to have to confirm my targets, then that I don't want emails to get back to the home screen to go through that at least once more before being able to key the food - PLEASE SORT! EDIT I now consider myself lucky if I only have to go through that malarky twice, yesterday I had to go through it 7!

Definitely works as a motivational tool to help maintain or lose weight, which is my goal. However, couple of some things that would improve usability, hence loss of couple of stars: If I'm adding food at 0730, it's not going to be for the last meal I recorded calories on, dinner, why not default to brrakfast? If I am adding breakfast details, why does the 'most recent foods list' not give me previous breakfast items at top of list.. not last nights dinner items?

Started out as an amazing app to complete my daily food tracking. Was easy to add what I wanted with the scan function. Reason for the 2 stars however is after so long of using the app, it now, every time I submit my daily calories, always says I will be 95.5lbs. The only other message is that I don't eat enough calories. It frustrating it seems to default now so I really can't tell if I am on track or not. I have looked for app updated and there are none.

Never counted calories in my life and the thought of it seemed boring and complicated. I tried this app after a recommendation from a friend and I'm finding it easy to track. I've tried WW and SW but they don't educate you on calories. I've eaten foods that previously was too expensive in points and I've lost weight. I actually feel more in control of what I eat with this app and so far so good!

I have used the app since March and it's a great app to keep track of your meals and calories count. Regrettably does not sync well with fit bit, therefore the exercises calories are not included into the daily calories count. Lately the "personalise" window pops up, and does not recognise the commands either "ask me later" or "accept all" this makes the app unusable. I have uninstall and reinstalled the app twice, with no success. I hope this gets fixed soon, as it's a handy app!

I used this app years ago and loved it. It's the only app I have successfully lost weight with, but it lost two stars for the permissions you have to sign to use it. I am not comfortable with the amount of access I had to give to be able to use it. I almost deleted it on the spot and am looking for another app I like as much. The data I had to give them access to makes my skin crawl...actually I'm going to revoke my permission right now. Bye MyFitnessPal.

A useful tool, but there is a lot of inaccurate calorie and nutrition counts in your search results, and the ads are very, very invasive. I don't want a premium account because it comes with stuff I don't want. I don't need macros. I don't want all that, and I don't want to pay for it. But the ads make the diary entry screen smaller than a 90s flipphone. With a better type of premium (tier is the added info of the current system, and a smaller rate for just removing ads) I'd rate it higher.

Unable to NOT do the premium trial - I've used this app on my iPhone for a few years. I've switched to android, and have newly downloaded the app and signed in. I'm not able to access the app at all - the 'try premium' screen has no way around it, so I can't access the free elements of the app at all. Uninstalling now, which is really disappointing as I've enjoyed this app for a long time, but I refuse to be pushed into putting my credit card details in.

Incredibly difficult to log in foods, the options are 'servings', 'pieces', cups... if you want to spend 10 minutes doing maths every time you want to log food, it may be for you. Adding grams would've so simple, weight the food, log it in, done. It didn't even sync with Samsung health, searching for solutions it seems to be a common problem. App deleted.

The best part about this is it has the most comprehensive calories database on food. I wanted to use it to track my fitness progress. But the app is buggy. I can't input the weight value beyond two digits. Maximum I could put for the dumbbell weight is 9kg. And you can't meaningfully track your progress or calories expenditures without the correct weight. Will change my rating if they get around to fix this, but I highly doubt it.

I'm using the free version and it does absolutely everything I need! I love that I can add my own workouts. The only thing I can suggest is to add other apps such as gym tracker (possibly not able because a competitive clause) or all trails as I hike a ton and have to input my own stuff. Also can't properly input said hikes as there are no accurate logs available.

Excellent app. Just a few things I feel let it down 1. When you click on a previously added food, I wish it told you the time you submitted it. This way you can see the exact time you ate, this would help with protein time tracking. 2. The Premium version I'd happily pay £5.99 for, but for me £15.99 a month is ridiculous. The extra features, like scanning products (which if u had the app a while ago you can still use for free) just doesn't justify the price for me. All in all 4/5

Instead of adding useless features to the app to make it look very cutting edge, how about you fix the important ones that do not work? For example, creating a recipe. When you add an ingredient, it doesn't show up immediately. You have to add a second one in order to see the previously added ingredient. The unit measurements are just a mess to deal with it and take too many clicks. Many foods don't have grams measuremen. Recipes don't have grams as well, only servings. It's a hard pass from me.

This is a great app for keeping an eye on your food intake. Easy to use the scan feature to find items quicker. Also some good content for tips, recipes and plans/challenges. I wish the premium was a little cheaper, I would upgrade if it were. There is an issue at the moment with syncing, I use Samsung health for all my steps/exercise and steps have stopped syncing. Hopefullynthat will be fixed so I will leave the 5* for now.

I'm new to counting calories and limiting my daily intake. My goal is to lose ten pounds by June and this app has been really helpful so far. I have a good diet already (Vegetarian/vegan) so my food is considerably healthy but I always had issues with portion control. This app helped me understand serving sizes and I don't feel limited by my daily goal. I've cut back on "snacking because I'm bored". This app does not substitute exercise. So make sure you're still getting physical activity in.

This is a great app to track calories/nutrients and exercise. I've recently used it to help with a keto challenge and I lost 14lbs. I would not have been able to make this progress without the help of myfitnesspal. Adding food is a bit tricky as there are so many variations. I was specifically measuring potassium content and some of the foods which have potassium were not listed as such, so there was a bit of searching for something I could add.

Fails without internet. This makes it useless for me. Cannot add weight or even make entries for items in recent history. Should have some limited functionality without being tied to internet access. Big failing. Cannot find upgrade price anywhere. Reeks of scam. I would never pay for this and the continuous stream of rubbish they force you to view on the home screen.

After a few steps it links well with the Fitbit app, sending calorie counts across easily... which is good because the MyFitnessPal app manages to find all the food with a barcode and automatically has all the nutritional information and serving sizes ready to go. Sometimes it has out of date info (new recipes of some food?) and you have to adjust accordingly. Most of the time though this app is a godsend. If only the Fitbit app had this app's barcode scanner.

I love this app. It's so easy to use and has all sorts of foods and international cuisine and the vast majority of items are correctly recorded (I usually check with other resource as well). I can even look up things in Bulgarian and there is plenty. The app also connects with my Samsung watch which makes it super easy to track calorie intake vs. burned calories.

Ever since the update the app won't even open anymore. Edit: I appreciate the reply of the developer. The problem was resolved like with a new update. Edit: All of a sudden there's ads all the time. I'm just going to start using my fitbit app to track my food. Very disappointed because I've been using this app for years. But we're in the days of can't pay for the full thing let's try annoying into paying a subscription.

The UI isn't great and there's lots that could be improved which hasn't despite the number of years this app has been around. The premium version doesn't really give you anything different either. Great for checking the info for a food (if it's in the database theres a lot of misinformation in here too so be careful) and tracking calories/macros, but not for anything else. That said still prob the best tracker there is just don't link it to anything else like garmin etc as it tries to be smart!

Great way of understanding what you eat, before this app I was totally unaware and amazed that some foods I thought were healthy actually weren't and visa versa. A bit of a task at first adding meals, recepies, scanning barcodes etc, but once set up becomes a breeze to complete your daily diary. Works in well with other excersise apps. A constant reminder to cut down on that alcohol! You have to be vigilant and honest for real progress.

Does more than I need it to do. Some times it gets the baroda scans wrong, however you can create your own from the product labels. Would be useful if it grouped each meal type items to make it easier to add regular food. All in all it is helping me retain with in my target calorie intake and links well with my Garmin with regards execsise. Keep up the good work.

All the recent changes are negative. It's trying to be some alternative social media platform. It runs slower. Pop up ads were added. I can't share meals or recipes with my wife anymore. It's a blank post instead of an option to copy her meal. But I can send likes and emoji. Wow, great. They want to downgrade your experience until they force you to get an even more bloated premium version with features I don't need.

It keeps throwing me back to the goal and stat screen many times before it lets me do anything. Super annoying. And I just realised they have removed the option of controlling your macros in the free version. And from what I remember even when you could, it would still give you annoying warnings about foods being high in fat... when you're on a high-fat--low-carb diet. I'm uninstalling.

Excellent app with many features. I like the ability to write posts to ourselves or perhaps it could be published on a Facebook page or other social media platforms if we chose. Current studies indicate that the more one looks at a program like this on a daily basis the one more is to actually lose and maintain weight. I have discovered this recently and we'll be following up this by trying to use the application every single day.

I normally love this app as it tracks everything (food and exercise) in such a convenient, user-friendly way. But in the past couple of months I haven't been able to add any new meals so I haven't been able to track new recipes. It's highly frustrating. I have uninstalled and re-installed, I have used 'force stop' but nothing seems to work.

Comprehensive lists of foods and being able to scan barcodes is useful. There are a lot of missing features on the free version but Pro is far, far too expensive (there are others that you can download pro from a few pounds). Perhaps they should consider a one off fee semi pro version? I like that it links with map my walk and Garmin, although ling with both caused it to register the same excercise twice. Now just using as a calorie counter as have a Fitbit which auto records excercise.

The calorie tracker is great but recently it has been so laggy and sometimes when I try to use it, it freezez then force quits multiple times. Everytime this happens, I have to uninstall and then install it again, sign in again, then I keep getting tutorial prompts and that is just so irritating. I only stick around because it has the best database for food and some personalised foods/meals that I added.

This app is great for tracking macronutrients(and micros if you enter those as well). Huge data base and very easy to manually enter. My only complaint is how much data it uses. If I open the app to enter one meal it uses anywhere from 60-120mb of data. I only use the app when I'm on wifi after seeing it was the highest user by far per month.

Great tool to keep track of your eating habits. I've tried a few other apps but I keel coming back to my fitness pal. it just offers so much functionality even in the free version. my favorite part is when you complete a food diary and get an estimation on your weight in a few weeks, it's really encouraging. the blog posts with workouts and healthy recipes are also fantastic!

From the pay wall for many of the beneficial features to the insanely inaccurate measures for many of the everyday foods, I really don't rate this app. The app itself runs well, is well designed and easy to use (which is why I have it 2 stars), but if I wanted to go in and record all my own weights measures and reasonable standard portions, then I'd just design my own spreadsheet or database.

Sooo helpful in tracking what you eat! I love that it has a large food database and your able to search for foods using the barcodes. I also love that the app does all the math for you when you change potion sizes. However, I do wish that it synced better with my Samsung Health (I have to put in calories burned manually) and I wish it worked offline.

Got the free version and it's just what I was looking for. Can put my exercise in and it adds the burned calories onto allowance so can either use them or save them to lose more weight. This is really helping me to shift the few pounds I want and I'm being alot more aware of when I snack on things unnecessary and it's working. I'd highly recommend this app!

Ok so for months this app is not syncing with other apps. Numerous conversations back and forth with support and nothing was getting sorted. So I do a review on here, and like instantly the situation is sorted, it's syncing, and all is good. That lasted for a couple days and now the same issue is back, not syncing. I'm done. Many other people have the same issue.

I have used MyFitness pal for 10 years and always loved it. Untill October 1st when the barcode scanning tool was no longer available unless you pay €21 per month for premium. Seriously? €21 per month is expensive to begin with, a lot of us literally can't afford it right now, taking away this tool that has always been free to use and was probably the most useful tool from the whole app is super greedy. Really disappointing. Won't be using this app anymore.

Pretty impressive app, but increasingly the data quality for the foods listed as ever more people add variations for basically the same foods is getting to be a problem. They really could do with having a cull of obvious duplicate entries. I also find the "can't complete diary entry with less than 1200 calories recorded" highly irritating.. Ok to issue a message or even a caution, but to block the action entirely is really crappy, especially when on a VLCD.

Terrible working recently. I have used MFP for years intermittently, I was using it every day for a month or so but from the update last week it is a nightmare. The fitbit sync doesn't work on the app, I have logged on through the web and it reflects here. It's so annoying. Also food diary was making multiples and not allowing me to delete and when I tried on the website it would show a maintenance page!

easy to use, amazed at vast amount of nutritional info available just by scanning bar code. Have yet to come access a not found. would consider buying it but at $10 a month find that too expensive. I find the unsolicited motivational announcement's a bit disconcerting. are they for me, or in the public domain. overall the app is helping me with counting calories and " pushing away from the table". After 7 months of use latest version of app is excruciatingly SLOW.

Have been using the app for 5 years.. I lost approdimately 4 stone.... easily, and have maintained ever since. This app changed my life and my future.. No significant changes to my diet as opposed to a little less on portion size. If you log it honestly and regularly you will make the changes you need to succeed. Love that it connects to my fit bit, if I move more I can eat more! Consume less move more. Back to basics!

I've been using this app for a few years now because it had the largest database and I've already loaded a lot of foods and recipes. It's very disappointing how they stopped improving it. The app has practically the same functionality of when I first started using it years ago but it's getting slower with more ads. Also, it's asking for unnecessary permissions. It's getting worse. Very slow, often unresponsive and crashing. Update: Now it's forcing me to sign up for premium.

Great app, really helps me keep to a diet and easy to use. Update: switched to the premium version, and the additional features really help me keep on track. Due to a medical condition, the additional information helps me manage my condition better too. My only issue is there is not a calorie counter/calculator for the majority of workouts/exercises. I'd like to suggest a liquid section to the diary, as I currently have to add liquids to my meals, so it would be nice to have a separate section

The food diary has been a bit buggy, not correctly entering food - I've had to repeatedly enter items that don't show up. I don't like the limitations on what exercise you can add. It hasn't seemed to pick up any of the exercise I've been doing from the linked Samsung Health App. I cant seem to add personal information that affects how I should be exercising eg. pregnancy or post pardum or breast feeding. But great prompts to remind you to log food and great variety of food and exercises.

The app is great for watching the calorie intake. The database for different food products is vast and in the mobile the UX is simple and everything is just a few clicks away. But there are huge downsides when it comes to connecting third-party apps (e.g. Runkeeper, MapMyRun, Google Fit). MFP either collects your exercise data from e.g. Google Fit or it doesn't. This is why I dropped the premium and set the calorie goal to include the volume of exercise I do on average each day.

I'm enjoying the app. Putting one star because of the nasty tonsil stones ads. I'm usually logging my food before eating, I'd enjoy not seeing that before my meal. Other than that it's pretty easy to use, mostly accurate at least accurate enough for me. It's helpful to realize how much I'm eating and how small things do add up. Would be 4-5 stars without the ads. Edit: I'm not getting these ads anymore! I've been using this app for a couple of weeks now and it's definitely great!

Used this app and loved it almost 2 years ago . Lots of issues now with it , won't recognise my Fitbit tracker as it says linked to an account already , which when I changed phones did not transfer over ,meaning I had to reload app. After a few attempts to rectify this ,it would appear there is no-one available at Myfitness to help. Also the scan barcode is now no longer available to free users , I feel this is a big mistake . Very disappointed.

Potentially good app but in a mess at the moment. Every time I open it I have to say no I don't want premium, yes save my goals and then no I don't want emails. I have to do this five or six times for each before I can even get into the app which is most frustrating. And even once you are in it you could be half way through logging food and the go premium will pop up again. It really isn't acceptable and if not sorted soon I will be deleting for a less in your face, invasive app

Disappointed. I used this about 2 years ago, and back then it was really good and easy to use. Now I'm trying to get back into it, but the app lags too much. I had to force exit the app multiple times when I was trying to log my food diary. I understand the ads are necessary when we're using the free ver., but they bombard the screen to the point of me accidentally clicking on some of them. Guess I'll have to find another alternative.

I use this to mainly track calorie intake but recently it stopped syncing with Garmin Connect. It only updates the calories on the first time. This makes calorie counting very inconvenient, and I only use MyFitnessPal to calorie count. On top of that, I paid the premium. When it was free I didn't have so many problems with it. I think the dev team is cashing out or paying out investors. I won't be around next year if this isn't fixed. I feel a bit cheated.

Love the Food Diary and the food database is so comprehensive . The only downside is that it does not sync my Fitbit steps which is a major issue. I would also like the check in function on the app so I can manually add my steps if they can't fix this problem. *Update: new Garmin tracker syncs perfectly and I am getting back to enjoying a regular exercise routine and better eating habits. I honestly couldn't be happier with this APP now.

It can be a bit tedious when making a meal adding all the ingredients but if it's something you eat regularly you can save meals and to save time. It tells you everything you need to know for tracking all of your macros but it's not that good for tracking exercises but on a whole it's great for what I need, and made me aware how easy it is to consume too many calories.

It has stopped allowing me to finish my day on my diary. I was able to finish on the first day, on my android phone. I get an error message saying it can't complete as it can't connect to the server. I can log it on my computer, but that isn't the convenient way I use the app. Also, the app and the computer app don't sync, so I get 2 different days. I contacted the devs and no one got back to me. Its a real shame, as I won't continue after the free trial.

I was on to this app a while back & used it pretty much daily & it's been a massive help for my weight loss journey. I didn't use it for a bit due to being in hospital & on holiday. Now I'm home I've gone back on it & am so disappointed, putting the barcode scanner behind a paywall is such a terrible idea. I get the pop-up ads, they're on every free version of an app so I'm used to that, but the barcode scanner paywall!! Edit:Never complained about the ads - clearly not reading reviews properly!

Used this app a few years and must say I am impressed by the changes to platform for recording food, creating recipes and logging water! Biggest issue is that you need to watch that the carbs, protein and fat in the food list are realistic. Where possible, use foods with green stars or better still, use the barcode scanner - which is an awesome feature!

When I just installed it wasn't working very well. But after rebooting a couple of times it worked and I really liked it! I like that you can introduce your recipes and meals. It also has lots of recipes and excersice videos. It's also very nice that many of the features are free. I really recommend this app to follow your calorie consumption.

App stopped working with my Fitbit well over a year ago and no troubleshooting worked. Eventually, it escalated to full page pop up ads with hard to locate close buttons every single time I would log a food or exercise. Now, they're gating the barcode scanner behind their exorbitantly priced paid subscription. I just bought an entire year of premium subscription on another app for $12.99, which is half the cost of ONE MONTH of MFP premium. Absolutely greedy. Recommend avoiding this one.

I've been using for 3+ months now. It has a great database and tool for food tracking. But it's incredibly bloated and very slow. Every single click seems to take 5-15 seconds to load, meaning I often double click thinking I've missed the button, and end up duplicating information. I would never pay for premium with how slow it runs all the time. I've only stuck with this app over other food tracking apps because I've put time into entering my meals and recipes already. I would probably change app if I decide to keep it more long term.

I use it to track my food....and has the most annoying interface to find something and add it. The community entered data is all muddled with quality data making it hard to figure what's right and what's not. I wish adding meals was much easier than what it is. Id have liked to see more stats, reports and other interesting data insights.... nothing available. really sad app, but the only one that works with garmin....which is unfortunate

Have used this app since 2016! Untill now it's been fab (5 stars). But latest update as seriously scuppered the functionality. E.g. search no longer searches for new items, it either goes round and round (can't reach your server?), or it only returns historic logged items and recipes. I've tried everything to make it work, including checking my device is connected to network correctly. Marked down to 2 stars as I can't use it properly anymore.

The food database is great but I don't like the app. It's usability is bad. How many taps until you finally enter the foods you had? Why are the recipes the button in the middle of the lowe menu? Everything is harder than it has to be. Plus, they have their articles from their blog, but if you want to open one in a browser to bookmark you can't.

Been using this for years and it's been reliable so that's why I have given the application 2 stars. However, if it was solely based on the performance of the application in the last month, I would only give it 1 star. This application is not reliable and does not prove to be robust. The application freezes more often than it works and sends your phone into lockdown. Massive improvement is needed. On that note: anyone know of any other food tracking apps?

I love this app for losing weight! Its easy to find almost every type of food in the database and whatever they don't have its easy to add. I think in nearly 3 months using it I've had to add maybe 2 items, which is saying a lot, because I tried other apps that didn't have any of my local foods. It's easy to track your weight and food intake and really encouraging to see your progress over time on the graphs. I don't use it for exercise tracking although that also seems pretty straightforward.

As useful as the app is at counting your calories, my time is constantly interrupted by the free trial premium advert. After selecting no to this advert, the app then asks me to update my weight details even when I select that I don't need to be reminded. This problem repeats itself up to 3 or more times a minute. The app also doesnt sync Samsung health correctly. Please fix these issues and then I'd be tempted to give you more stars!

This app is really easy to use, makes keeping track of what you eat easy with the scanner and is very customisable ... When it works. I've had this app for years, and since i downloaded it on my phone again recently, it can take up to 5-6 minutes to load, it wad almost 10 minuted just to accept all the data stuff when you first install and now it wont let me finish my daily diary. I can log stuff, but not finish the day. Shame, its such a helpful app other than that.

Very useful to keep my OCD about food at bay, and the free version has enough for most people who are not super into macro tracking. The app does its job very well But it also has always been rather slow. Especially the last few updates. When I purchased my phone last year summer it was a very solid mid range device. Still, sometimes when I tap on something in MFP I have to wait several SECONDS for it to respond.

Been using this app on and off for years and will now deleting. If you aren't a paid member it's pretty much useless unless you want to be bombarded with ads. Formerly ad-funded free features are now paywalled, but there are more ads than ever for less features. The tech has also gone backwards, integrations that were easy to connect no longer the case. Nothing "freemium" about it, don't waste your time with it, there are better options out there. It's probably a great app if you can afford it.

I only use the food dairy part. Which whilst this is great to do that I do wish it separated the food dairy into 3 separate snacks and 3 separate meals. I also find searching for the right option to be difficult as so many things have been entered in incorrectly or there are multiple options of the same thing but only offer the measurements in cups instead of grams etc. I would love to be able to search a product and then filter by brand or something.

I love this app and it would have been five stars if it didn't have so many bugs. My biggest issue with it is that it's recently been disconnecting from S Health everytime the app is opened. It's very inconvenient to have to manually connect them everytime I use the app. The second it that the app takes forever to load through wifi, I often find myself resorting to mobile data.

No free barcode scanner. That's a deal breaker considering all other apps offer it. It does have a lot of local foods, but not all. Best variety of widgets but no customization like transparency. When you connect a health service, it doesn't count all steps but only those from automatically logged longer walks or ones you manually input. It also looks like you have to actively tap on it for it to pull that health data.

Edit, the adding of barcode scan behind a paywall has killed this app. Don't even bother. Spammed by ads, whenever adding food, full screen ads pop up. App doesn't link with step tracking well, makes up random numbers, it used to work but now support tells me it's working correctly (by putting random calories in, or sometimes none at all). More and more food is displaying the wrong nutritional information, too. Honestly this app is garbage now.

Annoying interface even on premium. When I open it with the purpose to enter in my activity, it pops up ads for me to sign up fitness classes or something (not upgrade to premium as dev reply suggests) which have to be dismissed for me to accomplish my goal. This is with the premium trial, but app behavior that I expect from a free product. If I were to pay for it, I expect to be able to disable those ads and have a seamless experience. Absolutely not going to pay for it when the trial is over.

Typically don't want to give a decent app 1 star. Infact I rarely review apps and have never done so negatively. The app works, it's good, I liked it and it helped a lot. Butttttt, given the incoming awful business decision to put a barcode scanner which was always free behind a paywall - trash for so many reasons. Not supporting it. I just paid for a year up front in June so it wasn't going to be an issue for me. But can't support this, so I've moved to loseit and won't be returning to MFP.

I've come and gone from MFP multiple times since 2015 with my last effort being the most consistent. The program does help you stay accountable to yourself and to reach your goals. Finding some food is difficult when you're eating at a place which haven't uploaded their menu to the database, but there is such a big library that you can find comparable items (or add them yourself). The recipe feature is good but you need to double check the ingredient values as that is often imported incorrectly.

It does a lot. But the menu system is confusing making it hard to do the things I want to do, for example when I cook a meal at home there is no obvious way to share nutritional info with my partner, sometimes it works via the 'friend diary', mostly it doesn't. The premium app is also very expensive (non premium is unusable due to ads), for that kind of money the user interface should be more streamlined, allowing for a front page that's customizable with something other than just goals!

I have used this app off and on for years. It was hands down the best one for trackig my protein in meals. However, they have blocked most of the features now (that used to be FREE) and now require you to pay to access most of the features including scanning the barcodes. What a money grab. Will find a new and FREE way to continue tracking my food.

Very overpriced £15.99 per month or £64.99 per year, many cheaper options about for keto. It used to be a fraction of the price, and many features were free, I happily paid for the premium a few years ago it was 1/4 of the price being asked for now. What you guys are asking for is quite shocking, and many other users have highlighted this problem.

Back in the day, before ads were so prominent in apps, MyFitnessPal was a 5 star product. Nowadays half the features are locked behind a paywall. Now, I understand, you gotta make money, that's a given, but some features are just so basic it's mind-numbing why they would be a premium one. That said, this is still one of the best, if not the best, calorie counter apps out there, I do recommend it.

The paid version is definitely worth the money as you can set goals via macros (carb, protein, and fats) versus just calories. Saves a lot of time to help keep me on my nutrition goals. You could be hitting your calorie goals but be way off with what kind of calories you are putting in. Most foods are inputted you can edit and creat meals to easily add each day. My favorite feature is scanning barcords so it takes the guessing out of everything!

Really great app for tracking macros and calorie consumption but the downfall I feel is that although it has the option of weight gain it is still very geared toward weight loss as opposed to healthy weight gain which is what I am looking for. It makes you feel bad when you have gone over your calorie goal even though that is my aim. Otherwise great app and I will still continue to use it.

really useful app when it comes to tracking. I make all of mine and my partners meals and so it's good that I can create meals then share them so that he can log his. the blogs are really useful too. only gave a 4 star as it isn't as user friendly as it could be. the downside is you can easily get it wrong when searching for food (need to look for the genuine star) as people cn create their own food source. You want to make sure you're as accurate as possible.

It's an excellent app. I just wish that adding servings for created recipes is not so complicated. And I think it would be great if we could adjust entries for our own log, for example adjusting the protein or sugar amount in food, but just for our own diary, not the food entry itself, because some of the information in entries can be wrong, and I'd have to create the food all over again just to enter the right information. Thank you!

The app is ok, but has issues. Will not allow a log on when on WiFi, have to turn WiFi off to open the app. Is very flakey when connecting to other devices, have to reload and reconnect multiple times, and then has issues updating the information, such as exercise through Google Fit.
