Then the amount of ads and rubbish on the home page. You have to go Premium to get rid of them, why such an expensive cost ? and monthy subscription ? I would pay a one off cost for this...but not the ongoing fees.

I've used this app before and lost 40 lbs. Great for tracking calories. One of the best features was the barcode scanner that made it quick to add food and make sure you where selecting the right product because depending on what you search up it can be easy to sometimes choose the wrong entry with the wrong nutrient profile. Now, the scanner that has been free since the beginning is behind a pay wall!!!!! Really? There are ads on every page (fine), but the most useful feature is £18 a month!!!

This app is far from good. The most important problem in my opinion is that it displays the goal of Monosaturated and Polysaturated fats as 0, and prompts you to eat less of them, while it has an actual goal for saturated fats. The opposite should be true, since Polysaturated and monosaturated fats are healthier (check it out yourself). Also problems often appear (network errors) while searching the database for foods. Promotions of the premium version are somewhat intrusive as well.

Layout is space-inefficient, especially with the ad up and bottom menu placement/design. Database is great for pulling up barcoded foods, but finding an accurate entry for other ingredients can be a huge pain. Also, not enough quality control. Too many users input foods with volumetric measurements (cup, tsp, etc.) which can be wildly inaccurate and a pain to sift through when searching

love this app. I use it in free version and it's fantastic to count calories, quantity of daily nutrients and % of meals. It's really helpful to better manage in the proper way your nutrition. Thanks to this app I've improved my eating habits. I really suggest it to everyone! Only defect found on app is that somethimes food inserted not appear but it's still counted. There is a bug to solve. Suggestion !

It's amazing! Honestly the amount I've learned about calories and food in general with this app is not to be understated. Being able to so easily track my food is awesome. I love the pop up tips when adding food. Also connecting to the fitbit app is fantastic. It adds my steps right into my live numbers without needing to open the fitbit app (once you connect it the first time, close and open all the apps) All around awesome app. Keep up the great work!

MFP is great and does work well. But the app has mediocre UX. Eg, quickly adding multiple calorie counts when cooking is probably best done by just opening a calculator app before entering into MFP because there's no arithmetic support and quick adding is slow. Many database entries annoyingly don't allow weight as a unit despite being most reliable and easiest to track. Don't use exercise tracking. It's very inaccurate. Barcode scanning is the best feature.

Easy to use, & adaptable. Linked to fitness tracker on smart watch & phone, this app helps achieve / maintain goals. I have the yearly subscription version, & have used this app for 8 years, it has improved over that time & is more than just a food diary. Love the barcode scanner for the diary the ease of adding your own meals, & the huge database available. The nutrition & fitness videos, recipes, workout tips etc. are more useful than I thought they'd be.

EDIT: 1 star now for messing up the connection to Samsung Health! I'm a subscriptor, but big mistake making barcode scanner a paid feature. I started using the app free and I wouldn't have subscribed if that was the case back then. Now there's some new update and I can't even record my water consumption! How difficult it is to record that? Changing the old functioning way for a fancy one that doesn't work and not even lets you set the quantity you use the most? Don't fix something that works!

Used MFP for years on an iPhone with zero issues. Switched to Android about a year ago, everything was fine up until around a month or so ago. The app freezes, crashes, won't add foods or sometimes adds food twice, it's being extremely slow most of the time and it's become a pain to log every day. Reinstalling the app as suggested to other users did nothing. I'm about to go find another app for logging if this doesn't change soon, sadly 😔

Extremely frustrating to use when trying to add any food or creating your own because the app freezes multiple times and then asks you to close it. It even happens when you have just opened the app and added one food/meal. It can often take 5-10minutes just to put in your meals for the day and even more if you are planning for the week. I have been trying to add a meal which is of four items and it still isn't working after me trying for an hour... Worst app I have used.

I loved my fitness pal it was so streamlined and now whoever thought the changes were a good idea. It's like a course in what not to do to succeed with app growth. The ads are so messy and it is no longer as easy to navigate. Takes too long to bend over backwards to try and use free version. I would pay if what they charged made any sense at all, but they've priced themselves way too high for both what it offers, and what their competition offers. I feel really bad for the original app creator

I used to love this app but the new adverts are so invasive, it makes it almost unusable. Want to navigate back to add another item? Full page ad to click away from. Want to move from one screen to another? Massive ad to click away from. To add insult to injury, they're now also threatening to take away features from the free version. Awful

Good until Recently. It takes a bit of getting used to like any other app and I can see the improvements over the last 4 years. However in the last few of months they have had a syncing problem with some Android devices (mine included) which means the Android device doesn't sync with the server and nothing shows on the website. Therefore friends aren't able to see my diary and the predicted weight lose is so far out, it's useless. It seems to be taking forever to fix this problem!!

Been using it for a week now. Easy to set up and track meals with respective macros. Very helpful! A few times it automatically added my workouts calories when synced with my smartwatch and added the same workout several times. Had to turned it off. But overall, the app does it job. Also, loving the products database! Easy to put everything up.

I haven't used the app for a while. Went back today and there was an update. Now I can't log in. - 2015 Update: I still like the app, but the screen usability got way worse. I can only see 5 lines of my food diary because the bottom dashboard doesn't go away and neither does the top. Plus, the push to Premium also doesn't go away. It's become really frustrating to log anything cause you hardly can see what you are doing.

The app has a massive food library, a barcode scanner and works stable. That's on the good side, on the bad side the app is packed with adverts, way to complex, not organised, way to expensive. It's not an easy way to count calories. You need to work yourself trough the whole app step by step. Not useful for me. + big library + barcode scanner + stable build - too many adverts - unorganised - very expensive - price is different in different countries - takes you ages to understand the app

My Fitness Pal is a quick and easy way of tracking your food intake and stops me eating extra things without realising the effect on my calorie intake. I like that adding you exercise shows the increased deficit and the progress graph and where you will be in 5 weeks are very motivational. Nutrition breakdown is helpful too. The ads are a bit distracting but small "price" for free app. My only issue is I cannot get MFP to connect to my Fitbit as it used to. not sure why.

A couple years ago this was the best calorie tracking app by far. Now it is so bloated with ads its barely usable. They are going to put the barcode scanner behind a paywall in the next couple of months. The premium subscription is way more than any other calorie counter on the market. Worst part is all of the data they have for the barcode comes from user generated data. New apps have come out that are as good as this used to be. Try them first.

This app has been very effective in keeping me on track to lose weight. I've used it twice in different years and it remains just as usable. I've cut about 45 pounds with it. For those just starting, you can do it without excersize, but I highly recommend Cardio. when I ran and set it to lose 2lbs/week, I was in shape and way lighter. Although not all items are available via barcode, most are, any you could always build the item anyway. All in all, great interface and app!

The app works fine for what I want, a non invasive way to track calories. There are a LOT of entries to choose from, it can be a little overwhelming. I'd like to be able to more easily all home made meals; and haven't figured out how to copy a meal from further back than just the immediately previous day. I don't want premium, wish I could suppress the ads and offers on a daily basis instead of seeing them every time I log in (like, "remember my choice for the rest of the day " feature??

The most comprehensive food database out there. This app is best for logging food & counting calories but ads & constant invite to join premium are really annoying. Why isn't there a one-time fee to get rid of these? Also, no matter how many times I try, it will not sync & stay synced to my fitbit. No other app has trouble syncing to my fitbit except this one. Still a useful app. Just not as great as it could be

Great app. Some foods nutritional information isn't accurate though but you can put in your own foods, recipes and copy meals to save time. This has helped me lose loads of weight and because I am on the keto diet and need to calculate net carbs it's really easy with this app. Would be great if you could save a few more than 1 progress photo at a time but a minor thing and I love how you can do a side by side with the photos. Really great app.

Positive so far. I've been using it for about a week and have found it to be informative with regards to calorie content and tracking. The majority of items I've scanned are available on its database which is great. I've synced with my Fitbit app and that also works well. I think there are probably a lot of features I haven't used yet.

Uninstalling until they can sort out the login issues. Not at all surprised that now that I've given the app a 1-star rating that I've started having issues even logging into it. didn't think they would specifically go out to target people like that but i guess that's sour grapes for you. Is a very useful app the database is very well stocked with products and is easy to add things to. I do wish though that you did not need a data connection to sync to the pedometer app which is also on my phone

What the app does is fantastic. Really helps with my goals and I don't know where I would be without it. Unfortunately there are some issues which hold it back from getting 5 stars: the app has a tendency to freeze so adding in food and calories can sometimes take a lot longer than it should which is quite frustrating. It also uses a lot of battery in a short space of time and the phone gets noticeably hot when using the app for a few mins. I don't have these issues with other apps on my phone.

This is an awesome app. The only thing it doesn't do that I wish it could do is to let me scan, add and track my vitamins and natural supplements with the same accuracy that you can track food and water intake. Other than that the app is extremely easy to use. Tracking your exercise is very simple. Custumer service is responsive and the cost for the paid up is most reasonable.

Awesome! I'm into my sixth year of using this app and I can swear by it. Not only has it been a great help of getting back into shape but also helped me stay in shape afterwards and tracking my fitness over all. Easily the best fitness app out there, along with the Garmin Connect app, which it also syncs with. The only thing I would like to see would be integration with food scale (kitchen scale) apps and with more body scale apps.

Really useful so far. Unfortunately there is bad data for some food in the database no doubt entered incorrectly by well-meaning members of the public. The item you need is almost always there, but you have to ignore any obsolete or incorrect entries sometimes. The same products also appear multiple times in many cases, not always with the same data. Otherwise excellent (free version).

The app is pretty good and has been a useful tool for me. Unffortunately they are putting the barcode scanner behind a paywall, which to me is ridiculous and a horrible business decision. I (and many others) will start searching for a better alternative, which sucks because switching to a new calorie counter will be a hassle. For your sake and ours, please reconsider your decision.

Has to be one of the most (probably the most) frustrating macro/calorie tracking app on the market. €60 a year for something that randomly deletes meal and food entries when it feels like it and signs you out with the same degree of liberty. While also deleting all of your recent entries. Absolutely do not recommend. Go for Cronometer or Macro factor. Far better apps for the same price, essentially. Macro factor is slightly more expensive, but a very comprehensive app

There's a good choice of meals, it's easy to navigate in the foods, can't be connected and synced with Adidas run. Yet it doesn't always calculate vitamins correctly / doesn't calculate them at all. Also, when you click on a subtotal (eg, calcium, iron etc), it doesn't give a break down per food intake, because of which you can't really correct you nutrition. Overall, good calorie counter, that can be synced with a workout app. Not the best to understand your nutrition.

The app is good for tracking your macros, but it's SO annoying that if you leave the app, it closes your workout routine if it's open, and it can't save new recipes. So frustrating when you have to input the same stuff like 40 times only for it to say it couldn't be saved, please try again later...also don't like that if you modify your workout routine, it permanently changes the whole thing, it doesn't just modify it for the singular workout.

This app is one of the better macro counting and weight tracking apps. However some inconveniences that you can't copy certain items from another person. It makes you copy the entire meal. Also a huge issue is that my phone gets super hot while using it. I have to end up turning it off after to cool it down. It would be nice to create meals/ foods from another as well as an option to show net carbs would be great.

edit: Terrible UX. Cannot search, add or edit recipes that I've used (from their own recipe suggestions). Have to find it in their non_searchable recipe page. Copy meal only works in some instances. Cannot duplicate if you eat the same things regularly, even in the same day. I've been really trying hard with this app for a month now and still regularly frustrated. Only really good thing is the bar code scanner. Needs major fixes.

Great little app, super easy to use and has pretty much everything I want to add, and what it doesn't have you can just scan the bar code and the calorie details pop up in a second! I'm using it to count my calories so I can do an effective bulk without taking in more calories than is necessary, seems to be working well so far. I'm also vegan and was surprised to find out I was well under my intended calorie intake some day's! I now no when I need to top up and when I need to cut back.

Obsessed! This is such a great app that is intuitive and easy to use. When you input all your details, you're given a certain amount of calories to keep under based on your details and goals you've input. The app allows you to modify these goals and sends notifications when you've possibly missed something. The notifications are also able to be modified which is great if you're doing intermittent dieting. It has an easy barcode scanner that makes entering your meals so much easier. Recommended!

Informed. I used MyFitness app for the first time in 2016. I lost 50lbs in 6 months and was amazed at how easy it was to make a smart choices for meals. I think the water counter is most important. I've reinstalled MyFitness app for a 2nd time and noticed all the changes. I've browsed the recipes (even made a few), and have lost weight already. I will continue to follow the app daily. GREAT APP!!! I don't think that I would pay for the extra features though.

Lots of info and great recipe ideas. I'd like to be able to add my own food via barcode in "my foods" section. That, and be able to edit recipes I find, as I often use replacement ingredients, like tofu instead of chicken, or adding nuts, etc. . I'd also prefer if the meals in my diary were drop downs or something similar. It gets busy and makes it a bit harder to use compared to some other apps. Would be nice to clean up the screen and feel more organized. . Overall, I like it and it helps.

App used to be great, it has helped me lose 17kg within the last year. However the latest update when they've added plans etc, it is SO SLOW. Waiting the best part of 10 seconds to scan a barcode. They also moved the diary button, from the home screen you can't select your calories at the top to go to your diary, this now takes you to nutrition. For years this has been a link to the diary, why change it??!?!?!??! Gone from a great app to full of adverts and slow performance. Disappointed.

Used this app for ages and its been a great help, 38lbs down and counting, woop! However, As with most apps these days the ads are becoming more intrusive. If I could pay a one off fee of like £10 just to remove ads without the premium features, I'd be happy to do so. As good as this app is, to me, its a just a more convenient version of a pen and paper. I don't need the premium features but the ads are ruining it. 1/4 of my diary page is an advert, and now, full screen pop ups.

Sad to discover that as of 10/22 the barcode feature is only available to those on the premium subscription. I've used this app in the past (using the barcode feature) and it's helped reach my goals. Now having to manually search for items may become a barrier. As when I've used this it is not always accurate. It would be better if there was a way to input own items and their calories - a feature that Fitbit has used in the past.

I have used the app for years on and off. However, it has become unusable with frequency of self promotion, advertising the intermittent fasting feature in the paid version. This advert pops up at every page turn and prevents me from actually using many of the features on the app. I can't access the menu or the dashboard as the add prevents any access. Even if I close the ad it just keeps popping up. I will be looking for another app to track my meals.

It could be great app, but... ... it has a lot of bugs... And I mean a lot... I took 1 month subscription because I liked the idea, but if the issues will not be fixed by then, I don't see the point of paying for something so buggy... The idea is great. I like that I can compile my recepies... I did it in excel table until now and this is big improvement. You can learn a lot about food and your own habbits by using the app but there are some issues that make me doubt how accurate the data is.

It's a great app to help you with your diet. There's lots of articles that link in and it's very informative. I struggle with the usability and navigation but I've only been using a week to track my foods. Also as I'm in the UK and a lot of veg is weighed in cup size which can be a nightmare if the grams aren't included. I think I need to work with the app a little more to get the best out of it. Still a great app to use

Great app, I've been using it every day for years now. It's been working fine until the most recent update. Now the app is slow moving from one screen to another, much slower to search/add food. It's especially annoying that the app has started to duplicate entries: when I copy my breakfast over to the next day, some of the foods get duplicated but not immediately. Indeed I notice it later when I log other meals.

It's good but annoying at the same time. Some times it doesn't have the right food or when trying to put your own recipe in it changes some of the ingredients. Some times you can get the right weight but most of the time it's in either cup oz, and you can't get the right weight. It is good in showing what we are eating in terms of carbs, proteins, fats etc. I do like it, I just find it frustrating.

I'm looking at alternatives for this app... Lately it has become filled with bugs and freezes all the time. It takes me ages to log anything! There's also been some weird design changes recently that I find very confusing. Like taping on the calories summary on the home screen now doesn't take you to your diary anymore. It was an automatic gesture for me, that I have to relearn. And carbs/protein/fat aren't at the top of the nutrient breakdown anymore. Hard to read!

Great app, super idea, does the job. Few suggestion: strength trainings also born calories, after them calories burning is quicker than usual, makes since to take it into account. Choice of pre defined strength exercises is quite poor. Some GUI glitches: too easy switching between dates, need to press back too many times to close the app. Also it'll be great to be able to pair it with HR monitor to report the exact number of burned calories. Anyway, its a great app.

Now beyond an 1800 days streak using this app, but within the last few months it has gone from being my essential app helping me to manage calories and exercise, to being one that crashes with every 3rd tap. It's now a chore to add food, as it takes 2-3 goes to open the app again, and will often also add foods more than once, then needing more attempts to correct it. It's on its last chance. It has fallen a long way.

Have used for calorie counting on and off for years, and it's reliable. I would not pay for a premium version unless they hired someone to improve and maintain the accuracy of the food database. There are a lot of duplicates and inaccuracies. There are occasionally problems with logging in, or data not syncing (ex. Enter data at home on iOS, update on the go with Android, and the earlier entries don't show up in the diary). I would also love a MyFitnessPal "light" that only has the diary and weight entry, I basically never use the other features.

I have used this app to lose weight and, when it works, it's pretty good but I would say that it just doesn't open about half of the time I try to open it to log something. It just hangs and hangs and sometimes even after I restart it, still won't work. Also the "challenges" can be fun but don't work well in the app, like they don't come up in the menu of actions so you can seemingly also access them by scrolling through the news feed to find a statement about the challenge.

Update: the app deleted my account, now I can't log in because it say my email address is in use already... Tried forgot password but that didn't help . Super frustrated. this has been super easy to use. love that I can scan almost everything for nutrition, it reminds me of my nutrition goals and let's me track exercise. Only negative is I can't figure out how to track my strength training calories... luv this app. been super helpful!!!!!

Used to love this app... But now it seems every time I want to use it I am plagued with ads and every time I click on something it is only covered by premium membership. Even the barcode scanner!! It's hugely disappointing... I understand the need to charge, to develop and improve, but it's so expensive and honestly, I think I'm going elsewhere.

I've recently returned to using MFP after a few years and the bloat is unbelievable! So much advertising, constant prompts to upgrade to premium, MEANWHILE the stuff I am actually here for is frustratingly buggy. I have not been able to complete my diary for 3 days now. I keep getting a 'cannot connect to server' error. Everything is so slow - feels more like navigating a website than an agile mobile app!

Changing my review since the screen rotation issue appears to be resolved. I gave 4 stars instead of 5 because I would like to be able to track more micronutrients (b12, zinc, folate, vitamin E, etc.) It would also be nice if MFP integrated an intermittent fasting tracker (like zero). I think there is something off in how they calculate the number of calories you need to lose weight at a certain rate. Beware of the calorie over-estimation.

Recipes function is pretty neat. Unfortunately, edit and delete buttons for your recipes are next to each other and there is no undo or confirmation for delete. Edit 01 Sep 2020: I have just seen an ad that I wasn't able to close before a few seconds passed. It also automatically played some sound. This is ridiculous and I'll be uninstalling the app as soon as I find a suitable alternative. Needless to say, this obnoxious ad placement is not going to make me buy premium subscription.

I have used this app for over 8 years, it's always been something I can stick to. HOWEVER, the last few months it has been awful. The constantly freezes/ screen goes blank/ it adds the same item numerous times and general is just a nightmare to use. I just tried to add a recipe and it went blank after the second ingredient. Whatever they have changed to make this app suddenly absolute garbage please change it back!!

Hard to say negative/positive. The app has been great for helping me lose weight by tracking calories. And its great for seeing macros to help with building muscle. It's really good to save recipes and meals too! However... the app is VERY prone to bugs. You can lose all your recordings at times. Or (and this is worse), the app starts to multiply your workouts/your calories. So 3 times in 4 months it was unusable, for example it said I had eaten 2900 extra calories. AND lost workouts. Not great.

I have been using this app for nearly a decade. I wish that it was easier to group foods into meals/dishes (ie salad ingredients, needs to be easier to swap ingredients). I would like to see the food database cleaned up (remove inaccurate nutritional info). I would also like to see frequent foods grouped by meal type, so that when I go to enter breakfast I don't have to scroll through a listing of foods I ate for dinner last night.

It's great. Gotta check when you scan food items though, caught some errors. And the burnt calories is on the high end, the very optimistic, which is annoying. I have to cross reference and enter calories by hand for exercises. It would be great to update your widgets as well. The space grid it takes up on your phone needs to be reduced. It takes up 3x2, when it could easily take up 3x1 or even better, 2x1. 🤞 Please fix !

Was good, not so much any more. In the last few days I have also been having the issue syncing with Samsung with exercises being repeatedly added until there are hundreds of copies. Ads are getting silly in amount but I was willing to accept that for the features, until the barcode code was removed. Now I'm afraid there are better options out there and like a lot of folks I guess I'll be moving apps. Premium is stupidly expensive and I don't want it need most of those features. Poor show.

I have only used the free version. Really simple and quick once I had my regular food scanned or inputted as meals. I have my fitbit linked but each day I need to go into the website to disconnect it then reconnect. I also need to log out of the app then log back in again. That's super annoying. But still worth while. I really like the breakdown of macros and nutrients. Super helpful. I'm still trying to decide if I want to try premium.

I love being able to keep track of how much I should be consuming each day. I love that the library of foods is so comprehensive-- I remember years ago when I would have to manually enter food information because whatever I was trying to enter "was not found" Now there's ALWAYS nutritional values for items I'm looking up or entering. The one small thing I would improve is making the interface less cluttered. With each new feature or capability there's more text, which feels a bit cluttered.

It's a great app for tracking calories, especially if you're focused on tracking macros. Adding recipes and meals is really great as well and very helpful if you eat the same meals often. I'd say the app is lacking a feature to just search for a food if the intention is only to check it's nutrition value. The integration with Google Fit is not good though, it doesn't sync the walks, only jogs.

I love this app! It's really good to keep track of my eating habits, the only detail is that the exercise tracking is limited and unless you know exactly how much you burned, it won't be that accurate; sometimes some workouts don't even exist. Also, when you add some sort of exercise the app reduces the calories consumed and it can confuse people and lead them to think they can eat more (a.k.a. double), that should be changed or modified.

Used this app a few years ago and it was great. Now, the app just repeatedly asks me to upgrade to the premium account. Some days I cant even break the loop. I've just spent 10 minutes stuck in the cycle of saying no over and over again, now I give up. Very disappointing...you would expect some encouragement to upgrade, sure, but to make the free version literally unusable if you dont is wrong.

I really want to like this app, but it is 80% ads. I understand free apps have to have some advertising, but when i have to wade through ads just to find the app features, it is too much. I am deleting and will try something else Edit: so after spending the day trying many other apps i reinstalled this one. While the interface is not as user friendly as others and its full of ads, its got the most comprehensive list of food items. Many other apps i couldn't find the food item I wanted.

It's ok, has a bit of a dated feel. The calorie values seem to be all over the place when looking up branded food and drink items, so that data could do with cleaning up. But, it gives you a reasonable idea of calories consumed in the day and the nutrition data is interesting, so it can definitely help you think more about what you are actually eating, which in the end is surely the point.

The reminders are sporatic at best, and don't lead you to where you need to go if they do manage to pop up. For instance, if it reminds you to input your breakfast, it doesn't take you to the breakfast line anymore if you tap the reminder. It used to. It also gives reminders for tasks that are already done, but, again, sporadically. Very useful when it works properly though, but at the moment it's falling short.

Great app. I just have the free version which suits me for counting cals and seeing a breakdown of nutrition. Can be a bit hit and miss on product nutrition but for the most part it has been spot on or very close. I would like some of the features of the paid app but I think it's just too expensive. I don't find the adds on the free app too intrusive ang getting it for free, can't complain. I have hoverered over the full app trial a few times but just think it's too much to pay.

This used to be a good app, but now basic functions are "premium" and the ads are excessive. For context, I have used MFP for more than 5 years. When I started, there were minimal ads and you could scan the barcode of any product. Now, barcode scanning is considered "premium" and you have to pay $30 a month! Also, after switching to a new phone, I couldn't login to the app, and when I selected "forgot my password" the app claimed it didn't know my email & the recovery page led to a 404 error.

Great features and impressive setup to include everything you need BUT! It chews up battery life, it is also a major contender for data usage. These things are just not acceptable in an app like this. Most items I enter are the same every day so no need to use extra data there. I have concerns on the excess data usage as it could be a virus or something similar. Mild phone usage and the battery is dead by late evening. Terrible. Do not recommend

I do appreciate the calorie counting and being able to add in workouts. However, in the latest update I receive a lot of "network error" messages. When searching for food item, the top result is no longer from my history which it used to do (and which was a far simpler way of keeping track) . Very tempted to downgrade to a previous version which worked better and was more stable than this

I like the app. It has all the foods I have scanned so far. Sometimes putting the quantity in is awkward. I have to scan for every individual item for example a biscuit. It would be easier to scan it once then put in the number eaten. I followed WW for a long time. Their app is far more slick than this but also more expensive. MFP does the job I want it to do very well. Just a few more tweaks needed.

This app makes calorie tracking so easy. It has a bar code scan feature and so far there hasn't been a food that it hasn't recognised the bar code for. I can add in my daily exercise and water intake too. It shows calories consumed, calories burned and calories remaining at the top of the screen. It has so many free features and I'm happy with the app, but I'm considering upgrading just to see how much better it can get.

I am rating the app 4 stars for now, as I have only just started using it within the last couple weeks again. I really like the fact that there are a lot of workout choices, for example, housework can count as exercise, and you can choose light duty or heavy duty. Lets face it, cleaning house can be a darn good workout, esp with some great music and a fast pace😊, so no reason it shouldnt count. other apps dont have it in their list of exercises, so its great that MyFitnessPal does. Love so far.

The app used to be great but I recently re started using it and it's just not working. Every time I launch it it creates a loop of 'start a free premium trial' 'should we send you emails' and 'save your goals' over and over and over again. Try re installing it but it did not help. Update: super quick answer from the dev team which made me change from 1 to 3 stars. Still not working but appreciate they are working on it!

Was great until it became unbearably slow. After opening the app it would take 30 seconds before I could click on the diary tab. When I try to search food it will take another 30 seconds or so before I could type something into the search box. I've tried reinstalling and resetting settings and a new account but it's all the same. Finally had enough today. The best thing about this app is that it has pretty much every single food ever, but I've had enough.

Amazing app. Their calorie/macro calculators may not be accurate when they assign your goals. Every individual is different but they come pretty damn close to your needs, and their calculations are a good start to gauge how your body reacts, and you can easily adjust your goals and pretty much whatever you want. This app makes tracking very easy and convenient, you can create your own foods and it saves them to the system for easier input. I highly recommend this app.

Have used this app for years and it's been great until recently. It now doesn't sync properly with other apps. Items don't even sync right between the app and website. If I uninstall and reinstall, everything syncs up properly again temporarily. I have now done that over a dozen times over the last few days! If I log out of app, it won't let me log back in. Getting sick of this! Judging from all the other comments here, I'm not alone! Ready to give up. Looks like I may have to find new app

This is a great application that doesn't really introduction. It helps you to look after your daily food consumption. I find almost everything user-friendly and easy. The only thing that I feel like lacking is when you create a recipe and want to add new ingredients, you can search just by name or with a barcode. I cannot just pick my foods or my recent used components. So if I haven't saved a particular product beforehand, you get lost among all of the options of the same products in the system

You need to take care when selecting did from the list because the nutritional values are not always accurate, there are ticked products which are generally correct. The weights and volumes are a bit tricky to use as it's not possible to review an item whole trying to select it and there is no built in guide to allow you an educated guess about portion size which means a lot of flipping to Google until you get used to the values. I found that I started to understand how much to use fairly soon.

I've been using this app for years and for the most part is great. However in recent weeks it's practically unusable. It keeps freezing everytime I try to add a new food or click on a recent food. I tried to make a recipe for pancake day however it crashed so much and restarted the recipe from the beginning so many times that I just gave up. It needs fixing ASAP!

Huge inventory of foods; usually can find an entry that's by mass. Barcode scanning of packaged foods is exceptionally good. Sync with Google Fit has been improved greatly. Tracks nutrients, so you can set goals for sodium or iron or protein, etc. Entry is by keyboard, not an annoying scroll wheel, which saves time over other similar apps I have used. The ability to access your info via a computer allows easy entry of complicated recipes or meals. Some online recipes can be added instantly.

It's a really good app, but as they have added more features over the years it has become more messy looking and irritating to navigate around. I especially don't like the 'newsfeed', it's more about their writing than your own stats/diary/progress nowadays. They need a clean, smart daily overview page (similar to the Fitbit app for example) that keeps you motivated at a glance and then you can delve deeper into recipes, workouts etc if you want. Just needs some tweaking on the looks/layout and it would be perfect.

I had the free app for about 10 years, using it on and off as needed and it was awesome. Then it started looping though a premium trial upgrade and I couldn't even get to the diary without signing up for a trial of premium. I kept trying it to see if it was usable but it wasn't fixed for ages, so eventually I just deleted it. If the upgrade path had been fixed it would be a 4-5 star app but it's unusable in its current state.

The backend part works wonders, you most times what you're looking for. The frontend side of the app could be miles better, I have no need for 100 recipe suggestions, ads, updates from my friends in my home screen, even with the premium version. There's just too many settings in the swipe in left panel, I can never find what I'm looking for in 2 clicks.

Been using it for years. Easily the best way of meeting your weight and fitness objectives. Overly aggressive in counting exercise calories sometimes, but otherwise works pretty seamlessly and is easy to use. Would like to be able to copy meals from previous days (easy to do on an iPhone, but can't figure it out on Android). Would also be good to be able to edit incorrect descriptions and - in future - scan nutrition text from packaging alongside the barcode. Otherwise, it's excellent!

Been using this app for over 3 years and used to really love it. But the latest push to have users pay/go premium has been frustrating. The ad to go premium takes up half of the screen so it's hard to see the tracking. Can no longer flip phone sideways to see macros breakdown by meal and the scanner seems to have stopped finding many foods. I actually wouldn't mind paying for the app, but the subscription cost is rather steep, in my opinion. Might be time to make a switch.

I've been using this app for many years and overall it's a great app. I did use the paid version for a year during that time, and the extra features are handy, but for my needs, (tracking calories & protein), I've found that the free version works great. I don't mind seeing the ads as they are not obtrusive, (please don't change that🙏🙏) Honestly it is great there is such a vast database of foods, yes there are errors with some things but for simple tracking that hasn't been a big issue for me.

I've been using for a while as I like the sync with Google fit but I'm by no means a consistent logger. And as such I sometimes log everything at the end of the day all in one go. But this latest update is infuriating as it shows an inskippable ad every time you tab back to the diary from the search page. Every single time. It's unnecessary and does not make me want to purchase the premium version, it's just putting me off using at all. So many other ways to show ads.

So far so good. Just using the tracker to get in the habit of paying attention to what I eat and know the calories I'm taking in. I'm not bothered by the ads, I'm just impressed I can get what I've got for free! Certainly beats having to track manually in a food diary. To have a few ads to exit out of seems a small price to pay for what you get. Given 4 stars only because the interface is a little unsophisticated for my taste, but otherwise I really like this. And it's free 😁

Helped me lose 17 pounds I gained all the weight back on quarantine + 20 pounds more. I'm using it again with a free trial for premium and there's no difference than the free version. It doesn't always pick up my exercises from other apps I'm using. They changed being able to move single items from day to day. It's not that easy to navigate planning your next days calories. I hate that you have to reach 1000 calories to get a weight loss projection. It should depend on your height.

Although some of the food stats are off sometimes, it is one of the fastest apps I have come across so far for really keeping detailed track of foods and their nutritional information. Also great for setting macro goals. I enjoyed experimenting with daily meal plans and seeing how they would compare to the goals I was setting. It took time but not near as long as if I had to stand in the grocery store, or online and check things over and over. Great helping tool.

I used to use this app and it worked well. Now I manage to find the foods for a meal and I go to add the meal and all I get is the circle (like a buffering one). I've waited.....nothing. I've left the app and gone back in, it's still going. I've uninstalled and reinstalled but still the same. I'm not paying to upgrade unless this basic aspect is resolved. In the meantime, I'll look elsewhere!

Very dodgy subscription. It tells you that you get a free 30 day trial and all the features you get for it, but nowhere in the page, not even in the fine print at the bottom does it tell you how much the subscription will cost after those 30 days (unless that text is hidden behind the big blue "Start trial" button). I'm pretty sure that has to be illegal. You need to fix that.

I like the app, it does made a difference in me losing weight as I was never aware of the calories I was consuming before. One of the best features is the barcode reader so I can scan most items and it knows the values for calories and nutrients. The reason for four star is that it defaults on the home page and it annoys me (not a big deal but I feel like it's forcing me to look at the articles or whatever they are and I don't find them so interesting).

I love tho app and I use it for a long time, but after the update there are some serious problems with it. When I want to add a food by scanning a barcode, I have to pick a meal first (breakfast, lunch etc). When I select the meal, the barcode button disappears. So I have to go back and try again while the meal is selected. I think with the few tweaks the app can be more efficient

Used to be a good app. In the last day the app has lost years of data that I can't get back. After hours of trying to get it to sync with Garmin Connect it finally 'works', but the sync is incredibly slow and the data is wrong easily half the time, meaning my calories burned and consumed are always way out. So it's essentially useless except for telling me how many calories are in something, and I can get that information from hundreds of other apps.

I've been using the free version for around a year to track my food macros. I'm able to track and adjust fat, carbs, and protein each day and adjust if required. The app links well with fitness trackers too, to count steps and adjust daily calories based on the amount of exercise you've done during the day. It's easy to add foods, either by scanning the barcode or using the Search bar. Adding your own food and meals is simple too.

I love the app BUT, there's always a but and in this case a big one. Only 2/10 times does this app open for me. It says "please wait" at the start up screen and often doesn't proceed further. I have the most recent updates and it's really bugging me that I cant just get into the app and that it takes forever to open (if it does at all). For that reason only 2 stars as I can only use it sometimes when it decides to work. I also hate that there's no offline mode.

The app is good for setting goals and tracking food. I do have some issues, for some reason I cannot unlink connected apps so both Garmin and MapMyFitness are syncing the same workouts, but I can't disconnect either of them due to an "unknown error" so I have to manually delete one of them. The other pain is I have to login almost every time I use it. I don't know if that's because I am using Facebook to authenticate, but it is very annoying to have wait for about 60 seconds to log food.

I used to rate this as 5 stars, but the app has become slower and slower to open, to the point where now the loading screen just never moves on! I've tried everything, from closing and reopening the app, rebooting my phone, uninstalling and reinstalling. For the amount I pay per year for this app, this is atrocious. I'm considering moving to Noom despite my current subscription.

Loved it for the 1st 2 weeks. Really helped me keep track of calories and macros and I lost weight. Then all of a sudden, without warning, 2 weeks in the barcode scanner became a premium feature which you have to pay ridiculous amounts of money evey month/ year to access. Incredibly disappointed with this. Can't see me using it much now, despite being able to add foods manually. The barcode scanner was the easiest way.

Yes it's a good app to use. My only complaint is when trying to log the serving size, the options are limited. Often there is no option for cups, it only allows grams or ounces. Which is pain sometimes to have to Google the conversion everytime and you still dont actually know if that is accurate or not. Even worse, sometimes the only option is 1 serving without knowing exactly what size that serving is. Improvement in this area would do wonders for a beginner at counting calories, like me.

Been using since July. Huge database that comes with pros and cons. For one, you'd be hard-pressed to not find the food you're looking for but on the flipside, there are also so many random entries. App worked well for a while but lately it's been crashing on me every time I try to log something new which is several times a day. Borderline unusable, very frustrating, discourages me to keep logging everything.

I slip up. But when I'm back on track this is my go-to app. It's helped me lose weight in an easy to track, no pressure kind of way. I've got the free version, this is plenty for me but if you want to go the extra mile then that's also an option. I just read my rating back and it sounds a little staged? It's not, I'm still overweight but that's not Myfitness Pals fault, I own that. It's free, it's so amazingly helpful, especially when tracking macros & nutrients etc. Try it 👍

So far so good! I love the content on the blog I find it really useful and informative. I also like the app and seeing my daily calories + macronutrients allowances. Took me a while to really start using it for more than just calorie counting but I am now using the premium version. Also, the barcode scanning function makes it even easier to search the endless list of foods! Nothing yet that I haven't found. Customer support was super quick when I had a small account issue.

I have used this app for a long time and it's been great. Lost weight and loved it. Unfortunately now they've put the barcode scanner behind a paywall, it's just too time consuming to use. I know we can search for each food item, but it takes ages to do. The general feel of the app has got less user friendly with each update. Premium version too expensive for many in a cost of living crisis. I think myfitnesspal needs to go back to basics and rethink their goals. Hope it improves. 🤞

Very Disappointed! This app was perfect for helping me keep on top of my eating and keeping to my weight loss goals. I stopped using in June last year due to being pregnant, when I came back onto it last week everything has changed, can no longer use the barcode scanner, will not sync with my fitbit for the steps and exercise I have done. I recommended this app to so many people and now I'll be telling everyone to find something else, same as I will be doing! All the best bits no longer work!

Almost every barcode scans perfectly, which is super helpful. But, since the update containing dark mode, my app has done nothing but crash over and over. I can't even put in a meal consisting of 4 items without having to restart the app. 11 mins later and my dinner has finally been logged. Not the best way to spend your time. Please fix it, this never used to happen!

Downloaded the app on the recommendation of my trainer and am finding it very useful. The only frustrating part is trying to find certain foods when tracking meals. There is almost too much choice which makes it frustrating to have to scroll through a massive list if what is typed in doesn't match exactly. Other than that this app has been great. Still debating whether to pay for the premium features but only because I'm cheap.

Have been using the free version twice now and it's just so helpful! Yes, it's a pain to write down everything, weigh what you eat, but once you have your little data base together things get much easier. Love the scanner, which makes this even faster! Good stuff. Some tiny niggles though. Please include options to include body fat and muscle mass in the weighing data, option to reset the graph when one starts another period of losing weight and include the same list of activities in endomondo.

EDIT: fixed! Used the app for years, it's usually great. Recently after being open a minute, the app will randomly start playing radio music and I don't know where it's coming from. I'll be inputting my meal and music will start blasting. It's not from an ad or any other apps like Spotify. The music will only stop when I exit the MyFitnessPal app. This makes inputting my food extremely frustrating, I have to close the app and reopen it several times before I can put a full meal in

I love this app ! There is room for improvement with the messaging features, I find they're more like emails and it's less convenient than what we usually expect from messaging (read receipt, typing dots, conversation layout). I'd like to be able to tweak the calories of a food as opposed to grams or servings. I find the option to create my own recipes very useful , I like the format , it's really helping me meet my logging goals. Greatly recommend !

Loved this app when I started using it, I'd even been recommending it to others. Never again, I'm so dissapointed with it. Why the redesign? That chart on my home screen that showed my daily intake was exactly what I needed, I have dyscalculia and numbers mean very little to me compared to visual aids like graphs. But now you've removed that to make space for a huge, invasive advertisement box that takes up most of the page. And ffs don't even get me started on the barcode scanner issue.I'm off.

I love that I can set different goals for each day of the week. Extensive list of food items where I usually find what I'm looking for or I can just scan a product to make it even quicker. The option to save meals and recipes also simplifies the otherwise very time consuming process to add every item individually. Lots helpful tips and recipes are an added bonus. This app is a huge time saver compared to the one I was using before!

What have you done to the search...!!! Previous I could access my regularly used foods with two taps of the screen, now I can't even find them! They don't appear in recent items, regularly used seems to have been done away with - bad move! And they don't come up in a search result. If I scan the barcode they are there alright. But searching for the exact same name doesn't find it... Getting so frustrating I am starting to look at other options, this gets worse with every ypdate

Paywall for the barcode scanner. Ridiculous. Using MFP on and off for years, the barcode scanner was it's USP, and enabled all users to create a huge database, which is still probably the largest on the market, and is in my opinion the only thing people are clinging onto. Over the years I've seen many features move over to the Premium, not new ones that I want for free, the features that I used to get for free, but now I have to pay for. This final move will see thousands of users uninstall!!

I've been using this since 2012. Lately when you type in something to SEARCH or SCAN it CONSTANTLY LOADS. No results come up. It makes it difficult to track foods that aren't already stored on the my diary. This is the second time within this week that I've uninstalled the app to see if it would work. After logging in all that loading the same issues arise. I've been disappointed by this app lately.

For the free version, the app is great for tracking food intake. It is also good that you are also able to save some recipes and is able to remember your 'recent meal patterns', which makes input a touch quicker. In my opinion, in order to make this a complete app for food / excercise tracking, there needs to be a better UI for adding strength training too.

I've been using this app daily for a year. It has helped me lose just under 3 stone in 9 months. I love the fact it has a bar code reader and you can create your own meal plans. It also remembers the last items you inputted, so your favourite/regularly consumed foods are easier to find. It helps you track your weight & you can add photos to aid your progress. It gives you recipes & exercise tips. It's an excellent app, especially if you want to use calorie counting to lose weight.

I like the app. I use the app on and off and over time the bar code checker has improved and the list of other choices has grown. I do find it unhelpful that if you don't hit the minimum target calories for a day, as decided by the app, it won't give a projection of weight loss. I don't see why it won't and I don't miss the basic target often but some days I've eaten lots but the food choices are low calorie. I also find that although my exercise apps are synced with it it won't transfer the data

Excellent Caloric Tracker. I'd say about 90% of the time the barcode scanner works, all major franchises menu items are in the database. It really sets the standard for Meal tracking. The ads are not too invasive, and the premium options are nice to have, but definitely not necessary. I have it synced up to Garmin Connect, and have used it with Fitbit in the past. Both work great once set up.

Third year of renewing my subscription. Brilliant, has pretty much every food known to mankind on its database, or atleast most of the uk veg and foods etc. Seems pretty accurate too. Has been a solid companion in my personal health, dieting and fitness for sometime now, having moved from the free version a few years ago. Only complaint is nothing is set up for outside the US when it comes to the challenges, so if you don't live in America you are on you own.

Brilliant app for managing weight. Best used as a planner before eating / cooking but however you use it there are easy ways to figure out how many calories you've had. The bar code is easiest but in low reception area or at a PC then the search facility is also very good. Having lost 3 stone over a period of 8 months I can confirm that it works as long as you put all info in. I have recommended to family members who have had similar experiences.

Generally good for what it's designed to do. However, while not in use, this app used 3.5 GB of data in two weeks. This is not acceptable. I used less on. Netflix, Prime and YouTube combined during that time. I had to disable background data use for the app. Sounds like a small fix, but when you're two days away from hitting your data limit with another two weeks to go, its inconvenient and annoying.

Its a good and convenient app that has a big food database, so no matter where you live chances are you'll find the products you're looking for. Downsides are the servers are often down and you have to wait until they work to count calories and prep which is annoying. Also, the app is very cluttered with useless features and it'd be great if we could customize the app more! But its the best calorie counting app ive used so far!

I used to love the MFP app, have used it for years and was always happy with it. But now with the recent updates it's not userfriendly at all in the free version. The Ads take up so much screen space and then the navigation bar was moved from the top to the bottom of screen. So that now I have only about a quarter of my phone screen left to see the diary. That makes it difficult to use and navigate through the diary.

Incredibly helpful. Since I have started using this app the pounds have just been flying off. I had tried a few calorie counter apps before but they were difficult to use, mostly because you had to pay access the database. This one lets you access it for free and can be as simple as scanning a barcode. My only gripe is that inputting recipes and foods can be a it tedious because of how some foods don't have multiple types of measurements so sometimes you have to do manual conversions.

This app is amazing for calorie counting. I have used it consistently for a few years now and tracked weight gain and loss! It has a huge database of foods and is easy to add your own foods. Adding recipes is easy and can also be added from the internet. Some user-added foods are incorrect, so always be certain to check if things seems reasonable! This app is invaluable and I wouldn't be without it.

An app worth using but with some room to improve. It's great to have exercise pulled in automatically from my Polar watch! Also, the food database is pretty good. I'd like to be able to enter metrics without changing the metric selection from a combo box each time. I'd also like to see verbs consumed in the banner rather than just macros remaining at I'm trying to remain below 30g of carbs (absolute). Overall though, I don't know of a better app.

Clunky and complicated to use, also does whatever it wants regardless of your settings. For example, it decided, despite push notifications being turned off, that it wanted to send me notifications at 2 o'clock in the morning suggesting a nutrition plan. Don't waste your time, overrated calorie counter app and there are far better ones out there.

Good app overall! Over time a lot of things have become subscription based and paid (unfortunate) but for basic stuff it is really good. It has a wide selection of foods in the database which is handy and doesn't make calorie counting seem like a chore. My only little peev is if you eat too little you can't finish the diary and share your progress. I understand the app doesn't want to promote starvation but what about those who have had bariatric surgery and physically can't eat that much... :(

This was always the best calorie counting app, but the new updates make it annoying to use. You now need a premium membership to use the barcode scanner. These memberships are simply too expensive, considering all the data is crowd sourced, and don't provide functionality to justify the cost. If there was a reasonable option to buy the app outright, that would be fine. But the predatory subscription model kills it. Edit: yes, I'm keeping it up with a different app.

I love this app. It makes gaining size and shredding down so easy! However in the past two months I have been experiencing a lot of issuea. App is constantly crashing for no reason, sometimes it takes forever to load and it did not want to start on a couple of occasions. My phone is Samsung a40, so it's not old and it should be running fine.

I like that it's pretty easy for the most part for logging food. I have a little O.C.D. lol and when searching for calories on food items ...there is options from one end of the spectrum to the other. so it sometimes requires more researching to try to get the correct # of calories or close too it. I do love that it connects to my Fitbit! Still a learning curve to best use it's potential but it's very versatile. Also love the other features available to the users which can be so helpful!

Although I really like the app and it's features (to create recipes, to follow your progress, scan barcodes and so on) for at least 2 weeks now it has become a challenge to use it and it is really frustrating! The app freezes at the simplest comands, I can't record a full meal without it freezing and having to close and reopen at least 2-3 times, these days there is no chance to create a recipe either. I am trying to reinstall it, if it goes on in the same way...I will definitely use another app

VERY EXPENSIVE! It's a fab app and has helped me lose allot of weight on the trial version of premium. However on the free version the ads drive me insane and leave you with a tiny area of each screen available to view. It's such a shame it's so expensive as times are so hard for everyone at the moment (i.e. we can't afford to heat our house fully). It's a shame as I've used MFP on and off for many many years and apart from the ads It' great. Just wish I could afford the premium version :(

This app has made it a million times easier to reach my goals, the large comminity of people entering new food items help keep the database accurate and easy to use. The only thing keeping me from 5 stars is the fact that the exercises are confusing to me, and you cannot choose another option than grams for some foods. I don't own a kitchen scale, and I'm not going to weigh how much nutella I'm eating.

Been using this app for years without issue. But within the last coupe of weeks, it keeps locking up/freezing and crashing. What used to take a minute to do now takes many many more. Rarely able to complete a meal entry without a crash, normally several crashes, meaning I have to force stop the app and then reopen. It's just horrible. No other apps on my phone cause me this problem. Will look for an alternative

Helped me lose 35lbs and keep them off. The one irritant: although I connected Google Fit, the step count is unreliable - the calories show up and then disappear (and then sometimes reappear) totally randomly. I decided to disconnect it and manually add the calories from Google Fit. Not sure if the "disappearing act" is some AI, a design flaw, or a bug - I doubt this is working as designed.

I love this app as it helped me lose a substantial amount of weight by tracking my calories. However, I am forced to give it a one star for one MAJOR reason and that's that it has waaaaaay too many bugs and it has practically become useless. It constantly crushes, it responds too slowly and that's a huge inconvenience as it used to take me a minute or two to add items to my diary, and now it takes at least ten times longer. I am fairly certain that it's not my phone btw. Fix this asap!

Starting to get very frustrated with this app. I have used it for years. I pay for the subscription, the bare minimum I expect is for it to work properly. It has crashed a few times this week, displayed countless error messages, and barely worked at all today, firstly the scanner would not work and then the search stopped working and now it's logged me out and won't let me log back in. It's ridiculous that these simple things aren't functioning.

this app is very, very good. If I could I would actually give it 4.5 stars. The barcode scan works great for finding food items and the app is easy to use in general. There's probably 2 things I can think of that, if added would make the app just about perfect. The ability to copy recipes from friends that are linked and the ability to track a week's worth of calories similar to the poundaweek app, not just your average calories for the last 7 days. Overall though, an excellent app to use.

This app is great! I've used it on and off for years because it has great features (like the barcode reader that adds nutritional info to your diary in seconds, and the recipe feature which let's you save your home made meals too)! When signing in today the app did crash and kick me off a few times displaying a 'new accounts not available in your region' message. It eventually launched and works as normal now. In the future it would be great to have more direct connectivity to gym equipment.

I love this app and have used it for years, but as of a few days ago I've been getting full-screen pop up ads that are very hard to close, usually when I'm right in the middle of doing something. I understand ads help make money to keep the app going, but there are ways to do it that aren't absurdly intrusive and render the app unusable. Very frustrating.

Definitely 5 star. This app works. Very effective. Sync the Fitbit and you will have a total package for success. Bar code scanner and food search functions are fantastic. I also love being able to type in ingredients for my favorite recipes, with the auto look up feature and serving nutrition. The latest version is better than ever. Better than the others. Great job.

I think this app is great to help keep you accountable when trying the lose weight. we can very quickly eat too many caleries without realizing when we are used to eating a certain amount. I enjoy that I can see the last foods I imput into the device which makes it easier to readd foods (quick search). I like the progress picture option as well as the option to share your journey with others or keep it to yourself. This app is free so I can not stress enough how amazing this app is being free.

I haven't used it in a long time but it was quite handy in tracking your calories. You can just scan the bar code even to enter the exact calories. However, I got tired of counting calories and trying intermittent fasting with low carb diet instead. Much easier. That being said, weight loss people told me keeping track of what you eat (food journal) can help you lose weight. I don't know how long-term that would be but you can give this app a go.

Easy to use for dieting and counting calories, especially if used in a laptop. not quite so good when using on a mobile phone as some features don't work on there and you have to keep scrolling around to use the enter button, especially if you try build a recipe. But otherwise it's great. It is linked to my fitbit and updates with how much fuel I've burned giving me more cals. The adverts are really annoying and it seems to spend more time uploading them than calculating food!

I really like the app but there are a few issues. Some ingredients and foods have incorrect data which, if unnoticed set off warnings. You can correct the data by submitting the information, but portion sizes are fixed so you end up doing some math to extrapolate for the allotted sizes. You can build your own recipes, which is great. Cook, weigh your food and you can actually weigh out portions. But I've had issues saving the recipe more than once after scanning each individual items.

Overall, it's good. It makes tracking calories much easier and every period I track, I lose weight. But it is prone to many bugs that come and go, there are not enough confirmed foods in their database and we are swimming in duplicates with completely different counts between them, ads everywhere, and they lock out a lot of useful features behind a paywall which seems downright greedy coming from a giant corp. Just recently added timestamps to premium - really? That should be free no question.

I've been very happy with the app throughout the years, whilst I've been on and off the fitness wagon. However, the app has become very slow. When I'm adjusting the amount of food or if I'm entering x grams of food, it becomes very slow and takes 5-10 seconds before typing in what I've typed. Very annoying and destroys the app completely.

Like others I'm conflicted with this app. It's got a good database of foods and generally scans most stuff well. They do hide a hunch of useful features behind a paywall of a quite expensive subscription (for what you actually get) and constantly spam you to subscribe, par for the course. The worst bit though is now you're getting full screen ads that pop up when you're trying to scan your food. It's getting to the point if I can find another app I would probably move.

Good app, very useful overall. I use the free version. The recipe creation feature is particularly useful. As are the goal setting, day meal diary, macro breakdown, weight tracking and adjustment for calories burnt exercising. It has a few areas that could be improved though, particularly the search feature which often doesn't sort results well. For example, it doesn't preference generic versions of things like apples, meat, eggs, etc over specific brands of these which can be irritating. Overall, quite good and I'd recommend.

It is straightforward and easy to use. The food selection is very impressive and for the most part foods have different serving size options (g/lb/cup etc). I like the options to basically review my day, looking at calories and macros. The reason I don't give it 5 stars is I have found it a bit buggy if I'm moving between wifi and mobile data. It's as though it doesnt consolidate the input. I don't know how its linking with my google fit app because I dont see a difference, either.

Messy, unintuitive and dodgy data protection. I redownloaded this after a few years and was shocked at how bad it has become. No longer clean and simple, it is messy, confusing, frustrating and irritating. You have to set 'goals' that are useless - I'm not interested in that, I'm just looking for a calorie counter. The data permissions were dodgy. Avoid, avoid, avoid.

I rarely give any reviews, much less 1 star reviews, but this app is really deserving of one. As a fitness app u would think that exercise tracking would play a fundamental role in the development of the app. Sadly, that is not the case. I spent over an hour trying to connect the app to 3 or 4 different step counting applications which were compatible with the app. All of my attempts resulted in failure. I don't really see the point of a fitness app in which u can't do something so simple.

This used to be the go-to app for calorie and exercise tracking. The free version used to have a sensible and balance amount of ads. However, with the recent updates, they try to force more and more ads at every step in the process making the app a pain to use (clearly a ploy to force more people to take up the premium paid package). I don't need the premium options and i find the pricing not offering sufficient value. Time to search for a new calorie tracker.

Great app. 2 issues. 1 It seems to get very busy and then you can't use the app anymore until the servers clear up. But I'm using the free version so perhaps paying users aren't experiencing that. 2 It doesn't seem to sync that accurately with the Garmin connect app. Could be an issue with the Garmin app though. Have noticed a few others having issues syncing with their fitbits. But none the less, it's a great app for keeping check on what you eat and it's caloric value.

Loving using it. The only criticism is that it doesn't always let you enter the exact quantity of something that you've eaten. Also, the exercise section is a bit restrictive. It only let's you enter in the cardiovascular section. But other than that, it's a great app for people who are trying to lose weight and counting calories /carbs! Highly recommend it! :-)

I've used the app for years and in theory it's great. I log everything and it syncs with my fitbit so I can see my calories in versus out etc. Over the last few months though the app has become so slow and constantly crashes. I have a reasonably decent phone with plenty of memory and no other app is ever this slow so I don't think it's my phone. Its becoming unusable now.

THEIR ADS ARE NASTY! I have been using this app for years. Didn't have a problem with the earlier versions. The changes they've made since then are alright, I've learned to live with them. But whose idea was it to display an ad for toilet cleaner on a food tracking app??? Opened it to input my lunch, saw a picture of a DIRTY TOILET BOWL and immediately lost my appetite. I'm disgusted! I understand the need for ads but please use some common sense! I'm going to try something else. A damn shame!

I love it! So effective and very handy to be able to scan any barcode or search and calculate the calories. I've lost 2 kilos in 2 weeks. The only way it could be better is if there were a quick search function on the home screen for scanning or looking up foods. I would find that so handy in the supermarket. Otherwise it's great!

Makes it so easy to track calories, especially with the option to scan barcodes. Nutrient and macro details, along with diary prompts, are useful for keeping an eye on salt, sugar etc. The recipe blog is great for inspiration and instant calculation of ingredients. I'm using the free version and it does everything I want it to and have had no issues with the app.

This is a great app for food tracking. Most items scanned are in the database already. I have only ever had to fully input one so I can't complain. App has some difficulties with getting the proper measurements when items scanned. Would be good to be able to choose your own measurements ie 1/3 cup as serving size suggested, instead of the provided measurement which sometimes makes zero sense. Hopefully this will get fixed in the future. Would recommend to assist with weight loss or weight gain

Me and my friends been using MFP many years now, but here's the thing though...the app hasn't been working properly for a very long time; it will NOT sync my workouts (FitBit/UA apps) which is extremely frustrating to me. I can't dis- or reconnect either, the app freezes and dies each and every time. I checked if there was an update many, many times and today I saw there finally was one. I started updating immediately...only to find out that it made no difference! Fix it please! -☆☆☆!

Easy to use, and great to scan barcodes to get the details. Great for regular meals like breakfast (such as porridge) as the app stores previous details. Would prefer if I could combine milk and porridge into one click for next time though. No so easy if you don't know exactly what went into a meal, and have to estimate. Some weight measurements cannot be changed so have to say 0.2 portion (of bread, for example) Great to keep a track of everything, and it grows in experience as I diminish !

It's not awful but it needs work. I was very excited on first using it and was happy to pay the monthly subscription. However day 2 and discovered the barcode scanner does not work anymore. The app overall is badly designed, clunky and confusing. The content on the meal plans and articles is meh. The design feels a little bit all over the place. Adding food was great when I could scan the barcode however when this doesn't work it was a night mare. Loved that I could connect my Fitbit!

Have been using this since 2016 successfully, but something happened to it after an update recently. Every time I open it, the app freezes after a few seconds and tracking food has been a nightmare. Gone from a few minutes to 15 minutes, with at least the app freezing 6-8 times! Have tried to re-install the app, but no success. So today, I said goodbye to MFP and started Lifesum💔

I love this app, it's helped me track my foods and make better choices towards my goal weight. I would rate it 5 stars, however, the experience is being spoiled in the past few days by an extremely annoying advert for pampers which keeps playing with audio. The only way to get rid of the advert is to close the app. Unfortunately when I re open the app, the ad starts playing audio again. There is no way to block or report the ad. I shouldn't have to pay for premium to remove one ad. Please fix.

No longer scans! It USE to be brilliant till sometime in the past 48 hours they changed the scanning of bar codes. WHICH WAS THE BEST FEATURE! Now it's a nightmare!! Move it a way, move it closer, tilt it, more light, less light, it takes me 20 minutes to scan an item and I wish that was an exaggeration! Go back to the previous scanner!! It was fantastic!! Looks like I'll be looking for a new app! I have already filed tickets!!

Spotty at best! I know people want quick info and add the bare minimum, but if i change something to add data, it gets checked, so why aren't all entries checked. I've seen pizzas with 0 calories. Data needs cleaning big time. When it works, it's great! Everything should have a 100g option, though, to save time and make perfect for those who weigh.

To my disgust, I just noticed that they force you to buy premium. I swapped to a new phone and, therefore, a new version, probably. It is no longer possible to scan barcodes without buying premium, rendering the app completely useless. Because I can keep track of the water I drink on a simple checklist, but obviously not of pre-made food. This is how to make money in the short term, but sealing the nail coffin for your app. I hope a lot of people leave and get an alternative.

I do like the app, one of the best I've used so far to count my calories and add recipes, things like that. That being said, this week it's really stressing me out, I add things and they are erased, it's crashing a lot, if I try to ad a recipe or a meal it crashes and lose everything I did, and to make things worse stop syncing whit my tracker.

This app has always been great. But I've noticed lately that it consumes an insane amount of mobile data. In under 2 days it sucked up 1.7gb of data. It never used to do this. Syncing alone couldn't possibly do that much, and I have ads turned off so it's not that either. I resorted to blocking it from using data, so now it's only completely useful while connected to wifi. Very disappointing since I've been using this app for almost 7 years without issue.

I love that the app is easy to use, definitely more user friendly than other food tracking apps I have tried. The database is huge, it's not often I need to create a new food.
