I love being able to add recipes, so helpful when you eat certain foods regularly to not have to input each ingredient separately. The only con has to do with synchronization between the app and Fitbit. The app no longer syncs my steps daily, and doesn't sync exercise either. MFP will also not allow me to disconnect Fitbit

I've been using this app daily for over 6 years now. The premium subscription renewal price has increased well above other similar apps. I tried using the app without the premium subscription and found it very difficult to navigate with all of the excessive ads that pop up. I found it so frustrating to the point that I deleted it from my phone. So unacceptable that companies do this and indirectly try to force you to upgrade at an unreasonable price.

I would have given this app 5 stars a year ago. It has been my go-to app to get back on track for over 6 years. The new update makes the diary unusable with the amount of screen taken up by ads for premium. I heard they are moving their barcode scanner to premium so I immediately looked for other options (found Lifesum!) and deleted the app. Hope you change your mind on that decision unless you plan to be paid only.

A very good app in just about every aspect, easy to use and navigate, even on the free version. A few of the calorie counts for foods are inaccurate or haphazard, it would be easier if things in jars were measured by the jar, half jar and 100 gr. rather than a quarter etc, but this is a minor criticism. I am certainly very glad that I downloaded this app two years ago, it has definitely motivated me and above all given me an insight into which foods are highly calorific, and thus a choice

So when the app is working it's pretty good, would be much better if the ingredients and weights ect were more orientated to where you are geographic wise. The worst thing though is after spending a considerable amount of time putting in all my ingredients and weights it won't let me save the recipe and comes up with error "unable to save recipe, try again later". This is extremely frustrating and has happened multiple times in the past month I've been using this app.

New update messed everything up - no scan ability now. Anyone wondering about it, their support wrote to say that the scanner is now for Premium members only. Bait and switch. Many scans lead to erroneous info lately, so it's just as well. I've had to enter things by hand a lot. So while the scan is useful at times, it is not consistently useful enough to pay for it. Nice try though. Lack of comms on the subject too. Why not indicate it in the app as one tries to use the scan?

I used to love this app, however after it disabled the scanning barcode feature, it's rather pointless and very time consuming. I refuse to pay the over-expensive premium prices when I wouldn't use many of the features! Disgusting. And before you respond with 'there are other ways to track your food...' I am WELL aware. But these alternative ways are not quick nor simple, which is what is needed in a food tracking app. You should be making a fortune on ads alone. If I could rate it 0, I would.

this app would be great, if it worked at all. it is incredibly glitchy. whenever I try to enter a new food it will show up three times, or not work at all, or put a completely different food it. it also wont connect to my fitbit, when I click the connect button it just defaults back to the home screen. extremely disappointing all around.

Is good, but could be better. Just a problem with the measurements units it's too "imperial metric system" while the rest of the world uses the decimal metric system, which is more intuitive and easy to approach. Should be a way to be sure that the data of the product (food) you are seeing corresponds with reality because as it is based on other user's reports some of them are (pretty) inaccurate. The portion management when you do the manual singing of food is confusing.

If you are new to fitness, dieting, etc it's a bit of a minefield. I have the paid version which makes it add free, but let's you track nutrition calories and a whole lot more, but if you are new to discovering carbs, proteins, fats and what % each of these should be (for the average person) it difficult to find out. It is there and there is a shed load of info to help you I just think the app needs to be easier to navigate. A better clearer dashboard.

After 10 years of use its not living up to what it was. Bought a Samsung Efit. MFP won't sync with Samsung health. I had to use a work around requiring the download of two other apps and pay 2.99 to get it to work. Issue has been known for the last year and MFP still hasn't fixed the bug. They claim an update was released in Feb, but this app was downloaded 2 months ago... updated and still unresolved. Food tracking is fine. S20.

Great when it works and the database is quite large, but has constant network issues lately - keeps saying "network error, come back later" so I cant just track on the go as needed, which makes it hard to track consistently. I came back to this app after putting some of the weight I had lost back on but I may have to switch to a more reliable app.

It's great for free. But do find it a bit sluggish when entering data in the food diary. Also you have to be careful which food options you choose as some don't have nutrition associated with them having been entered by other users. It's easier to find calories etc for processed/ready made stuff which doesn't really help healthy living. My biggest bug bear is being asked to try Premium without being told up front the cost after a free trial.

This app seems to have lost some functions that I used to find useful. Like when you copy a meal you can't select which meal it goes into which is annoying when you often have left over dinner for lunch. Also it used to list my frequently paired food really well which was a huge time saver, now this function does not seem to work well. It is, however, free and probably the best calorie tracking app available

Great app to follow your calories, water and macronutrient intake and also log your exercises. It also has lots of suggestions for diet and the premium version comes with daily exercise regimes from various trainers. That's extremely useful. It is a very mature website in terms of content and functionality. The only problem is, the food search facility is really clunky. In 6 years of using this app they have not improved the search function. There is little intelligence to it.

I've used this app for probably about 4 years and I've really loved it. I only used the free version because it was enough for me. I really enjoyed tracking my food because almost all my foods where already in the database. Nonetheless it is almost unusable now. It keeps flipping to the "welcome back" and after that to the subscription screen. It's like an endless cycle. I can't track my food and it is so annoying that I stopped using it. I switched to an alternative app for food tracking.

Really easy to use, especially scanning barcodes to add foods. I like the create meals and recipes option too. It makes it quick to add my go-to meals, and anything I've batch cooked and frozen. Tracking what i eat is really helping me manage my diet and make better choices. My snacking was way out of control and my diet was unbalanced. I ate too many fats and not enough carbs. Only a few weeks but I'm seeing steady progress in the right direction.

The new update is so annoying!!! I've used this app for 3 years and absolutely love it, but the new update is frustrating. When I add a meal it doesn't go back to my diary anymore, it goes back on to the food search screen. If I've added a pre-existing meal, I don't need to add more food, I want to see straight away how many calories I have left or enter information about a different meal, like it did before the update. Now I have to click back every time. I changed my review from 5 stars to 4.

So far so good I am on the 30 day free trial to see if it'll work for me. It has great features that include meal and exercise plans. I have trouble tracking steps (I use Samsunghealth for it, yet doesn't sync). Finding recipes (using the app) is a bit hard, the barcode database isn't so wide and the option of ingredient substitute isn't available (it's not that bad, I just don't have a lot of the ingredients where I live). Other than that, its a good app. Would appreciate timed notifications.

Everything was fine with the app, no faults, the barcode scanner was working fine, and one day, randomly, it logged me out. When I tried to log back in, it kept saying my password and email were incorrect. I was told to delete and reinstall the app only to find the barcode scanner and other features I used are now premium, and I can no longer use it.

Best app for tracking your diet and nutrition. Would recommend. Update Dec23. The amount of ads now present in this app make it very annoying to use, especially because they pop in and out as they load causing stuff on the page to move around randomly. And they are EVERYWHERE! I wouldn't mind paying maybe €3-€5 per month for the ad free version but €20 per month is extortionate for an app such as this. Not enough value for that price tag. Cannot recommend due to excessive ads or high price tag.

Good for calorie tracking, with a large database of foods you can scan the barcode of. Constant and long lags when opening diary, trying to enter food, entering servings, scanning items, quick selecting most recent items, etc, seems to be related to ad loading time which is up to 10 seconds per page which means up to a 1 minute trying to log food often with errors with food being logged multiple times and deleting entries means more lags. Pretty mid now. Barcode scanning which used to be free moved to paid was a shock. Ever since this was bought by under armor this app is pretty bad. You're telling me I need internet to change my weight goal? The app just took a full minute to open and I'm on a brand new s10+. Overall I've found it very useful, has helped me begin losing weight within a week as I became aware of caloric and nutritional values of the foods I regularly eat. I love the large database of foods. My frustration and I suspect why I stopped using this app for so long, is the adding foods measurements. I make a recipe with 1/2 cup oats. Meh. This app has great intentions but as others have said, it bugs a lot. Doesn't sync properly with Endomondo or Map my Whatever. Excellent app for tracking calories when paired with a step counter app or (even better) a Fitbit with heart rate monitor so it can see what calories you really burn. Okay, so the app just randomly kicked me out of my account (created with google) and won't let me log back in. This app leverages data entered by users to quickly calculate nutrient intake, which is great. But they should fire their designer and some of their engineering. Great calorie counter. Easy to use so I don't spend 20mins just trying to add food. You can even take a picture of the bar code on food to quick add. I love that you can make meals so you don't have to keep adding each ingredient every time. It's helped me so far I've lost 21 lbs and counting. Very useful, can scan bar codes of food (US and European), link to other fitness apps, very easily enter food over the course of the day. The difference between free and paid versions is reasonable and while there are ads in the free version, they're not too disruptive. Definitely recommend.

I have used MFP for 5 years now and think its the best tool for weight loss. In thag time I have tried diets but always ended up gaining weight in the end and going back to the simplicity of calorie tracking and lifestyle changes. I've lost 67lb now and am only a few lbs from my goal weight. Its very easy to use, the barcode scanner is brilliant. I'd like to see a better connection with fitbit for exercise as workouts don't transfer & inputting manually means its doubled on fitbit.

I have used myfitnesspal for years (as well as the premium version) and recently returned after a wee hiatus. I'm not sure i'll be using it for very long unfortunately. Having a 'not now' option at each log in might be a simple way of offering it without compromising the service.

It turns out, I eat less calories than I thought. This app helps me to keep track on how many calories I take, especially since it has an accurate calorie value for foods in their list. No not so good since update. I'm a type 1 Diabetic insulin pump user. I have to carbohydrate count each meal to help work out how much insulin I need. Easy to use and somewhat customisable. Check data regularly though, I noticed that daily caloric intake guide was inaccurate (can easily be fixed) and occasionally food data is not correct. App double counts exercise if you use Samsung Health. Not helpful if you are paying the annual fee especially to track your calories accurately. It has a better selection of food than the app "lose it" and I like how it shows the vitamins you consumed and not just but the macro nutrients. Its a good app with one or two failings. This app used to be great. However it increasingly saps more and more data even when the app isn't open. nornally a very good app. but it has some serious glitches. Extremely frustrating. A few days ago I was unable to create any recipe in the app and now on top of that absolutely all my information in my diary is gone. Alll my foods in the computer and phone. Unusable... I've used it for some time, and even tried premium, but it didn't work for me so I returned to the free version. Probably the best way to lose weight, keeping track of your calorie intake and to ensure it is balanced with the essential proteins, carbs and fat as well as vitamins and minerals. I have had this app for 10 years if not more, but now they've started charging for the barcode scanner, it's was bad enythat it sometimes came up with the wrong foods, now it's not going to come up at all. I like this app. It really makes life easier with detailed macros & protein found in all types of food. Best Fitness- and Calorie-Tracker ever! Perfect also for Keto, you can adapt your Nutrition-Goals. I have only used this app for a short time but I am positively impressed. However, something seems to change that I need repeatedly to fiddle with my settings to get stepcount to appear as +ve on the MyFittnessPal. I can't understand why. Requires much commitment!

Good but too many bugs so no way I'd buy this. Creating meals is a nightmare. You'll spend ages adding ingredients and they'll disappear, especially if you edit the meal. Take a photo and it might be there for a few days then again mysteriously disappears. Trying to connect my Garmin to record steps simply sends you in a loop although it tracks running just fine!! Shame because I would like to get rid of the ads but this isn't a polished app.

Either make your subscription more affordable or keep the barcode scanner. It's basically the only feature distinguishing you from other calorie counting apps - without it, what's the point? It's the entire reason most users choose this app over the others on the market. I've trusted MFP daily for years to reliably track my calorie and macro intake, but I know myself among several others who are disgusted at this clear money-grubbing tactic who will be switching to another app.

It was amazing, I've used it for years and years. Added loads of foods to the community crowd sourced database, which was easily the best feature. Unreal that that's now been paywalled. I don't expect to get something this good for free but the subscription cost is a joke and the ads ads unbearable now. Happy to pay a one off fee, but during times like these where it's hard to get by, the sub cost is a joke. Sad loss of an amazing app

Keeps me on course. Barcode ability makes it easy to track foods. I can also link it to my pedometer, so there's the incentive to do a little bit more. Would recommend. Update: still pleased with it but it does lose connection with my pedometer on a frequent basis, not the end of the world but annoying.

3 stars. I've been using this for 8 years, the last 3 being premium, and this last update has killed it. This used to be so easy to use. Now you have to go through extra screens and options just to add. To quickly check what you have left, it's back through the screens, and then forward again. Just plain inconvenient and not user-friendly. Too many options when all you want is one thing, which it had a few weeks ago. I'm getting close to cancelling. Total pain to use now.

This app helps me so much with gaining insight in what I put in my mouth. It has helped me before and now it is helping me again.Tracking calories, easily scanning barcodes on products and giving macro insights... I really like this app a lot! Thank you, team MFP, for making it so much easier to gain insight and through that being able to lose weight.

I would have given 5 stars, but lately, after the update, I can't get in MFP without internet access. It used to be really useful, as you could check your calories through out the day and quick add some, or just add something from the recently used list. Now this feature is unavailable to me and I am very much annoyed, since it was one of the few things that made me pick MFP over other apps. I hope this issue (feature? Not so much) will be fixed soon. Kindest regards, A long-time user

It is very useful and has some great pros. But the measurements for food is very weird and you cannot select to change units so somethings are recorded in oz, others cups, grams or in units (which can be any obscure amount). Plus it is not region locked so searching terms result in a lot of American franchises not here in australia which is a bit annoying. But overall you'll be hard done finding an app anywhere near as effective

Surprisingly easy and straightforward. Once you've input your usual meals it literally takes minutes to plan out how much of what to eat for the day based on your personal goals. I was under my target weight and I can now clearly see I wasn't getting the correct calories/macros. Since using this I've consistently gained weight week on week. It works - period.

Never seen a app with so many bugs and it gets worse by the time. Now you can't add items to your meals beacse the item is sent to your diary! So it adds food to your diary that you didn't consume. Also a lot of times the exercise added gets duplicated. The app is a mess. It's useless is it doesn't allow you to track the calories and exercise correctly.

This app used to be brilliant, but now the calories i'm burning aren't being synced with Google Fit. I can only enter the food i'm having each day but it doesn't take off the calories i burn. It's been like it for over a month now. Please get this sorted, it was so good when it was working properly. Plus I'm getting ads on it now which never used to happen, i even get one that gives out a ladies voice talking,(annoying!!!!)I've tried everything to get it working again, but with no luck.

I would rate this higher if it actually would sync with my fitness tracker and automatically register my exercise. As it isn't doing that due to being "unable to connect to the server ", I'm knocking off too stars because not doing this vital part means I can't properly track my fitness and calories which is the point of this app for me!! This issue went away but now the same problem is back so back to only 3 stars. Pls fix your sync issues and actually track the exercise

I have been using this app for some time now. The new version is okay as I managed to familiarise myself with the new dashboard. However, this week there has been introduction of advertisement within the diary section. When you search for food to add to the diary, you can't go back unless you watch the advert. The only option is to close the app & then go back into it.This defeats the purpose of the app being quick and easy to use, now that you have to watch adverts while simply updating diary

Pretty useful. I only have the free app and see no need to add the premium. Drawbacks for the nutrition diary include some inaccurate nutritional information in user uploads, inability to do a macro breakdown by meal, difficulty assessing composed dishes like salads, but these are all minor issues. I'd also prefer to set my own macro and Cal goals rather than have them assigned to me by some body weight algorithm.

Inferior to cheaper similar apps. Diary page is very busy and doesn't display clearly. Database is extensive because it is evidently not regulated. Some foods are on there multiple yet identical times with different nutrition data, some liquids are listed in grams. And at £10 for the premium version, I use nutracheck instead which is far superior in all these ways and £4 a month.

Fitbit integration doesn't seem to work properly anymore. The more steps I take the more it impacts negatively the over all net calories. For example, I took 11k steps, it would be expected to earn some calories at intake, but instead the calories are being taken away from intake, in this example -606 calories was the outcome of 11k steps. So I'm burning calories therefore I should eat less. This has been happening for months now and it's making want to leave the app.

It takes a while to get used to it but it has loads of useful features, especially adding your own recipes as it calculates all the nutritional info for you ; you can also download ingredients straight from a Google recipe :) Only one problem; I synced MFP to Map My Walk - the calories burnt on MMW were 666 but it uploaded more than a 1000 to MFP! The 'Help' & FAQ options on the App are empty! I found out that the App estimates the days calories from the exercise you have done - that's crazy!

Mostly really helpful, my main complaint is not being able to access the ingredients for "my recipes". Sometimes I create a recipe and then either can't remember what I put in it last time or want to edit it. But all it tells you is the nutritional information and not the list of ingredients, and it doesn't let you edit the contents.

Update: I used an online breastfeeding calorie counter and used that number to enter a custom goal. It's not perfect, but it works! Thanks :) old review: I used to use and love this app, but it doesn't work for me anymore since there's no pregnancy or breastfeeding option, both of which greatly change calorie requirement.

Absolutely loved the app for the first 3 months. Lost 40 pounds and felt that was an ok trade-off for the high data usage, around 680mb per month. In 28 days this month it sucked over 2.6 GIGA BYTES of data ($150.00 of overage fees). Note. They seem to have fixed the incredibly high data usage. However, now all of a sudden it no longer syncs to samsung health, and it keeps insisting I'm taking short bike rides nullifying my 10+ km of walking for 9 cal worth of biking. BAH!

Really user friendly. So informative, the foods database is waaay better than Noom (plus cheaper and more non US friendly) allows macro tracking and is well integrated. Can look back over the days previously and see progress. Only loses a star because it doesn't allow calorie tracking for weight training, only cardio, it doesn't include hiit workouts as exercises to log and it keeps telling me I haven't logged meals that I have definitely logged. Other than that great, worth going premium.

Have been using this only for 5 days and am VERY impressed. Considering upgrading to premium once i have better learnt to navigate. Really informataive articles on the blog, great recipes, barcode scanner works, the food database is awesome tho....would like to see more "check" verified foods. The one complaint i have is that there is not yet a distinction between free vs intrinsic sugar intake, but you can get around that by adding fruit/veg as a separate category. AWESOME!!

The new update has ruined this app. Now unable to copy meals from day to day, which when on a diet and eating similar meals was essential. Overall the app is now harder to use with more clicks required to do anything like add meals, see what you have logged and scroll through different days etc. All in all this is a terrible update to what was a great app. Will be cancelling my payments and looking for a different option.

I've been using it for a little while and the basic functions I need - tracking calories and macros, logging weight and workouts - work as they should. The best compliment I can give is that it works as it should, no crashes or overwhelming amount of ads. Good library of foods, though you will see sometimes different calorie values for same foods.

I lost over 60 pounds with this app & LOVE everything about it (esprcially that it connects to fitbit). I'd absolutely give five stars if it had a dark/night mode option. I usually log my meals before bed so having the bright white screen isn't very great at all. Everything else about the app is amazing though, so I'll definitely be rating five stars as soon as dark mode becomes available.

I am using this as a calorie tracker and it is very useful. I don't know if it is possible, but it would be helpful to be able to have a quicklist of meals you eat regularly, so you don't have to add all items individually or search the menus and wade through everyone else's peanut butter and banana on toast, or whatever - It might already be a feature I don't know how to use yet. But very good.

What is going on with the app? The new look I'm not a fan of but can deal, all extra functions are now premium at a rediculous price but today the water log function is not working. I like the way it was before, I have custom amounts every day & they just saved at the bottom that I just had to use 1 click after. Now it's in 250/500ml increments, so I have to use custom ALL the time. It's not saving my total intake at all, I've reinstalled the app twice now.

I love the new look of the app however what is up with the billing? Sometimes when I click on premium it's 7.99 a month and sometimes it's 15.99 a month. Same discrepancy for yearly. It's led me to not trust the app. You seem to be offering massively different prices but I can't figure out the reason. Logging out and back in sometimes spawns the cheaper price Edit yes logging in and out halves the price and I've got screenshots to prove it. Very strange and dishonest

I've been using the app for a few months now. It works for me mostly. For the food diary I have to estimate my portions most times as there isn't a serving size that works for what I ate. My son also has the app & it would be nice to share recipes. As for the exercise part when I use my watch to track my workouts it will put the workout in multiple times and say I burned ridiculous amounts of calories like over 10,000 calories burned. How much would you have to eat in a day to burn that much?!

After 2 weeks of using it, the bar code scanning options stopped working and keeps saying "an unknown error occurred". But after leaving a review here about having difficulty, they actually sorted it out so quickly that they definitely have a permanent app user. It's so easy to use and gives you detailed nutritional information on each meal you add.

Meals function is unusable. When I create a meal, I can only add it to the diary as a whole, so I cannot cook and log anything that is bigger than 1 portion. Having more than 1 person in the household I always cook multiple portions; no way I can add custom meals by weight, like any other product. For me, this makes this whole thing with all its bells and whistles just as useful as an Excel sheet and calculator.

In the last two weeks there have been huge lags (hours) to sync my fitbit app steps and the app. Have tried closing out of everything and opening it up again, restarting my phone, and disconnecting my fitbit from the app and reconnecting it again. Not a glitch you'd expect when you've paid an annual subscription. Aside from this the app is good so that's why it gets 3 stars.

Not many apps manage to decrease in functionality over the years. That's quite the achievement. I've used this app for many many years and not only have I never seen it improving, but I've put up with more and more rubbish alternative listings for any one item; and ads being more intrusive etc. The final straw is that this last update has stopped the basic features working properly - you can't see calories for the week, only for a day at a time - are we living in 1990? 😡

Very handy, easy to use. Geez there's some junk in the catalogue tho. Fresh food items should be verified and those promoted to the top of searches (especially if search includes "raw" or "fresh"). Verified values are currently not so trustworthy either. Barcode scan is a super handy feature and normally returns the right values, but it pays to check everytime.

I like the features allowing you to find restaurant food and the helpful videos. But it really chews through my data allowance. I had to restrict it to WiFi only, which reduces its usefulness drastically. It can easily eat 2 to 3 gig in a month. September 2022:: every upgrade recently seems to break something. This time the water log is broken.

This is a useful app and one that is easy to use, even though it starts showing its age. A general overhaul and rethinking the old functionalities would do it good. For example, the "add frequently paired foods" algorithm is dumb and unable to learn from recent examples: it blindly offers those foods that once, however long time ago, were added together with a particular food, and there is no way to interact with this behavior on the user's side. At least, I haven't find a way to do so.

I've just been logged out of the app, it won't recognise the password and evertytime I click "forgot password" all it does is send an email to my inbox with a link taking me straight back to the app ... giving me no option to change the password. why was I signed out? I'll just get a different app, or try and write my calories down instead. Just tried exiting the app to see if that would help with the email link, it didn't

I would give this app 5 stars, but only like using this app when I have a premium membership. The free version is missing many tools. I am very disappointed to see that, even though the premium subscription is already extremely pricey, they decided to add a new tier to tier subs with premium plus?! Like seriously, I already pay way enough. I want the planning features but am not paying more. Were you not making enough already with your high monthly cost. Just ridiculous.

The app only shows limited nutrient info and doesn't allow you to add info for several important nutrients & minerals like Magnesium, Copper, B Vitamins, Vitamin D,K,E and a whole lot. It's just a simple update, but for some reason the developers refuse to do so. It's very irritating. If I'm going through the trouble of logging in every food I eat, I atleast expect that then I get complete info about my nutrition & I won't have to do guess which Supplements I need. VERY DISAPPOINTING!!

Sign up process was confusing and UI on selecting the date of birth on Android was horrible. User has to manually swipe every months of the years until the date of birth. Just provide an input box to manually enter the data. Moreover, there is a bug. The daily calories goal doesn't update even after changing the weight goal, activity type and loss weight goal per week. I like the scanning bar code feature a lot. Hope things I mentioned above will be fixed.

All diets, whether it's WeightWatchers, Slimming World or anything else, all work on the basis of calories in versus calories out (even if they don't admit it). Take the time to *honestly* and *consistently* monitor your calorie intake and you *will* lose weight, and this app is the perfect (and best) tool to support you in those goals. I've used it for years and have lost 4 stone. Highly recommended.

this app was working well for the first few days but keeps coming up with a network error shop i can't log any food. i shall wait a little while longer. I have refreshed my rating from 3 to 5 starts because it has been working flawlessly for a while now. Does everything i need and integrates really well with Garmin connect and training peaks.

It's really useful for logging my food intake: breakfast, lunch, dinner. The database gives you the ability to add a food quickly, organised even by the brand of the food. The information includes all the essentials. However, if you're looking for detail covering, say, your intake of carbs or fats, you're going to have to do a lot more work for yourself. You're going to have to log details separately on a separate app (like a notepad or diary). OR you're going to have to upgrade to Premium.

This app used to be so simple to use for counting calories. It used to link up and sync with the edmondo tracker and fitbit apps. You would enter calories and my fitness app counted them, took off the exercise you did to give you a daily total. 'So simple'. I've not used it for a while but bought a new fitbit Versa and synced it to My Fitness App but no exercise is showing. All its doing is counting calories !! I've unistalled the app and reinstalled it. Have been through settings. No Joy !!!

Search results sorting is illogical. For example, I search "chicken breast" and the top verified hit is a brand name CANNED chicken breast. I remember why I stopped using this app. There are so many conflicting and inaccurate food entries and finding basic foods is a real chore. Why don't you link to a verified food database API and prioritize results for real, unpackaged foods, with information on WEIGHT rather than poor and inconsistent units like cups?

This app is basically Malware, it changes the results of searches through your browser (without asking for any consent) rerouting it to their blog which will appear as top results. It also changed my Firefox home screen to blog posts on the myfitnesspal site. Unsubscribing to emails or the service is confusing. It asks for too many data for what it's supposed to do and, last but not least, it asks you to forfeit your European privacy rights in order to use the app. Highly recommend avoiding it.

This app is really useful. I am pretty healthy and fit but get off track every once in a while. This app helps me be aware and more conscious of what I am putting into my body. The bar code reader is extremely handy and I love the recipe importer. My only beef is that it doesn't always connect with my favourite site. Since it does work some of the time I am not sure if it's user error or my recipe site or this app. It takes a bit to figure out how to really use it, especially if you want to create your own recipes. I enjoy the blog articles and recipes so overall a great app.

Too much hassle to get basic features working. I spent 2 days trying to get it to sync my workout and steps from other apps that I used an when I finally got it working my fitness pal got a UI update just for me to have to struggle with the same problem again. And to report a bug doesn't work either. Just keeps telling me my email address is invalid. Done with this app.

Absolutely ridiculous app. Taking away the free barcode scanner was the worst decision they ever made. Every time you click on anything you get another ad. The app is virtually useless and unusable now. If the bot that's responding to everyone could please not bother - yes, I know I can search the data base manually, no, I am not going to do that for every single thing. I have deleted my account and will find something else to use. Such a shame.

The nutrition aspect in this app is good so far, but the workout/exercises aspect needs 2 main small modifications: 1. We need to be able to add the exercises that we've created into the workout routines. Another tab for exercises inside the workout routines tab would be sufficient. 2. We need to be able to add an image/gif for an exercise. These small modifications would make the fitness part of the app much more better, that no one will use a separate app for that. You could even premium it.

500 characters isn't enough to go into how much this app has helped me. Being able to track what you're putting, and equally importantly, what you're not putting in your body is eye opening. Suffice to say, if i can spend £8 a month on Netflix, i can spend £40 a year on this literally life changing app.

I love it. It's very informative and has a wide variety of food available. Normally because of my location calory count apps normally don't know some of the food available here and so far, I am pleased. It has different plans and is customizable. and at the end of the day based on your what you ate it tells you how much you would weigh if you ate like that everyday, which shows you what you need to cut back on and increase. It's a great app.

The app is okay by itself BUT as soon as you go premium and decide you don't want to be on a premium account, there is no way of cancelling the account! I have been trying for about a week now, I've tried on the app, on google play and on the website and still haven't been able to cancel it! I don't want to be paying £40 to an app that I don't even use anymore!!! PLEASE make it simpler to cancel an account because I'm confused on if it's even possible!

The app is actually really good, even if not premium. I had this before an you could take pics of barcode, which now you can't unless premium. The main issue i have with this app, is its always off with the nutritional values! Fibre it always gets wrong an always comes up under the correct amount. Also the protein an carbs are never consistent. If carbs are correct, then protein will be wrong vice versa. It really is annoying to be fair. Please can you fix this if possible!? Thanks

My only niggle is the watch widgets would be better if there was an option to show my remaining calories as opposed to how many I have had. At quick glance on my watch I just want to know do I have enough calories remaining to eat that! I have premium + now and it does tick pretty much every box!! It's extremely easy to use, and has a lot of extras that I didn't realise I needed until I upgraded!!

I went from 115kgs as a 19 year old male to 88kgs using this app. You have to be dedicated to find the right calorie counts and weigh food before you eat it. I have learned soooo much about calories and health. I can safely say that this app has changed my life doesn't the better. There are a few things wrong with it but otherwise worth the MBs on your phone.

For tracking macros this app is one of the best out there. Its calorie intake suggestions for weight loss in women should be updated. No app should recommend 1200 calories. Secondly, it would be helpful to track menstrual cycles/symptoms alongside weight as this can provide better insights and trends for women on their health journey. Water tracker function could be made a bit more intuitive - maybe per glass/bottle rather than estimating overall volume as you go the same way it tallies macros.

I'm generally very pleased with MFP. I really want the ability to track - Net Carbs (Carbs - (Fibre + Sugar Alcohol)), Sugar Alcohols, and Omega 3/6/9 grams. And servings sizes available in metric and imperial. With the rise in 'paleo', 'keto', 'lgid', ... it only makes sense to include these features. **it would be nice if incorrect/outdated food items could be removed from the database.

The fact that using the barcode scanner (once part of the free version) is now only available for $20 a months is insane. I have now deleted the app. All i used it for was to log and keep track of my food. That is not worth such an insane asking price. I won't be coming back, before you know it there will be zero free features available. Absolute jokers

Just awful. I tried to sign up with 2 different email addresses and 1 Facebook account. Neither of them worked. After I submitted everything, including my password, when I had to log in it wouldn't let me because the email address wasn't registered. I tried to do it the other way, which is to sign up again, but now it tells me the email address has been already used. I've done this 3 times. By the way, yes I did confirm my email and try again. Still wouldn't work. It was SO frustrating.

Been using this for years. Now all of a sudden you get these pop-ups non-stop for subscription. They took away the barcode scanner unless you have a subscription. They're basically trying to force you into paying and it's not even a reasonable price that I will never pay for an app. If there was a price to buy outright without a subscription I might think about it. But with the ridiculous amount they are trying to charge forget it time to look for a new app.

This app is very helpful to track your weight loss/gain/maintenance goals and targets. I personally don't really count calorie as I don't think this matters: 1 calorie of avocado doesn't equal 1 calorie of crisps so this is pointless to count if you still have bad eating habits. On the other hand, it helped me see how I improved with my eating habits which is great!

I mean it works just fine as a calorie counter. It's useful even without subscribing to premium. My biggest issue with the app is that a good portion of the time it won't load. It'll be stuck on the blue loading screen for minutes and because of that, some days I can't log my intake. This would be a five star app if it weren't for the loading issue

Good for it's uses, but it's begun giving adverts with sound that you can't turn off or figure out where it's coming from, clearly to try to annoy you into buying the premium version. I also dislike the focus of many of the sponsored articles being on weight loss rather than health, but that's a personal opinion. I have troubles syncing my Google fit app steps, and I never used to be able to sync my iphone either.

I've used the app for years. Always liked it. I used to pay for premium but then the cost was getting too high. And now with the update it's got even higher and they've took basic functions away from non-sub members? If they had different levels of subscription for full package or just certain features like ad-free, or just food logging then I'd consider using the app more often but not value for the money now. Hopefully it will get back to it's best in future

1) Nutrition data doesn't sync to Google Fit (despite what it says in the "connect apps" listing). 2) It's quite complicated to enter the amount of each food item: you can't just enter "40 grams", often you need to select "a 0.4 fraction of a 100 gram serving". Plus, many items have units that don't make sense: cheese measured in cups or liters but not grams? 3) Browsing to find the best listing for a type of food could be easier if there was autocomplete/ live refresh

I've learnt a lot about what foods have high calories, and have been able to reduce my calorie intake to meet the number I'm allowed. Its very good and i lost 3 pounds in the first week. But the interaction with garmin connect doesnt work properly, and sometimes the addition of a food to a meal goes wrong, or fails. you have to watch that extra copies of foods don't appear spuriously. On the whole I'm pleased with my progress and intend to continue until I reach my goal.

Does what I need it to - tracks my calories. Cons - can't get it to sync with Samsung Health for my daily steps. Also, some food items in Europe that are being added by users contain errors. It'd be good to have the option to suggest an edit as there are sometimes many multiples of a single product. Also also, having products verified by someone would be great.

Pretty good so far. One functionality I wish they had is the ablity to view and save your friend's meals. Say for example you've just had dinner with your family and all of you are using this app, one of you could save the meal and the others could access it rather than each of us individually scanning all the barcodes etc. Uploading the meal to the database doesn't seem to happen straight away Thanks

I have been using this app for years now. I used it on a low carb diet and I use it for the ketogenic lifestyle I am following for over a year now. There are so many features that were added along the years that really save a lot of time and make my food entries a lot quicker. As stated by others, the import of the step count never really worked, but I did not mind as that was not my primary use for the app. I always recommend the app to anyone who wants to start on a health journey.

This is an excellent App for both management and control of yoir diet, exercise and nutrition. i recently noticed however, that the ability to monitor nutriant details seem to be more comprehensive on the iOS version! My partner is diabetic and would like to simultaneously monitor calories and carbs on the Android version, but doesnt seem able to without a relatively expensive subscription.

Just went to use the app again after about a 6 month break, just to find that things I could do before, I now can't unless I pay?!? The best feature was being able to scan barcodes so I didn't have to search through all the different options, but I can't justify spending $33 a month just for that. So I think I might just stop using again.

I want to track nutrients for health reasons and to gain weight, but the app focuses on calories. There are not really apps for tracking nutrients in the app store, that don't focus on loosing weight. Though I found this a best option. Unfortunately there could be more nutrients that I would like to track e.g. B vitamins. Also a lot of nutrients doesn't get tracked e.g. iron or fibers in oats = 0?? The round blue bar at the bottom is bit distracting if you want to view the main content.

Great and the barcode feature is brilliant. Loses a star though due to sending notifications saying I've not logged meals when I have which, although no big deal, is annoying. Notifications are on as it would be useful but only when they are correct! Other than that though, the good outweighs the bad. Nutrients feature is interesting and it's really easy to use so I'd recommend it to friends.

Absolutely DREADFUL! Would give 0 stars if I could. Used to be so good, but now won't sync any exercise I do, wipes my food entries and often won't let me log in as the server is down! Seems that this has been the issue for a loooong time now, with no resolve, despite a huge amount of customer complaints! For goodness sake MFP.... SORT IT OUT!

If I don't open the app every day, I get caught in a loop between the "check your goals" and "free 30 day trial" screen. The goal screen always pops up if I didn't use the app for a while, and after I click "continue", the "trial" screen pops up. Since I don't want the stupid trial, I press the "back"-button (there is no "no thanks"), whereafter I have to confirm my goals AGAIN, and when I'm finished, the trial pops up AGAIN. This repeats 10 - 15 times before I can actually log some calories.

Brilliant app. I am a busy professional and many times i end up skipping my planned meals. I tend to then get hungry and look towards junk food. Having this app has really helped me as the log created for the meals I have had makes me track what all I have missed and eat those healthy missed meals rather than jump onto the unhealthy snacks. It has also helped me to track calories so there is no Guess work to see if I have eaten less or not. Nutrition information breakdown has also helped immense

As a diabetic type 1, I am using the app for years, however typing everyghing is time consuming. I would love to be able to speak to the phone while meal prepping. The app could transfer it to the table with pre selected macros so I can double check the input and approve. Process would be way more user friendly and app would be worth the subscription.

do not yet buy premium for this app. I'm "a bit" frustrated with the integration with google fit and health connect. The stepcounter is broken, and the amount of calories burned with exercise and walking changes from positive to positive and back again with a 1500 cal marge. Steps are NOT counted correct. Exercises are updated and showing, and with the next refresh removed. It's one broken mess. Edit: support is pretty quick, we will see how long it takes to fix.

This app used to be good, now it's pretty much awful. Ridiculously expensive, and basically unusable if you don't get premium. And anyway it doesn't meet my needs as there is no way to set different calorie budgets for different days. The UI is also quite cluttered/busy, unintuitive and ugly, especially for such an expensive app, I would expect much more. Going back to my other app and won't be back to MFP.

Extensive nutrition value database, a great tool in planning meals. Would be even better if it syncs with my Garmin. Update: the app syncs with my Garmin! Even for the free version, it beats many other paid apps out there, and its paid version is particularly valuable to those who want to work on their macronutrient. Absolutely THE best weight management app, not one of it.

Was the best calorie tracking app before the faceluft update. I was a premium user for almost 2 years, but now decide to take a break for a while and just use the free version. Honestly it is unusible! Almost 60% id the screen is coveted with adds and menus. Fell horrible I do not even want to use it. The pay version looks much more expensive from what I remember payed in the passed that is not affordable anymore. Also I had years of progress pictures taken lost, replaced with food pictures?!

Following MyFitnessPal has been the only way I have been able to watch what I eat and lose weight without feeling deprived or restricted. I love that I can eat anything I want, I just have to count it! Scannin the barcode is so easy and gives you accurate calories as well as helps you control portion sizes. I would highly reccomend!

When it's so easy to forget what you ate 8 hours ago and just have that extra snack or bigger meal, MyFitnessPal keeps you on track. I never fail to lose weight if I set my goal in the app and stay honest with myself. Scan foods or search the database, it's rare to not find a suitable listing to log. Save meals once all calculated from ingredients and share with friends using the app too. It's brilliant.

I have to update my review. Previously I gave 5 stars but said use the website too. I've logged in and used the MFP app every day for 2466 days (I'm not joking). So believe me, I've used the it a fair bit. Their integration with FitBit seems to go down every other month, and the scanner frequently crashes and doesn't work. To make matters worse, their adverts now play audio completely unprompted, even if your phone is locked or you've just got the app going in the background. This isn't OK.

I was struggling to lose my last bit of baby weight and only have 3 pounds left and it has been painless because of this app. I still get to drink my Prosecco and have treats but it just makes you aware of your calories and having to do some exercise if you have a treat day or night coming up. It's also really easy to scan your food and makes you aware of what essential vitamins etc you may be lacking.

Since the update, my regular foods don't come up in the list or are in completely random places and don't come up when searched. They seem to get forgotten quickly, making it very difficult to enter things I eat regularly. EDIT: appreciate the reply. This seams a bit better now. I will update the review when it's back to normal. A usefull feature in My Meals would be the ability to copy-paste or duplicate a meal so you can change one or two ingredients quickly.

I've used this app for 8 years and in the past year alone I've lost 4 stone. Unfortunately, like others I've found with every update they are trying to make the free version less user friendly. I've never needed to pay for premium because it doesn't have any features I require. I think they know this and that's why they removed the barcode scanner from the free account. I can't afford or justify £15.99 for premium just to scan food so if this continues I'll have to find something else. Shame.

The App refuses to launch or load correctly. After 15 years using the app store, this is the first instance where I can't get an app to launch correctly. Initial pages to request permission to pull data from your device and push subscriptions have no issue loading, unfortunately the same cannot be said of the actual service itself. Very disappointing coming from such an established application.

There might be extra features if you pay for the premium version, but the basic flaws of nutrient tracking have not been addressed. The daily allowance for healthy fats (mono and polyunsaturates) is still 0, while there is an allowance for bad fats (cholesterol, trans fats). Carb intake is also misleading as the app includes non-bioavailable carbs (fibre) that do not affect weight gain to your allowance - but you can always focus on just sugars. Otherwise, it's good for basic calorie tracking.

Excellent database and easy to use features. I'm just using the free version. Ads are annoying but I can ignore. I like being able to copy meals from one day to another. You can put in your own recipies too. Excercise buys you extra calories. Automatically updates exercise from fitness tracker if linked. I haven't been able to get the bar code reader to work but I can live without it.

I first used this in about 2013 and it was all you could want from a calorie tracker, perfect. It's now a bloated, difficult to navigate, ad-spamming paywalled mess. I feel bad for having recommended others to use it. How do you screw it up this badly? Literally undo the last 10 years of development and it would be a better application in every way.

Really great app!!! I highly recommend for keeping track of your food intake.. I struggle to eat enough each day, so this apps holds me accountable and encourages me to get in enough calories. Its great also seeing what nutrients etc you are putting into your body per meal/per day and what your weight will be in 5 weeks. It really pushes me to reach my target everyday and eat healthier aswell.

Not that great as a food tracker. Remember to use the search terms in significance order eg. "Tortillas spicy tescos" but you will still find many irrelevant matches and not in relevance order. Can not see the ingredients of pre entered recipes from your diary. Barcode search takes ages and often fails even when it scans the barcode right. The micro ingredients analysis is much more limited than say cronometer. Worst bit is ingredient units are fixed, it can't convert between gs, tsps, servings

It works fine since I subscribed to this app. After a month of using it, I uninstall the app from my old phone because I had a new phone. Installed the app in my new phone and logged in, but suddenly after that I couldn't access to my premium subscription anymore. I already paid for 1 year subscription. Did email the support, hoping for quick response.

A brilliant app that let's you keep track of your calories and nutrition. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to keep a health eating plan and great for helping you loose weight.. Its amazing to see how many calories I was actually eating before I started using it.... I would be lost without now. Iit has worked perfectly without any problems. Fantastic app.

Its not too bad and free version is good value so don't change that developers please. I think there are too many options for the same food this needs to be regulated and standadized. It should be easier to amend amounts a weight types. The exercise part has no way near enough options and lacks detail. What is the point of the water section if there is no target? Same for veg daily target. I like the this good has a lot of notice more detail there , like carbohydrates a lot of people want lower

So, aside from my issues with the glitchy Health Connect, which doesn't allow two-way synchronisation, now I'm having problems with my foods lists! Now I can't see many of the items I add every day in main menu! Several have just disappeared completely! Just noticed that using "Most Frequent" sort shows some again.

First this is a great app and really helped me reign in my weight and stay focused an my goals! Wide data base and the barcode scanner made everything easy! Thank you taking your time to develop this! Some ideas: It would be good if the app calculates how you have left to consume in relation to the calorie count and your goals. e.g. help me work out how much pasta I can eat to stay within my total, and macro goals. "you can have X g's to stay within your goal"

I enjoy the app for adding my food and recipes. I like seeing how I'm doing and nutrients for the day. It also doubles the exercise Samsung health records. $200+ for a yearly subscription is a bit too far out of the ball park when all you're doing is logging details and on a budget. The free side does enough to support most daily needs

A decent app overall, with some major annoyances: 1. It automatically logs me out multiple times a day, and there's no biometric sign-in, only password. 2. A large percentage of the barcode scans are wrong - they almost feel AI-generated. 3. The widgets, while really useful, could be smaller/more condense.

Was using his app a couple years ago and loved it! Just downloaded again and my Fitbit won't disconnect. I even revoked access through Fitbit bit it still is connected on Fitness Pal. Also connected to Google Fit, as this is now what I use, set this up as the step tracker and nadda! None of my steps or exercises are syncing. Really disappointed as I loved this app when I used it previously. Side note- it really needs some updating. It's like walking into a home from the 90s.

The free version is unusable, you are bombarded with popups for the paid version and for every action you have to close the window 2 or 3 times. You basicly can't use the food scanner option. I know that it's the free version but com on the experience is atrocious and incredibly annoying. The premium version might be good, the app seams nice but I'm no longer inclined to pay for it, I would rather pay for another app.

Used to be a premium member (for about 4 years) as I needed to track macros and micros with flexibility to change targets as often as I needed. Then my annual subscription ran out and, without warning, the cost went up to a sickening $20/month. Absolutely ridiculous. App was immediately uninstalled. Don't know what happened, but obviously greed has taken over. Hope this app loses its user-base and dies off - the only outcome suitable for this level of greed.

Not good if you want to track your vitamin and mineral intake / adequacy. This app really just tracks your calories and see macronutrients. Also annoying: their food database is peer-sourced, meaning there are multiple records for each food, each with diff nutrition!

Considering the price I pay for premium its not very good. So many bugs. Often won't read a bar code unless I wave around the camera so it blurs. I started using this app for basic information recording over 2 years ago, although I have not used it for a few months now. I understand they want a monthly/yearly revenue stream; however, the amount they want is simply too much. That is the primary reason for my low rating. I will be deactivating this app now, and deleting it soon.

pretty good app. great way to control your macros and overall calorie intake.....it's scary how much sugar I was consuming unknowingly until I started to log my food, drink & alcohol intake. App could be improved by giving better directions to users so that they don't replicate existing products that have already been created. many products literally have 10's of the same identical product.

Notified I had signed up to Premium when I was not aware!...£64.99! Luckily, I saw the email from google advising me my trial period was finishing. Used to be very good but now I'm constantly having to uninstall due to either the repeated pampers advert that constantly plays or that my exercise and steps logs as activity in the diary but the exercise number remains at '0'. Generic response received that advised to unlink accounts, reinstall, etc. Still no success.

No good for counting NET carbs in the UK - why? The US version allows you to count up Net carbs, which is really helpful if you're on the Keto diet, or other low carb diets I suppose. Hey, if you sort this out I would use this app, particularly as it's more reliable with bar code scans in the UK, however falls down subject to it not meeting my needs on keto.

Completely broken as of 30 Jan 23. I have been using the app since before they stopped partnering with Samsung. I should have months of data and have an account. Today it suddenly locked me out. Was great app, but been slowly going into a decline. Started with no syncing with fitbit ( unable to disconnect fitbit account or add a new one too). Now it is stuck in a updating your goal loop. I'd hold of downloading till the issue are resolved (On android)

I subscribed to premium and gained minimal advantages over the free version. It doesn't synch properly with fitness watches and especially the calorie burn. I hope there can be an option to manually input the calorie burn without the need to individually mention all the workouts done. I found a similar concern 2 years ago (November 2022) and was surprised that the reviews and feedback are not taken seriously. I hope anytime soon this can be resolved. The "Scan a Meal" feature is no good.

Very useful. I didn't think so at first but once I watched the how to video's and got to grips with creating recipes and meals it got so much easier. it is awesome. It helps me track my calories and macros so that I am eating enough to get bigger but without getting overly fat or unhealthy. It also ensures that I am eating enough protein. It may not always be accurate all the time but I scan foods that has a barcode or type what I had eaten and it would normally give a good estimate of the calories and nutrients.

I've used this app off and on for 8 years and this last year has had the most horrible glitches ever. Not being able to log food, no notifications of messages or comments, resetting the feed constantly while scrolling through and the plethora of ads that clog up the feed... its getting to the point where I'm going to look elsewhere. This app has gotten ridiculous. Thanks, Under Armour, for ruining a good thing.

I am a Premium member and since the App was updated I cannot log in anymore!!!! I tried des-installing/ reinstalling, restarting my phone before and after but nothing! I use the app constantly and plan my meals every day. Using the website version just doesn't work as half of the features are on the app only!!!

Have used this app for years and it's been great and the ads never bothered me. Earlier when I use to find out the results were quite accurate... But now I see it is giving incorrect macros.. As me being on keto diet currently its not helping me out... I see there are many options with calorie n macro counts ranging from sky to earth.. Very difficult to know which is correct n which is wrong.. I guess too many people are adding their recipes in the app and spoiling it.. The app for me has degraded in performance over a period of time..

I love this app. Improvements for 5 stars would be: I wish meals saved automatically as you make them so you don't lose everything if you accidentally back out, and I wish there was built in options for pregnant or breastfeeding mothers. Right now I just add a cardio exercise called "breastfeeding" every day, but it doesn't adjust the required nutrients.

I've been successful losing weight with this app because i can be very specific about not just counting calories, but nutritional value and am able to tailor my diet and routine to meet my unique body's needs. No pushy ads, optional support community if you need that and a huge data base of information, even on less popular food brands. Excellent!!

Great app for tracking your diary. I use it every day, its quick and easy enough to use daily, whithout frustration. I also found that the barcode scanner tends to find more items than another barcode scanner app I previously used. On the negative side: it doesn't pair with my phone's stepcounter. (Huawei P10)

Not good if you need to change your profile. I needed to change my email address as my account had been signed in with my FB account and I no longer use that email adress. No probs changing it on FB. Also why is it 3 times more expensive to pay monthly for premium than to pay up front. That's a rip off.

No longer worried about consuming so much I hope the app caters to those who burn more than 2,720 calories a day by letting users type in how many calories they usually burn a day (thanks to the data recorded on their activity tracker). I usually burn 4000 calories a day as a full time, single parcel sorter so I would appreciate more relevant guidelines for me.

Have always liked this app until most recent update. 1: Takes way longer to open, I've gotten into the habit of doing other things while the app opens, 30-60 seconds. 2: I do not like how I can't see what's recorded immediately in a meal. They've added an additional click to see the overview. 3: They got rid of the warnings about unhealthy parts of the food recorded (those were extremely helpful). 4: Overall very clunky. Will be looking for a different app to use. Use Excel, they don't change.

Awful, awful, awful. I used to use this app a while back when I was trying to lose some weight. I loved it! I've just logged back in and I hate it now and will be deleting. It's a tracking app. Do I really need to confirm my goals every time I eat. Such a shame, it was such a good app

The app is very good for logging food. The food database is extensive. In terms of user experience of the home feed, though, there are too many ads. Another annoying issue is that it's hard to scroll through your feed because it keeps jumping back to the top of the feed. Also, the home feed hasn't been updating for the last 4 days causing significant inconvenience.

I installed and upgraded the app today. Yearly subscription. Diligently logged my foods during the day - 3 times or so it was fine. And I intend to use the app because I need it, but now I get the feeling that I don't trust it anymore. How do I know that after a month of logging I don't come into an empty diary?

DONT PAY FOR PREMIUM! App is okay but many faults... I've created meals and when I add them to my daily diet diary, they can sometimes add extra portions of that meal I've added. It will also duplicate meals in my created meal menu. The app is decent, but do NOT pay for the monthly premium... for the amount of faults there are.

Extensive library of foods that help me keep on top of what I'm eating & drinking. However once a year I've noticed the app wipes all of my progress & logs me out. This time it wouldn't let me log back in either. Since this keeps happening I can never recommend getting any of the subscriptions for it nor can I recommend getting this app.

Good app for working out approximate* daily calories and nutritional breakdown and for keeping on track. I like the articles too. * The lists of foods vary in stated calories especially for homemade or whole items eg. Chicken breast, so you need to work out which is closest to the food you've eaten. However, very motivational and helpful.

It's unfair and bad to change a previously free function that users have gotten used to, and putting it behind a subscription. I'm talking about the function to scan barcodes, that has been a free function and now suddenly is only usable if you subscribe. Update: The barcode scanner being put behind a paywall is one of those company choices that just ends up hurting the company's reputation in the end and pushing users away. Try adding more features to premium rather than paywalling free ones.

Great app... completely let down by a garbage database. So if you are creating an entry for apple pie, make the only option weight, and so on.

definitely one of the better apps for calorie counting and weight management. extensive database of foods and lots of options to customise your experience, macros, meals. intermittent fasting tracker now available which is a nice addition, and you can also track workouts. links up to fitbit etc for added accuracy on calorie burn. most of these functions are available without paying extra which is fab. MFP is my go-to not just for myself but also recommend to PT clients.

They have progressively reduced the features of this app and increased the intrusion of ads until the free app is borderline pointless. Every time you add any food you get an ad. No longer able to set your own flexible goals. And if you are paying for premium to get rid of the ads, I emplore you to look at the other paid tracking apps out there. There are much much better options.

♡♡ Really nice app to track your calories. Syncs pretty well with the step counter but sometimes doeant record the steps so i add manually. The app is excellent however I'm trying to get premium and it just takes me to a blank screen? Also I have found some foods and trying to add to my diary and they simply arnt showing up. It's an OK app. Very useful for tracking calories, but sometimes you really have to work to get the right info, and correcting things that are wrong never seems to stick. I've been using the app for nearly 15 years. It's the best food tracking app but I constantly have issues with glitches, where food items are duplicated. good app but annoying bugs. if you tap something multiple times, it will register that food multiple times or open a prompt multiple times. i had a bug where i tried to add a food to my meal and it wouldn't get added. i tried twice. so i switched to adding another food and it got added 3 times. overall the app is also slow to respond and no instant search for looking up foods

Could be perfect but infuriating as the water logging just doesn't record properly. great app to use and maintain calorie, but been running into issue recently where the fitbit tracker isn't increasing my calorie count depending on my burn rate. Very buggy, issues don't seem to get resolved (have reported). Only 10 free scans / mth but friends using Apple version don't have same restrictions. the app is great and works very well in any android phone. it gives you all information about calorie count and the macros as well. the downside is that when you sync the activities with you Samsung galaxy watch, the calories count in the app get completely wrong. the issue is being going on since I have the app, January 2019, but I did a research and it looks like it is from July 2018 that the app have this problem. i paid 50 pounds for the app, so fix the problem and I will give you 5 stars.

Additional feedback, from today (19/04) app has started kicking out after entering exercise, then crashes phone for a short time. Much better than it was previously. I've used this application for the past 2 months and can't really fault it. I set my target weight, the timeframe and a few other criteria. Here I am now, 7kg lighter, and eating much healthier. The app is great but every time I open it I have to refuse going premium, setting my goals, and refuse the emails 15 times (I am not exaggerating with that number). One of the best apps, when it comes to tracking your micros and macros. It's a great app, but even though i'm using premium plus, it won't let me use the meal planner? This app has helped me understand food portions and how to eat, get all my nutrients and still loose weight. I have another lifestyle app I use and this is by far easier to use. Love that it tracks nutrition as well as calories, easy to record any workouts and generally really helpful in my fitness goals. I have recommended it to friends and family. The app is perfect to track your food intake will definitely help you to lose weight. Extremely over priced for the full paid subscription version, and intentionally frustrating, irritating and limited in the free version. I originally rated this as 1 star (see the reasons below). However a friend suggested reinstalling which seems to have fixed the issue (fingers crossed). The only app that helped me lose weight, get fit and feel good.The hard part is to keep entering each food item you consume. But it's a great way of being aware of what you're eating. Good database of information to keep tracking calories easy. I think it is fair to keep more of the advanced features behind a pay wall. App helped me to loose 11kg in 3 months by following a diet of 1.5k calories a day. Really useful app and very pleased with it. Makes calorie counting easy especially with the barcode scanner, portion / measurement adaptions and extensive food database is awesome. Really helpful for me. I put on so much weight after having my 2nd baby a year ago. I've put my mind to it and this is really helping me stick to my daily calorie limit. this app is brilliant and so easy to use. I've tried others but they were so fussy to log food. this one's a breeze. App does what it is supposed to do most of the time. From time to time there's an outage and it stops working but now.... I just paid for another year of subscription and it keeps kicking me out. Useful app, when you remember to use it. Best for tracking food intake. Wish it had better exercise tracking functionality since that impacts net calories but only cardio exercises can be considered. Great app. But when searching for a food, why do some foods not appear when sorting by "most frequent" but do appear when sorting by "most recent" and vice versa. Charge you £17 a month for software that doesn't do what is advertised. User friendly, it has also recipes and video trainings for specific areas and not only, great index of calories for many type of foods, including products sold in the US, though I m not from there. I have been using the app for last 2 years and works fine until the last update since the app updated the fitness tracker does not work and it doesnt log your exercises other than that the app works fine but it is annoying when i want to keep track of what workouts ive done for the day. Love this app, you can find almost any type of food to log into the food diary. Also informative about the nutritional content of each meal. Four stars because when this app worked properly for me, I found it amazing for tracking what I was eating and realising the calories in things I thought were innocent enough. I like the fact you can add your food and exercises and you can see your daily allowance and the remainders. I'd prefer the fitness interface to tske prioroty.

It is very good for checking your calorie intake and encouragement for losing weight. Good for tracking calories and macros, wide variety of foods pre-logged (even if most of them are measured in cups, handfuls and whatnot, quite approximate measurements); one problem that is not fixed yet is that the app keeps crashing when you try to personalize the workout routines. tried the free version, couldn't sign back in so I didn't use it. when I signed up for the free trial it said it would give warning before the subscription came due. in an earlier review I gave it 4 stars but now, it fails to sync with my Garmin connect. Pretty good, but gets a lot of the nutrition info and even names of food wrong (bar scanner). You can submit your own adjustments, but this adds a lot of time. Great idea and massive potential. The app has also mixed up all the pics I set for "My meals", again, not devastating, bit frustrating

Cannot believe they've made the barcode scanning function premium. It's such a basic tool and it's what made this app so good and usable when out and about. I've been using this app for years and recently lost almost 10kg diligently logging every food and workout. I could even forgive this app for being so clunky, slow and unresponsive. Great app. One of the few that can record in kilojoules and not just calories. Weight control (lose, gain, or maintain) is always hard to achieve but an app - any suitable app, is the easiest way. This app is for me the best. It integrates with Samsung health, fitbit (both trackers and scales) for free. Scans food labels. Thanks. Well done. I have subscribed.

New dash is rubbish! surely the whole point of the app is to track calories AND body weight. The app is good but is lacking one feature that has been being requested since 2017- a reset/delete all for weight entries. When you're struggling with weightloss you don't need old low weights in your face, and the process to delete each record individually is SOOOOO time consuming. It's painful.

Paid for premium for a couple of years now, only to have all my data randomly deleted and my premium subscription unlink from my account. Have attempted to resolve this with customer service, which was not helpful at all and they are difficult to reach. Unable to see the updates made by the app on web and vice versa. My steps haven't synced for the past week but I've read online that it's been an issue for other people for longer. It's a shame because when the app works, it works brilliantly.

Great app. Perfect for Keto. Can track all my macros ( gram or %) by day, week, meal and food item. Been using it for 5 plus years. Extensive food database .....just beware that the info is added by other users and not always accurate. So double check the barcode at first and you'll soon have a list of your own favs that are correct

Great little app. Mainly use to count calories and nutrients. The fact you can scan barcodes to avoid manual input is great. Would really recommend if you're trying to keep track of calories. Also pairs with map my run to keep track of calories burned on walks and runs to ensure you remain in a deficit if that's the aim.

Great App but partially exclusive. My brother is Type 1 Diabetic and needs to track net carbs as all diabetics do, however, this particular calculation requires the pro subscription in order to do so. While I understand that this is a commonly used nutrient to count, those of us who are counting it for alternative reasons (i.e. Keto) are more likely to pay the subscription anyway. At the very least they could make a setting to track with total OR net carbs and limit access to macro charts etc.

Just started using this app. The begining itself was a fiasco. Tried connecting the strava, runkeeper app it doesn't connect, neither the application tracks the steps. How can one get a snapshot of calorie intake and calories burnt in the day? Gain/loss??? Kind of wierd application. Set the application right in the first place, make necessary changes, get the UAT done and on successful testing deploy the same for users, this is misleading.

Please bring back the great big PLUS (or add) button on the overview. I don't want to scroll down to the bottom of the meal to add something. Also the font and 'useful white space' is too large. It isn't nice and compact anymore, scrolling a lot isn't something I like doing 😜 great app though overall. Thanks!

I've used this for ages and found it great however when logging food this morning, it's deleted some of my history so I have to re scan the barcodes.
