Far worse than before. Less features and more adds. Since moving the scanner to a paid service it's lost a lot. The database for having to type in foods left to free users is cumbersome at best and not at all helpful to people trying to start tracking their intake with all the incorrect information in there.

Used to love this app. Now all you get is the premium advert continually popping up! Dont seem to be interested in fixing it, you just get sent a link to customer support that doesnt help. Will be looking for a new app now.

Great functionality! Love the barcodes too and great database. But for now I'm only giving 4 stars because the UI hasn't changed since 2yrs ago and it could really use a prettier interface. And cheaper but great fitness trackers such as Mi Bands can't be synced directly, so I hope that can also be included in the updates.

This app is ok, a little inaccurate, but overall gives you an idea about what you are eating, how much and the nutritional value of that food. So would probably assist with weightloss as long as you are eating the right foods, in the right amounts, at the right times in conjunction with exercise.

Fantasic app. Using everyday, it's simple enough and can just scan barcodes of food, works really well and links in with other apps for effortless sync and tracking. Needs to be more versatility in the excercise options though no option for HIITS training, even big names like insanity workouts etc, having that would make it perfect.

Every time I press "Complete Diary" it loads for a few seconds and then says "Alert: There was a problem sending your request to the server. Please visit the main website or try again later." I've always been a bit dubious about this kind of app and how accurate it can possibly be. I was pleasantly surprised. Have used MyFitnessPal for years and it is generally great. In recent months, though, has been doing a very strange thing in not retaining foods I eat frequently: some just seem not to register in the "My Foods" section at all; others will register and be there, then just randomly disappear.

Used to be good. Since the recent updates it's clear premium is being pushed. The app itself is now laggy whenever you navigate the screens. I will be looking for an alternative - I have changed to 1 star from 2 star as now its full of adverts. Everytime you input food advert.

Disappointed. I revisited this app after a few years as it was such a helpful tool when monitoring meal to meal and day to day calories. The difference from then to now is unbelievable. This is by far the easiest calorie tracking app, and I've tried a ton of them. I never have much luck finding every obscure product I eat in a food database in any app except MyFitnessPal. Quick and easy to find what I'm looking for, and without premium the app is exactly what I need. Calorie tracking works for fitness!

Been using this app for years now. It's been really helpfull to get a general overview of my food intake. I only used the free version and I'm pretty happy with it. It's really nice that any activities tracked with my Garmin are also included in the daily diary, so it gives me a more accurate idea of my daily efforts.

June 2022 UPDATE* The new widget is garbage...! Bring back the ability to click "scan" to start the process of logging food from your phones homescreen. The scanner and range of verified foods makes it simple to track calories. The fact it seamlessly links to STRAVA to update my calorie expenditure for every workout is brilliant. Keeps me on Track! I am on a bariatric journey and this app is perfect for me. I have protein goals as well as calories and water intake and MyFitness Pal is able to help me stay on track. I have tried other apps, but this one is the most user friendly I have tried. I like that it tracks everything. I can even add photos to my weight entries, so I can look back on my progress.

The App is fuctional however the persistent advertising is just plain OBNOXIOUS. MFP has been a great help for me to lose weight. Used to be fantastic but now it freezes so frequently that it's barely usable! My guess is that the ever-increasing amount of ads is bloating the app while it tries to load everything. It will also often delete or duplicate items I've just added. Please fix this ASAP!

As previous users have mentioned, the app has become far too buggy over the last few years. Have had re install it multiple times due to this. Please move your focus towards creating a bug free tracking app. Have found it to be eating so much data, up to several gb per day, had to re install and restrict its usage on mobile data due to this.

App is good but flawed. The fact it recommends connecting with certain pedometer apps and then they don't work is ridiculous. I am a person who tends to overeat and put on additional weight. MyFitnessPal lifts my blindfolds and is a great tool to track my calory intake. Was good for a while, will be uninstalling though. Invasive ads became annoying but the app still outweighed the annoynace. The app syncs with my Garmin, although it's a bit slow to catch up. It's a fairly good guide for checking your calorie in take and over the years has got much better at recognisingote barcodes. This app is bloody incredible! Spend the time to enter you recipes, meals & foods and you can track everything you eat perfectly keeping track of everything that goes into your mouth (behave) Your macros - and nutrients, if you have premium - will never look better, after a short while using the app, adjusting your goals and meals etc you'll not even need it as often as you learn over time what meals together equal to what macros & nutrients. If you put the effort into this app 5* no doubt

Totally ruined , once was the best calorie tracker now its un unworkable shambles. Changed far too much, too many menus to put in the details. You have to switch back and forth to put in your meals. In the past months I was not able to use the app. I keep getting the message with "send/don't send e-mails" and "send notifications to keep me on track". I just deleted my app. It used to be nice, usefull and easy to use. But you ruined it! Thank you, but I am out!

So far so good. Using this on the recommendation of my girl friend who has diabetes. Love the ability to scan barcodes for calorie tracking and being able to sync with Samsung Health. Waste of time

Hi I do not like the update. It was more organised when you had breakfast things in one place, lunch in another and dinner in another. Really like this app for keeping me honest with my meals. Entering food, amounts, and times is simple and quick and easily personalized and the barcode reader is great. Good app, havnt used it for years, much improved from the last time I used it. I love that I can just scan products and the amount of products that are in the database. Not to mention being able to add your own recipes is amazing and makes for quick adding later on.

I wanted to start using the app again today, after using it for many years before, only to find go premium in my face all the time. This app used to be really useful to track your nutrition and quick to use, but now it constantly crashes making planning meals really slow. I used the computer version of this ages ago and only recently found the app version, since installing just over a fortnight ago i have already lost 8lb, its easy to use and log your food and lets you see in black and white just what you are eating, I would recommend this for anyone who just wants to keep an eye on the calories.

Constantly crashing I love being able to track my calories and exercise but this app literally crashes more often than it works. In order to input one meal you usually need 3 attempts. This app is pretty cool. I've only used the free bit and even though i don't know what I'm missing out on by not upgrading, I'm very happy with it. The barcode scanner is brilliant. I love this app. It really does make dieting much more simple. its a great app for calorie counting but i am strugling to get connection between the app and my sports watch. sports watch shows connection but not the reverse. also feel the monetization of the macros and such is poor form. when someone is trying to improve their health, it should be a privilege to help, not an opportunity to exploit them.

Awesome app! You can search and add pretty much any food you can think of. Such a great tool to help achieve your goals, whatever they may be. Used this app on and off for years, even with all the restrictions I kept at it for the barcode scanner feature but now that they're getting rid of it I'm planning to uninstall the app. Download LoseIt if you're looking for the barcode scanner feature without having to pay an absurd amount of money!

It's ok for keeping track of my carbohydrate intake being a type 1 diabetic but find some foods are not accurate enough. I wouldn't like to use it as The Holy Grail or Oracle, yet it provides a better guide than guessing. It isn't puritanical because individuals own and decide what to with the information. Overall a great app. Used it before to help lose weight and tone up. Is a real eye opener to what I was eating. Started using it again and everything was great. Best App for health and fitness. I started using this app after gaining a lot of weight over the first two lockdowns. I've used this app for years and it was the best thing I could have found for weight loss until this past year. On going issues. The problems dont get solved. I honestly hope you guys get your act together. You about to loose alot of people over this. Knock the ad pushing off of the home feed and get back to the basics of developing a good functioning app. We are all tired of this

TL;DR: uninstall and move to the LoseIt app. I've used MFP for 5+ years and the app for has been getting more and more frustrating over the last year. Yes the adverts are more intrusive, but I understand sometimes you need to balance making money with usability. What broke the app for me was moving the formerly free barcode scanner behind a paid subscription. Locking existing free features behind a paywall screams desperation and a complete lack of understanding of your users. Uninstalled.

I absolutely love this app! If you want to count calories or any other nutritions, this is the best choice out there. It's easy to find the food you're looking for by scanning barcodes or searching by name. The yearly cost for premium is worth it to be sure, although the free version is great also.

If I could give it negative stars I would have...got an email today stating that I'm paying 50$ as a subscription for the next year...never got any notifications I will be charged...tried to cancel but NOPE the subscription is until next year. I tried the app and it's completely useless for me. Super annoyed. At least try to bother yourself with notifying the customer your about to steal 50$ from their credit card. DISGUSTING

Tracking my food is really helpful and the app allows you to do that easily. however, the Bluetooth connection with my Fitbit doesn't work well. It only tracks part or even none of my very hard earned steps each day. Many days it will show that I stepped 3,000 steps with about 300 calories burned but I've walked over 11,000 steps with over 2,000 calories burned. Very frustrating. Nothing I do will update my Fitbit data. I end up adding exercises to make the calories come out right each day.

I used to really love this app, but for the past year it wouldn't connect my data to the server, so no logging new recipes, no account of calorie progress at the end of the day, and the website and my phone app did not sync. Upside was I could still see my weight progress log ins, and my calorie consumption for the day and the macros from it. BUT SINCE YESTERDAY previous log ins have been erased. I can't handle anymore bugs. It's getting worse. Please figure it out.

I used this app for years and I loved it. It helped me lose weight and kept me on track. Unfortunately, everything that makes it great is now behind a pay wall. It's annoying that we had the options for free then taken away. I don't even recommend it anymore because of this, it's like any other food tracker app now.

I'm usually good with tech and apps but I struggled to connect to my Garmin, and I found it very time consuming to input some foods because I couldn't measure in grams or units (only options were Oz or lbs) so I had to convert quite a lot of foods (others had the option to log in grams or units but not all). I wanted to use it but only managed 3 days and then gave up.

I have been even more aware of what I'm putting in my body. I have been more alert to my best and worst days, the stress in my life, and been able to take the necessary steps to change. You might look and see a calorie counter or general fitness app, but really its a lifestyle app. If you stick with it, it can be a life changer. A daily partner that is more reliable than your lifepartner eating those oreos and icecream next to you.... yeah, them.

This is the best calorie counter out there for free. I have tried other ones and they don't measure up. Samsung Health even lacks when logging food. If you have used Samsung Health app before you will be able to navigate this with a short learning curve. The reason it didn't get five stars is need to have a cheaper option for premium features. 49.99 for a year for not much extra. You can find out where your calories are highest and get recipes. It's a little too pricey. It Takes the crown.

Find an alternative. Paid for premium had constant issues. macros by meals not showing accurately. Exercise calories being added to daily cals despite switching them off everyday, the moment I close the app it reverts to on. Decided to cancel my subscription only to find u can't change your calorie goal...pointless. as for customer service, rubbish. No help.

Don't get me wrong, the app is nice; good interface. But, requires premium plan to do basic things, like scanning barcodes for food, which costs $80 USD. That's how much fitbit premium costs, and it does 10x more than this app. The value proposition just isn't there.

The app used to be incredibly useful. But lately it's impossible to get past the constant schilling for the premium membership. The moment you open the app, BOOM! Shill. That and it used to sync up with my Google Fit app, but that synchronicity just stopped working. Not sure if it was because of this app or because of the Google one. Whichever. Finally had to put the app to pasture.

After the update it does not work at all. I have been struggling with logging in, the app crashes, takes way too much time, faster to do it on a browser. As the barcode is now under a pay-wall, i think it's time to move on and search for a new app, with at least less lagging and crashing.

Unable to sign in or log in , every time it asks I do enter all details about height , weight , goals , etc I also do accept terms and conditions but at last when I click on accept it is not registering my account it's says to wait a minute then goes back to start page , tried too many times now tired of filling same details again and again .

Loved this app for a very long time but am now done and do not recommend. It used to be very easy to use and the barcode was the best part - made adding new foods so easy! The barcode is now only available with the premium version even though the app has tons of ads. There are tons of other options - use one of those.

I'm very pleased with this app. It's kept me in check, and is helping me to discover more about food choices and nutrition. It's caused me to become more conscious of how much and how often I walk and exercise. The Calorie counting is perfect...I can now eat a variety of foods within my calorie intake goal without feeling overwhelmed. I wish I discovered it earlier 🙂.

Just needed a calorie counter/mapper to figure out what all I need to eat in a day to stay under 1700cal. I use the my meals and recipes to plan an entire day of food and just log that I ate 1600cal meal at once UNTIL I started seeing issues after a month. My meals got deleted, my recipes reverted after editing. I got this app just for this specific purpose and logging some gym walking. I will be searching for a new app now.

Really wish you guys would stop "updating" this app with bug fixes that just create more bugs. All of a sudden, you won't sync with my Fitbit. I have uninstalled and reinstalled My Fitness Pal. I have un-synced and re-synced my Fitbit. If you can't fix this problem I will find another app. BTW, I am a paying customer!

I've tracked my nutrition thru this app since having Gastric Bypass surgery in 2015. Its the app. we all use in my program to visually see our nutritional data instead of guessing! I have to adjust parameters and because of my particular needs, I still use it to be sure I'm getting my protein ,iron, etc. After having Iron Deficiency Anemia , I now can be sure I stay in the healthy (+) numbers for me. Being hospitalized with dangerously low iron is a one time experience for me.

I like that it syncs with other apps like a walking app. I like that I can put my own recipes into it. Also, that it's separated into each meal and snacks. My only thing is sometimes I have to guess which food to choose because it doesnt have everything, but there are so many different foods and varieties

Fantastic app. Used on several occasions now at times I've wanted to drop body fat / lose weight. Macro split is important to me to maintain muscle and this app allows you to fully configure macros. I find tracking food a real pain to be honest and the simplicity and effectiveness of this app goes someway to making the tracking experience far less painful. I've lost weight and fat every time I've used the app. As long as you have the discipline to follow to the letter it will absolutely work.

I tired to cancel subscription on the 1st of May while still on the free trial because I just don't use it and it kept saying technical issue try again later. finally got it cancelled on the 3rd of May. Looked at my bank account today and I've been charged the yearly subscription. Checked my subscription and it was still active! REALLY disappointed with this. I shouldn't have been charged that money and would appreciate it paid back.

Would not recommend. Constantly nags me about entering meals I've already entered. I have to force close it a couple times per day. The entire app seems designed around trying to upsell you to premium. The calorie counting part is ok, but there are plenty of other apps that do it just as well or better. I used this app several years ago and it was much more useful. Typical corporate greed from Under Armour. At least make a quality product before trying to take people's money.

So much better than Lifesum! Don't believe the ratings for Lifesum. Even the free version of Fitness Pal is better than the premium version of Lifesum. FP has a much better interface for logging foods and creating recipes and its food database is much more accurate. Lifesum forces you to choose a diet plan. The "premium" recipes are over-complicated and expensive to follow and I am someone who loves to cook.

Loved this app for the free features. I use this and another app together get what I need done. I don't like that for some of the free features, they are now pusing for a subscription like scanning Upc/sku codes to add to the diary. Why charge? It benefits you and the consumer by adding more accurate data to your database and helps the use find best details for their meals.

I really like this app in conjunction with another app- Samsung health. This app is great for food tracking, but it doesn't cover enough workouts. I often do HIIT for exercise and this doesn't have many options. Also it doesn't give an estimate of calories burned when lifting. If these improved I would increase my rating.

Everything seems great, apart from the fact that a competitor app also has images of food items that make things a lot easier and faster to work with. This does seem to have some additional foods compared with others, but it has been around much longer. The yearly cost is much higher than others and can not see right now a real reason to pay the higher rate.

I stopped using this app when my phone broke over a month ago. While I was using it, it was very helpful and I loved it even without paying. The app recommended I get to 135 pounds or so for my height even tho my goal was 120. I ended up stopping at 135. I'm not downloading it again is because I don't think counting calories is a good idea for me as long as my clothes fit. Thank you so much for helping me reach my goals, AND stay healthy while doing it by telling me how much protein etc I need

This used to be a great app. Now, you have to pay $80/yr in order to scan your food. A feature that was once free. I paid a flat fee to remove the ads but now they just increased the prices to an absurd amount. There are other apps that have the same basic features at a more reasonable cost.

I really like this app, and it is really helping me lose weight. The barcode scanner is such a great idea! There are a few bugs, especially with the barcode scanner, sometimes for some reason it says it got the food but then it doesn't actually add it to your recipe. But all in all, very helpful! Updated: the new version has fixed the bugs with the bar scanner, thank heavens! I use it daily.

Good but could be great/so much better. Im a premium member i.e pay for additional services and really cant see the value. Hige difference between apple and android users (im an andriod user and have far less). Wish there was a way to lock the country for scanning so dont always get wrong information for different countries products. Also the amount of times you receive an unknown error when scanning barcodes is shocking.

At first app was good. Recently I have noticed that there is a glitch in the exercise data. It is multiplying my workouts. I have submitted a work order ticket. They came back and said it was resolved.. but it is still constantly duplicating my workouts, which throws everything off for tracking and monitoring calories.

How long has this app been around? That's just long I've been using it. Currently, I'm using the free version because I can't justify $20/month for the convenience and familiarity when there are a) other apps out there and b) $20/month can go a long way otherwise. I'm disappointed that scanning is no longer available in the free version, which is now a barrage if ads and this feels like a shell of what it used to be but I suppose it's no longer meant to support its original users.

Terrible! I wanted to upgrade and continue to do the yearly, but everything I do it says the money will be taken out on April 29th. I'm guessing it's because that when it would renew from last year. But then when I'm in the app looking at the premium version, it says "purchase the premium version to see" What's going on?

Used to really like this app, it genuinely helped me on my weightless journey. But now all of the usefull functions like scanning the barcode of food are only available through subscription, despite it not being that way for years. I can also no longer log into my account on the app for some reason so had to make a new one to log anything. But the app is so much slower and more anoying to use, so I won't be using this anymore, which is a shame because its been my favourite for years

I've had this app for about 2 years and at first it was amazing, but now everything is only unlocked with "premium" and projections aren't given until a 7 day streak. The original weight loss projections were accurate without waiting. I have lost a lot of weight, but I'm not paying monthly for things on this app that used to be free. Definitely going to find a better app!

I used to love the app. Useful features and a clean UI. However, over the years, the ads for "premium" subscription have gotten more and more aggressive, at least 3+ popups before you can actually use the app. And now, developers have removed basic functionality and features (like scanning barcodes) that used to be free, and put them behind a subscription in a blatant cash grab. After 4 years, I will be uninstalling and moving to another app. I suggest you do the same.

I moved from MyFitnessPal to this app about a year ago when MyFitnessPal took away the free barcode scanner. Well, now Lose It! has gone the same way as MFP unfortunately. I'm actively searching for a better app. I'd understand it if they wanted to charge for new features, but pay walling old features is very frustrating. I used to be a big advocate for this app at work and with friends, but not anymore. Enjoy the fruits of your greed I guess. A one time paid version would be nice too.

I liked the recipe feature in the paid version and easy to use interface. The database contains lots of inaccurate items making it difficult to select. Many entries don't contain nutrient data. There is a "verified only" switch but drastically limits the choices. It's a good value IMO if you don't mind wading through the data.

Purchased lifetime since I'd been using the app for years at this point. Functionality is great, very useful, only ever had one hiccup that got resolved in a later patch anyway. After the latest update, I am getting ads for a 3rd party keto diet course that no matter how many times I say no thanks, it will not go away. It is very annoying to have a life time membership and STILL get ads, for a service I don't want, from a company that isn't LoseIt, under a membership that says I don't get ads.

I've used and loved this app on/off for years and it helps me stay on track when I'm wanting to watch my intake. I've gone back and forth bw the free & premium version, depending on my situation and needs at the time. But CONS: • No way to mass delete old recipes. • It was a stupid idea to make the barcode scanner a part of premium when it has been a basic/free feature included for years. • The pressure / pop-ups to switch to premium has increased & gotten a lot more annoying.

I love the update, adding food is easy. This app allows me to keep track of my calories, water intake and macros also. **Note that I have the premium account. However, keeping track of my weight loss is a little discouraging. The graph shows my weight loss but the numeric proof is not calculating correctly.

This app is very user friendly. It's helped me keep better track of what I'm eating and when I exercise. I've lost 25 lbs in 2 months. I wish the premium version offered a discounted trial, or billed monthly. So far I'm still on the free version. Update: after I hit the 25 lb mark, and especially after the 50 lb mark, there were no more badges to earn. It's been very disappointing. That was a big part of the motivation and fun.

I am only a few days in, but so far I really like the app. My favorite feature is that I can scan everything, whether it's a barcode or a plate of food. So far every barcode has been recognized. It doesn't always recognize actual foods, but it's easy enough to do a search for something if it doesn't. I haven't tried all the features yet, but I think I am going to upgrade to premium once I get a wristband that tracks exercise. Once I have used more features I will update my review.

Terrible experience. The app frequently hangs and crashes, barcode scanning only works like 5% of the time, and pretty much everything is locked behind a premium subscription at this point. Worst of all there's ads CONSTANTLY. Every time you add food to a meal, it plays a full screen ad for 10-15 seconds. Plus a bunch of "Verified" foods are just completely incorrect. Don't bother using the app, it used to be decent but I'd pretty hostile to use now. Any other calorie counter is better than this

Fighting weight all my life. More excersize and less calories is the only thing that works in the long run. And counting calories is the most difficult part of it. I've been using this app for several years. It's not difficult, and I find it quite accurate. I lost the weight I wanted and have sustained that by Keeping Up with the calorie counting.

The app had me go through several questions for initial start up. I gave it my weight, height, goals, and it gave me a daily calorie limit. Once that was done, it loaded up the app... Only for it to have all my numbers wrong, answered questions wrong, goals wrong, and the timeline suddenly being limited to one year unlike two years in the start up questions.

UPDATE: Okay, I've had this app awhile, and I'm less impressed than I was before. The main reason is it keeps screwing up my weight. Sometimes the app won't let me go back a few days and add my weight if I forgot to put it in. I even have a paid membership! I feel so cheated! Also, once I create a recipe, I can't edit or delete it. That irks me a lot! PLEASE fix and update!

I've used the app off and on over the last year, and recently started using it again after not doing so for a few months. Imagine my surprise when I went to scan a food barcode and a function that used to be free was now suddenly a premium feature, and I was asked to pay $39.99 to unlock it? It was nice while it lasted, but nothing about this tracking app is worth even 1/4 of that. I'll be moving on to something more reasonable.

I've been a frequent user of Lose It throughout the years. Even paid for premium a few times. I'd just planned to start using it again only to find out that scanning barcodes is now a paid feature. Uninstalled the app on the spot. I'm not paying for a standard, basic feature—especially one that gives you incorrect nutritional info 95% of the time.

After scanning an item, it may be incorrect. I scanned beef, seaweed snacks, keto flour, and other food items, and the calorie counts were all incorrect. The keto flour says 1/4 of a cup is 80 calories on the bag, yet the app tells me it's 110 for the same amount. The beef I bought says it's 190 calories for four ounces, but the app says three ounces. Net carb calculator works and it's a good way to count calories. Better than MyFitnessPal. But needs some adjustments.

I really like the app, but it lacks the level of integration similar apps have. I want a premium app that integrates with samsung health, but myfitnesspal is too expensive and doesn't offer a lifetime membership. This app is almost the same price for the subscription but does offer a lifetime subscription. Unfortunately, it lacks Samsung Health integration. In fact, it offers very little integration compared to MFP.

I used to use this app because it was simple and easy to read and use. Now it's complicated, ugly interface, and EVERY click leads you to an ad for premium service, and also shows you features that are locked for non-payers. If it was a one time fee, I'd consider it. But it's a sub so forget it. Get off my phone. I'm replacing it with something else.

Tracks you and your information just like any other invasive app. Disappointing that you cannot use the barcode scan feature without giving the app full access to your files and media. This hasnt always been the case. Years ago, when I first used Lose It, it didnt require anything but the camera. I understand that you have to get paid, but dang... Just show a commercial based on workout gear or something. You wouldnt even need to collect user data for that.

Easy to add, although a bowl of cereal, for example, can take a while, since each ingredient is a separate line. Excercise calories burned may or may not be legit, but judge for yourself and i just adjust as needed. There are a few things that you can do online but not in the app, so check out all the settings on both.

Consistency is key. The app has cute little reminders to keep you on track. Honestly writing down what I'm eating on a daily basis has been the key of my weight loss. sometimes just knowing that you will have to add something to your tracker will keep you from eating something that is not healthy for you. I got the premium version for the ability to track in advance because if I am planning on eating a certain thing I can budget for that. I've been eating the calories recommended and have not been hungry. it's up to you and how dedicated you are to your own health but this is a very helpful tool.

Loose it was recommend to me because of its accuracy of nutritional facts. It's not accurate. Tracked calories for years. My fitness pal "free" is more accurate. Probably others as well but I can't vouch for them. After a few weeks this app starts sending lots of ads & stops you from inputting your data as well. Looking forward to "loosing this app" & going back to something that is effective for my fitness goals.

This app has decent UI; I've found it very easy to navigate.  The free version is serviceable if you're on a budget or like to save money, and the database of foods is comprehensive and makes logging meals a breeze.  Knowledge is power: having this app at my fingertips has instilled confidence and motivated me to stay consistent.  So far, I have lost 20 lbs. by simply sticking to a 1,833 calorie diet.  I'm never hungry, and I feel better than I have in years.  Give it a try!

Food library is very expansive. Most chain restaurants and brands are in it. Bar code scanning is very nice. Adding my recipes make adding my home cooked meals a breeze. When I actively use it and consciously try to stay under my limits, I feel better and shed weight. It's also nice that it links with Fitbit, Garmin, and Google Fit. Would be nice if it supported Samsung Health.

I really enjoy this app , Its really easy to use and I love that it has a bar code scanner so I can scan my foods. Its a super fast way to record your calories. However I wish there was some way to record foods for the next day, as I have to prepare my breakfast lunch and snacks the night before for work. It would be so nice if I could record them for the next day this way I don't miss count my calories . Other then that it is a great app!

I like this app. Do I love it? No. But it's adequate for starting out on my health journey for now. I use the free version, which allows me to track my exercise, weight, what I eat (calorie count) and also see my daily food intake divided into fat, protein, and carbs. The "upgrade to unlock" parts are a little in your face, as well as the frequent "sales" for premium, etc. It would be nice to not have the premium features on your dashboard. But overall it's doing what I need.

I've used lose it for a long time now and preferred it to mfp, but I got a new phone and forgot to install it for a little bit after and when I did now you can't even customize your BASIC calorie allowance! You can, but you've got to PAY PAY PAY! Don't get me wrong, I understand you gotta make money and gotta paywall a lot of stuff, but a fixed budget is the most basic feature. I don't want to consume 2500 calories a day, I would prefer to set to lower number. Will be sadly Uninstalling.

As promised, I was going to change my rating if this app changed my view of it... And sure enough it did! I'm so glad I came across this app! It's much cheaper to subscribe than with MFP, which has ground to a halt for me. Boo! This app pretty much does it all, track cals, fasts, macros, and pretty much any health item you can imagine. I don't really see myself gonna back to MFP at this point ☝️

This app makes me sad now. I've used this app on and off for many years now. It used to be a lot better. Since the addition of ads the app is very slow and clunky. I used to zip through and add up all my food in no time but now it it's slow and frustrating. At least they're getting paid I guess. It's always at the expense of the user experience though. Just about like every other app and service I use, the product gets worse as the prices go up and you get nickel and dimed to death.

The layout and general setup were ok but a lot of the nutritional info was incorrect, even when scanning barcodes. Also a lot of items forced you to log in 'servings' instead of allowing lbs, fl oz, grams, etc. ...So if I'm logging a potato for example, it makes me say how many servings I had... I don't know what a serving of potato is, but I know the weight of the potato I had so it would be a lot easier to just be able to enter that.

I used to use this app it WAS very useful. But now with all the pop up ads. It freezes. Is inaccurate and simply just sucks. Uninstalled and reinstalled but to no avail. Some things are better left alone. But being an app that is a cash grabber I too will moving to another app. It's sad really because I had been using this app for years. It was easy to track with the scanner option but now it costs. I was a premium member but it had nothing to offer for the price, so I went back to basic.

I'm loving this app so far! The database has been great and the user interface feels so much cleaner than other calorie counting apps I've tried. I also love how I'm able to easily change the unit of measurement (ounces, grams) to whatever I need and the program does all the conversions. It makes it so much easier to track and stay motivated. The app also seamlessly syncs my exercise data from Strava and adds my exercise calories. Highly recommend this app! :)

This app is extremely easy to use. I do not pay for anything to utilize, I have the basic version and it does what I need it to do. It only works if you are consistent and devote to logging everything you eat and the exercises that you do. You use your phone to scan UPC symbols on food packaging to simplify and speed up the logging process. There is also a line graph to show your progress with your weight to help you visualize your journey. There are also challenges you can do within the app

I've been using this app for at least 10 years. Some time ago, I decided to agree to pay $100 for lifetime premium. Looking back, not really worth it. VERY, very few "verified foods" and those that exist aren't accurate. App is very buggy when a user tries to edit (correct) erroneous nutrition data. Now, there is a notification that can't be cleared unless the user pays $20 for a useless education program. RUN - don't walk - to MyFitnessPal or Weight Watchers.

I used this app (free version) over the years on and off. This time, they want money for the barcode scanner. I will never pay a subscription for an app. Maybe a one-time fee of 2 dollars or something (to get the scanner and basic app) but subscriptions are against my app philosophy. No thanks. I'll go somewhere else. Another customer lost!

unlike most apps which you have an option to get a subscription for It actually allows you to use it. It's really helpful if you want to kind of keep track of your food (food diary) and basic workouts. They have a huge database of foods, they even have foods in there from my local eateries. I personally only needed the basic stuff. But the paid option is really helpful for people who need extra support . It's not overly complicated and it helps you keep track of everything.

Used (free version) a couple years back, but fell through with it due to personal reasons. This worked amazingly and I never had trouble with it. When they didn't have an item I ate on their list, they allowed me to add it myself with the appropriate nutrition label. Definitely recommend for people who are looking to watch their calorie intake!

I have been using this app for a little over a week now and I love it. I upgraded to premium 3 days in and am glad I did. It is very easy to track calories, macronutrients and sodium, as well as my weight and blood pressure. Extensive food bank with many national restaurants and store brands, the ability to scan bar codes and manually enter nutrition info to create foods and recipes. It loses one star b/c the "scan your food" function needs work...it identified pork tenderloin as French toast!

I wish there was some way to export the data in to excel (.csv) All the foods, times, and calories, carbs, fats, data are locked in the app. More convenient then a note book I guess. 48 days straight day logging and now I would like to examine the data but I can't. If I could export all the trapped data I would purchase the app. I guess I'll keep using it while looking for an app that has useful reporting... I can do the basic math myself.

I love this app! I would have given it 5 stars because it does really meet all my needs except: 1. It doesn't allow to move a food item into a different meal rather than having to delete it, then add it to the correct meal. 2. It would be helpful to edit personally created recipes. For example: any recipes that I created have to be recreated if I need to edit ingredients. Honestly, these are features I'd like to see added in new editions of the app. Hopefully they read customer comments! ;-)

i like that it has a large database of foods. and to use the basic functions you dont have to pay. I do wish some of the foods had more options of measurements. i mostly use cups and tablespoons so ounces and grams dont really help me. Also, there needs to be a way to edit or delete recipes. After seeing the calories on some of the things i eat ive been trying to modify but i have to make a whole new recipe rather than edit one i already have.

I tried the free app and it didn't allow me to post my meals. In fact I wasn't able to find the daily journal or start a food list. It continually informed me that I had to buy the upgrade to make it work. I have used other free diet apps over the years, putting up with the adds and they worked fine. This app, like the other new ones is too busy (if it worked). I am disappointed and shut it down.

This app took away features from the free version that have been there for years and now require payment for premium subscription in order to access the same stuff we could before. This app had the barcode scanner for free for years and now they want you to buy the premium subscription in order to use it. Honestly, that is just annoying. They just want as much money as they can get. This feature was literally free for they past like 5 years. This was my go too app but not anymore.

Eh everything costs money now. Not just this app but all of them. I just want a simple nutrition tracker, not just calories. I'm trying to pay attention to protien intake and fiber as well. But you can't see that on any of the apps I've found without paying. That's okay, it's not that hard to keep track yourself just takes extra work. I'm not paying for that.

Writing down my meals daily has been very motivating. I like Lose it because it is easy to search for the nutritional value of most of my meals, however the nutrition value of many food items are not complete or have not been verified by Lose it. So I find myself checking for myself. Also more instructions are needed for recording your meals. You eventually figure it out, but you end up using the Save feature erroneously at first. Still, it is a very good app for weight loss goals.

Works well enough and the food database is nice, but I don't need any of the paid features. Unfortunately, the app bothers me multiple times per day with a very intrusive reminder to subscribe. I'd be happy to pay a one time fee of $10-20 to support the app, but since subscribing is the only option, I might try to find another app that bothers me less.

I have previously used Noom and My Fitness Pal and neither was as easy to use as Lose It! I went with premium when given the half price option and I'm glad I did. I love the barcode scanner for entering information! I also like the setup for the meals. I can see which areas I need to focus on with the macro calculator. I'm much more mindful of what I'm eating now. I highly recommend this app!

This app isn't much different than many of the other apps I've tried. Lost 10 lbs with my fitness pal, but I set this app to lose 1 lb a week and in four weeks I've only lost 1 lb! I didn't even include my exercise which I do 5-6 days a week, so I've been under their recommended calorie count and still haven't lost the 1 lb a week they told me I would. I also don't like the subscription model. My fitness pal included many of the things this app wants to charge me for.

Easy weight tracker!! No problems with Ads! Millions of foods in their database, plus if a food is not in there, which is rare, you can enter it manually yourself! Tracks your carbs, proteins, fats, etc of what you've eaten in a day in easy pie chart form. Tracks any exercise and water consumed also. I love that it tells me the date I will reach my goal weight, as long as i continue to monitor my food intake through the app. It makes me 100% accountable for my food choices. LOVE! <3

Pretty good... but one big flaw (for Android). Me and my wife eat a lot of the same meals, but there is no way to share the details once all of the entries are made on my phone or hers. So, we both have to enter all of the same details. It would be much easier if she could just send and I import into whatever meal I need. Also, it doesn't I directly integrate with Samsung Health. With all of the Samsung devices, I would expect that integration to be there. Other than that.. app is pretty good.

I love the app but very disappointed in what seems false advertising sale price as $39.99 shows regular and on friends. As I took screen shots of regular price, 25%, and 50% off. The all go to same price point. Other than that I love the app and was going to buy full version until I noticed the sale / non-sale. Also, if it allowed me to pay monthly it would have been even better.

This is the best app to develop safe habits around diet and exercise. By setting a daily caloric budget and tracking every food and drink you ingest, you are forced to eat healthy, which means you learn to appreciate which foods have unnecessary and excessive calories. Soon, you learn to avoid them, if not despise them. This is the essence of eating habit change versus "a diet." When the power of eating habits is combined with trade-offs for exercise, the result is a complete lifestyle change. Once you achieve a lifestyle change, you never need to go on a diet (or anything like it) again! This is the safest, healthiest and most educational life-changing application there is.

Quite a good app but the ads are worse and worse all the time. I literally have to close the app to make the ad go away, and then open it up again....several times just to input a single day's data. PLEASE DO NOT TELL PEOPLE TO PAY YOU $ TO REMOVE SOMETHING YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE PUT THERE IN THE FIRST PLACE. It's like punching people and then saying, "No problem. Just pay us to stop."

Used for awhile And it was great. I stopped using and recently began again, however the app's exercise options are going wonky and I can't figure out why. I try to input my walks on the treadmill, using my own calories lost and duration, and its giving me crazy calories lost numbers- in the thousands! It won't save my input. What's up with that? I can't use the app now because it keeps logging 2,700 calories lost for a 30 minute walk lol. Once that gets fixed I'll get back on it .

No quick fix, no trendy diet, no quick uptick in working out, no expensive shakes or prepacked meals. I am proud to say that in the last 2 months I have lost 15 pounds, mostly by journaling my food intake, every crumb, in the Lose It app. The app keeps me in line. The barcode scanner in it is remarkably accurate. The algorithms in the app gave me a calorie target to fit my loss target and it has been SPOT ON. Use this app, put EVERYTHING in there, don't cheat yourself and you WILL lose weight!

This is the best weight loss app I've used so far. But I have one complaint. I've been using Lose It for literal years (almost a decade). I use the basic version and not the paid version. I went to scan a food item today and apparently I can only do that if I pay now?? What the hell, man? That used to be one of the best features of Lose It, & anyone could use that feature, and now you're telling me you've yanked it from basic users & only premium users can scan food now? What a money grab.

I love this tool. If you have a difficult time tracking your food intake, this app simplifies your efforts. It has a variety of brand names to select from, it gives you a My Food Choice to track the foods you eat, a place to save your favorite meals. It tracks your exercise and gives extra calories for your effort. It has much more. Check it out.

This is a great tracking app! It's very simple - you set your goals and it tells you how many calories you need to consume to reach your goals. It also gives guides as to how to split up the amount of fats, carbs, and protein you require. There's a large database of food/drink items and you also the ability to scan an item in or manually enter an item if it's not in the database. Definitely helps to keep me honest and on target.

33 pounds down and working on gaining muscle! I have used the app for about 2 years now and have seen constant improvements. For the most part, it is easy to use and helps me stay on track. I would like to see the "Plate Reports" on mobile to make sure I am getting enough veggies, but not a big deal. I can't imagine my health journey without this app.

I used to really like this app. Now, features that used to be free (scanning bar code/taking pic of nutrition label to upload product name and nutrition info) are only available to premium members. I'm not even allowed to download the app to my phone so I can have access to it off line. I have to use precious data time and access it through the Play store. Sorry, I used to like the app but, it's too much work now.

I have lost 36 pounds so far and love the free version of this app. It is easy to scan barcodes and track calories. I love the badge feature. It would be cool if you could use benchmarking data to compare my weightloss with similar women of age and height. Or maybe a few success stories of women who have lost weight and how they did it, in a separate tab.

Okay 3 stars. This app is really great for keeping track of what you're eating! its got the scanner that recognizes real store barcodes and can really help you to understand and control portion sizes. However, this app is seriously lacking in the community factor. Support groups/friends are one of the biggest parts to a successful weight loss. App needs some major updating to the social aspects such as finding groups/people and being able to smoothly connect. (and only email notifications 👎)

I like Lose It compared to other apps because their foods list is extensive. I have yet to find something that I have eaten that has not been on their list - and it includes branded manufacturers and many restaurants. Additionally, I love that it breaks down my meal into the summarized nutrients so I can see how I balanced my proteins with my carbs, etc. If you are someone who doesn't need or want a coach, but you want a place to keep track of your exercise and eating habits - this is for you!

This really does help me stay accountable. Very easy to use. Saves meals for easy reuse (rather than entering each item all over again). The bar code scanner works great. They have most restaurants/brand name foods. Lets you track macros. My only wish is that I could meal plan my days for a week at a time without paying for premium as the other features arent that exciting for me. Otherwise love it.

This app is super easy to use for tracking all your health metrics. Recently I decided to take control of my health, I have High Blood pressure, am overweight, out of shape and not getting any younger. I am able to set goals for multiple health components, not just weight. When I meet with my PCP I will be able to show her a months worth of complete data and we can better partner on my long term goals for achieving a healthy lifestyle and not just focus on "losing weight ". Highly recommend.

I have used this app for several years. I recently stopped paying for premium. I like the app but it's too glitchy to spend money on it. Too often it stops syncing with Google Fit. Food I enter into My Foods goes away. Sometimes weight gets measured in hours. My exercises are not in the app. I think developers have a right to charge for their product but I don't want to pay for a product that is not dependable. I don't really want to spend money just to be frustrated.

I want to like this app. Most of the time food is easy to enter and the barcode scanner is the best. My problem is that the choice of measurement options doesn't work for me. My food scale has grams and ounces. Lost It doesn't always give those options. I don't want to convert grams to cups when I enter a food. If that doesn't bother you, I recommend you give this a try. It's unusable for me.

I think this could be a good app if they were to change some things. There are tons of surveys to get through when you first start out before you can even start logging anything. There doesn't seem to be a way to set your own calorie or macro goal for free. If they were to add those as option I think it could be great! I really didn't like that they have plans that have you eating 900 calories a day! Even if they say it's not recommended, it's still irresponsible!

Love this app!! I have tried other apps, but this is the best I've tried. Very easy to use. Love that I can just log quick calories if I don't want to enter a new food. The database for restaurant foods seems to be pretty accurate. I would have rated it a 5 a couple of weeks ago, but they took away one of my favorites features, which was the quantity "spin" feature. Now you have to enter fractions on your own. So now if I eat 3/8ths of something, I have to figure out for myself what that is to enter. Sounds like a silly complaint, but fractions have never been my strength. Other than this one little thing, it's the best app around!!!

So far I've lost over 100 lbs. I'm on a CC diet ("counting calories"). Couldn't have done it without Lose It. I only have one objection and one suggestion! Objection: I'm an android user (as I'm sure many users are) and I can't transfer a posted meals to a different date. That means I end up posting it twice then deleting the post on the date I don't want. It's time consuming. Suggestion: I want to be able to access my notes with a search option so I can refer to them.

I'm literally crying right now! I lost 18 lbs in the last 3 months using this app!!! I thought there was something wrong with me forever and I was about to give up and just be the fat auntie. The premium feature that tells you what foods are keeping you on track has really been so helpful, it encourages me to log everything so the stats can be accurate. I've never stuck with weight loss this long! I highly recommend this app!!! Be sure to use a food scale for accurate measurement

For years, this app has done a fine job helping me track foods I eat throughout the day... but lately it's been nagging (and I mean NAGGING!) me, sometimes multiple times a day, to upgrade to the premium level. It's to the point that I almost no longer want to use it, and may stop recommending it to others. Ease off the nagging, Lose It!

Best out there. The free certain is great by itself, but it's worth it to subscribe, and affordable. Easiest to use, and will track carbs, calories, fiber, fat grams, etc .. Figures out your calorie needs to lose weight at a rate your comfortable with, this app does all the work for you. Will configure in exercise if that's your preference, track your sleep, water, and macros. Also has groups to join and challenges if you're a social butterfly. I can't say enough about this app. 😊☺️

Canceled subscription today after more than 2 years of using several times a day to track food. It used to work but hasn't worked right now for a while. Numerous emails with very nice tech support, but the longer I go without this working, the more I no longer have the urge to enter my food in it. After more than 2 years of daily use, I'm done. I now have $30 a year to spend on something else!

Easy to find foods and to use them on a daily basis since it remembers what you used often. Also easy to put in exercise and to keep track of your weight. I really like the fact that anyone can use this app and it works well. If there is any downside to the free app is that pretty much every day you have at least one or two times and add pop up but I just hit no thanks and go on to my work. They want you to buy the paid one.

Most frustrating app I've used. After going through set up and beginning my first food diary by adding my lunch, every item was added twice and I wasn't able to delete it once it was submitted. I did notice it before and checked all the doubles off then submitted it but it kept them all. I just want an easy, simple and no drama app. This wasn't it for me.

helpful app to help you keep track of all your calories during the day. it has been very helpful so far, ive already lost 2 pounds. I did just have a small bug in the app though, i tried to add a meal on sunday morning, but any time i would add it, it would add it to the day before. so now its showing my saturday calories as if i ate too much and i cant fix it, nor will it add the meal to todays counter. im going to try to uninstall it and reinstall it to see if it fixes it.

After 8 days I'm finding a different app. It seems to have issues with basic math. Edit; leave a negative review and they will delete your account. Basic math issues; adding food, it tells you the macros and then adds whatever it wants. I watched my goal date change every time I opened the app. Left 2 stars, changed it to one after discovering they deleted my account.

Just a few years ago everything or just about everything on this app was free to use. It sucks you have to pay just to log in your water intake or other very basic things. The free version isn't really worth using when on any other diet app you get so much more free. Hopefully they'll make some changes but until then I'm going elsewhere. Best of luck to everyone out there trying to make healthy changes.

I paid for premium on 3 apps and then cancelled two of them after deciding on this one. I've been using Lose It for over a month now. The calorie counter is superior to any I've used before. I also like how you can join or read social posts. The price is better than the other apps as well. I've lost over 10 pounds so far. It has an exercise tracker that is great for me but it might be too basic for more serious athlete types.

I was recommended MyFitnessPal by my nutritionist but I was not able to make an account. I looked up come competitors and I found LooseIt! I am very grateful that I did because this app is fantastic. I did not mind paying the $40 for the yearly subscription because I have been using this thing daily. The food database and the exercise database are amazing. It also allows you to make your own recipes and exercises to calculate things more in tune to your personal day-to-day. This app is awesome!

For a long time, I held this as a five-star as it was one of the best apps I've used. With a recent update, they have restricted some of the things that made it the best. One such thing is the scanning of the barcodes to input food is now only allowed to be used if you're paying for a subscription. At $10 a month, when I am just using the app to help track food, that seems unreasonable. It was a fantastic app, but as time has passed It has become very limited and less practical.

Lose It! is an awesome app! I've been using it for quite awhile now and, even though it is a calorie tracker like so many, I love the inclusion of the macronutrients. I like seeing my calories broken down into those components. Plus, I love the little food icons!! They're so cute and they make me happy! And the food database is ASTOUNDING! There are so many options and so many foods, plus you can always add your own if it doesn't exist! Thank you so much, devs! I don't think I'll ever stop!

It comes down to discipline, no mater what the app tells you. If you eat less calories then you burn - you will lose weight. With that being said, this app was awesome in helping me identify my bad eating habits and in turn, eliminate them. I'm currently at 197 from 230lbs (6ft male). The app didn't make me lose the weight, but it was an excellent log. Be honest with yourself and you will see results.

It's pretty solid. I enjoyed it as a free user. Because it didn't feel like I was being abused, unlike MyFitnessPal, and the price was fair I decided to go premium. I'd still strongly recommend the all for those that are looking for calorie tracking on a budget. That said they could make the app even better if they would add a bit of case based reasoning when I'm adding foods to my diary. I'd like the app to be smart enough to know that I prefer a certain type of measurement for certain foods.

Exactly What I Was Looking For. This app has set me up a plan based on my height and weight and my goals for losing the weight. Additionally the app has given me control over how fast I chose to lose the weight to create realistic expectations. I loved how the app allows you to scan barcodes from food items to get accurate calorie counting. I'm on Day and I feel much better than when I started! You'll be amazed of how many mindless calories we consume on a daily basis.

Taking away previously free tools. I have been using this app on and off for years and have really enjoyed using it, however, I opened the app today to put in my meal and went to scan the barcode and I can't. It now has a pop up for premium and is no longer a free feature. This was one of my favorite things to use on the app for convenience, it made tracking so easy. Really disappointed they'd take that away for free users just to try to get people to switch to premium.

I was recommended to use this app by my dietician and within the first month I've lost a little over 15lbs. I like how easy it is to log food but I've found a majority of the time if it's 'premade' food it's inaccurate. It's time consuming to edit everything to make sure it's correct. I also wish I could pair my Samsung watch to the app since it tracks my steps, heartrate and sleep already, especially since I bought the premium.

Horrible app! It automatically charges you $39.99 for a yearly subscription after advertising a 7-day free trial. Moreover, it overwrote the existing data I entered in the initial questionnaire, identified me as female, messed up my DOB, and allocated me just 555 calories a day (ridiculous!). I just wasted 30 minutes on a Sunday evening answering their questionnaire, which I thought was going to get me somewhere.

This app is stellar! Even the free version is really good. It contains caloric counts for many many foods (you can also scan bar codes) and drills down to your daily fat, protein, and carb intake. The log looks really clean: you see how many calories you can take in, how many you've used up, and whether you're over or under. You get a daily and weekly overview and see how you progress to your goal. Afs are very unobtrusive. I'll go for the paid version to help these developers.

I've used Lose It! On and off for several years now. When I faithfully log, I lose weight. I really enjoy being able to just scan bar codes and not have to worry about logging every detail. Upgrading to the premium is worth the buy as well. It allows me to create recipes so if my family has a favorite soup or casserole dish, I create a recipe the first time. After that, I just click on the recipe and log how many servings I ate. My eldest son now uses the app.

So far its working great! This is my first day but it seems to have all foods even the stuff I order from optavia show up. Its a great way to keep track of exactly what your eating. You think oh this little bit of this or that here and there aren't going to hurt you. But when you can add it all up...... you realize how many calories you are actually eating. Definitely keeps me on track and aware of how much I'm eating. Plus its super easy to use.

I really love this app. It has a database of ssoooo many foods, so you don't have to worry about how many calories most foods have. There is also a barcode scanning feature, so you can scan different foods and get their calorie count automatically. There are a few more features that you'd have to pay for (like nutrition tracking). But if you just want simplified calorie counting, this is it

I've been using this app for a few weeks now. This is my first week of seriously applying myself. I'm on day 3, and have been able to come in below my calorie allowance the last two days. The app really does make it very easy! Just make sure to put in the correct portions, and dont forget to log EVERYTHING! Every calorie "counts", so be honest with yourself, and dont be afraid to over-count, by a few calories. Just do not under-count. Do these simple things, and you will be successful.

I love the calorie budget function. Search for or scan in foods - very easy for me. My first time counting calories. Used for 4 days so far. Best thing: I don't misplace it like I did my paper food log, and no manual math required. I can estimate amounts and run. I feel like this is helping me get to my weight goal (finally!) by giving me a daily food budget. Yay!! Controlling what I eat does not come naturally to me, so this has been super helpful.

I've had this app on my phone (off & on) for the past 7 years (2015), but didnt start consistently using it until May 2020. I began that month at 267 lbs. By April 2021, I was 174 lbs. And do you know how much exercise I did during that time? ZERO! If you use the app consistently, and you remember to log your weight every few days so the app can recalibrate your daily calorie budget, it'll work miracles!

Very great app, I love it! Very accurate calorie counter, and you can scan barcodes to find the exact food you're eating. If it doesn't find the food from the barcode you can add it using the nutrition lable. It also has a great list of workouts, and as a breastfeeding mom, I absolutely love that breastfeeding is on the exercise list. This way I can track it so I make sure I'm eating enough to be able to feed my baby but still stay under my calorie budget for the day and lose weight. Wonderful!

This app is super helpful for tracking my calorie intake. It's made me more aware of my portion sizes and snacking off my kid's plates. One odd blip: last weekend I hiked for 7 1/2 hours up and down a mountain. My calories for the day ended up being negative 2,200+. The app doesn't know how to show that day's info. It just skips that day, saying I haven't done 7 straight days. Weird, but I still really like the app.

Was very excited, until I tried to plan out the foods in my lunch for the next day. Even LOOKING at the next day requires premium membership? I write out what I eat BEFORE I eat it to make sure I don't blow my calorie budget? Of all the things to put behind a paywall, that's what you choose? I downloaded this because I had finally given up on MyFitnessPal, guess LoseIt is just as bad! Fastest app I ever uninstalled!!

This app is amazing and I can track what I am eating and how many calories I am burning a day but not every exercise has a light, moderate, or vigorous level for them. Being a kickboxer, I train for at least an hour and 15 minutes a day some times I work harder than other days. I'll be drenched in sweat and other days I'll barely break a sweat. So when I put the time I have worked out, it's the same amount of calories burned which in my opinion is incorrect. Same goes with martial arts and stretching.

It does what it says but it's not perfect. I understand that they want to make money through subscriptions but why not let me pay for a lifetime license? This seems unreasonable for an app that acts like a glorified calorie calculator. The advertising is also quite intrusive. The "limited time" sale is perpetually there, don't be tricked... That's kind of sketchy

I've been using the Premium version of this app for about 3 years now and it has helped me stay on track for monitoring my macros for weight loss. You have to be careful with some user entered foods, but you can scan barcodes easily into the database and there is a verified food entry only option you can select. I had a recent issue with entering recipes. Support was very quick to respond to let me know that their engineering team was on it and let me know as soon as it was fixed. Love this app!

It's a good motivator, but I have found that the nutrition information is often wrong when the app enters it into your log, even when scanning the barcode from the food item itself, so I have to create most of the foods I enter. That makes me concerned about the validity of the nutrition info for all the foods already stored in the app.

This app is pretty good, especially if you get the premium version. However, there is some things that need to be fixed: 1) I'm having trouble loading the group I'm in and the app even crashed at one point. 2) I want to be able to add/see the type of fat being tracked, not just fat and saturated fat. 3) I'd like to see the vitamins able to be listed for each food. The biggest problem I'm having though, is loading the posts on my group's page. Sometimes it'll even say that I'm not in it but I am.

I gave a five star rating because the app has alot of different food options to add to my daily meal log and I can also add the amount of excercise I do. The allowable caloric intake value is customized for your goals and lifestyle. I did not upgrade, I downloaded the free app. If I upgrade, I can also log water intake and other important daily activities. Great app either way!!!

I simply love this app. It makes it easy to keep track of what I eat. You can scan the bar-codes of food packaging and it has a HUGE list of pre loaded foods to choose from. OR, you can "adjust" them to your specific needs, OR you can add your own. In addition, you can look up food recipes or add your own suggestions. It's very customizable. Add exercise plan if you wish, a fitbit, plus much more. You can keep as little information as you wish or add as much daily activity as you want. Works for me and the cost is reasonable.

Not worth it anymore I have used this app on and off for years and always used the free version. I came back to it a few days ago and saw that I could input my food as usual but can no longer use the barcode scanner unless I am a premium member! I refuse to pay for any calorie counter app as I can do it myself. I chose to use another app. This app has a premium version as well,but as of now , can input food and use the scanner for free. It also has a lot of other features that are pretty cool

I loved this app for so long, but now it's becoming nothing more than just another calorie counting app. Previously free features are now locked behind a paywall, seriously? Features I used just a few months ago I can no longer use unless I want to be a 'Premium' user. That's exactly why I swapped from My Fitness Pal to Lose It in the first place. Guess it's off to find a new app once again. ✌🏻

Love this, the more you add, the more you learn & it becomes easier to tap & track. I lost 1lb since I started this app 7-15-2019. I'd recommend this app to everyone who is struggling with portioning out your meals. It would be nice now that I'm more into this app, that if they update it to take each meal & let you know how many calories are left next to the amount that you already used, so you don't have to remember what the calorie count was at the beginning & shows how well you're doing.

Shortly after purchasing both a bathroom and food scale, I downloaded this app. At first I was frustrated using the food log (it took me a good 30 min. To make a sandwich) but I quickly learned what I was doing. I started at 201 lbs. Oct. 15 and am now down to 196 lbs. This app helps tremendously when it comes to watching your portions. Highly recommended for those who may be wondering how to start losing wright. Just by seeing your daily budget is enough to get you to make smarter decisions. This app works best with a food scale to more accurately track meals, but even if you just have a bathroom scale, you should be good to go.

Great easy to use app. Strong db of foods to choose from. Barcode feature works great on pricessed foods, plenty of options for building your own recipes and the app analyzes them for calories, protein, etc. i wish there was better analysis tools, though; would love to see what percentage of calories are coming from animal products, for example.

No longer tracking the number of days until I reach my weight loss goal. Each day when I add in my calories consumed and hit done. It show "0" days instead of the number of days that I have been using this app. It also no longer tells me the date that I will reach my goal. It also no longer syncs to my fossil smartwatch & Google fit app. Very disappointing..... I'm going to look for another app.

Would prefer to give 0 stars. Been logging on this app for over 1035 days and up until 3pm today everything was fine. Annoying with the intrusive ads after every log, but fine for a free app. Logged in only to find that all of my progress and information was wiped and I have to take a quiz with detailed personal information to open the thing. Over two years and 20lbs gone for what? I'm out. Ads had me on the fence but this tipped it. Don't waste your time on this app.

It's about the same as my fitness pal, but since I paid for the membership i get "insights" that let me see things like, "on days you drink coffee you eat less calories" ... which is useless because i literally drink coffee every single day. Also, as with any calorie tracker, tons of foods are just slightly inaccurate. Like a can of white claw is 100 calories, 2 carbs... but this says 110 calories and no carbs... aggravating! I would not have paid for the year and i known.

made a rash decision to download this and subscribed to premium yesterday. They have you fill out a refund request form that requires a refund reason, but doesn't have a way to input one. Calorie counting can be really dangerous, and they don't have any information about how to try to stay safe about it. I really shouldn't have signed up based on the name itself, but it looked like an okay way to track food patterns. It's not worth the rest of the app to me.

First off, I only review apps based on their free content, as I'm too broke to do anything else. I am in love with this app, extremely fair. It doesn't harass you with notifications, it's super easy to scan bar codes and track info. The paid-for content would be nice but does not noticeably take away from the free experience. If I were to pay for an app, this would definitely be on my list.

love this app! Even the free version is better then Fitness Pal or any other counter out there. Easy to use, not loaded with ads, has a vast database of foods and a bar code scanner. What I love most is the incredible simplicity and ease while still offering a breakdown of daily intake and remaining calories as well as what your balance is between protien, fat and carbs. Really awesome!!

Few things to improve. Bug-consecutive day count is broken. For the premium options allow users to open the feature and explore it. You can still prevent logging in it until they buy. I am interested but hesitant to buy pro without actually seeing the features (what does glucose tracking do?). During the questionnaire you can say measurements or BF% or important to you but you can't log either of these metrics. I recommend adding these where you enter your weight.

This app is good for monitoring portions and what not, but I'm very disappointed with what I was greeted to when I opened the app. First of all, you need to be 18 to have a profile on this app... Seriously? You need to be 18 to have a dietary plan and lose weight? Like you can't do anything without being an adult. On top of that, they immediately put you on the paid option for the app and you have to manually chose the free version. Super scummy.

The free version is excellent. I love the food tracking features including the food lookup abilities. I also love the progress graphs for your weight over time-it helps with motivation. I just don't like how frequently it bugs you to upgrade to premium. I have upgraded in the past and haven't found the added features very useful, but maybe that is just me. I wish they had a "don't ask me again" button instead of asking you to upgrade each time you sign in.

For calorie counting on its own, this is a great app. It is extremely intuitive and the systems it uses to recall data make it very easy to enter after you've been using it for a while. That said, it has gotten extremely aggressive in its sales pitch. Between the launch pop-ups, the "flash" sale ticker that has been going for months, and the full half of the data entry dashboard taken up to show upgrade features, the self-promotion is easily as intrusive as any ad-supported app I've used.

I used LoseIt for years, and have finally made the decision to move to another app as I have found the macros (and sometimes calories) on most foods here are not accurate. If you're fine with double checking everything or if you have a pretty basic diet, the app is great. I love the interface much more than other apps, all the different options you get with premium, and the groups. I just do not have the time to manually enter or correct every entry as I eat a large variety of foods.

Definitely the best free option out there, this app makes it easy to stay consistent. Ads don't bother the app experience. One thing that could be improved, from the perspective of someone who had an eating disorder as a teen who used this app to bolster it: when someone goes "over budget," change the red to another color. Have it be yellow or something, and don't have it switch to red until they're over their MAINTENANCE calories. People shouldn't feel bad about eating a smaller deficit.

I've used this app for years. My only issue is that "user shared" products are almost always wrong (when compared to the label), and there isn't always a "verified" version. Often times there is no info at all, except the calories (which are usually wrong, too) It sucks having to edit, or create from scratch, so many items. It would be nice if they'd stop making "share with users" the default. Most people won't stop to uncheck the box, or check that their entry is accurate.

I really liked this app and it definiatly was fun to track my food and lose some weight. After the recent update Oct 2018, it now comes up with option to enter number for servings or amount of items, instead of being able to scroll through numbers. I hate the new update, i don't want the number pad to come up every time i select a food item, i would rather scroll like it was before. why change something that was just fine like it was. I was thinking of getting the premuim version, but if it is going to be annoying having the keyboard pad come up every time, then forget that.

Easy to use with an exercise section that deducts calories burned by a long list of activities, including weight lifting. Previous items and even entire meals from previous days can be added as a convenience. However. Lately the app has slowed down.
