I'll select a food item and nothing at all happens for maybe five seconds, then--finally--it appears in my log. These delays seems to have increased in direct proportion to appeals to upgrade to the premium version, which I don't need.

After the past 2 updates the recipe logging is borderline unusable as it does not accurately calculate calories per serving because of this. Also, it has started frequently crashing in the background and android is flagging it as a high battery usage app. I loved this to start with as its helped me lose over 50lbs and want to get back to that again.

A great, stable, well-designed app. Ads are not intrusive. Searching for challenges did not work for me. The only thing I really wish could be added is tracking of net carbs (total carbs - fiber). This is not available even in the premium version. I'm not sure how accurate the calorie estimations are for exercise, they seemed high. It would also be great if we could track body measurements in addition to weight.

This app is fine. I switched to this from MyFitnessPal a few months ago on a friend's suggestion. I loved their "pattern" recognition where it would notice I was more or less likely to go over or under calories with certain foods. However, they moved this behind a paywall. They also used to have more statistics and carb goals but then they moved those behind a paywall too. Almost every reason I was using this over MFP has been moved behind a paywall, and while I'd be happy to watch some ads or something to unlock features for the month that's not an option. I'm moving back to MFP because, while I think this is a better app for paid users I am not one. Now the free version is just a tracker with less features than MFP. Good app, stable, great pay features but too hollow as a free tracker.

Every time I log in, it tells me I'll save a percentage on life time. "Save 50%" "Save 62%" etc etc. The money saved isn't anything. The price keeps getting higher and the percentage gets tweaked to make it seem like I'd be saving money. The offer sucks and it's annoying to see every time I log in. Other than that, it's a fine app. Kind of hard to navigate and make changes to plans and goals. But the tracking of goals is good.

I really do like this app. As someone who has never tracked calories/macros in their life this app has made it super easy. I started by looking into noom(way too expensive for me & felt it had a potential to end up down the disordered eating route as well). The scanner feature makes it really easy to track everything I'm eating. It helps keep me accountable & mindful of what I'm putting in my body & Lose It has made it possible! Plus it's free & premium is affordable. Thank you Lose It!

I am using the free version of the app. I like it so far. I enjoy the ease of using the app. I like the icons they show for the food, it gives you a nice visual besides numbers and words. I like the badges they give you, it is a nice touch. I also like checking in on the social feature. What i don't like is when you start a new day it takes a while for the date to switch over. i also don't like that their exercise calories spent are different than the planet fitness machines. i have to tweak the

It's a fantastic app. Lots of ways to customize your goals, water tracking, trends, and more. The premium is worth the price if you are getting serious about your weight loss. My only complaint is you cannot disable the basic meals (so instead of having an Afternoon Snacks and an Evening Snacks, I'm forced to keep the generic Snacks category.)

I've never had much dedication to weight loss diet. Now, for health reasons I have more resolve, This app has been very easy to track my progress. I m using the free app, which is working just fine. But may join the paid app, which is only 2.99 a month, as I can track my water, and the exercise I am adding. I've tried to be very honest about the food, and have lost about 10lbs in a little over a month. 30 more to go!

Very easy to use! Setup goal ..and start logging. Best part is we find all sorts of food i can just select and avoid trying to find calories on every meal. I can scan too! Already losing as predicted by the app.. although i am way below suggested calories. I Have not used premium where it tracks detals like calories fe fat sugar etc. May be worth it for those having more than 10 or so lbs to lose. Social and friends part needs improvement. But overall an awesome app.

I've used this app over the course of 3 years. When I was on point logging everything, I lost upwards of 45 lbs in a year. I really enjoy the personalization and seeing how my timeline changes based on MY choices. It is a little User unfriendly, finding the right link to change goals and desired total calories is a little difficult but I spent 30 mins clicking on every thing and found what I was looking for. I went premium! It's worth it!

Edit: Long time user here (years). I do not need and would not use the premium features, so I've always had the free version and did not mind the banner ads. The recent addition of full screen pop-up adds (with sound!) is slimy and very obtrusive. I can no longer recommend this app to friends and family, and I will be looking for something else myself. I might be willing to pay a small one-time fee for an ad free version, but a premium subscription would never be worth it to me.

Used the app years ago & it was great. Seems to have been upgraded and is more complicated to use now. I wish it would allow me to completely delete all my past failures when I reset goals or restart a diet. No one wants to be reminded of a long history of diet failures!! I've switched to the keto diet so I'll just use their specific app.

I stopped using MFP because you had to pay an obscene amount for premium just to scan barcodes. The 'Use It' app has been fantastic! The premium membership is very very reasonable. I know it sounds silly....but the fun food icons make tracking my food more appealing. It scans barcodes flawlessly. Its easy to track my food in grams. Ive only been been using it a few weeks but so far it's a winner! even if MFP gets their $hit together I wouldn't go back!!

Great app for calorie counting, the social side of it sucks hard though. The janky message system seems to have been made even worse than it already was by the new unecessary "feed" tab they added. You get permanent notifications (that you can't clear out) for messages that you can't view. Just stick to the calorie counting, but don't bother posting in the groups, it's not worth the headache.

I like this app so far. It's relatively basic without buying the add ons for more assistance in what foods are helping or holding you back. It asks in the set up if you are managing any health conditions while dieting, and doesn't ask anything further upon selecting yes. Seems silly and pointless. Not very personalized without buying a premium membership. Also, as a dancer, it would be nice to be able to log dance activities as more than general "dance" in exercise. Decent app overall.

I have tried another popular diet and exercise app before. This one is easier and better in my opinion. I love it! My updated review 11/21/21: I'm unhappy with the projected elimination of challenges in December. There are many different challenges for many different reasons. They encourage me and others to be focused on certain elements of the weight loss journey. These will be a bad loss!

Pros: food database is reasonable, bar code scanner also, price is not insane unlike MyFitnessPal. Cons: adding food and tracking your own recipes is not as easy as it should be. Many food entries in the database offer one single size "1 portion", very uninformative. Having a weight or volume to go with what that means would help, as would allowing you to specify the amount in your units of choice for any entry. Similar story for your own recipes. But, also, not sure what's better out there.

This use to be an awesome free app. Now that they have put all the features behind a paywall, it is only good for calorie counting alone. There are better apps out there, especially if you are already using a fit bit or other movement tracker. I would be fine paying a one-time charge to upgrade, but not a monthly/yearly subscription. I'll find something else.

I've been planning to rate this five stars but haven't taken the time to rate it untill now. But by now, when I finally am takeing the time to rate I've been disappointed. I still love the app it is very helpful in tracking calories and nutrients to get me the results I want. The reason I give it four stars is that, for some reason the app has become very slow. I don't think the problem is my phone because lose it is the only thing affected. It often freezes up and is "not responding".

I installed the app over a year ago. I immediately lost 10 pounds, and another 5 over the first month. I was enthusiastic. I am not fond of the constant pop-up asking me to pay for a premium account. Update:. After using the app for a year and a half, I have uninstall it. The constant pop-ups were annoying, but the last straw was when they made excersize a premium feature. Looking for something new.

It worked for two days then crashed. Sent in feedback. Still crashing. Will have to get rid of it and use another calorie counter. UPDATE: I did not see that lose it reached out to me and for that I am sorry. It is now a year later and I am not having any issues with lose it. More than likely it was my phone having issues. I have lost nearly 20lbs using this app. I will continue to use it. Keeping track of calorie intake is important.

So far this has been my favorite tracking app, for both nutrition & exercise. The ease & swiftness of barcode scanning, picture taking auto fill nutrients, etc. are such a time saver & make this a genuine on-the-go app. I do; however, have two complaints, hence 4/5. I wish there was a skip meal button for intermittent fasting. I know, simply "don't log it, " but that leaves it looking incomplete. Also, maybe some nutrition guidelines/info for things like keto when it comes to tracking/meals.

The scanning of barcodes was slow and their database does not include grams for some foods when entering foods. How can an app even call itself a calorie counter and not have the grams for butter (Smart Balance actually) in their database? This is supposed to make it easier to track your calories. How is having to measure the butter for your toast out in teaspoons easier?  I also find the interface when entering food to be confusing. The designers did not take into account that when the text entry field is active, half of the screen is taken up with the keyboard and it covers up all of the options they show you from prior meals.  It also has the same perverse obsession that all of these apps with classifying food intake according to breakfast, lunch, and dinner. But I did not take any stars off for that since that seems to be a pandemic problem in all of the counters.   One star off for the clunky interface that does not focus on what they user actually wants to see and one off for a database that lacks important data.

I really enjoy this, makes keeping track of everything quite easy, and it does all the counting for you. However all of a sudden the fat carb and protien tracker wont show me how many grams I've had a day, have had the app for not even a full week yet and all my tracking of those are gone/hidden. If it's a premium feature I wasnt made aware upon downloading, and if it stays that way I'll saddly have to find a new app to track these things. Other than that it's very user friendly

Too complicated. It seems to have extra features that some people would like, like lots of nutrients graphics, images of some foods, etc. But I wish I could set my own goals, and I absolutely hate having to answer all these life questions if I haven't used the app in a while. Why are you trying to lose weight? How do you feel? Etc. I just want a simple interface to count calories at my custom amount, maybe log weight, and make sure I get enough protein. I miss my old app that was discontinued.

This is not an ad-supported or free version, but only a free trial. Users should be told up-front, before bothering to download, before the app does its data gathering, that the 'free' version is only a 7 day trial, after which it will automatically charge $39 a year. No scummier than most apps, but that's a low bar. If you're into being manipulated, the graphics look good, and a lot of thought went into the process of making the user feel comfy about it.

There are a lot of food selections, that makes calorie tracking easy for the most part. It does not integrate with my watch or Google fit properly. It consistently is extending my goal day out, no matter if I am eating half of my calories. It doesn't consistently save my weight, so every few days it records me back at my starting weight messing up my projection. I even paid for the premium subscription because I was recommended it so heavily. I have cancelled it after using for six months. BAD!

I've used lose it off and on for years. I just reinstalled it and found out that I can no longer scan barcodes unless I want to go premium. It's one thing to pay for some features that make the experience more in depth and desirable but how can one even use an app such as this without scan feature is beyond me. It would be more hassle then the app is helpful. It should be included in basic plan. Please note, if money is not an issue for you, use it. Its a good app! Basic isn't non functionable.

After 10 years, I'm still very happy with this app! It synchs with my heart monitor watch seamlessly, and they keep making it easier to add my food. I like how they added body measurements and goals, along with data about micro nutrients. When I hit plateaus, the app helps me see if I've had a lot of sugar or carbs, and when my body is converting bulkier fat to leaner, heavier muscle. Quick, simple, robust, excellent!

Two things I didn't like about this app; 1, I have a full time job that alternates between reception and physical labor and I work out 6 days a week, I have no idea what activity level I fall under. 2, according to this app, losing weight at the rate I already have been would be extremely difficut and inadvisable. It was pretty smooth and easy to use, so I might try again.

This is an excellent app. it has all of the features you need to track your food effectively, whether you're trying to lose, maintain, or gain weight. It also has amazing widgets, so you can see your calorie budget and macros on your home screen. All of that is free. There is a premium version but all of the core functionality is accessible for free, and the premium version is reasonably priced if you're interested in the extras.

I am a 55+ male and used Lose It! to lose 30 lbs in 5 months spanning the holidays. It is very good and easy to use, The paid version integrates my fitness watch. The food database, barcode scanner, and ability to store recipes makes tracking calories easy. With a few enhancements, it could be great! The food database allows the user to enter a food item by only one type of measurement: count (e.g. number of pretzels), volume (e.g. cup, teaspoon), or weight (e.g. grams, ounces). The nutritional information is often provided for at least two of these types. Further, when searching the database, it is unclear which of these entries will be useful for the measurement you have. The other issue is the unfortunate emphasis on "net calories", those consumed vs burned. When looking at your personal history, it is difficult to distinguish between a day on which you simply sat around and starved yourself versus a day in which you took a long hike and ate a hearty meal. The latter contributes more to overall health and should be more easily displayed and tracked. The app also provides the ability to look at your food history to see where you get your calories and the balance of your nutrition. These features are interesting and informational, but not as critical as the shortcomings expressed above.

Incredible food database plus add your own food and recipes, gentle reminders to keep logging if you forget, and so easy to use. I'm actually losing weight with this app. BUT...the most recent update messed up the way you enter foos portions and makes it much more difficult. Please bring back the old way of inputting portions! This update made me change my mind on the Premium upgrade....

Love this app !! Very easy to use ! But will be looking for another due to them removing challenges. That to me was the best part. It kept me motivated and could track my progress with others. Very sorry that it's stopping. What about making challenges only available if you purchase app..and not with free version? If it is about money to keep them going, than maybe more people would purchase app? Because it's not really clear why they are stopping then.

Great app. Looks great, is fast and efficient, scanner works really well. It has a comprehensive index of products and allows you to customize entries that might not match due to a change. I don't like that you can't log food for tomorrow unless you pay; most other free apps have this. May not track as much as other apps, nutrient-wise.

I used to love this app. I used this app for years, and I always came back to it after taking breaks from dieting, but it seems like everytime I come back the app gets worse. It's super slow, theres ads everywhere, and everything is behind a paywall now, even the barcode scanner! And premium went up in price! The price it was before was still not worth it for what you get. At this point, I'm better off getting a journal irl and writing down my intake/excercise/weight. This is ridiculous.

I think the only way this app could fail a person is if they were'nt commited to losing weight. It gives you easy food tracking, and weight tracking. There are groups available if you want support or just to share. I've used one of the older, probably best known weight loss companies in the past. I think this app should provide the same success. With one exception. This app is Free!

This app is exactly what I was looking for. I have used many different apps for logging my calorie intake and Loose It! is by far the best. The barcode scanner is fast and reliable. The food database is extensive. The interface is easy to use and navigate. The integration with Garmin works great. If you are looking for an app for logging your calories and weight, you should give Loose It! a try.

The app has great features, even the free version. In 2016 I lost 50lbs on 6 months using this app. Once I stopped using the app some of that weight came back over 2 years. Started using it again and I lost most of what I gained. The key for this to work it to log everyday and check your weight 1 or 2 times a week. Changing what you eat isn't easy but once you do and stick with it, you'll see a difference.

Easy, not crowded with ads, connects to Strava if you pay. It is only $40 a YEAR. I havent upgraded yet, but thinking I will. I like the barcode scan option. Havent used the food photo yet. Has all I need. No pestering coach, but it does send a notification like once a day if it has been a while since you recorded. I like a little reminder, but not one ever hour as some apps seem to do. So far, I like the app. Much better than the other free one I tried.

Excellent app! Super easy to log and track calories. Wish the 'reviewed for accuracy' foods were a little more accurate, but overall a great database of foods. Bar code/nutrition info scanning takes nearly all the work out of the experience. I have no interest in all the bells and whistles that come with a subscription. I wish there was a way to pay $10 to go ad/nag free instead.

It is so easy to keep track of what you are eating (I was just jotting calories down but I'd always forget some) and the ease of adjusting food size or to cancel an item. I like that I can add Exercise and my Scale Weight. Lost 11 pounds so far which I credit to this app that my daughter had previously used. Lose It! does work and so easy that anyone can use it!!!! Love it....

I have only used this for 2 days. I will adjust my review after the month of May. But at this time, I find it so easy to find foods and brands with ease. Logging food is so easy. I also have connected the app with my Fitbit. Again no problems there. I want to look more into the whole program. I decided to go premium due to the low cost of this choice. I plan is comparing how I do with my food choices and watching calories.

This app is super easy to use! The food barcode scanner works really well, and most fresh foods without a barcode have already been entered. I like the breakdown of carbs/fats/proteins, as it really illuminates where my calories are coming from. Overall, just being able to easily and quickly see how many calories I have left in a day is helping. And I appreciate that a snack is included in the daily caloric intake planning. It's very realistic!

I like this for calorie tracking, it's nice to have a visual on my intake. It remembers foods I eat and it congratulated me when I hit milestones like losing ten pounds, for example. I don't like how it asks me why I've "come back" when I haven't used it in a while. I did use it almost daily, but now I only use it for calorie info and to look at how far I've come on my weight loss plan. Being grilled just because I need to pop in is super annoying.

Buggy functionalty for logging exercise ('cooking up an update' for 30sec after every single entry for months now), not to mention barcode scanning getting paywalled when it's free on so many other apps. I'm a long-term user of probably a decade and wanted to purchase premium this year. The ads were fine, the loss of free scanning was annoying, but the freezing after exercise inputs is intolerable. I'm a creature of habit and really hate to switch, but LoseIt just isn't functional anymore.

Never did I think I would enjoy counting calories. It's always been so frustrating. I was blown away when I went to Olive Garden and thought, how am I supposed to input this in the app? Literally search Olive Garden and their menu items pop up. When I make tostadas or other foods with multiple things, I dont have to count individual calories. Just put in the whole recipe once and click a button when you want to log that meal for the day. If youre losing weight, THIS is the time to be alive.

I've used the free version of this app off and on for years. I'm now seriously working on some health issues by changing my diet. I need to be able to input homemade recipes in order to get correct calories, sodium, protein, etc. The ads didn't bother me. I'm trying Premium for one year to see if it's worth it; if it makes entering recipe content easier.

Updated 03/2022. I'm disappointed I paid for premium. It has more insights, which is great, and its easier to log meals. But the challenges are gone and its really hard to find new groups. Those were helping keep me motivated last time..... I love the extra features with premium. The insights page is helpful and the group's, forums and challenges keep you motivated. The app itself occasionally freezes, not more than once a week and I use the app daily.

Really happy with this one. I bought it, which makes all the difference. WHAT I LIKE: I can create recipes fairly easily, it remembers anything that I've used before, I can scan the barcode of a new food, and I can add foods from previous meals. WHAT I DON'T LIKE: It saves any food that anybody enters. This means that you have multiple entries for the same food because somebody didn't scan it, with different spellings, and with a completely useless 1 serving for the amount.

So easy to use and understand. Tracking is totally up to you but by being honest you will achieve your goals. This has helped me lose 50+ pounds and will help me get to my final goal and during maintenance. Recent update has improved scanning of foods so much faster. This is by far the best app I have found for food/exercise/challenge tracking. Please PLEASE fix the scanner. I do not have 5 minutes to wait for the scan.

I got the pro version for a year and the app works great for what it's meant. I'd love to see under the "Health" option, along with the water/step/weight tracker, a multivitamin tracker. Just as an additional option, such as the water goal, to be able to keep track of everything in one place. The look of the app (visual, not layout) could use a little work to be more visually appealing as well, but the way it looks now isn't an issue as the features make up for it.

Smooth user interface that I've yet to have issues with. They have advanced metrics such as calorie percentage, net carbs, ect. I've hardly ever not been able to find a food that I've searched for. The smart fill in functionality and previous meals quick add is great. I can quickly add what I ate which makes it easier to stay on top of using the app. The different goals that you can set within it are also important to me. All in all, I like this app over any other.

I used to love this application because of it's fair premium price subscription compared to competitors and it's simple, utilitarian vibe. It honestly helped me lose 70 pounds. But lately it has been crashing on the most important of functions - adding a food. So disappointing that if this isn't fixed, I'm going to have to move to another service. In it's current buggy state, I would not recommend.

I really like this app. It has helped me lose about 15 pounds in about two months just by being a great food journal. The search capability is great and, if you're super small, you can input your own food items work nutrition information. I only gave it for stars because it keeps asking me to upgrade and I feel like there should be a snooze button on that advertisement for a week after someone clicks "no thanks".

I'm kidding, I still am. Though documenting my food intake was incredibly helpful as was the calorie goal. And I'm starting to see weight loss on the scales. The exercise input is good to have too. All the integration of other apps is very welcome as is the group input on food items. Would like to see more verified nutrition food items but pretty satisfied overall

I've had Lose It! for about 3 years. I love the simple interface of this app as well as the goal setting and progress tracking features. I think it integrates many different and useful aspects of a calorie tracker/fitness app very well. Customer service is also very responsive and polite. I have found it to be well worth the subscription for the premium version, but it's great in its free form as well.

This app it's great for tracking calories, macronutrients, and has a great food tracker. You could just scan any barcode and find exactly what you need. One thing that I would like to see is the ability to track intermittent fasting. Hey support, do you think you could add that?? Otherwise, it's a great all-around app for tracking all of your meals!

Used happily and successfully for many years. Didn't mind the ads until lately, they are now beyond intrusive, they hinder use of the app. Sadly deleted the app and am here shopping for an alternative. Yes, I tried the paid version for a year and did not need the features and can't justify the cost in my budget. Hoping to find an app that plays nice with Samsung.

I've been using the free version for 593 days. I love it! For me, the biggest problem is that, when I enter a new food, there can be many entries of the same food (brand, serving size, etc) that all list different calories. Even if I switch it to "verified". Once I find the one that matches the calories on the box or package, I can edit it, enter it to my meal and it will then show up in "my foods". But I'd like to delete the incorrect ones that make the list so long.

Brilliant. I've lost 23 lbs so far and I have to credit some of my success to this app. Lose It! makes it so easy to track foods and log workouts and the barcode scanner is off the hook as far as accuracy (and I've used a few of these apps!) I paid to unlock the full version. (Which - FYI also keeps you a little more motivated since you've invested in it!) Bottom line - I love how intuitive the app is and I really feel as though this is a fantastic tool when it comes to weight loss and health.

I've used this app to lose almost 100 pounds, great calorie and macro tracker. One of the recent updates has made the Android version very frustrating as every time you search for a food if you pick one and it turns out to be the wrong food you cannot return to the search where you left off but instead have to start the search all over again. This was not the case previously.

Very helpful ap. Thorough list of foods and exercises. Love the bar code scanner. The beta picture food recognition feature is fun to play with. It can recognize some foods. I like that you can record your weight too. I have the free version- I don't see many ads and they are easy to click off. I have been tracking for 2 months now and have lost 10 lbs! Exercise alone wasn't enough- this was the final piece of the puzzle.

Very easy to use this app. I like that I can log everything I eat and can find every food item possible, even create my own recipes, and especially the scanning option. You scan the bar code of anything and it tells you the calorie count. And you can adjust the portions you ate so it's more accurate. I can also see throughout the day how many calories I've eaten so far, or enter my meals ahead of time at the beginning of the day so can predict where I'm at.

I love this app, for the most part. HOWEVER....I wanted to track my water intake so I upgraded to the Premium account. Now, the water tracker section I saw on the free version of the app (which could only be accessed by upgrading) is nowhere to be found on the Premium version. There is no FAQ option to see where to find it. if I don't get help or figure it out, I am cancelling my Premium subscription. $40 bucks a year is not worth it if I'm not getting what was advertised. *THX 4 HELP. GOT IT!*

I've used this app for years and I really like the usability and interface. It always allowed you to connect your fitness tracker to it to keep track of calories burned. Now all of a sudden you need to have a premium subscription to connect your tracker. Really disappointed and will probably use a different app now that has kept that as a free feature. Shame.

I really wanted to love this app. It's beautifully designed, but to get to micronutrients you have to be premium. Ok. But then when you use the barcode scanner and the only data you get is calories, it's a little disconcerting. The database does have a verified filter, which is good, but there are a lot of discrepancies even when you use that. I guess it's back to MyFitnessPal for me.

Works well most of the time, scanner works nine times out of ten, easy to use, reasonable goal settings, but I REALLY don't appreciate getting notifications that it's okay that I missed a few days of tracking when I haven't missed a single thing in over a week amongst other poorly timed notifs. Over all it's fine but the notifs can be down right stupid instead of being helpful or actually encouraging. Personally I'm turning them off because they've bothered me enough, but to each their own.

Can't recommend the Premium because it doesn't sync half the time and is not user friendly. Very disappointed and wish I could get a refund because it's rather expensive. However the Basic is good for logging meals, exercise & weight. Don't expect to take a picture of your meal and get a calorie count 'cause it just doesn't work. The food database is above average, but the calorie count is often wrong. Try it, but don't bother with the upgrade. Just my opinion...

I've been using this app an extensive amount of time (6 years) and have found it very useful and easy to log both food and exercises. Recently, pop up ads had been introduced and are extremely intrusive. When adding an item an ad will pop up and only some of the ads are skipable. I completely get that it's in a businesses best interest to monetize but the number of pop ads have made it harder to justify the use of this app. Editing nutrition of an item after scanning it is also broken now.

helps keep me on track with losing a few pounds and counting calories. I wish that I could get the premium can't really afford it. I love that it has pretty much every food and that you can also scan. Scanning make things a lot easier. The only thing is that when I put in my exercises sometimes I kind of have to make things up and it's not really specific. or compared to my other app the calories that I burned for the time that I worked out is off. But overall this is an amazing app.

I've been logging for over 230 days and I've definitely lost weight in part to the app (around 20 lbs). It's great to be able to see a number and get a more realistic idea of the energy count of the food I eat. App is easy to use compared to similar apps. A bummer is there are features on the iversion that aren't available on android, like the ability to copy one of your own recipes and the constant updates are nice, but sometimes they break the app and take up a lot of space

I really like the app for counting calories and 'My Foods' is helpful. It would be nice if the app could convert grams and ounces for you. Also, your projected goal weight timeline changes to further out even if you stay within your allotted calories. I'm doing the free version. I tried premium at one time and quickly realized all additional upgrades are sold separately. There is not a premium account for all upgrades. I think most people would be happy with the free version.

I have used this app for awhile now, it is mediocre at best. The most frustrating thing for me is that if I create an exercise it doesn't stay at the calories I originally input. I know they change because when I create an exercise I input the calories burnt in the title. For some exercises I created awhile back the variance is as high as 10 calories. All together I have noticed subliminal changes that, in my opinion, are done to try and get the user to invest in prime membership.

It looks OK overall, but the foods are usually not listed in grams, which is too annoying. When counting calories, it's easiest to throw the food on a scale and then calculate based on that, rather than trying to figure out tbsp or whatever. Almost every label lists servings in grams, so it should be in the database. Also, the app doesn't seem to let you define a manual calorie target.

Downloaded this app and chose the free basic version rather than the $39.99 a year version with a 7 day trial period. Then it offered me a 25% discount. So I accepted that so I could try it with all of it's benefits and see how I liked it. Within an hour or two I hated it. I'm pretty app savvy and I found the UI frustratingly counterintuitive. When I tried to cancel, it said it would not renew my subscription in 12/2020! I guess the discounted price didn't include the 7 day trial. Unacceptable!!

Very easy to use. Really like how it saves food you eat so there is less need to look up repeated food. Also like being able to look up different types of exercise. To me this is more precise than the fit bit app. Can see more information on the initial screen which means less time going from screen to screen to find data recorded.

The functionality is great. I do find the UI to be outdated and not terribly appealing. If it got an aesthetic makeover, I would definitely use it more. It could also really use a couple widget options (basically like the Yazio widget - shows calories minus whatever has already been consumed, plus whatever has been earned through exercise, resulting in a final "tally" of what you have left for the day).

The app is a great way to start managing calories to either maintain or lose weight. The large database of food makes calorie counting so easy by just being able to scan a barcode or search up foods. The free version is pretty barebones, but works well. The paid premium is pricy but has a load of cool features which allows me to limit my sugar and sodium intakes, among other things. It has a smooth and uncomplicated UI, which is always important as it is not a hassle to use.

This app has really helped me keep track of my calories and what I'm eating, I've already lost over 13 pounds in a month! It sends gentle reminders to track meals, which has been really helpful since I'm busy throughout the day. I paid for the yearly version but was having trouble syncing it with my Fitbit, but the customer service was really helpful and refunded the amount since they couldn't figure out what was going on. I recommend this app, it's very user friendly!

Good-ish, but has some issues. It says you can adjust calories on the "daily calorie budget screen" by using the adjustment field... but that is not possible because there is no adjustment field. No mention that it is only for the premium service... So frustrating. Often gets stuck searching for a food. Some barcode scans can be adjusted which is helpful, but some are juat plain wrong and I cant adjust. Ugh.

I like this app. It is a decent tracker.Lots of ways to individualize your weight loss tracking. Most of the things you need to pay for are not that important if all you need is to keep track of weight and food eaten. Requiring a premium subscription to track fluid intake, along with monitoring vital signs, like blood pressure, however, loses two stars for me.

The app is good at what it does and easy to use: entering foods is simple. The confusing interface beyond entering foods leaves a lot to be desired, and dealing with a pop up add for the paid version every single time you open the app is exceptionally tiresome. It's a shame that there are not more options available for simple calorie counting.

I've actually lost weight using this, which I am flabbergasted by. I would definitely recommend, but just remember to not get overly obsessed with counting calories, and remember that you should also be considering your macros, not just calories! Overall, a great app that's really helped me improve a lot, and I'm planning to continue! Edit: since the new discover update came out, it won't load groups, social, or inbox. Before mine crashed I saw others saying they had difficulty loading as well.

I like LoseIt better than My Fitness Pal. For me, it's easier to use, but they could make some of the features a little smoother. Like being able to edit your custom foods without creating an additional food. Or having to switch back and forth between Search and My Foods when trying to log meals. Other than that, this app is awesome! Would definitely recommend.

Great app! I love that the entries are verified so you get a lot more accurate information than other trackers out there. With others the items would be very off on calorie counts. Where you go to create a recipe is kind of annoying to find but once you do its easy to input. Hoping they add the service to allow you to easily import recipes from the web. Connects to fitbit too!

Only been using it for a few days but so far I like it a lot. Integration with Samsung Health would be amazing! I have to use a 3rd party app to sync from SH to Google Fit, which then uploads to lose it. Not terrible but it'd be great if all my info just synced from SH directly. So far all of my food scans have worked no problem, but I added a recipe and need to change it but can't delete it or edit the nutrition.

Excellent app. Very easy to use and very comprehensive. It lets you know not only the calories you consume but also details on carbs, net carbs, fiber, fat, proteins, cholesterol, etc. You can also adjust your goals and modify them at any time if needed. It also has the menus from hundreds of restaurants, and a database with most supermarkets' products.

Used this app for quite a while, but finally had to give up on it. It now asks you to buy the full version every single time you open it back up. The app just freezes for several seconds and you start to think your phone is frozen, but nope, the app is just loading it's "do you want the full version" dialog box...

This app is fantastic! It makes it very easy to track what you consume, and gives you an accurate, appropriate calorie deficit goal for each meal. There are no invasive ads (thank you developers)! The food selection is infinite due to being able to scan a barcode, even my supplements are included. So far after a week I've lost 4 pounds. My only suggestion is making the option to manually program at home lifting exercises!

The premium features sound interesting, but while I would be willing to pay a monthly subscription (right now $2.50 per month) for the premium features, I don't want to pay for an entire year (on sale right now for $30) at once and up front. If a reoccurring monthly subscription is ever offered I might reconsider this app, but not now for $30 up front. The free features seem accurate and easy to use, and I consider this free app a good choice for nutrition management as is.

Does what it says! I've been using this app on and off (usually when I convince myself I'm gonna be healthy for like a week lol) for like 5 years. It's sort of my go-to! It's got a great search tool for when you're ordering food from somewhere and want to log it, and has a barcode scanner for any packaged food you use at home. Super easy and useful! (Though if the programmers read this...I wouldn't mind a widget that tells me my calorie count without opening the app 👀)

Gets the job done and can be really motivating, but has a few places for improvement. I personally hate all the pop ups reminding me to do stuff, so it would be great if those could be disabled. Also, the app doesn't have a "yellow zone" for going over your calories. Like, if you already eat at a 200 calorie deficit per day, then it shouldnt be a big deal if you go 50 calories over your plan.

As far as calorie tracking goes, this is my favorite app. There's a huge database of foods and the UPC scanner works great. Some of the features are buggy. I added my husband as a friend, which was a bit of an effort, but the real drag was my inability to share recipes with him. Like, the option is there, but it doesn't follow through. He never received the recipes I sent. Other than that, I love it.

Have used for quite a while, with generally good results.  PRO: + Well-designed user interface. One can log meals, exercise, etc quickly and easily. + Love the way it keeps record of past meals, so I can easily log that same meal again. + Ditto for keeping past food records + Rapid customer support response to an odd issue (see below) + Excellent charts showing weight-loss progress (or lack of such!)  CON: - Annoying full-screen nagger to upgrade. (To be fair, how else can they make any money?) - Occasionally sends reminder notifications, even though they are turned off in the app. But got rapid response from customer support.

I had downloaded this app and loved it! BUT, I changed phones and had to reinstall it and suddenly to track my protein and carbs, I had to upgrade to premium. I kept the app anyways, just to keep track of calories. Didnt use it much, switched to a different one. Out of curiosity one day, I opened it to check if maybe they allowed carb and protein tracking again, and they not only didn't, they had raised the price! No thanks!

I've been using the app for a few days and I have to say it's much easier to use then sparkpeople. I've used weight watchers in the past but the point system makes it impossible to track nutrition. I'm vegan and understanding protein consumption on a daily/weekly basis is pretty important to me. The app makes adding prior meal easy as it sort of defaults to that. I exercise a fair bit and track it through Strava. That data is automatically pulled in which is a big time saver.

Waist down 2 inches in 28 days!!! I'm almost at a month of tracking with lose it (free version) and the app is very non judgemental and easy to use. I was shocked by how easy it is to scan food products in. You enter your height/ weight/activity level /goals, and it estimates your daily calories but you can adjust that any time. The app doesn't have distracting ads at all, and sends well timed alerts to remind you track your meals. I've recommended to many friends already. Thank you.

Just not what I was looking for. To be fair, I didn't give it enough time, but I found a couple of other apps for tracking keto specifically that impressed me more than this app. One thing in particular about this one was that it has a button or a gold key to unlock premium EVERYWHERE. It was just a little too cluttered with the focus of getting me to subscribe for me to put enough effort into trying the app. Sort of an "over selling" situation IMO.

This app helped me get back on track. I lost 40lbs 10 years ago but I was suddenly gaining and had added 15lbs. I couldn't seem to get and stay on track. This app really helped me see that I was overeating and that I needed to get my portion sizes back under control. Thank you! Down 7lbs and staying aware over the holidays!! The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is it doesn't sync with my smartwatch, it doesn't have a notes or journaling area, and the exercise list is a bit limiting.

Good app, but recent update reduced it's usability. At least they added back the scroll wheel for entering portion sizes, but it doesn't work as well (ex: if you flipped between grams and ounces it used to convert the initial quantity for you but doesn't now... Also, the wheel doesn't have the same inertia now, so it takes a long time to scroll down to "100g" for example)

I really liked this app, it has helped me lose 15 lbs thus far. However, lately the app has been constantly loading and or freezing anytime I try to look up a food in the app. Because of this, I have been having to leave the app to look up how many calories my food has online to manually create food. This has become super inconvenient and really slows down the process. I'd like the option to search foods again.

Used this app several years ago to track carbs and meals. Bought the upgraded version even. Extremely annoyed to return to it to discover that most of the useful features (configuring meals per day, carb tracking, etc.) that used to be free are now behind an annual subscription, and no way to just go back to the old version where these things were free. Massively overpriced for annual as well. Greedy. I'll be saying "nope".

Great app. I've been using it for years and it always keeps me on point. I have the Premium version. One request would be to include a reminder for drinking water. It only allows for logging water, but while reminders are optional for logging food, there isn't one for drinking water. I don't want to add another app just for that. Thanks, Lose It!

I apparently gave this app five stars back in 2015, but now I'm lowering it to a 1. This is a great app usability-wise, but now they have full-screen, loud, video ads. I know the idea is to use full screen ads to hopefully annoy users enough to get premium, and if not hey at least you earn extra money because the video ads pay better, but you're just going to push them away instead. MyFitnessPal integrates better with other apps anyway so this could be just the kick I need to make the jump.

Not worth a damn. This app used to be free. Came back several years ago then it had some options to pay for and one free option spammed with ads. Now come back a third time and there is no free option. Not interested. Gonna look into other apps. I could do this pen and paper for free I guess if they all cost charge monthly now. Who needs another annoying bill when you're just trying to do better for yourself? Lame.

I'd previously used this app to achieve both weight loss and maintenance goals with a fair experience in regards to tracking my weight changes, adjusting calories for a few years. The use of the app was convenient for scanning ingredients as I went through the day. However having recently come back to the app, I was disappointed to find the utility of scanning barcodes to have been locked behind the premium features, making the app as useful as a pen and paper. Better apps out there now.

Another otherwise good app ruined by forcing it onto the subscription. I bought the "Lifetime" version, and was happy with the purchase, right up until the account was locked. When going to support, I was basically just told to make another account and use the free stuff again. And now features that were free are slowly being locked behind the Premium wall again. I was happy to pay once. I'm not wasting more money on this bait and switch again.

I love this app and will keep it on the long term. I managed to lose 20% of my total body weight by being guided and motivated in a healthy way. Moreover it does not seem to be a one off event in my life, but somethin I can maintain without extra effort. I bought the subscription just out of curiosity, without being especially motivated, but then the whole thing turned out to be much more.

Takes a long time to record everything you eat esp.ly when your diet is not exactly mainstream (vegan for example) and you make a lot of home made stuff. But definitely recommend as keeps me on track. When I've reached my goal and switch to maintain, it gives a silly allowance that will ALWAYS make me put on weight again. This should be fixed.

I'm already paying, and still get bombarded by ads. If you use the free version, you'll be prompted to pay. That's fine, and normal. But if you pay for an annual membership, they seem to double down with a prompt to upgrade to lifetime every time you open the application. That's every meal, snack, etc. Which sort of makes you not want to use the appvfor the sole reason you pay for it. Good application, really annoying.

Lost 7 kg in two months. Yay! But now, after reaching my goal weight, it is not possible to set a new weight goal without going premium. Which is a shame, because I only used the app for logging weight, nothing else. I only logged calories two times the first two days, which gave me the picture of how much I am actually overeating. I don't want to pay 35 dollars just to be able to set a new weight goal. :(

Update: reported instacrash was fixed same day! On the plus side, the food database seems quite large. The UI could be improved but is not too bad. On the minus, constantly bugs me to upgrade to a paid subscription - with a pop up which I need to manually dismiss. I used to be able to restrict 'My foods' to 100. Now it seems to show every food I've ever logged.

I LOVE LOVE LOVE this app! I started with the free version & started transferring data from another app I'd been using. Half way through that process I had no doubt that I wanted to purchase the annual subscription & I haven't looked back since! I LOVE IT!!! Logging food, the analytics & the easy look & feel belies the power behind the info captured! And the barcode scanner to log food!!! OMG! I was running around my kitchen and the grocery store like a seasoned checkout chick! Brilliant!

I used this app for 2 years and now with all the ads I am ditching it. Seriously way too many ads, onto better food recording apps. I hear my fitness pal is much better though it doesn't work to sign up on my phone. Hope the tech gets back to me soon so I can "lose" this annoying ad ridden app! Responding to the technician, every time I go into the app I have to click no I don't want to go premium. It's so frustrating and I'm not going to pay money to record what I eat while people go hungry.

Negative:1) It keeps transforming kg into lb in a wrong way eg 55kg turns into 55lb without option to correct it. Then the calculations turn all wrong!2) Most features are available in premium Positive: 1) easy food tracking for calorie extimation 2) It has many foods in its database, it scans codes, it lets you to enrich its database by adding foods by scanning available for everyone. That is that you can find ( or add) locally available packaged goods! Amazing!

My experience with Lose It is a positive one. Easy to use app. If like me, it's a case of cutting portion size and increasing exercise, I wouldn't have been able to do it without being able to track it daily. The app can get abit addictive in terms of weighing out food and inserting food and drink into it but this spurred me on to keep going and so far I have lost 12 pounds! I don't think I would have been able to loose this weight without using this app so thankyou Lose It!

Just installed app. Was going to try it. First thing I saw was an attempt to authorize reoccurring payment for premium member ship after a free 7 day trial, a typical scam... But then the second thing was an ad for "50% discount off for 'water tracking', an exceptional scan, suggesting even premium doesn't unlock all the apps features and, intimately, they are trying to scam you. App exists with a singular goal, maximize profit and screw the customer. Done with it after 45 seconds of use.

I like this app, so I subscribed for a year to lose weight. However, I am giving 4 stars due to followings: 1. I am using Galaxy S21, and the notification (the "1" bubble) just doesn't disappear even though I checked everything in the Discovery tab. 2. I am doing intermittent fasting, and there's no history of how well you did this just like anything else like calories. There's just a timer, and that's it. 3. Why can't I see my friends log or any other info on how they are doing?

It is a useful app to track my calories. One suggestion is to create a neat database, a standard nutritional values for certain food/ produce. For instance brocolli!!!! There are lots of options for brocolli in the app (way too many), I am really not sure which one I should be logging. It makes me question about the accuracy, since I trust the information in the app.

I tried this app for quite a while and really stuck to the plan but I didn't lose any weight. Then I received a comment that basically I was falsifying my entries...that I was lying. Shortly after canceling the app. I looked into why I couldn't lose and found that there was salt in our well water making me retain water. Now that I addressed the problem my weight is going down and I'm not bloated. Bottom line, don't send negative messages to clients and don't assume you know everything.

I've been using it for one month and with the 50% sale I bought a year of premium because it's a fair price for an amazing app! I have two suggestions that would make the app better in my opinion: the option to remove the EXERCISE/HEALTH tabs from the log menu, and the option to resize the widgets that I can put on my phone's home screen and view quantities in grams, and in daily form like you can do in the app! Thanks and I hope you don't give in to greed someday and remain true to your users!

Not sure why they say it's free when it's pretty useless without premium (can't even track protein intake!) Having said that, I can't even log in, as there's NO option to log in with Apple. Nice "cross platform" app when it has you make an account on your iPhone and then be unable to use it on any other device. Guess I'm sticking with Cronometer.

- The nutritional values quick view is unaligned. This means you cannot fully see what nutrients intake you have. - upgrading trail to premium =lost all recorded data, "my food list" and costumized saved products. I had to start over! Only the saved recipe list were still intakt. - 3 weeks after upgrade, I'm stuck on "cooking an update" screen for 2,5 week, and they refuse to give me my money back bc I contacted after money return guarantee expired. Pro: food scanner ✅

The app works really well, but after 5 months I have stopped using it for one reason . There is a popup that appears pretty much every time I start the app asking me to buy it and offering 25 pc off.. Either make  a free app or don't, but this halfway house thing with popups is really annoying.  So buy it ,I hear you say. The reason I won't is because this app, like so many others, has adopted the greedy business model of wanting my money every month. Gone are the days where you can just pay once and own it and quite frankly the extras you get for the 'buy me every month' plan are of no interest to me.

I love this app. I have been using it for years and I recently purchased the premium version and like how it interacts with my fit bit. I lost all the weight I needed and I am now using it to maintain my weight. I log my food daily. I am really interested in the nutrient percentages/grams. It is more important for me to see my nutrient totals for the day than the calories. I am a female in my 60's and would really appreciate it if you would add the calcium amounts. Update, the app has been crashing for the last few months. If this did not happen I would have renewed my subscription. It used to be a great app but not any more.

This app works, I lost 20 kg (44 lbs) with it. But I do think the paid version is a simple rip off. It is marketed as ad-free, but it prominently advertises me features I don't want to use. The premium reports are subpar at best. There is no convenient way to e.g. get a report of the data I have inputed (weight, calories, food). Nutrient data is very flaky as it seems the food data is community sourced and does not always match the packaging. So, an awesome app, but don't pay for the premium!

Lost 17 kilo so far using this app to record my food. Works great! Great food database for my area and I love how you put in recipes, so useful. The whole app is Intuitive and useful. I hated the ads so I paid for the full version when it was on sale. I don't use much beyond the free stuff though but it's nice to have. edit: lost 26 kilo and have been maintaining for 6 months now. still use the app daily and still love it! being able to put units in without scrolling is awesome! thanks!

It is very unfortunate that a feature such as scanning your food has now become part of premium. I have used this app for almost a decade and heavily relied on the scanning and recipe features to quickly log in my meals. Now, with that gone, Lose It better stand out from other premium weight loss/ meal management apps. As for me, I might as well shop around. It's time to bid goodbye to Lose It unless we get the free features back.

It would be nice to be able to connect Samsung Heath to the app. The apps and wearbales that do connect in the app, I either can't afford or they don't work for me. I hope there are more and better themes in the future though, and it would be cool if we could make out own theme, like choose the colours we want and the pictures we want. So far this is the best app I've used to track calories, so thats pretty cool.

I lost 14kg in 9months, only 5 more to go. I got one year subscription. Huge food database, bar code scanner works most of the time, scans the dietary breakdown and adds it, tracks weight etc., adjustable weightloss plans, awesome statistics and overview of macronutrients etc., awesome challenges, food and exercise plans. It really has all you need to motivate you and keep track of your weightloss/gain. I will go for one more year subscription to help maintain my weight. TY!

Not a bad app, like other calorie countets I've used (my fitness pal and nutracheck (I'm in the UK)) you need to pay for premium services to get the best out of it. I was surprised about the amount if UK foods included I initially thought I'd need to add loads in as it's mainly aimed towards those in the US. My only niggle is that when you scan something, it doesn't always let you change from 'serving' to be able to input an actual weight, so you have to go back and search for it manually.

Love it! It's easy to fool yourself and forget what you have eaten. Having an easy to use log on my phone with me all day stops that. The bar code scanner is a real plus even if it occasionally gets it wrong. (Lol they are often realy funny!) The app remembers your food and even meals to help, so you don't need to keep entering the same details for frequently eaten foods.

I emailed support immediately after downloading and several times since and never got a response. VERY HARD to get a refund even when you contact within 48 hours- the app won't load or loads very slowly, it only shows I'm a premium member half the time, when I make a selection it only registers half the time, I've deleted the app and want a full refund. I shouldnt have to pay for something that doesnt work. There are several other apps that work better and more efficiently.

Picked this app over another popular one because of the attractive visuals and easy-to-navigate interface. I do not regret it! A week later I've become much more aware of how calorific different foods are and have actually lost 1kg just from making sure I'm under budget each day (same amount of exercise as before). I still have some of my favourite calorie-heavy foods but am more careful about the portion. It's really much simpler than I imagined. Thoroughly recommended!

I tried it yesterday and everything was perfect. But today all the units for measuring my weight appear as stones and pounds. Yesterday I had an option to switch to kilograms, but now this option is gone and I can't find how to change it anywhere. Am I missing something? I don't want to uninstall it just for this reason, everything else is great! I was even considering getting a premium.

This is a great app for setting a weight goal & monitoring your daily intake. The basic version works fine. Premium is nice but not really necessary unless you get serious about what you're monitoring. Showing nutritional breakdown (fats, carbs, protein) is really useful. Only problem so far is I've had to google a few serving sizes definitions for calories/kilojoules as some options for certain foods are only per serving, & therefore had to figure out what fraction of a serving I had to input.

Mostly great but a couple of suggestions: Biggest complaint is you can't choose to loose less than .5 lbs a week. I want a .25 or other lower options. It's worked well for me but I want to go slower now: the .5 calorie budget leaves me starving and I am in no rush to loose those last few pounds. Also, anyone can add public info, which I'm sure makes things easier on the app maker but isn't great because people add innacurrate info.

I have a Sumsung Galaxy S3. The app is useless for me. It won't let me sign up or log in (my internet connection is good), and it set my calorie goal to -200 calories and I can't change it (I tried setting it to 1000). In the limited experience I had using it, the portions were very confusing as there were no ammount in grams, just fractions. When you put it your weigh, it can only be a whole number.

Loved using this app before Christmas as it was a better version to use over the others (due to their restrictions), but when I logged on today after a break from exercising, I come to find out that most of the features I liked about this app are now locked behind a paywall; Scanning barcodes for one! Why?!! This should be accessible for people who are beginners; now it feels like you're no better than the other money grabbers. Disappointed is an understatement..will be uninstalling.

"Log In Future" no longer working. Meal planning was easy before, now it seems that all foods I enter in future days are no longer greyed out, they are shown as logged and calories counted even though it's one or two days in the future. I have to go in, tap on each food and turn future logging on. Please fix! I paid for a premium subscription and between this and the fact that text and info gets cut off if you don't make your system fonts extra small...two stars is pretty generous.

So far so good. I just started using it. I switched to this app from MyFitnessPal after being a loyal user for a long time. I hope this app doesn't disappoint me. One advice or suggestions to the developers, healthy is not always loosing weight. What if someone is counting calories to gain their weight!? It would be nice to have that option under weekly target.

I just installed this app and it automatically calculated my daily calorie intake and the expected goal date which was good. And then it said my account couldn't be created which was fine but after that it shows my daily calorie intake full when I didn't even enter any calorie. And if I add any meal, it says I have gone over my budget???? I really wanted to use this app.

I think this app is amazing, it tends to everything in my day to day life. It has made me more aware of what I'm actually eating and the calories in it. And I can track all the exercise that I do and I found in the exercise section that wii fit is there! Which I use so I didn't have to create it and there's a section where u can select the certain exercises that u did and how long for! I love it fully recommend!

I love this app, moved over to it last October when Myfitnesspal removed the free barcode scanner. I moved and paid for a yearly sub to Lose It (half the cost of mfp and the app is better overall so worth it if it's something you'll use everyday). My only gripe, is that since the new year, every other day a notification pops up when I open the app giving me an offer of a yearly subscription. I already pay and feel a bit bombarded now. It's annoying!

Edit: (Changed from 4 stars to 2) The new ads are very annoying. I'd be willing to pay a fee to go ad free. I tried to check the premium option, but the button didn't work. Get your act together. Original: Pretty good. The UI is a bit cluttered, and the constant nagging about upgrading is annoying, but the core calorie tracking is quite good.

Lose It! is awesome!! Why? Ease of use, ease of learning, great options such as my food, my meals, info well organized, ease of info editing, large database of food (even with no wifi), bar code system works very well, calculates calories as you add food, logs exercise, great visuals of calorie intake. I only wish that some of the food (very small %) with locked in 'serving' for size would alllow other measurements (cups, tbsp etc.). Super great app!!! I would definitly recommend!!

Excellent way to track calories out vs. calories in. Have most foods, most brand name items. I learned to check that the food item has the breakdown of carb/fat/protein included so the nutrients breakdown is correct. Also using the starred items is best for accuracy. When I can't find exactly what I want in the list, I choose something close and modify the portion, especially when the calories are lower for a homemade dish. This is a terrific app for me. 💜

This was amazing...until i started having issues with the barcode scanner. It used to work perfectly and now I scan yogurt and it tells me its a candy bar and all it wants to do is take a picture.. disappointing. I would've given 5 stars a week before the new update. I am also not able to scan through a restaurant's menu..i know there's more options at the bottom but the app won't let me scroll

Lose It! gave me the confidence to explore my eating habits as they are, with no need to hide anything. I’ve been using the free version for 2 months now and lost 15.4 lbs (7 kg). Tracking my calories and macronutrients empowers me to make healthier choices. Lose It! has significantly improved my nutritional literacy. This intuitive and informative app has changed my relationship to calorie tracking and exercise.

Great App. Lost 3 stone in a year with this. The improvements in the last couple of years have made it even better and now use it to maintain a steady weight. Would be great if you could record your weight up to 2 decimal places though. I'm fed up up recording 10st 10.75lbs and it reverting to 10.8lbs. If my aged scales can recognise 2 decimal places why can't this app?

Pretty good so far. I can search for or bar code scan my food items and it has found most of them. I can manually add any it doesn't find. It stores them in My Food list and it also provides lists of recent meals. I can add excercise (including gardening!) and adjust times/ calories. It gives graphs of my daily recorded weights and shows either Calories or Fat, Carbs and Protein summaries. All this for free. Premium adds more stuff but it's an annual subscription so you can't try it for less.

The food tracker is easy to use and allows for recipe creation, and foods that are recurring are easily accessible. I also found i had more hits using the bar code scanner with LoseIt than I did using the Fitbit app for tracking my food. Also prefer the dashboard on my Pc, as well as overall look and feel for both PC and mobile app. So far so good.

This is my 4th day using this app (free version). I have found it very helpful for motivation, easy to record calories, lots of foods in the database. One does need to check when changing quantities as the calories don't seem to automatically adjust, but that is fair enough. I would be tempted to try the premium version on a monthly basis but it seems like the only option was annual which I can't afford to commit to at the moment. Overall a very good app, more than just a calorie counter

We love the scanning of codebars which makes the input much faster. Very large datanase of american products. The display of results is not the clearest. Too many foods recorded only in cup and not weight, which lacks of accuracy. We track sodium as well, and it is missing in the app. The basic metabolism calculation does not take the BMI into account.

Nice, but could be made better... For example, the option to select regional product lines only; or that the app keeps track of what you've already used/scanned. Wasting a lot of time every meal having to re-type and locate what I've previously used. Also the possibility to use only products using the local measurement system etc. Annoying to finally find a product only to see that it doesn't have grams available as weight. These would be a great improvement to this expensive app.

Awesome app. Love it for Calorie counting and macro tracking. Sadly, like other users, I am currently experiencing some bugs re custom recipes, calories and serving size. No matter how many servings I give a recipe, it's still telling me that each serving contains the full calories of the whole recipe. I can get the right calories by logging a partial serving but it's not ideal. This happened before the last update but could be fixed by editing the recipe, but now it's stuck. Please fix!

Useful and pretty clear, unlike some other, but only applies to the free version. Only 2 stars because I bought the premium version and it's totally pointless. It doesn't sync with Garmin, when clicking on any article or recipe, it'll say that it needs internet connection, whether I'm on WiFi or 4G. If you want premium features, I'd recommend looking elsewhere

Let's start with the bad. I tried to log some foods I was having for a meal but upon scanning I was informed that the items couldn't be located, 4 out of the 5 it couldn't find. Not great when other competitive apps do the same easily. As for the good, other than the above the app is nice to use and also is easy on the eye. I was looking for an alternative to MFP as the last update of theirs was horrible in my opinion but unfortunately this won't be it.

Better than the competition. Having used MyFitnessPal for a long time, I saw this while browsing Reddit, I was blown away by how much faster it is. It's easier to navigate, less bloated, and adding items is so much easier! I do unfortunately own a Samsung phone and smart watch, so it gets one star less as it doesn't support as many fitness apps as MyFitnessPal.

Really good app. Especially if you're just looking for a calorie counter. Easy to use, seems pretty accurate, lets you set goals and reminders and log excercise! No annoying adds. You can put in your weight goal and excercise level, and it will tell you the recommended calories/per meal. And if you want premium (which lets you sync to SPECIFIC devices and apps...(not Huawei band btw), it's pretty cheap, 20ish/year. Adds water tracking, sleep, glucose levels, nutrient intake, etc. 10/10

I really like Lose it, it has a huge food database and displays macros. The exercise database is also of a good size. However, I would upgrade to premium only if the billing was changed from yearly at nearly $60 to monthly, I would like to be able to test whether it's something I would get sufficient use out of before comitting to an entire year payment. Other than that the free section is sufficient.

The pop up with the upgrade prompt is probably the most annoying feature i've ever seen in any app. Every day, multipls times a day, sometimes at different places in the app so you'll click it by accident. It's damn misleading and definitely made me uninstall it. If you want to charge thats more than fine, but your way of going about it is costing you customers.

It really helps with balancing the macro nutrients but you have to double check if you picked the option with accurate nutrition facts. some are extremely inaccurate; like chicken without protein. I can't find all the food so I often have to manually enter the nutrition facts. I find the excercises menu extremely limited and they don't even have the very standard machines you would find in a gym or even basic workouts.

This app ticks all the boxes for me for a weight tracking app (I've tried many). It has a decent barcode scanner and a reasonably well curated database, option to save meals and recipes, and a breakdown of macronutrients you consumed in the free subscription. It doesn't try to solve all the world's problems and do it poorly. That's impressively hard to find! I also like the UI, it's pretty, intuitive and uncluttered.

App helped me lose 100lbs. However, 3 stars because now it's a subscription service which I do not see a need to sign up for at all - so the constant pop ups are annoying and a turn off to use the app itself. I liked the layout and flow of the app and wanted to buy it because I've used it for several years and it helped me track my nutritional habits to lose weight, and I wanted to take advantage of their other tracking services within the app - but for a subscription? That's silly.

Really easy to use, does what it says and doesn't need to do anything more. The graph of weight loss/gain is really helpful, so are the (kind of hidden) daily and weekly budget screens. My only gripe is that I'm happy with the free version and wouldn't ever spend 24 pounds on an app, let alone every year. I'd be fine with a one time payment to get rid of the constant adds, or a lite version of the app that only has the free features.

Loseit is a great calorie tracking app. It has a very large database of foods, and gives good options to enter your own food such as taking a snapshot of the nutrition label on a product and converting that to an entry. My only beef with LoseIt is the cost. If it were possible to make a one-time payment to unlock premium instead of a continuing subscription, I'd probably do it. Then again, considering it costs $13 CAD to disable ads, the one-time price would probably be set too high anyway.

While the calorie and weight section register, the calories in the data base are often wrong. Must be since I'm often holding the same brand of the item and the calories it says half a cup is ends up being 10 more or 10 less than the can says.  On top of that, while I don't find the ads annoying, the two nag screens twice a day are more than annoying. If I wanted the premium plan I'd have upgraded by now.   This is considered a bad user experience by Google. Nobody needs nagged twice a day with two screens to upgrade to something they have no use for.  For that reason, it doesn't deserve many stars as far as I'm concerned. If it has ads in it, it shouldn't be nagging anyone that often.  Uninstalling and finding another.

Great app overall. I wish I could purchase a version with no ads instead of subscribing to the premium plan with features I don't necessarily want. The iOS version is also much cleaner, which is disappointing. Edit: New version adds more bloat to the screen to pressure getting a subscription. I reiterate that I would be happy to pay a one time fee to at least remove ads and the constant pestering. I'll likely change apps otherwise.

The app should provide a small trial period of premium features (a week/month) option for customers to see the premium features, so customers can make an informed decision. Besides, I got only one subscription option - annual. I purchased the app, the features were clearly not what I was looking for. I tried to cancel the subscription, but I am stuck with it for a year. What a waste. :-(

This app is pretty great, even in the basic (free) version. However, I've encountered a few problems recently: 1) the app kept crashing and scrolling down to the exercise section in Log, even though I tried to scroll up. I had to re-install the app 2) the several servings option doesn't work for recipes. I put in ingredients for an entire pot, which includes 5 servings, but it counts the calories from the entire pot as one serving, which is SUPER annoying...

Would not recommend in its current state. Every time the app is opened it displays an annoying 'Buy Premium upgrade' notice. It takes forever for it to find a scanned item in its database. For most of the things I've scanned, I had to input nutritional values myself since they weren't in the database. A lot of the products have wrong nutritional values displayed. Guess who corrects them? Me. And still I am prompted 5+ times a day to buy a premium. This app is a waste of time.

Requires paid Premium plan to connect to Fitbit. A real shame as I've been using it for 6+ months and had great results with weight loss, also, the interface is excellent and easy to use. However on getting a Fitbit to track exercise I discovered it isn't possible to sync without signing up to Premium. I won't pay just to get a feature which myfitnesspal offers for free, and for that reason have unfortunately stopped using and switched.

After 40 days of using it and HONESTLY putting in my calories I lost a bit more than 8kg. Lose It is all about consistency, which has always been a big problem to me. But it helped me build a healthy mind set, and the only mind set that will get you to your goal : there isn't good and bad food, you can eat everything and anything as long as you're tracking how much of it you're eating. The only thing that I see can be improved is making app available for people wanting to Gain It!

I've been using this app for years and was about to upgrade to Premium in the sale, but now I'm uninstalling and going with a competitor instead. The free version of the app has suddenly started running really invasive video ads every time I log a meal. Utterly slimy, predatory behaviour that that's completely put me off giving any money to the developer. Using the app is a chore. It's not like there's only 2 calorie counting apps out there any more; I'll happily pay for one that's better.

Thanks for a great app. Been using the free version since 2015 and each update made improvements.
