The biggest problem, even with this new update is that serving sizes cannot be manually manipulated; for example, the nutrition label says 1/3 can (53gr) is 70 calories. It does not allow me to enter 80 grams, it will only accept fractions. Also it no longer allows switching between metric & imperial measurements. And as other reviewers have said, the food search says 1 serving but no weight or count. I'd love to say that a jar of Nutella is one serving but alas it is not so.

love this app, the bar code scanner is fabulous and really quick to recognise items. It's quick and easy to count your calories one the go and I love the fact that it stores meals that you've previously had so with one click you can add the same again, and you can save your own recipes. Brilliant would recommend to anyone trying to lose weight or just maintain weight.

I tried loseit because I find the MFP interface to be lacking. However, I wasn't able to create a recipe using bar code scanning. It wouldn't save the items unless I searched. I want to scan and be done with it. The site version is worse than mfp, in looks and function. I really wanted to like this and was willing to pay for premium but it just isn't worth it.

The only thing which has worked for me. Keeping track of my food intake makes me more conscious of what I am eating & helps me stick to my diet. The free version does virtually everything I need, but I would like to be able to review/edit/delete recipes - can't always remember the quantities I input. As it stands you can't even delete & start again. Hence it loses a star.

I've been using the app for over 40 days, sticking to the calorie counting and logging all meals as accurately as possible, and I've lost over 8 lbs. No BS: if you follow your plan, stick to your daily /weekly budget, and are tracking your calories in and out, it should work for you. Most foods out there can be found in the database, and the barcode scanner works well. I'm a cyclist, losing a few pounds for the season to climb faster, and this app has helped a great deal. Thanks!

Getting more frustrating by the day. Constantly missing foods and incorrect calorie values. I was spending so much time editing foods (and now, it doesn't even seem possible to save edits anymore). Also, so many foods are not available in terms of weight. If you're not weighing your food, you're not going to be successful. What good to me are units like "serving", "each", or irregularly sized/shaped things measured in cups!? I've had it with this app.

Great app for tracking calories. Almost all foods can be located already entered. Great methodology for adding your own recipes to get a meals calorie count. Many great options for tracking weight, water intake, blood pressure, and more. Only downfall is when you enter exercise, the app increases your allowable calories for the day but doesn't allocate an increase in the allowable protein, fiber, and saturated fats. So, every day, I'm over the set amounts.

Great tool for tracking food, but I've been using it for over two weeks now and every time I finish logging for the day it tells me that when I've tracked for seven days straight it will have enough data to review my goal (or similar). So what's going on there? Revision re above: I realised that I have not "finished logging" every day. So I went back and did that and the prediction is working now. :)

Years after my first one star review, this app has come a long way. Using the app enabled me to set goals like : - the number of calories I should eat daily - the minimum number of protein I should eat to not lose muscle while dieting. Also, tracking nutrients as enabled me to correct what I felt was an effective diet when it really was not. With a lot of trial and error over 3 years, I have lost 13 kg and I am e losing 1 kg every two weeks. The bar code does not work again thought.

I've come back to Lose it premium after a few years. I love the GUI, lack of ads, the patterns it identifies with my food. The only complaint is that I cannot exclude activity tracker calories. I like being able.to track my activity with my Fitbit, but like any other activity/exercise, I'd like to be able to exclude those extra calories and just stick with my goal.

I love this app, I have bought the premium membership. Its helped keep me on track, its easy to navigate and the library of foods I think is very good. It would be great if you could add the option of using samsung health in the connected devices, I have a Samsung watch and it would really help if this was an option as I wear my watch all time and use it for my fitness.

On day 816 & have lost what I NEEDED to (months ago) but continue to monitor my weight so I stay on track. The best feature of this app is being able to enter personal recipes/foods and figure out how much of those favorites is a reasonable portion. I have never denied myself any treat or family favourite: just how much I consume. I did have a small problem with my data but that wasn't a big deal because support was excellent. Nothing was wrong- just needed them to guide me-prompt response too!

The app had been working fine for me for the last few months I've used it, but lately i'm having issues such as logging back in and losing all my progress such as food logging/tracking, weight loss progress and other important things, which was from Dec. 2020 to just now as of July 13, 2021. The app also keeps crashing now whenever I log meals. It really sucks to see all my progress just gone like that. But, luckly I was able to store the rest on Google Fit. I Hope to see this issue be resolved.

Easy, reliable and effortless to use. App facilitated my loss of 20 kg. Genuinely greatful for the help it offered. Easy to use, reliable database (with a little bit of your own checking), not invasive and makes the effort of logging minimal. None of the essential uses - logging food and tracking weight - are behind a paywall. Have recommended it to others.

Made the mistake of not trying the free trial before signing up for premium. Useless if you're in Europe. Barcode scanning doesn't recognize any products so I have to type it all in, including macros. Really regret wasting my money on this one. EDIT: Changing rating as the app seems to recognize products now and the initial fail could have been a glitch.

Great app. Very easy to record what I eat, my weight progress and my exercise. I've lost two and a half stone with the use of it. I recommend it. Only possible downside that can easily be resolved is sometimes it gives quite varied options for how many calories is in food. It can vary from 10calories from something to 50 calories for the same thing. The first time I eat something new I have to look online for the correct calories but from then on I know which option it is.

Just the job for counting what you eat. Database of fod is pretty extensive and the barcode scanner saves loads of time. Easy to add your own foods and to save regularly eaten meals/recipes too. Linked to my Garmin account and the calories used information from that is used to adjust available total for the day. All in all a great app - good enough I paid to get rid of the adds!

I've used both myfitnesspal and Lost it, and prefer Lost it. I like that there aren't as many options per food type and instead a greater range of foods. Also it was able to pick up items via barcode that I thought there was no way it would, and it even knew the correct portion size!! It makes logging food SO much easier :D it also has an "auto real label" function for foods not in it's database (which is rare, so far only hasn't been able to pick up two barcodes and they were off brand items).

I am only using the free version but even the free version has met my needs. I find my calorie budget easy to keep and I don't feel hungry at the end of the day. I just found a feature that will making tracking even better where you can load your recipes and it can help you work out your calories for your home cooked meals. I really recommend this app to anyone who wants to change their eating habits. I've lost 1 kg since I started 2 weeks ago (chose no exercise and loose slowly)

The app has an expansive food database and easy input methods with the bar code reader. Connecting to fitbit was unfortunately not available on the free version but the first year offer of 50% off on premium was not too high price to pay for my future healt and well being. Setting everything to my liking was a bit of fiddly work so if you are not technology orientated or have a short temper, ask help and prepare for at least 30min set up proses.

Amazing! I can't believe this app is free. It's so good. You're able to log your meals and you're appointed a certain amount of calories per meal. They allow for snacks too! You can log exercise and it also give you tips and tricks. I love it! Managed to lose 4lbs in my first week. I was stunned! Definitely recommend this fantastic app!

Best calorie counter hands down, I've used a pen and paper in the past to help track my caloric intake but with lose its database and barcode scanner it was an absolute snap, I lost 8lb in 4 weeks limiting my intake of calories and didn't pay a dime. I'm going to pay for premium because I intend to use the app long term to lose another couple pounds and to help me maintain it. This app won't make you lose the weight thats up to you but it's the best tool to help you achieve your goals.

I was looking for a less prohibitively expensive app to replace weight watchers and I found this. In my opinion, this is better in every way. I particularly like the ability to create (or copy) a recipe and immediately get the calorie value per serving. I had a minor issue and emailed the team, they stuck with me for the best part of a week until the problem was resolved. Big thanks to Savannah!

Free user - Helpful app for losing weight. Could use some polish, Eg when sharing a recipe with friends, whilst accepting it tends to time out / crash. Never had the auto fill nutrition feature work, would help if it had flash/torch. Barcode scanner has been good. No way to duplicate a recipe, and then change part of it, eg different amount or type of chicken. Only other issues are users entering trash nutrition information, but thats not the developers fault is it :P

'Lose It' wasn't the first meal/calorie tracker app that I've tried but it has been the one that I've been most successful with. As with anything, the app is what you make of it & will be beneficial to those who consistently & honestly track what that they are eating. The app is to point and very user-friendly. For Premium User there seems to be many more features to help with meal ideas & for tracking macros. I should probably upgrade now just to show my support. Here's to the new you!

This is an excellent app to track your calories, macros and workouts. I have lost weight before without tracking, with manual tracking and with app tracking. Apps take manual calorie counting out of the way. Love that it breaks down macros to inform me how much protein I am eating each day from each of the foods. Just be cautious of calories listed on foods can be inaccurate so you'll need to so some research. For $2/day (on discount), worth paying for but free version is more than enough!

Way better than other food tracking apps I have used. The food item selection is great and the layout is user friendly. You can look at various breakdowns of all your micros and macros each day (I like it enough to pay for the upgrade). I think my favorite feature is that if you happen to miss a day, it will let you go back and fill it in, rather than completely scrapping your streak and throwing off your motivation to keep going.

Wonderful free app to lose wait. You can access the platform on your cell and online on a computer, you can find food in the database, create them or scan them (love that feature) making the logging of food seems like a breeze. Another great feature is the estimated time before you reach your goal (you can set up the goal you want). The app is surprisingly accurate when it comes to the weight per week you wish to lose. I strongly recommend.

I got this just because I'm fat and wanted to lose weight. For me, just adding food into it made me more aware and educated about how much food i should eat. I ended up getting a year sub because i want to track macros. I wish i could "add a recipe" because home made food i end up adding usually as the ingredient elements and things like pizzas wouod be cool if you could select the recipe, alter it a bit and it would also be able to track the macros more accurately.

I've had a lot of success with this app for calorie counting. Emphasizing recently used foods simplifies logging. One minor annoyance is that custom recipes/foods do not allow specifying *both* a total weight for the recipe AND number of servings. The verified foods are specified multiple ways (volume/weight/count) so this is just something they don't allow users to do.

Latest update ruined everything I liked about the app. Arbitrary categories Grocery Store and Restaurant are horrible. Essentially, fresh produce can't be entered, and no local brands make the list. One can read bar codes, but most produce has none. I am actively looking for another app, after years of loving this one. Whoever came up with the changes must be working for someone else.

Perfect for my needs and approach to a healthy lifestyle. Calorie counting and tracking is made easy after getting to know this app and what it offers. Set a target and get on with losing that unwanted weight in a stress free way. It's like keeping an eye on your cash flow balance; calories consumed and left, which is helping me to make informed choices.

I have been using it for more than a year now and recently updated to premium. The free version is really neat and works just fine, but I think the premium comes at a very reasonable price and has some added cool features; I especially like the weekly emails with my food intake and calories as they are a great help when I want to save, organize and see my data. All in all, although it might take a while to get used to at first the app is simple and very user friendly, works great.

Can I please get my money back? The calorie counting is a basic feature of many apps & we paid a year subscription thinking it will give extra features. But now we repent it. It is useless to pay for basic calorie counting. We ended up eating more with app than usual as we're always under calorie threshold? Me & my spouse are extremely dissatisfied with this app. We kept it on phone so it reminds us not to do the same mistake again. 80% time a recipe has 1000 different calorie variations.

Great app, and has helped me lose 40+ lbs so far, and their customer service is super friendly to boot! They were really nice and helped me get my measurements even though my premium had run out. The app is awesome and straight forward but also covers all the bases as well, and out of all the fitness apps I've used (Fitbit, myfitnesspal, lifesum, etc) this one is the easiest to use and my personal favourite.

4 years motivated. I have been using this app for a minimum of 4 years, currently at 367 days consecutive for tracking. It keeps me accountable it has many food options and has the ability to create your own recipes of your favourite food so that you don't have to be searching multiple ingredients all the time. I love that syncs with my MapMyRun. I have been maintaining my weight in my BMI index. If you want to be accountable and you want to either maintain or lose weight this is it!!!!

I found it really easy to use, wanted to lose 1lb a week which is exactly what I've achieved, losing 10lb so far in time for my holiday. I would recommend this for short or long term use. I'm not one for healthy eating so this is great for just making sure I'm that bit more careful about snacking and I've upped my exercise to make me work that bit harder for it. love this app, would highly recommend.

I have the premium version but haven't been logging recently. I find putting the recipes in very tedious. We cook pretty much from scratch and therefore cataloging ingredients with weights etc is really tedious. So I stopped updating. I also find measuring units a pain, serving, fluid ounces, grams etc. It varies according to recipe or food. It's a hood app but my laziness will stop me using it. 😂

Would have been 5 stars if it weren't for the recent push to force more ads, and more intrusive ads on the user. Now, full screen ad after logging a meal?? A few small banner ads here and there are OK, but beyond that, it affects the user experience negatively. I left myfitnespal for this very reason. It might be time to start looking for another fitness tracker again....

Overall, it's a good app. However, most apps let you put your meals in the next day with the free version. In this one, you have to pay. Also, some ingredients have only one option of unit, and you need to click on it to see it. Would be great to have a converter in the app so we can put the amount in the unit we used and it would convert it automatically. Also, not so good for your own recipes. You don't have much options on serving sizes.

Great app. No doubt about is. It was recommended by a friend. However, the free version doesn't allow you to track your physical activity, sleep, water and coffee intake. My current need involves the tracking of all the above-mentioned. If you just want to track your kj intake, this is just about perfect.

my favourite app! it's simple and easy to use and has literally everything i need. it lets me set my own calorie goal, barcode scanner works pretty well and when it doesn't have my food it.lets me create my own, nutrition and everything! you dont really meed to buy any premium options to enjoy the app, though premium offers more extensive nutritional details. i don't recommend it to anyone who has food issues though.

Great app, I have premium which I mostly use for macronutrient goals + meal planning for the week. The app would be much improved if there was a way to view all of your notes in one place, as opposed to having to look back through every day It would also be really useful if they had an 'adjust recipe' option; so if you're making a recipe you've created for one of your meals but want to adjust how much of a specific ingredient you had.

They offer a free trial but you have to apply your card to move forward and use it. However, after placing all my details hoping to at least try the app it is not working and you cannot fully "enjoy" and use the app since you are on trial period. I then uninstalled it the next 2-3 days. They have not notified me that my trial is up since i completely forgot about it and they automatically charged me for an app so useless!! I am requesting for a refund but it has been more than 10 days and NO fee

This app is decently complete, yet individual features need redo, more polishing and inline help. I dont like the fact they do not count calories for your base activity, if i start my day with a long 10km walk, they see the steps but dont account for the calories right, also the holistic daily budget is not to my taste, i would prefered to have a fixed food budget, then see all my exercise accounted to a grand total. Good enough thou.

I would like to cancel my subscription from now, not after a full year - this isnt a gym, it's an app. I very rarely subscribe to anything but I feel sucked in and have learnt my lesson - I must've missed 'full yr' in the fine print. I would like to cancel because I find it really demotivating if I have a 'bad day' and it pushes the estimated date when I'll achieve my goal way way out. It doesn't seem to average progress it just assumes that you're going to eat like that forever.

Easy to use and provides the right information. Great that it can find local dishes in searching for what I ate. I also like the electronic encouragement when I complete logging food over several days. The exercise portion can be improved a lot if it can measure caloric burn according to the number of steps I take during sports or physical activities. Have not tried connecting it to a pedometer but will try it out soon. Overall, it's an outstanding app people should subscribe to.

Most most comprehensive food database of any app I've tested. Only issue is duplicates with different values. Items like cereal that have both weight and volume and their nutritional facts sometimes only have one or the other. Miss you have a hundred grams of cereal for example you may have to go back and stick it in a measuring cup or vice versa. app is more than adequately functionable without having to pay for premium services which are fairly reasonably priced for what they offer.

I love the idea of this app and it's cute how they measure how much weight you've lost but I've recently discovered that some of its calculations are way off. They sometimes rely on users to fill in the calorie/nutrition of the food but I imagine, like me, most people don't know how, hence needing the app, so you have people adding in the KJ instead of calories. My last straw today was seeing Mountain Dew at 21 calories for 600 ml. I don't think I'll be renewing my subscription.

I'm disappointed. I subscribed to premium assuming full connecitivy with Garmin. Just 3 days after I learned that the app can only receive data, it does not send Calories intake to Garmin connect, which is a key functionality for me. Now I'm stuck with a 1-year subscription with no possibility of refund according to the terms. It's a pity because the food logging functionalities are great. I hope the team can find a satisfactory solution.

I really like this app. I found myfitnesspal way too complicated. the scanning feature is so helpful and the membership is really worth it, but I would recommend buying the membership only when they do an offer. HOWEVER, it is unfortunate there are only a few compatible fitness devices. In the next update, they should consider adding more, such as the Huaewei bands.

Decided to upgrade to premium. It charged my credit card but didn't actually make my account premium. It gives me some pop message saying it's being processed and to try again in a couple mins. I've tried several times to exit the app, did an app update, ect nothing is working. I expect an app like this or any other to have the capability to automatically upgrade/unlock the premium features instantly when you pay, what exactly are you processing? Fix this now!

My wife and I wanted a new app to track calories together. This app is very nice to use, ticks all the boxes and makes calorie counting a breeze. We liked it so much we both bought premium immediately. I had a slight technical issue with my app so I reported the problem. I had a response within an hour and they rolled out an update to fix my issue within 48 hours. Outstanding support.

Amazing app for, well, everything. Tracking calories, exercises customizing meal plans, that is if you have a premium account. Nonetheless, if you have a free account you can still track calories and gain insight! Which is why I took this apo, so no scam here. Easy to set up an account, amazing overall. Well done.

This app is amazing! I've never counted calories before. It has opened my eyes to what is worth eating. For example a small dip with pizza had almost the same amount of calories as two slices of pizza!!! Wow! It's easy to use and has SO MANY items. The barcode scanner is cool too. You can easily adjust the serving amount if needed. I was able to plan a movie night out with popcorn and a glass of wine without feeling guilty. Love this app!

If you eat the calories the app recommends you lose exactly the weight it says you will. At 48 I managed to shift 10 kilos that had been hanging around since I gave birth! I feel and look like a 30 year old again! Very user friendly. Note, I prefer creating my own food logs than using ready made ones from other users as I find the calories they have recorded are often inaccurate. Once you have created the log of foods you regularly eat and their calories they are stored forever and easy to use.

So amazing at finding common restaurants to add food and easily shows calories and lets you put quantity of each food. Very user friendly. I love that it lets you enter daily calorie limit so you can easily tell when you are getting close to your limit in real time. Best calorie tracker app I've ever used and helped me lose a few lbs already 😀

Love the quick and easy barcode scanning. The app logs previous meals and favorite foods so you can quickly add them while on the go! I can even gain daily calories to use on a cheat day by logging exercise as simple as vacuuming my house or walking my dog 😋The cute reminder to log food is helpful and foods from Canadian grocery stores (even Costco) are easy to find. It's never been easier to lose or maintain your desired weight! 👍👍

All in all a good alternative to my fitness Pal. It's a bit more janky and misses or missnamed entries for foods but the majority are there and the scanning is pretty slick. The main issue is the little constant "subscribe" nag and more recently really obnoxious full screen video adverts after you enter any items. It's annoying enough I've started to look elsewhere. I've no use for the subscription and no one time purchase to avoid ads so that's the only option sadly.

It is good app. But there are a lot of wrong info in products list. For example i found "baked/boiled tuna steak" with over 500 kcal in 100 g😅 There are also unrealistic numbers in some sorts of breads: a SLICE! of bread with 400 calories? Wow!😁(it has to be 100 g, a slice is about 20-30g). What I am trying to say is... May be you should add some way to propose fixes, to existing products, that other people already added. Cause it may mislead those, who never counted calories by themselves

Best Calorie Counter so far. I've tried a variety of them and the basic features make it more than useful on its own and the premium option is significantly cheaper than many competitors that quite frankly take the piss. Yes I'm looking at you MyFitnessPal. App offers a wealth of data on a variety of metrics, and premium enables me to sync up my garmin to add exercise data as well as sleep, weight, body fat% and steps data with ease.

I had been using SparkPeople for years, but they have just decided to abandon their offering, so I was looking for something else. I should have found Lose It earlier. It is a much better offering if you are just interested in counting calories and other nutritional elements. Their searches is extremely intuitive and they have an enormous Library of products. As a Canadian, I am very pleased that they have almost all foods available with grams rating. Highly recommended.

Wonderful app. Love it. It has all the necessary tools I need to keep track of my weight-loss. Love the scan barcode and share with others options (tried many apps but none has food from my country). I recommend this to everyone. I have learned so much from it. On the minus side, it cannot differentiate between good sugar (coming from fruits, vegetables and legumes) and bad sugar, in order to keep track of the bad sugar intake. It would be perfect if this function can be added too.

Great app to track your food intake & progress on your weight lost. It has recipe, the subscription worth taking and does cost that much, track work out or you can record it yourself, does have exercise too you can follow. You can have support via other user by joining a group or take a challenge. I'm using it every day few times a day. Great way to keep control of your calories intake, carb, ... check it out for yourself.

I would like to see and exact time of my meal. It would be helpful since I'm doing intermittent fasting. Also I would like to be able to let my friends see my log so they know what is my diet like. Water logging is set to 250ml I would like to customize the cup size. You can't change the resapie icon. I think my fitness pal is more technical and detailed.

I've been using the free version of the app for several days. The information you can input is enough to get you started on a weight loss program. Also, it's user-friendly, and you can input food items or update information that's already in the list.aside from food, you can add workout from an extensive list.

Why has it started to show a Chinese ad, with no way to stop it! Great app, but the one problem, when selecting a food it comes up with dozens of options, the database could do with a good cleansing to reduce number duplicate items. Also it you be nice if a picture of item could be added and also a description field to allow you to extend description. How big is a portion and if an item quote a portion, but there no details if that a portion is? Look at number of iPhone items that are edible!!

I think this app will do what I want but I'm not finding it user friendly - maybe it's just me but I'm struggling to find where I change weight from pounds to kgs and walking from miles to kms. I also want to link my step tracker but can't find where I add this. There are only a few set up to choose from and I don't use these ones. Sort these few issues and it will be near perfect.

Just the best app to stay healthy, have been using it to record my weight daily, setting a goal of how much I want to lose and has been really helpful. At the same time since you can add the nutrient facts of everything you eat, it helps you to keep a balance between the amount of calories and the micronutrients you consume (proteins, fats and carbs). (Have been using the app for about 5 months now)

I really don't like that inputting food for future days is a premium feature it's not really a feature at all. I like to plan certain meals days in advance around expiry dates it helps me stop wasting food more than anything weight related, I'm not ready to commit to premium yet but it's a deal breaker for me to even use the app tbh so you're never going to entice me as a paying customer.

All good things come to an end at some point and for me it feels like it has, I've tried a year premium after a year or two without ( thought why not, seemed OK) But honestly didn't see much point in another year. If it was a one off thing yeah but not a yearly sub. I use it lightly as a calorie tracker and to log my fitness via garmin. premium has ran out I can no longer log via garmin fitness. And now there's adverts to contend with. So long and thanks for the useful info

Phenominal weight loss of 18Lbs in the past 3 months which I was unable to achieve on my own. I managed to break bad habits, reduce portion sizes and feel satisfied at mealtimes. I signed up for lifetime premium membership by choice as the app has a far better food database with far more options than any app I'd used before. The bar code scanner and Snap It meal pics to help calorie counting are invaluable. If you use it, you Lose It. It's that simple.

My biggest beef with this app is the sheer number of foods that do not contain any details on how much a serving size contains. Is one serving 50g? Is it 200g? It's impossible to accurately track your consumption without knowing these important details. It's not enough to list "one serving" as an amount without identifying the volumetric weight of that serving. Great range of foods available and a great ability to create your own meal, but largely useless without understanding serving size.

Incredible! It helps you keep to your goals. Can track calories efficiently and makes you feel like your making progress! Its so easy to use and you dont need to even get the paid version. The paid version is much more for fitness gurus and the ads dont even get in the way! This Is the app to help to you weight!

I installed the app to check out the advertised "Snap It" function that tells you the amount of calories in food by photo. This function does not seem to work at all, it recognizes a beer can as a doughnut, not to speak about regular food on a plate. Scanning bar code of that can also produced nothing (it suggests you to add stuff manually). Ridiculous. I guess it may have worked for some food authors tested it with, but in general the app turned out to be pretty much useless for me.

What a great app! I have used it for just one day and it has blown all the other calorie tracker apps I've used out of the water. Now since it's been only one day, I'm not sure whether the features will stay or will they be put behind a paywall, but even if they were, the app is so great that I would buy the premium version without second thought. Great app again, and kudos to the devs!

It's easy to use compared to other apps, plus the free features are decent, but if you are really into your diet you can buy the premium which also has some pretty cool features. I recommend this app to anyone who is on a keto diet so they can manage their macronutrients and you candy find how many grams of carbs you have eaten, so in summary, it's a pretty good app

It's a great app. You can see your estimated calories, how many is left to consume, and also if what you consumed for the day consists of carb, protein or fat. You can also search bar codes of food. Of course, so much more could be done with the premium but the free features are also great.

Good interface but some inaccurate nutritional info. I prefer the look & use of this app to others but the inaccurate info is putting me off - it's frustrating to know its wrong and have to go find the item to scan, can see that some details are wrong even when an item is scanned, or to know its not correct and not have an item to scan so can't check it. It's probably fine if you're using it as just a guideline but I couldn't rely on this for exact numbers.

chaotic list of foods, seemingly similar but with completely different calories. many entries without macros, which are useless if you want to track your protein or fat intake. the option to take a photo and have the food automatically recognised is in beta since forever and cannot really identify an egg or an orange - while Google images can identify very complex dishes since years! The product team spend their time doing changes with no impact all the time, essentially the product gets worse.

The app's functionality is great, but there's some weird business practices I don't get. Like for example: On a previous version of the app, it would display your Macros on the Dashboard in grams by default, but for some reason now it's paywalled? What a weird thing to paywall, especially on Android where I can just...install an older version of the app.

Great app to track food and weight. Been using it for 6 months now, lost 11+kg. Really helpful to know how many calories still to go in the day. Lots of custom recipes from around the world, almost all barcodes work. You can create your own recipes if you've made something different. Haven't tried any paid features, but that's not needed.

I like the user friendly interface. However, there are two things I'd want in such an app if I'm paying for it. 1. Break up of micronutrients along with macronutrients 2. Mapping of nutrients consumed against the goal Similar apps like My Fitness Pal have this feature (that too for free). If this app is not upgraded, I will switch to My Fitness Pal during the payment renewal cycle.

I used to love this app and lost a lot of weight but since I've changed my watch from a Fitbit to a Garmin LoseIt doesn't recognise a lot of my exercise anymore. It used to extend my calorie budget really well as I could fuel properly for my workouts. Now I do the same exercise but I always go well over my calorie budget as I don't get the calories added back. Real shame as it worked so well before.

I've reduced from four stars to three following April 2019 update. The "finished logging" messages have been changed from a pleasant pat on the back to the kind of shouty shouty stuff that REALLY ANNOYS ME and puts me off going to gyms. Otherwise I'm still finding this app very useful and easy to use in its free form, avoiding the complexity of the advert-free version.

I find that this app really helps a lot, i have lost 25 pounds in the last two months, i have gone on ten minute walks which does help you lose your weight faster. You do have to pay for certain things when you go on but I don't do any of the other things, i just limit what i eat and i eat heathy, overall id recommend this app to anyone that wants to lose weight.

Could do better but it's the best available. Its the best tracker I have found but the ux could be improved massively. There is just too many steps to add food (potentially 6-7 actions to add food) which isn't great if you just want a quick snack. But that's my only complaint so far Just some small tweaks to improve the experience (I've only given one star so the Devs will see this I'll notch it up once the ux is improved)

Downloaded this app after using MyFitnessPal for years and learning they were putting the barcode feature behind their subscription which is ridiculously expensive. I was surprised to find out that Loseit is not only resort to use but they have way better tracking, and the barcode scanner works great. It is a much better app overall and even if you want the plan, it's priced to be affordable.

I really liked the app, but I wanted to connect it to my fitbit and it requires a premium subscription to do that. I don't mind paying for an app, but I hate the ongoing monthly payment. When there are other free apps that will track my calories the same way and connect to my fitbit absolutely free, I just can't justify it. Uninstalling, back to My Fitness Pal for free calorie tracking and fitbit sync. Sorry guys, you lost me.

Using on free version and finding it very helpful, easy to add foods and Excercise. Lost 3kg so far, really does help consider what parts of each meal really drive the calories and slow weight loss. Only issue I have found is many foods don't have protein, carbohydrates and fat breakdown so when added to your meals the pie chart for nutrition can only track items with these stats, as I'm on low calories but trying to keep protein % up to avoid muscle loss this is always understated, good app..

A really good app for tracking calories consumption, but can't be synced with any of the workout apps I have. For some reason worked better for me when I was using iPhone (I have an Android now). Not many commercials which I love, asks for payed upgrade for water consumption and sleep which i dislike. But all in all - a useful tool to have.

Very good for tracking weight, exercise and calories. Wide variety of different activities and foods. My issue is that the big app it connects with is google fit and doesnt allow for apps such as samsung health which I rely on. Also the step counter is way off for me. When Samsung has clocked in 5000 steps, lose it is at like 7500. I wanna make sure everything is so accurate as possible. Otherwise great app

I am super impressed with this app! I've purchased the premium package and so far have no regrets. It's easy to use and has just about every tool in order to make better choices for my health and goals. I would like to see more exercise options for logging. There is a HIIT option, however controling calorie defecit will be more accurate if I could enter specific exercises.

This app is fabulous! I have used it for previous diets and now currently am using it for weight loss, heart health and nutrition and it is the best!! Premium version makes those things easy (and is necessary to track those metrics). Now I have everything I need to stay on track for life ❤️ love it!! Oh!!! I do wish the cards within the "Goals" screen were customisable (in terms of order).

Using this app (free version) for about 3 month's and found it really good . Until now , it crashes when I try to log my meals but everything else in the app seems to work fine. I'm hoping it's a bug that can be fixed with an update . As it's one of the better apps for calorie recording I've used. Would recommend it if this problem is fixed..... After writing this and updating app ..problem seems rectified

Keeps me very accountable. I usually don't write reviews but this app is definitely worth it. If you're looking for an easy way to keep track of calories, exercise, water intake, your weight, or even looking for a community, this app is for you. Loved it so much, I upgraded from the free program. Even if you stick to the free one, so much more worth it then ones like weight watchers that charge you so much. Love this

Simple interface, large database of foods and ease of use are my top most important things when using a calorie counting app, this one has all of that! The free version is more than enough for your calorie counting needs, I have enjoyed it a lot so I decided to pay the premium version and I am very happy with it. This became my favorite calorie counting app!

Great for Weight loss! I purchased the premium version of this app after struggling for years to lose weight. Its so easy to use, interface is friendly. I've managed to lose 8lb in 4 weeks. The only negative I can give is some of the calorie facts are wrong when you search for food, so double check packaging! Would encourage anybody trying to lose weight to purchase this app.

Rating 1 star because I've paid for premium and my account is not allowing me to login. Few days ago it just logged me out (on it's own) and won't allow me to log back in. When I try to "rest" my password it says, there's no recollection of my email. But when I try to make a new account it says my email already exists. I went on the website looking for a contact number or email and couldn't find anything so I'm hoping someone can fix my account before I get rid of it complete.

Started using this app when another popular calorie tracking app kept acting up. I won't be going back because I love this one! Much easier to convert serving sizes here. I love that I can select to track but not include my workout calories against my total for the day. I love the recipe feature and I find the search so easy to use. I also love that I can transfer a whole meal to my next day easily. Overall a very intuitive app.

I was uncertain that this app would help me lose weight but I gave it a try. I wasn't disappointed. It has helped me so much. By tracking the calories I eat and inputting the exercise I do I have lost almost two stones to date. It's easy to use and the bar code scanner is a big help to identify your foods too. Give this app a try, it really does work

I've been using this app for a while now and I've found it really good. I like the look and layout of it and the data given is informative. The free version does the job but paid for version is quality. Currently contemplating the lifetime membership. My main criticism would be that fruit sugars and processed sugars are lumped into one. Which can be fine but if I have a few pieces of fruit then I'm usually way over my RDA. I have other tweaks I would like to see but that's me being extra.

I just use the basic version and it really suits for daily logging of calories. It has a pretty comprehensive list of specific foods and sellers so makes it nice and simple. Logging is fast with little hassle. I may even be tempted with a purchase for a year so I can log everything and really see how effective the whole app is.

This app is fantastic!!!! I can track my calories but also track other key indicators like fiber and sugar. It helps me understand how to eat healthier. I can plan out calories for the day so I know what I can eat later. Adding in exercises and impact on calories is really helpful. I have lost 10 punds!

I can't even describe how glad I am that I decided to download this app, it's changing my life and my eating habits to the better everyday! I tried so many diets before and nothing worked especially because of my binge eating habits, but finally I found something that works! also I love that you don't have to be a premium member to access enough for your diet unlike some apps. would definitely recommend.

Totally Worth it. I have always been fat, and decided to take my health seriously. Counting calories is doable if you are determined, but Lose It makes it so much easier. The thing I realized is that it's not about "being on a diet" but about learning what is causing you harm and what is healthy for you. Not only it tracks calories but also nutrients, and it helped alot in only a short amount of time. Lost 16 pounds in only 40 days from being mindful of what I eat, thanks to the app. 10/10!

Good solid app that will genuinely help you count calories and lose weight. the food database alone has every food you are likely to come across thus no problem adding correct calories. perhaps a little too many features that aren't necessary but use it how you want to. As a simple calorie counter and weight monitor it's perfect

I honestly can only recommend this app. It gives you a daily budget of calories to eat, the percentages of macronutrients you've eaten in a day, a summary of your calories intake throughout the week, plus after 7 days streaks you get a new goal projection based on how you have respected your budget (e.g. if you exceed your budget you're gonna get to your goal slower). Also you can simply scan the barcode on the food and add your own food/recipes, it's very simple and fast.

Great app. I can't pay for the premium version but the free version is amazing too. Easy to log calories also has a intermittent fasting logger if your interested in buying premium. Shows how many calories you have left. Shows your streak. Been using it for 3 days and I already love it. I haven't noticed any bugs or anything wrong with it so far. But I wish there were different things you can measure by like I don't know what the serving size is but could I do it in grams or something else.

App seems good. Nice features for tracking fitness, nutrition, ect., however I can't seem to connect my Samsung Health app (through Samsung S3 watch) to this app. Also, I should be able to track how many sets I've done and how much weight I used which I can't. A few updates could be made to better the app.

This app is very handy for weigh loss. I lost 3kg in 3 or 4 months. The list of foods is wide and your calorie allowance is calculated for yoy. You just have to log your food each day. I only wish that it would always have measurements for all foods. Sometimes it says 1 serving. It is hard to know much that is.

Not unusable, but extremely frustrating to use. The quality of the database is very poor. I don't find most European products, so I need to manually enter most things. The things that are in the database are also poor quality unfortunately. Many times factually wrong or measure in weird units (what the hell is a serving of chicken, or what crazy person measures fruit by volume). Scanning of nutritional information sometime works, so that's good, but usually it misreads at least something.

This app is incredible. I can't begin to tell you how, if used religiously, it WILL, help you lose weight. Track calories, search foods with history or bar codes or your own food creations. Track your workouts and deduct the calories burned from your calorie intake. OMG JUST TRY IT! You will not be disappointed. It's easy Intuitive interface is kids play. Lost fifteen pounds easily, because of this app!

I've been using this app for close to 1900 days, and today after logging my workout it says I have a big fat Zero for my streak. This app helped me go from being at risk of future health issues to a perfectly healthy and food conscious adult. The streak system motivated and helped to feed my drive to keep going and doing better than the day before. Now that's all gone. Thanks for the update that basically took away the reason why I didn't change to another tracking app.

Amazing app, I've lost almost 10 kg (25 lbs) just by registering everything that I eat, it really makes you conscious about all the things you eat a day. Plus, kuddos to the "what's new" notes team, they're genuinely the funniest ones on the play store if you get all the references!

After using a few other apps for calorie counting I have found this to be the right one for my needs. I would like to upgrade to Pro but an annual subscription is too expensive, a one of payment would be a better idea. You can still use a lot of the features in the free version and it seems to ok for what I use it for.

I love the app and used it daily for more than a year. However, there is a (new) problem with the exercises section. When importing the activities from Google Fit or Adidas Running, the nb. of calories is *hugely* distorted. Please fix it, it's not helping us towards the goal of getting fit. I'm on Android 10, OnePlus 6, all updates (for the 3 apps) installed.

I really like this app, the layout is great and the projection is fab, it works great even using the free version ... But a lot of the items calories aren't correct, which kind of sucks to be honest, for example it tells me 1 can of heinz beans and pork is like 300+ cals for a tin?? It's only 200. This makes me really not trust any of the calorie counts it gives me and means I have to input my own..

Really feature rich and has really helped me with my weight loss journey so far. Some of the UI elements could be a bit better though, there are areas which are hidden away which I have to jump through hoops to get to. Also, I've noticed an annoying bug where the app crashes halfway through editing a recipe. Specifically if I scan the barcode and it doesn't get found, only happened a couple times but v annoying as I lose my recipe! Still, I'm considering going pro at some point.

This app is intuitive, easy to navigate and very helpful in giving a general overview of your macros - would be nice if there was more of a micro nutrient breakdown. And I wish I could see carb/protein/fats grams on the free version. But then if I really need it, I suppose there's premium...

Losing weight on it so that's a good sign :) Nice layout and easy to add foods and see progress etc even with the free version. Word of caution it's best to check your calories on your own packages as some of the user inputted foods seem way off but once you've added them in yourself you can pick them for future too.

I love this app but I'm only giving it 4 stars because there are so many incorrect food entries in here it is starting to get incredibly frustrating and almost impossible to track your food without searching for a long time. If people want to make up nutritional info or fool themselves, it shouldn't be searchable for those of us who actually care about macros and calories. Purge the BS entries or make a feature so we can save or only search for verified/ correct nutritional info.

Garbage. Kept crashing in the middle of logging food. Finally became unresponsive and randomly logged me out. I uninstalled and reinstalled the app to find out that all my data was lost, including custom foods I've made for myself. Not synced to my account, not in a local cache, nothing. Went through troubleshooting process advised on loseit website to zero effect.

Best diet and fitness tracker I've ever used. It can be used solely as a weight loss tool. But it is also brilliant for logging exercise and ensuring that nutrition is balanced. There are so many additional features, which make this such an interactive app for anyone who likes to analyse their habits. The barcode scanner needs a mention as it is so good. As users add nutritional information its data base is massive and international. Yearly membership is great value and encourages commitment.

I have used this app for years with no issues. No, all of a sudden since I did an update, it struggles to scan barcodes and whenever I use the app longer than 20 seconds, music randomly starts to play and will not stop until I force close the app. If I just leave the app, it still plays and over rides all other sounds on the phone. I have to force close it to get it to stop, sometimes even restart my phone which is hugely annoying

Clean design but no other pluses. Just scanned a barcode that needed me to add data in kj. Why kj? I only have calories. I did not find a way to add calories instead, I don't want to convert it somewhere else. If you want to give me a free trial - let me know the following payment amounts. I don't want surprises. And too much questions, mates, with no option to skip them. I don't have a plan, I don't need an advice. I just want to know how much a ate.

Great app but I dont use it very often and I paid for a year thinking it was a one off payment and didn't realise it was a rolling subscription so I've just been charged 30 quid out of the blue. Is there any way of getting this refunded or am I screwed? I have now figured out how to cancel the subscription so it wont happen again but I could really do without losing 30 quid right now 😔

The app is great butbi deleted for a while. Upon coming back when logging in and signing up there seems to be a new format which is nice and all but everything I sign up there's a message that says "incorrect e-mail or password try again later ". Then I tried to make a new account. At the end there's another message that says "can't validate the at username right now try again later." Is the system down or something?? Please help

Really easy to use (I particularly like that it has a very functional web platform as well as the app... sometimes I hate typing on phones!). Customisable with very useful support section. I'm just using for to help my weight loss goal so this gives me good tracking of calories, weight and exercise which is all I need.

Went from good to useless. This app used to do exactly what I wanted it to: logged fairly accurately and left me alone. Now they've taken to posting intrusive, triggering (inaccurate, outdated, possibly dangerous) breakfast "advice" in the middle of my log. It is more annoying than the ads, it can't be removed and it's impeding logging. This app sucks now. I was just about to buy the full version, but now I will be uninstalling it instead.

Logging food is a time consuming nightmare. Bar Scanner works only for 1/3. Adding new food is a pain because scanned doesn't pick up table correctly all the time. Even suggestions are not accessible between breakfast and lunch. Looks like food powered only by the community. Logging must be smooth, fast and effective but not like that. I've chosen this only because of garmin integration half year ago. My only achivement is the weight stopped increasing.

Disappointed by the latest update. Food that I've logged in the past use to show when I searched for it and had the dates I logged it. Now it won't show and I have to go look for the nutrition labels of those food again which is quite annoying. Please fix this issue. I was loving this app up until recently. 7th Sept - uninstalling this today which is a pity because this use to be the best calorie counting app until all the recent updates ruined it.

Got a cheap subscription and the app nicely combines intermittent fasting, calorie counting and goal setting. Also connects with your sportswear (eg garmin etc) which I find important. Loses a star as you can only log whole weight numbers eg 80kg, 85kg but not say 80.3 or 85.5 which seems incredible for a weight loss app. This issue has been here since at least Aug 22

Have used this tool several times to chart a weight loss effort and give it loads of credit for my success. It now includes options for more non-US foods, which makes my life abroad easier. I would give it 5stars except its missing an integration with the Nokia/Withings app that would allow Withings to show logging data from LoseIt. It does have the ability to use weight data from Withings, so maybe it wouldnt be too hard. I have used this app since 2011.

Was a really good app, but they have now completely lost my support after changing barcode scanning to premium only. I was on the verge of going premium because I thought the appwas pretty decent, but this move is going to wind people up, now I feel like I am being forced to go premium because it's exhausting not being able to scan foods. Last time I use Loseit.

Edit: issue has been fixed. Nice app, does what I need it to with less fluff compared to the other one. Well it worked alright for over 120(paid) days. Now it crashes as soon as the add food button is clicked. I tried to report this with the support email listed, but that's "unmonitored" as the nice automated message told me. So, here we are, public bug report. Please fix

I would have given this 5 stars if there was a built in pedometer, at the moment I have to go from this app onto my Samsung health app to find out what my step count was for the day then go back onto this app to enter the details...it's a lot of messing around. Apart from that though I'm really enjoying the ease of logging my foods especially with the barcode scanner. The weekly report is really insightful too...I didn't realise that 10% of my diet was bread!!!

Was a decent app for tracking calories, but many features that were previously free (like bar code scanning), are now only available with the premium paid account. This, along with increased ads, has made me go somewhere else for tracking calories. Shame. It was good before these changes.

I am enjoying the tracking and the ability to scan barcodes. In fact totally overboard with barcodes scanning to really see calories! Feedback is this app is totally USA centric. Despite in setup requesting weight in kgs, it still will only let me track in Imperial. Dudes NOONE but US uses imperial anymore 😂 Additionally emails are again total USA centric - trust me, we are not cold here, we are dying of heat, humidity and fires. This app was recommended on many sites including UK and Aus

Update: What's up with the annoying background music? Turn it off! it's definitely one of the better apps, however I would like a way to just manually input the maximum and minimum amount of calories that I'm aiming for per day, and then just have a be happy with that number. In other words it will be red if it goes outside of that range. and it would be cool to have the ability to only show dinner for somebody such as myself who's on an intermittent fast for 19 hours per day.

Way more intuitive than My Fitness Pal. Which makes it faster and less time consuming on the long run. Unfortunately is called "lose it". If you want to "gain it" won't really fit your needs. At the moment if you want to add weight it will only show maintain as target.

Resuced from 3 to 2 stars because the popup to buy the premium version keeps coming back despite pressing no thanks. This is very annoying. If I want to purchase the premium version I don't need a reminder every fricking day. It's a shame that in the new version measuring the daily macronutrients are no longer available in the free version either.

Absolutely destroys my battery and overheats my phone. Also disappointed in the fairly poor quality (inaccurate macronutrient estimates) of the database content. The whole point of the app is to track macros. I subscribed for a year before realizing how poor the database entries continue to be, and the unexpected battery drain and phone overheating make this a HARD PASS.

I was stupid and did not read reviews before applying for the free trial. Wanted to see how different the premium was compared to unpaid. Decided almost straight away it wasn't worth it and have been trying to cancel since. Its impossible to cancel and I've tried contacting them and they're "out of office until next week" which is wonderful as thats when my free trial runs out and money will be taken from my account. Please save your money because its apparent in going to lose mine.

Started using this app at my doctor's request. Like the ability to scan a bar code and having the nutritional information come up. Considered upgrading from Lose it free to the premium, decided against it as it's a yearly subscription rather than a one-time payment. I used to be able to scan barcodes and have nutrition information come up, but now it's only available in premium 👎

I used to rate this app a 5/5 but now it just seems like a vast majority of the options that used to be free are behind a paywall. I adored the feature of being able to scan food items and adjust my plan more but now I'd need to pay for it. I wouldn't have an issue if it was NEW content that needed to be paid for, but previously free to use? Are you kidding me? If things change I'll update my review but for now I just give it a simple 2...

This app is PERFECT. It's super easy because it already has a huge library of foods and the nutrition info for everything. I'm about to get gastric sleeve and my Dietitian told me about this app. I need to be accountable and this has support groups that I haven't used yet. I can also keep a diary. It does EVERYTHING that I need and want. Thank you!

I think this app is the most useful and easy to use calorie tracker app. there's a huge data base of food products to choose from to help make tracking easier you can also scan in items if they don't have it already. There's a free version that has everything I need to count calories and it has a premium version with more features but I don't need all of that. nice to know it's there tho. great app, 5/5 from me.

Really helpful app for weight loss. I've been using it to keep a track of my calories . It's very easy to use, has a very handy barcode scanner and an extensive catalogue of foods and the premium plan doesn't break the bank. I've lost 4 pounds so far and happy to continue with calorie counting using this app for as long as I can.

I absolutely love this app and appreciate the developers so much I really mean it, thank you guys. I was slightly over the body fat I wanted to be at and bc I counted my calories with this app and watched what I ate at literally every meal, snack, and even how much I exercised was accurate to the machine I was using. will be spending money on the app the day I get paid. If you're into fitness, get this app.

I used this app for over 2 years. Now the ads are so annoying and I hit the x on the ads but it opens to another ad. I just want to log my food intake, that's all. If they clean up this ad mess, I I'll return. The first year, I was on the subscription but really didn't need the extra stuff.

I miss the way the app used to work. I've used this app off and on for years but now everything is premium! Even water intake is premium! And it's constantly advertising premium. It's so distracting. I get you have to make money but seriously it's so hard to use for free now because how much premium span is on screen. Sadly it's still the best one out there because the calories per food item is usually accurate and you don't have to mess with it too much.

The app did not support switching between the units of food unless it was in the database. For example one of my foods (Huel) the serving size was two scoops or 100 grams. If I weigh out 60 grams in my scale I have to do unit conversions between scoops and grams in my head, other apps support this built-in.. I would have given it three stars, but I ended up giving two stars because since I reached out to support multiple times and heard nothing back.

Simple, easy to use app. It helps me keep track of how many calories I intake each day, which has helped me lose 15 lbs of excess fat. Overeating and laziness have been my two main downfalls in the past. The solutions to these problems are clear: daily excercise and decreasing calories. By the way, keeping track of calories helps me stay away from the horribly unhealthy foods. If you're honest with yourself and keep at it, this method of calorie counting works.

Had this app for a few years use to just look at total calories I ate for day and use scan feature. But past few months using other features too. I love the tips but I especially love the dashboard. There I can see if I'm over saturated fat or sugar for day and avoid rest of day, or if I'm under on protien or fiber. Then look at tips for recommendations on what to eat. I Love and recommend this app. You pay annually, so its around a few dollars a month.

I am loving this app. I love the list they have for food and exercise and also that I can set the calories I burned in a workout. I am currently on the fee app and considering the premium. I am using it with My fitness pal because the free app doesn't include a break down of your nutrients break down which is crucial for me. Will be using it long time. I also like the tips they give about regular foods and how they serve your journey.

Free trial for the price of a yearly premium subscription! Immediately charged me the full yearly subscription price when I said sure, I want to see what the premium version looks like. I'm usually pretty cautious with subscriptions and am aware of most of these dark patterns but they got me there. Haven't even tried the product but with a start line this, I'm uninstalling immediately. Back to MFP.

I really like using this app. It gives medals for weight lost, days in a row using it and compares the weight you lose to real life objects. The medals and days in a row tracked in particular have helped me stay on top of my diet and fitness routine. My only complaint is that I don't know that i trust the calorie burn amounts on the fitness section. For example, it says I burn fewer calories when I run 3 miles in 30 minutes than when I run 3 miles in 40 minutes, but that's a small thing to me

So far this is the easiest calorie counting app I've found so far. I'm able to track my weight and daily calorie intake. It hadls definitely helped keep me on track. I have not subscribed to premium yet because I felt I didn't need it right now but I can imagine it would just the app that much better to use!

I've been using Loseit for over a year and I loved it to bits until recently. There's ads that immediately pop up while I'm in the middle of inputting my meals for the day. It's becoming more and more of a nuisance. I don't want to have to switch tracking apps but I'm leaning towards that option... Please fix this!

Edit: the issue seems to be from my SD card, not from the app. I was able to install the app on my internal storage with no issues. Apologies for the poor review! It has been fixed. For whatever reason, it crashed any time I tried opening the app. Uninstalled it and cannot reinstall it.

The premium version is great. love lots about it but wish 3 things. 1. Ability to save a custom water increment. my water bottle is 27oz, so 8 dies not work for me. 2. Ability to set my own exact weight goal (set by my nutritionist) 3. Have the lose-it verified food check mark show everywhere, not just in search mode. Works better than the many other apps I've tried and aside from those things I love it.

Possible to add an option to input just calories burned during an exercise without having to setup a custom exercise routine with a preset calorie counter? I only want to quickly input the calories that show on the display of a piece of equipment, like a bike or a treadmill. I would like to keep it simple. This is app can be potentially great!

The app is by far the best app I have encountered, but the only thing I wish would change is that it would also give some recognition for weight-gain and not only weight loss, which seems to be the main audience for the app. The UI is filled with bugs once you try to configure to a plan to gain weight, and it's too bad because this is a legitimate goal for a lot of people. Anyway thanks for a great app and would love to change the rating and buy premium if it would be fixed

I have found this app very helpful. It has helped me stay accountable and it is very easy to use! 1.10.19 question for the lose it team and I dont know where else to ask this. I still love using this app in comparison to many others I've tried. I'm really intrested in tracking additional nutritional information such as vitimans and minerals from supplements I am taking is this something that lose it will ever add. I do already have a premium account.

I am 63 and use this app daily. I used it to help me drop 70 pounds which I did beginning July 2022. I am NOW using the app to maintain that weight loss. It is so so helpful. My fitbit easily syncs with the app and that is great. This app is NOT glitchy at all and I've never had even one tiny bit of problem using it. Outstanding for tracking everything from activity, calories to steps and exercise as well as trends in what you eat. I love this app.

Used this app for a couple years now, no issues. Recent update started the full screen ads every time I log a meal and while I've tried just ignoring it, I've found it too much to bear. Unless that is removed, I'm sad to see my streak and progress gone, because I'm not able to use something that stresses me out so much like this.

Terrible customer service, there is none. Only automated replies with outdated instructions and impossible to get the correct answer you need to cancel subscription. CAREFUL because they get your payment info right away and the 'easily cancel any time' is not totally true. Avoid headaches, don't even download this app. NOT FREE at all, don't accept the "free trial"

I've been using this app for a while now and recently decided to go with the premium service. I could not love the ease of food tracking through this app more. Just discovered this morning the ability to scan food items with a barcode! not to mention all of the other factors I can track. Water, exercise, and other and other health metrics.

This is the app I was looking for (after trying 3 others.) It's so easy to scan foods and put them under 'your foods'. Also you can put your recipes in. So you can put your most eaten foods in the recipes. For example I put in my usual breakfast, I mix 2 cereals, almond milk and coffee with sugar and creamer in a recipe and just press one button every day. You can do the same with sandwiches and salads. It breaks down the nutrition at a glance for the day also. So comprehensive!

Been using this app for 3 months now and it's been an amazing help as I've moved into my first actual weight loss journey in my life. Thanks to tracking my diet and knowing where I should and shouldn't be when it comes to food, this app has helped me lose 22 pounds so far and I don't even need that premium stuff. Reported an issue with the app recently and got a response within hours. Much appreciated 💜

I paid for a year because my daughter uses this app and I thought we could share things, but have regretted it since day 2. The scan feature is lacking. If I eat a bag of salad that is 100 calories per serving and the bag has 3.5 servings in it, and I eat the entire bag, I should be able to scan and say I had 3.5 servings. All of this input is grams ounces or pounds. The math that goes in to each of my foods eaten makes this not a helpful app. The UI is not very friendly. I disappointed.

Let the enshitification commence! It's a perfectly functional app that does what you need if you just need something basic. It gets 1 star out of 5 because it's apparent they've got enough critical mass to move on to the taking previously free features (like barcode scanning) and shoving them behind the paywall phase of an apps life cycle. It's only a matter of time until the race to the bottom fundamentally ruins another half decent app.

This app makes it easy to keep track of what you're eating. It let's you scan barcodes of food, has almost every known produced food on the planet to choose from, as well as fresh veggies/fruits and such. It's very customizable and if you're really honest with what you eat, it helps you lose weight and stay on top of your health! Also love that I can pair my Fitbit to it to see my net calorie intake vs just a raw calorie intake.

I've been using this app for over 4 years now and LoseIt was the only app i've ever stuck to through out my weight altering journey but this last update literally is a disaster. the scanner never works (i have to type all the value info myself), i can't pick my calorie budget anymore, the graph that showed how much I've lost is gone, the blue bar design looks depressing, the units change back on their own no matter how many times i set them to metric, and the list goes on.. PLEASE CHANGE IT BACK

Best food logging app but tracking food everyday is a laborious task and why apps like Foodvisor have a chance if they improve the tech. LoseIt offers their version of logging with a photo but it's slow, inaccurate and doesn't detect multiple items. Invest in camera recognition tech and I'll switch to using it everyday. Also don't like how the recipes are grouped into weeks without names easily searchable?

I find this to be a very useful app for watching calories and tracking progress. A great interface, excellent database of foods, useful nutrition info, and goal projections. Makes it easy to plan your daily meals. Plus, it syncs seamlessly across platforms. Highly recommended.

It is a great app. But the app sometimes does not work, it won't scan the food's barcode, I can't search food to log. It will stay like that for couple of days then it will be normal again. Tried refreshing my phone, uninstall and install the app again but it doesn't work. App would've been better.

On 11/30 I decided to take advantage of the half price premium lose it. I gave my payment information and then received an error message that said unable to complete transaction. I tried again to no avail. I get a message that says your subscription is paid for a year but when I try to do anything else I am told there is an error with my payment. I have not received my payment back.

I needed a tracking app for my journey with weight loss, but I'm also trying to incorporate a plant based whole food diet. The app is perfect for diet monitoring, but for PBWF, it doesn't translate as well. Totally recommend this app, just keep in mind if you have certain restrictions to your diet.

So much better than my fitness pal. I love that I can see the breakdown of calories I should budget by meal and that it rolls over unused calories from breakfast and lunch to snacks or dinner. It really helps me plan ahead and visualize how my food choices now impact what I need to do to stay on track for the rest of the day.

Tried Fatsecret and Weightfit before this one. Loseit is by far the most intuitive and entering meals is far simpler and just "flows" better that the others. Also entering custom food recipes is great. Well I wanted is a basic app to track my daily nutritional intake and this app does it and does it without the frustration like the other ones I experienced.

Several of the food listings that are verified are incorrect. You have to go to the desktop to make corrections. Getting a refund for Premium involves hunting to find the process then they send you a link that doesn't work. I would have given it a three if they had adequate customer service.

Updated: the issue I was having seems to have been fixed by reverting the way recipes are entered. Original review: The app became essentially unusable when it removed the ability to fill in recipes completely with how many and what kind of servings. Now you can only enter ingredients and it's all as if it's one serving. Impossible to use this app of you actually cook food.

I have only been using this app for a few days, but it is super easy and helpful. I love that it tracks both food and activity, and I have yet to not find a food or activity that I am looking for. It also made a realistic estimate of my TDEE so I feel meeting the calorie goals are realistic. I have had trouble in the past with other programs cutting my calories too drastically and then I crash when I am doing a lot of hiking or cross country skiing. This counter works great for my needs.

Would give it 5 stars but it is very irritating that literally every time i open it and like every other time i go to the log screen it puts up a full screen advertisement for the pro version and i have large fingers so it can get tiresome closing it. Also that i have to edit about every 3rd item i use the bar code scanner on because it gets the values on it wrong. It is good app though. With its assistance I have successfully lost over 50 lbs in under 6 months. Now just 60 more lbs to go.

So I've been using this app for the last 3.5 months and I have lost 20lbs (9kg) already. This is not short of magic! All I had to do was to count my calories and keep them under the weekly budget. Sure, I cut a couple of things from my diet like coke and rice but besides those, I'm eating all I want and I am going down constantly. I was categorized in obese class 1 although I didn't look it being 6ft tall. But now I'm down to overweight category. 3.5 more months to go and I'll be normal again.

You have to fix nearly every scanned item. The calories and macros will be off by quite a bit for a lot of items and when you're depending on tracking those things carefully, accuracy is important. It's not terribly user friendly either. Not a great experience. Definitely prefer MyFitnessPal to this tracker.

The app makes you go through 15-20 screens (this isn't an exaggeration) to answer various questions and only AFTER you've done all that you find out it's impossible to use it without making an account. Creating an account should be optional, NOT pushed on users. There's nothing about counting calories that requires making an account. Won't be using this app because of this.

Issues on android Been using this app for years on iPhone. Recently switched to Samsung. No more themes, and for some reason, can't see my profile or badges. Is it's not supported on android version? Food tracking, calorie count, and macros works fine. Deleting food is less intuitive. miss my iPhone version of this app

Edit: I'm aware of how app monetization works, but you're ruining the app's rep by pushing the pop up ad every single day, sometimes it seems like multiple times a day. Quit being so pushy about it. Not everyone needs yet another subscription on their monthly bill. I'd gladly pay a one time fee. This is a helpful app, but QUIT WITH THE POP UP ADS PUSHING SUBSCRIPTIONS.

This app is good for tracking your calorie intake and monitoring how much protein, carbs and fat you're getting in your diet. As well as putting your weight on an easy to read graph so you can watch the line go down. Good things to add would be something to track your measurements or monthly photo updates so people who have trouble seeing their progress wouldn't lose hope.

Just added this today to replace MFP, there's a little bit of a learning curve to it the only thing that's kind of bugging me is that the breakdown of each section is kind of cut off and it's not easy to read on the nutrition breakdown, but other than that it's pretty good I also wish it would link to garmin and Google fit at the same time

Everytime I add my current meal into the daily log, the last meal or parts of the last meals of the day will delete. It's making this app pointless to use as I could easily keep track of things by just writing it down on a piece of paper or on my notes in my phone. Such an irritating process of re-adding meals in constantly
