I started with the free version of this app on the advice of my cardiologist. What a great find! After about a week I committed to a year of the paid version and I have no regrets at all. It's very user friendly, easy to add foods and recipes. Easy to keep track of a ton of different goals too. Best of all, when I sent a note asking if they could make a small change to one of the screens so it was more useful, not only did I get very quick follow up, but the upgrade actually happened, and I got a note that it did!! Thanks very much to Sal and Pete :) I'll definitely be using this app for a long time. On top of everything else, I've lost weight too!!! If you're looking for an app to help you lose weight and/or keep track of your nutrients don't hesitate. At least try the free version. It's awesome.

It feels like a very good college project. There are crashes that annoy me, such as when I'm trying to upload a photo and the app dies because it's too big. There is unverified food that is ridiculously incorrect and a default "share my food" option that is probably to blame. Auto adding food to recipes is hard because I have no idea if they added verified food or not. Let me drag and drop food between meals. Let me add a timestamp to a calorie entry. Perk: it's cheaper than other apps.

11/3/22 Had to stop using this app due to the lack of integration with Samsung health. I really would like to come back, but I need this app to allow exercise updates from my Samsung watch and phone. You need to be careful and double check some of the calorie counts. But this app has helped my wife and I lose over 20lbs each (and still losing). The best part is we are able to check and support each other.

fun app for counting calories, makes it easy to keep track and its much less of a chore. Also less complicated than myfitnesspal, which I tried before this. This is for calories and nutrition, less of a social media app, which is what I was after in the first place. Its not perfect cause the barscanner doesnt work all the time, and its annoying to manually enter food in of itself, but it exceeds the basic expectations. plus i like how it syncs with the fitbit app.

This is so far one of my favorite calorie counting apps. The calorie counts are pretty ACCURATE! (Unlike other popular apps). My only gripe so far is the portions are often listed in grams or ounces, which is hard to measure. It shows fat, carbs, proteins. Subscription price is way, way better.

I have used the Lose It app for 6 years and liked it a lot; however, they have announced that they are going to discontinue the challenges by the end of 2021 because they're not cost-effective. I use this app not only to log my calorie intake and exercise and lose weight but also used the challenges to motivate myself to eat better and get more exercise. Without the benefits of these challenges, this makes the Lose It app just another calorie counter and not worth the money to upgrade to Premium

Loved the barcode scanner, layout and pretty much everything else, but it's really just a teaser to get one to subscribe for $. I'd rather be subjected to ad's and have more of the features that can only be unlocked if we pay. I already have more features in Samsung Health, except not the barcode scanner. Deleted.

Love this app. It's so easy to use and really encouraging watching the weight line go down! I love the way you can scan products and fill in information if it's not there so others can benefit from it. It's also great how you can choose which measure of weight you want to use when recording food.

I love this app as a way to not only keep me on track for calorie counting, but carbohydrate counting too! As a type 1 diabetic, it has helped me immensely being able to see my carb count for a meal and then know how much insulin to give. I really hope they keep this as part of the free version, as this app is so user friendly and I use it everyday.

I think this app is excellent. If you have the motivation to lose weight, you don't need Noom - you need this (this doesn't include education). The library of foods is huge and syncs with Google Fit, which is useful. Some aspects of the app are a bit clunky, but it's got a ton of features and generally is a pleasure to use.

I just joined so I cant say anything yet about my weight loss experience, but I love this app! I started out with the free version. I tried to upgrade to premium but there was a problem paying through Google Play. Lose It! had a limited time discount offer. I contacted customer support and they responded promplty. They solved my issue (by- passing Google Play) and gave me the discount that had just expired! EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE!!

I've used this app for more than 2 years now. I am satisfied with the results. One thing I would like for more apps to be able to transfer workout data or steps. For my case, I used to use the Google Fit app because my daily phone was the Nexis 6P. I would like it for the Samsung Health app could communicate with this app to transfer my steps / activity automatically. Now I use the Samsung Galaxy Note 9. I would really like that. Thank you for your time.

I like this app. Easy to use and keeps you accountable since what you eat is logged. I wish that the tracking water feature was part of the free account. It makes sense that the more advanced features would be part of the paid account but tracking water intake.... I don't know. That's important enough that it should be offered regardless. That's actually why I gave the app 4 stars instead of 5.

Looks like I'll be sticking with my fitness pal until a better app comes along. The nutritional values are completely off on lot of the foods even if you use the barcode scanner. You can't log foods in grams which is also a huge drawback. And you have to upgrade to unlock the most basic settings like water logging.

I have used this app for years and love it. But the update a couple of months ago has rendered the cumulative calories over/under for the week useless. At first it didn't show up sometimes at all after the update. I contacted customer support and it worked for a week or so after I updated, and now it is adding up and showing the wrong total. I wish this could be fixed, or go back to the old version from the summer that worked for well over 10 years. I never doubted it until now.

Functional but too many premium features. It does some things better than other apps but it locks so many basic features like macros per meal and logging days in advance behind a paywall. The interface looks nice and I find the food I want to log most of the time. The automatic calorie adjustment and the goal projections after you finish a day are great. If the developers would only lock advanced features behind the paywall I'd give five stars.

Amazing weight loss tool, although there are some foods you need to double check overall it works great. No spam on the basic version, just a few adds but that is worth it to use it for free. I am planning to try out the paid version soon, since compared to others it is a good price.

I like it but not without issues. What I dislike is meal planning ahead isn't offered on the basic version...I mean all other calorie counting apps I've used include such a basic feature, even myfitnesspal and thats quite expensive on the premium. So I wish they'd allow that. But overall I like the aesthetic, and it just suits me more.

Works flawlessly! I've never had an issue with this tracking app. It has never failed to work perfectly. I used a more well known app in the past and even paid for their premium services and was terribly disappointed with it. Lose It! app simply works. No glitches, no server issues, no drama. Recommend!

Update 30/05/2023: finally reached my goal! 20 lbs lost in 4 months! I read a lot of negative comments about the ads with the free version but honestly I didn't even try the free version. For a little 30$ cad a year it's a no brainer to switch to premium. Been using it 4 months and I love it. I'm really happy of how easy it is to use and I can even connect it with my fitbit watch. I now have a better understanding of the calorie cost of everything I'm eating. Scanning feature is working great!

The recipe feature is mad glitchy. It kept resetting in the middle of creating a recipe and when I finally was able to complete it, my entry of 1 serving showed calories for 10. And its so stupid that unless you clear out your ENTIRE history, you cant delete weight entries or change its date, or reset starting weight/date -- all of which you can do in MyFitnessPal. Theres 1 random number ruining my progress numbers/chart from Jan when I first tried the app but I didnt start using it until Aug.

I started using this app as an iPhone customer 3 years ago, and it was great. I had a premium subscription and used it a lot. But then I switched to Android before the end of the premium period and found that LoseIt premium wasn't anywhere near as useful on droid, and a lot of features were missing. Now I'm being badgered to upgrade to the now-useless premium every single time I try to log a food, and it's so relentless that I'm ready to delete the app and find another one.

I like the simplicity of this app. Makes counting calories and Macros easy. my only complaint is if you enter a weight by mistake you can edit it, but you can't delete it. other than that little glitch, it's been a great app so far. Plenty of food in the library, so the calculating is done for you. it's great!

So simple and clean! I love this app! I was discouraged from using my fitness pal when I realized users must now pay to use the barcode scanner. Lose it premium is generously priced and the app has a clean interface and it is easy to use. I've already "lost the weight of a pineapple"! I love the analogies in the app too.

Like the other users here, I also encounter the annoying issue of barcode scanning. It just keeps scanning, eventually showing protein shakes and other irrelevant things at the bottom of the screen. This makes the whole app useless and very very difficult to use. I can't believe it was still not fixed after so many uodates. Didn't you guys do the A/B test before releasing the updates?

Very nice app. You can easily track your food and add foods. I lost several pounds in 3 months sticking to their guidelines but I got so tired of measuring everything that I stopped. Well I'm ready to start over again and the app is still great even if I'm only doing the free version.

Lose It! has helped me stay on track; I have lost weight at a fairly consistent rate since I started. I love that it connects with my Fitbit (subscription option), as that helps me keep more accurate track of calories burned as well as those consumed. I am also a big fan of the weight loss graph and of the option to scan the bar code of a food to record it - that's a real time-saver! Anyway, this app is working for me. I have already lost 12 of my 35-pound goal before my daughter's wedding!

It is hands down the best calorie and health tracking app I have had. Thanks Lose it for not taking for granted so many amazing Details on your App! Since the design of the icons, food, the variety of foods and with Logos of the Brands or places and how User Friendly. It is. I am so excited to finally reach my goals logging in everyday to this super effective and cute app!

started using another app. liked it except the food database is horrible. searched for another app but found a they were too fancy. probably suited for the prissy health nut that wears designer cloths and carries a toy dog to the gym. not for me. continued to look for a good calorie tracker when I stumbled across Lose it. The app is not loaded with fancy nonsence and the food search is very easy to find what you consume with accurate data compared to the nutritional facts label. 😉

Just started using this tracker app and committed to a year of the premium version. Thought the price was worth it for a year. App feels a little cluttered doesn't have that intuitive feel. Biggest complaint is that it doesn't stnc with my Samsung watch for gathering data. Would definitely increase rating if it would sync with my Samsung watch.

Thank you, the newer update appears to have resolved my previous issues. Only giving 4 stars though, because there are some weird issues with serving sizes... A recipie uses 10 serves for example, but instead of 1 serve as what I ate, I have to put 0.2. Unusual. For someone bad at math, it's a headache. It's different now, but it's not fixed. Now the total recipie size has been made to match the portion size on all of mine. So if it's 8 serves, a portion is also 8, not 1 of 8. Confusing.

I REALLY love the app, and am likely amongst the longest term users out there. More than a decade. it's a shame that the developer contact from Google Play for them goes to "unmonitored email" and is not an avenue for support. Also of note, this app does not sync via health connect making it way more difficult to consolidate all your health and fitness to a common database.

I've used other calorie and intermittent fasting apps, and this one is great. It's private and flexible. I'm not starving and feel like I'm losing weight the right way - slow and steady and sustainably. The food log list is very comprehensive. I love that I can plan my meals for the whole day, so I'm not scrambling wishing for calories at the end of the day.

I really love it, I just wish more features were free but it makes sense what they keep and what they dont. The minimum needed is free so It's still good. I still wish i could track water intake and sleep for free though. Other than that its pretty good and helps me with diet control and helps me work out more as well as not binging.

Was super happy with this app. Was fine with having ads on the page itself. I'm now extremely unsatisfied with having an entire page of an ad pop up, not allowing me to do anything and having to wait to get of it to be able to continue. Some ads are inappropriate!! I hope this is fixed or I'm moving to a different app.

I love the layout. It doesn't feel overwhelming. I skip breakfast so being able to remove the meals I don't eat during in my plan helps minimize the clutter on the dashboard. It's small, but not revealing the weight number on the main page helps me not obsess about that days number. Creating my own meals with my own metrics helps me. Though folks are wildly underestimating the calories of what they eat lol. Good luck 🤞.

So far so good been doing this for 3 weeks now and I have to say slightly difficult to get round at first, having to log everything but I've got into it and love the fact that it saves your meals, been a creature of habit, makes it so much easier now to enter. And I lost 4lb, but I didn't have any scales first week so I feel like I've lost more, happy days and I'll stick with this, would definitely recommend and I'm getting slimmer - thank you 🤗 😌 🌸

I used to love this app, but the recent update removed the ability to edit recipe ingredient amounts. You now have to delete an ingredient and reenter it, instead of being able to change the amount of the ingredient. I think I will switch to Fitness Pal if it doesn't go back to the way it used to be.

Why do you think it's a good idea to force me to answer 100 questions before I can even look at your app and decide if its what I want? I gave up after the second chapter of interrogation. Yes, the questionnaire is so lengthy it is broken down into EIGHT sections each with multiple questions that don't all even relate to weight loss. Sell information much?

Ads, ads and more ads!!! I loved this app to track my food but it completely took over my Samsung with ads! Everytime I would open my phone, another app or this one it would pop up an ad that I had to X out of. Sometimes it would even crash my phone. I went months trying to figure out which app was doing this. Well, I found it and I'm not happy that I had to delete it. Great app but not worth the ads.

I think this app is great! If you are serious about losing weight this app will help you monitor and control your calorie intake and burned calories. I was having a hard time lowering my body fat, and with one week of using this app I was able to constantly achieve my calorie deficit and reach my goal (and that was using the free version). In other words I definitely recommend this app.

This app has an international database of food products and nutrition tables, which makes it usable outside if the US. Most other Apps lack in this regard. It also works well with google fit, so my nutrition and calorie data is synced between apps. One major flaw is that the App doesn't seem to understand that I actually want to gaim weight. I set my weight goal above my current weight and the App keeps telling me I have already reached my goal.

I have been using Lose It! Off and on for several years and it is great! I have the premium version which allows you to track macros and set goals by macros as well. The food database is very comprehensive. I have used several different tracking apps over the years and Lose It! is, by far, the best!

Most nutritional information in this app is incorrect. For example, items like calories, carbohydrates and proteins are not always correct and in fact very can be far off. Where my actual carbohydrates are 180g, this app will tell me they are only 130g. This may have something to do with the fact that anyone can go in and adjust nutritional information. The app would be great otherwise but I cannot continue to use it or refer my clients because of the abundant false nutritional information.

This app is totally useless and a waste of money. It's complicated. I would like to cancel my subscription but I have already paid for one year. There're other free apps better than it. I don't recommend it to anyone. Save your money. They'll ask you to upgrade to premium for specific services then you'll find out it's useless. For example to count the steps it doesn't have this feature I had to connect the account to another app to do it. Also I couldn't convert the weight into kilograms.

I'm at my healthiest weight in over a decade, passing my 100 day mark of daily use and have lost 26 lbs! I simply wanted to feel healthier, to play with my kids and go up stairs without being winded. I love this app as it's not a fad diet, but rather a tool helping me with a lifestyle change. The first few weeks were tough getting use to eating correct portion sizes, but I've kept the long term in focus, been consistent and honest with tracking, and celebrated milestones. You can do it too!

Only been using two weeks. Ran it along side trial of noom. I find this easier to use as more foods are listed so easy to click on. Weight graph good to watch your results. I have had the premium as only £15 year but to be honest not using the few extra features this gives you. Afew more inspirational messages be good but that's only difference between this and noom and ofcourse not the expense.

Great app for tracking calories and weight loss. Really gives you a good idea for your calorie goal and daily calorie usage. I only use the free version but it's already helped me lose 30 pounds. I see a lot of additional content for premium but in the free version you get everything you need.

I use the free version of the app to keep track of my calorie intake, and it is great. Very simple and easy to use. Scanning barcodes to get a food's calories is a handy feature, and having the preloaded calories for all sorts of ingredients is a fab resource. It retains the info for meals you've entered so if you have some regular staples you can just reload them as a whole meal. Great App.

Great app. The ability to not only scan barcodes, but entire nutrition labels is impressive. I add items to my meal, then easily combine them to create a "recipe" for frequently eaten meals, perfection. I didn't need the premium features but paid for a year anyway as the app has been very much worth it.

Great app for counting calories. I was worried about how hard it would be, but the database of foods Lose It has makes it easy. I marked at 3 stars due to their Fear Of Missing Out marketing of a premium subscription. It's really obnoxious once you realize how your emotions are being manipulated.

Most foods are in the library and easily scanned or typed. I've only had to manually add a couple things and edit a few of them. I would like to suggest that you give us the option to just add the calories to homemade foods/meals. If I have the recipe in hand I don't want to add the whole thing to the app (each ingredient and it's nutritional info.) I also would like to suggest that you make this app available to sync with the Samsung Health app, not everyone uses iPhone or Fitbit products.

This is a very good app and I like the way the dashboard is set up but there is a couple things I wish they would work on. First off if you cook something a day in advance you cannot put it in the next day if you need to scan a barcode without being a member. Lose it quit being chinchi and let us be able to put stuff in advance! Second lose it needs to get with the times and start helping the keto diet members by calculating net carbs on our daily consumption.

Fun & easy to use. Features I really like: that the premium service allows you to track blood pressure, body measurements, exercise and water intake. I love that you can scan bar codes or type up your personal recipes to have precise calorie information. This app really helps portion control and to be mindful of what you are eating. I'm looking forward to trying some of the recipes the app offers too. I highly recommend this to anyone.

Love the free ap and its great resources and recognized foods for calorie counting. have been faithfully using the app and sticking to my goals for 40 days and i have lost 17 lbs, even through Thanksgiving. Highly recommend this app as a wonderful tool for the highly motivated and committed user. Just remember this app is only a tool. The commitment and desire to lose weight must come from within yourself!

If you just use the free features (there's a lot of ads and pressure to pay a subscription) it's a decent, user friendly, accurate tracker, although there's a minor issue which could be corrected by more vigilant monitoring. As the majority of nutritional information is user generated, I see a lot of incomplete, half assed or just plain wrong entries: however the option to correct the data is an excellent feature, and being able to track your fitness activities and weight is great too.

This app became extremely sluggish on my Galaxy S21 Ultra a few weeks ago. I've cleared cache, just in case. And nothing else on my phone is slow. It was true before the latest update, and I've taken the update yet see no improvements. And worse, this update adds an extra click for me to see grams instead of calories per macro. Why not both together? I paid for premium and don't like this direction.

It would be very useful if it were accurate at all. I checked several of the "verified" nutrition facts against the nutrition facts printed on the box or listed by the restaurant. The Lose It app was accurate about 15% of the time. I had to Uninstaller and choose a different app. To be fair, maybe the Lose It app hires food scientists to research nutrition facts independent of the manufacturer and their numbers are based on their own findings......but I doubt it. Good app, sloppy execution.

Thid app is so unusable with the already entered calories. For example, instead of putting the serving size in for cereal as cups, they use grams. Who the hell weighs out their cereal with a dope scale? Nobody. Then when people have entered it in by the cup, it only has the calories and not the fat, carbs, and protein. For crying out loud you have to have a graphing calculator to figure up the calories for a bowl of cereal. I got this app to make this easier not harder. FIX YOUR APP PLZ!!!

First thing it demands is a weight loss goal, so not really helpful if you aren't trying to lose weight but to eat healthy for other reasons. Second thing it demands is a log in, so not helpful if you don't feel like sharing your eating habits with anyone else. That was enough for me. I didn't even get as far as trying to log a meal, which was the goal.

10 years ago I lost 80 lbs in under a year using this app. Back then it allowed me to see nutrients and water intake without paying. This version is still working for me this time around but it is a little disappointing that those features cost money now. 🙁 Still it's a great app, the biggest hurdle I have always had is realising what I'm putting in my body vs what's going out and this app is great for showing you exactly that! The bar code scan is super convenient.

great app. i used other apps/sites for calorie counting but this is the easiest & cleanest I've found. On other apps i needed to add new foods often but this database is very comprehensive. Recipe calculator is ok but needs a field to enter cooking directions.The barcode scanner works great, easy to correct information that was entered incorrectly. cons- i wish it gave a lower limit to prevent over restricting and a way to imput that I'm a nursing mom, i just increased my calories myself.

Just started using this a few days ago but before this I never used to count calories like pre-workouts and other supplements- super helpful to have that tracked. So far everything I've had I've been able to scan with their barcode scanner so real quick to log everything. Couple days in but really like the app so far.

Algorithm is messed up. I'm on a strict 1330 calorie limit which should be losing 2 lbs a week (according to the app) and I ALWAYS eat under that calorie amount by at least 300. But for some reason whenever I finish logging for the day and I click the button on the bottom, it ADDS days to my estimated weight loss goal... what the heck is that about? If I'm eating less than I'm "supposed to" for losing weight, why is it adding more days. I wouldnt mind if it stayed steady but that cant be right..

Overall the app is great so good in fact I paid to upgrade my plan to the premium version. I did notice a bug in the premium version though, I switched my plan to a fixed calorie intake and it broke my goal and made the options for maintain/lose lbs per week grayed out. Switching to a default plan let me change it back to losing 2 lbs and then switching it to fixed kept it locked to that but it took some trial and error.

Great app--easy to use and keep track of calories and exercise. Makes it easy to lose weight slowly without feeling hungry by giving you calorie targets based on weight and activity level and adjusting calories down as you lose weight. I have been on almost every diet out there and this has been the easiest and most successful--I have lost 45 pounds.

This is the best health tracking app I have ever found. When you start free, you get offers for great discounts on the annual premium subscription. After I used it for a few months, I accepted one, and then got a New Years offer for lifetime, and accepted that too. I don't generally pay for things like this but I believe Lose It is entirely worth it if you want to seriously track your well being.

I have the basic and love it. It does what I need. I log and I track....weight, calories, and exercise. The barcode scan is dead on every time. Not once has it failed. I've tried other apps and the scans are "iffy". Once I have an item in there it's easily pulled up again. Very user friendly.

I downloaded this to try after I lost the one I had. I don't see how people could lose weight or get an accurate count of calories. Since you can't put in the weight of what you are eating. For example it says one potato that can have a wide ranging numbers of calories which can be from .5 pounds to almost 2 pounds.

This app is brilliant! I absolutely love it. I've used several different calorie tacking apps and this is by far the best. So far everything I have scanned has been recognised and the calories have been correct according to the packets listing. This is not always the case with other apps. I love the little pictures that appear next to the food too. Plus you are able to see at a glance exactly what you have logged without having to navigate too far. No glitches either. Highly recommend, thank you

This app showed me I could reach my desired weight that I have chosen for now, by Oct 11th, and that gave me hope! To see where I can get with some help like this has highly motivated me!!! I have been on this app for only 5 days and have already lost almost 1lb. I don't like diets, so this app allows me to eat what I want but be accountable for the portion sizes I'm eating. I didn't realize the calories I was taking in before I started using this app.

Updating my review. Recently re installed and almost all of the previous free features are only available for premium. Kinda sucks. Uninstalling and unfortunately, removing my 5 star review. —--------- Love this..the ability to log all of my food items along with my weight and exercise on my phone is so convenient.

Lose it helped me lose 72lbs in 8 months(mid 2017 to 2018) . I recently just had a baby in 2019 and am back using the app because it worked so well the first time. Absolutely love this app! It's easy to use, learns from your inputs, and gives results! Love that it gives you little badges along the way and the app reminds you to log. Will forever use this app and recommend it to others. ( recently just convinced my husband to start using it). :)

It used to be good but is now a mess and I have cancelled my subscription. So many inaccurate food entries in the repositories. No ability to track micronutrients (which are extremely essential for weight loss because they can influence how hungry you are while in a caloric deficit), and The barcode scanner barely works.

Very good for logging calories. I've lost weight by keeping myself honest. Some of the data for exercise looks a little iffy... (1700 calories burned hiking 6 miles?? Maybe if I'm going straight up a cliff the entire time). And be sure to turn the security level up or you will be buried in spam.

I love this app, it has everything that other apps lack. I used My Fitness Pal for years and this is better by far in functionality and reliability. I do wish there was a counter for vitamin content and actual nutrition outside of protein, fiber, fats and carbs. but I really enjoy this app by far more than the others.

I only use to log food and exercise but this is by far one of the easiest calorie counters I've used. I can find every food quickly and easily so far, which makes logging quick so I can do it right then and there rather than waiting till I get time to find everything. So far, I love it.

I've been using Lose it for years! I love this app! It helps you to track your daily food intake and exercises. I have an issue with overeating and it helps me to regulate how much I eat for each meal ensuring I workout with the right food intake to reach my goals. Definitely one of the best apps out there!!!

I have been going in circles to stop auto renewal of the membership EVEN cancelling your account does not prevent the app from withdrawing the funds from my bank account. I have gone through numerous directions to stop that from happening by going to subscriptions in google play but none of it worked. It feels like its made so difficult to keep your money which is unfortunate.

It costs to see your macronutrients (such as protein). I don't remember it costing in the past. I came back after many years of using Lose It! On and off and it has been my go to for over 10 years, but not paying for basic features when it's free on apps that are just as good.

Great support team - I had an issue with logging ingredients that weren't then showing in my recipe. Nik, one of the engineers has work hard to resolve the issue which I'm really grateful for. Thank you. I have to say the Lose It app is really good for logging my Keto daily meals and I've managed to lose 35lbs in 5 months - it really has become my way of life and the app has enabled me to create regular recipes and ingredients to help me in my Keto journey.

Purchased premium in app via ad for lifetime access w/o yearly subscription. Logged in and saw yearly renewal date. Reached out to dev for clarification and eventually refund, haven't heard back. Tried to refund via Google within the 48 hrs, but they are useless. They keep replying with a canned response about my request not satisfying their terms and conditions, but don't list the terms. This app is also available via ios through a diff developer. App is sketchy when you Compare the 2 sites.

I loved this app until recently. Every single time I open the app to add a food, it pops up asking if I want to pay for premium. There's no way i'm paying an annual fee to use a calorie counting app. I don't mind the occasional reminder about premium services but you guys are ridiculously excessive in asking.

Relatively easy to use. The free version is actually enough to help keep you on track and gives enough basic information to improve. I love that you can put in custom foods and recipes! The full version also doesnt seem like it will break the bank (which i will be purchasing soon!)

Overall a really useful, somewhat intuitive, app for logging and tracking. Like that it provides past examples of meals for faster, easier logging but it doesn't always do that, so temperamental in that regard, hence the 4 stars. Has been a great help to keep me on track.

This App is AMAZING!! 😍I have had it for a couple of months and it really works. I lost over 20 pounds in a couple of months! I HIGHLY recommend this app to everyone. It has changed my life dramatically, and it will for you too. Yes sometimes I do slack off, but the app keeps me motivate to jump right back on track! 😊 Again, this app is AMAZING!!

Used to be good, I used this app for a long time. It was actually recommended by a doctor, because while it had some pay features it had enough for free. He especially liked the barcode feature. Having to pay to use a feature that was free isn't worth it. I'm letting my doctor know to stop reccomending this app too. After years of use I'm switching to a different app.

Have lost 2st so far, it's made counting calories so much easier. I don't think I could have kept up and got this far otherwise. It took some getting used to, but do persist! Lost a star as I feel the navigation and interface could be better, I'd like to easily view or find certain things (e.g photos) but it doesn't seem possible.

love this app so far!! used fitness pal for years and they decided to put scanning a bar code into their premium which used to be free. so the scanning of the barcode got me looking for another fitness/calorie tracking app and found the Lose it app so happy I did! Very user friendly -scanning barcodes and easy to navigate-very affordable upgrade. so far very happy with this site!! thank u!!

Food is either in weight/volume OR serving size, making it extremely inconvenient if you want the opposite type e.g. you had half a serve but it's recorded as weight or you had X grams but it's recorded in serves. Either way you have to do math to get the correct portion size. Other apps such as MyFitnessPal record weight per serve meaning you can use either option for every food.

This is a good app. There are ads, but they are unobtrusive and don't hurt the core functionality of the app. It does not overcomplicate things and it tells you only the most relevant information (calories and macros, saturated fat, fiber, etc). One thing I don't like about this app is that the macros don't correctly add up to the calorie amount for some of the use contributed items.

I saw this in the app store, and figured I might try to switch from MyFitnessPal to this one if it was better. The user interface is all right, it seems pretty easy to use and has potential. However, they paywall all of the features that you want in a calorie counter. I have a Fitbit and I usually connect it to my calorie counters, such as MyFitnessPal. However you can't do that unless you have their premium membership. This is a free feature in most other calorie counters, which ruins this app

Like the app. As to improvements. It.would be great to see.what foods.also impact sugar, colesterol and other health issues. To try to either change food products or better choices and solutions. Feel its missing that. Not to replace a doctor or nutritionist. But would also aid in letting each user add to the conversation. So the doctor or nutritionist can back up these points as well and why. While each user is on there health and weight loss journey.

I had a discount on noom to pay 260 annually and I couldn't even implement my own recipes. On this app I can implement my own recipes but also add the nutritional information to items not in its inventory. I just added some spaghetti noodles from a brand I like and my homemade bolonese sauce into recipes. Tracking my protein, carbs and fat for one day like normal has already shown me the huge gaps I have in my nutrition. 10/10 worth the 40 annual price.

I loved this app and have used it in the past. Its easy to imput data and track everything in 1 place. Low star rating is due to the fact that I have to constantly click "no thank you" to their ads and "get premium" pop ups. If I wanted to pay for the app I would, but to keep harrassing me with a premium pop up every single time I log in is just ridiculous. I can't even pair my Fitbit without paying for the app? Really? Time to find a new and better app

I absolutely love this app. I don't plan on ever using anything else. It gives you forums for you can have groups that fit your goals. You can record your food intake and it's very detailed. If you pay for premium membership, which I do recommend, you can get recipes and more detailed results

Iv been using this app for a while but more recently started to get serious with it, I have lost 70 pounds so far and am very grateful for this app for it, premium is a but to much to drop all at once for me but the free version works well enough for me. Smooth interface, easy to use and set up. I recommend this to my friends all the time.

Awesome app! Great tool if you are serious about losing weight quickly. A real eye-opener when you start logging nutritional information about the foods you have been eating. I have lost 8 lbs in 10 days by changing my eating habits and tracking calories. My goal when I started using this app was to lose 40 lbs. I am already 20% there. At this rate I will achieve it in another 40 days!!!

If you want to lose wait yet still crave for favorite snacks this app will help you limit your intake. Also, this app guides me to keep track of the food I take everyday. You'll be able to have the result of your proteins, carbs, and fats for the day. Above all, the free version is already a big hand how much more the premuim, right?

Great app, fair price. I waited half a day to sign up for premium, so they dropped the price from $39.99/yr to $19.99/yr. A year worth of tracking for the price of a month with the blue app with wrong food info. Please add potassium to nutrients tracked. We should get between 3500-4700mg/day from whole foods. I like Lose It's UI better than Cronometer, but they'll get my renewal bc they track potassium when y'all don't.

I thought I'd read that there was a free version that I could play with until I decided to buy. There is none; only a 7 day trial. For those of us that take more than a week to really test an app, the only option is to go ahead and subscribe. There's also no monthly subscription, so I would have to pay for a year before I know if I want to keep it. Decided to quit and uninstall instead; it's really not good enough for that kind of commitment.

My husband and I started using this app and love it! Its easy to use and really makes you aware of everything you put in your mouth and what activities actually help burn your calories. I was writing everything down in a small notebook and it took a long tedious time. I just scan the barcode on almost everything.

Great app, sucks that some features I would like to have are locked behind a premium purchase. One thing I would like to see is at the end of your day, if you forget to press "done logging" then you can go back the next day to say you finished logging. This would be helpful because I usually forget to press it during the night when I'm tired, and I cant maintain a streak like it wants me to. That's the only downside I really see.

I love this affordable app. It does everything with me and for me. The database has a plethora of foods and easily incorporated my scanned foods. I love that it is not overbearing but is sufficient. I wanted simplicity, functionality, efficient but fun-bullseye! It is that and more. I didn't have to study how to use it. Well done. The interface is user-friendly without insulting, and the colors are uplifting. I say- Thank you!

Was good but now the recipes section seems to be bugged. It's now unusable as no matter what number of servings you put into the recipe, on the food log 1 serving = original calorie amount. Waited for the past couple of updates in the hope it is fixed but now uninstalled as I was using fractions of servings to get the correct amount. I'll keep checking back on the hope it is fixed soon

10/10 app, Don't be turned off by the fact there is a paid subscription, it is for people who want the advice part of losing weight. This app is literally what it says, a calorie counter, you put in calories, and take out calories. Even if you are looking to lose something small like 5 pounds, get this app, it is amazing at small and large weight loss. I've personally lost over 50 pounds since I started using the apps calorie limit. get. This. App.

Like the app but recently I have entered a meal and after saving each item click on done to find out it did not save anything. Very frustrating. I have an annual subscription that has worked great for a few months and now blah... I'll keep going but this is frustrating.

Intrusive ads that take up the whole screen when you try to put in a meal? I close the app and come back. I don't mind the small ads in-between segments that take up only a fraction of the screen, but since the newest update, the fullscreen ads are too much. I've been using this app since 2018, and it's definitely put a sour taste in my mouth how hard you're pushing for people to pay for the service. No thanks.

Been using this application for 2 years as a paid subscriber and it seems like the quality keeps degrading. The application is not as quick and snappy as it used to be. For example when tracking water consumption you need to wait about 1 second between clicking each 8oz glass of water icon, before there was no delay. It also had a graph of your daily weight loss/gain. I lost 25 lbs over 4 months and it was very easy. It also has a maintenance feature once you reach your goal

This app is just what I needed. I tried about 3 others and NONE of them are as easy to use as this one. I upgraded to premium...love it even more. Track your food, your water, blood sugars, sleep, blood pressure, fat, carbs. When I see my Dr, I open the app and show her all of my health points for the past few weeks. Great app !!

Great app! Lost 30lbs in a little over 90 days just by paying attention to what I eat and eating right by logging it with this app, didn't even workout, just eating properly did it. I'm now working out though for muscle growth. Highly recommend this app to keep you on track and aware of what you're eating.

Lose It helps me to hold myself accountable, and I like the fact I can receive badges as rewards for my progress. I can keep track of my calorie intake, carbs, and much more. This app helps me keep track of my weight loss, or weight gain, and the calories I'm burning in exercise. I also like the fact I link this app to Google Fit, and other health apps. So, far I have lost over 100lbs.

Awesome app! I have been using this app since 2018 and had significant results, lost over 60lbs. You have to be serious about logging in your food if you want to see results, this app has all the tools and resources you need to monitor your calorie intake, workout calorie burn, and food logging. I often recommend this app to friends.

The program enables me to track not only calories, but to customize it to track what is important to me. One other commented it kept them on day zero, but I found if I click the done tracking for each day, it keeps track if each day and let's me know where I am with days tracked.

The app is nice to track the calories intake, if you are using basic version, you will see some ads showing inside the app which is totally fine with me. But what I noticed that is you are trying to use the app to control ur calories intake or weight lost, the ads is throwing you bunches of mcdonalds pictures...lol...what a day...

I've been using Lose It on and off over the past 1 year now and it helps me keep track of my workouts and calories. It takes discipline to record your food intake, calories and workouts through this app. Obviously, you have to those yourself onto the app but once you achieve your goal, all you need is to scroll back to the day you started instead of writing down your workouts, food intake and calories burned on a notebook.

Signed up for free trial and suddenly was asked for payment. I didn't like the recording method and deleted the app the next day, well before the cancelation policy. My money's gone and apparently there are no returns??? Very disappointed in getting sucked in to this scam!

The app is great, you can use UPC codes to log food info, and data base is extensive. User friendly interface for the most part. Lots of social contact and support is also available. I do wish they wouldn't ask quite so often if I would like to go "Premium".

Great App not that MFP have removed their barcode scanner. Will be paying for pro on here however an issue that bugs me is not being able to log tomorrows food. I like to plan what I'm having and log before I eat so I know what I can have extra. But apart from that - keep up the good work

Love it! So easy! Can't believe how much is in the library of products! This is the first calorie counter app I've used. Love how it adds up calories in several different ways: by meal, by day, total consumed, total left. Very happy with this app!

The app used to be good. The free version used to let you track macros and calorie intake, but as of recently that became a premium feature. I cant reccomend a product that takes away features to used to be free to gate behind a paywall. Find another app to help you track. Avoid this one!

Two months ago I contacted Loseit about the app kicking me out every time I scrolled to log snacks and exercise. They seemed like they wanted to help. They told me to send them a log next time it happened and I did so. They said they would try to fix the problem but never did. I'm uninstalling this app. It was great whole it lasted which is why I gave it two stars instead of one.

This was a fantastic app until they are now charging for features that were once free...like scanning barcodes. I do not like having to be "forced" to pay for a subscription to receive the same service that has been provided for free for years prior.

This app is a beauty! I've used it many times in the past to lose 5-10 lbs and every time I use it, I lose weight within a few short weeks too. I'm sticking with it this time and will not settle until I reach even greater goals! Eat what you want, no special diets...just keep track of what you put in your yap- it's that easy

This would be five stars if it wasn't for the fact that there is no option for sugar alcohols in the nutritional information. That has a huge impact on the net carbs of a food. When can we expect that slot to be added into nutritional information. It does no good to pay for the premium and be able to track net carbs if the app lacks the ability to properly calculate them.

This is new to me, my pastor's wife told me about it. You can be certain that I will pass it on. My 3rd day since downloading the app and I am well pleased. I love the way it reminds me to log, and keeps track of calories I take in and how many I have left. I can eat, stay full and do it with no guilt. Yes I LOVE this app, and will love to see others find satisfaction in it also.

This really helps me be aware of what I'm eating. There are tons of pre-loaded foods and you can even import a link for a recipe and it will calculate the nutritional value. Very handy! Sets reminders for intermittent fasting, too. The only drawback for me is that even though it pulls sleep data and steps from my Fitbit, it doesn't pull my exercise info. Overall, for $40 a year, this is very comprehensive and helpful. Would recommend!

Such a pity what has happened with this app. People managing this app are a bit ungrateful for all the people that helped growing the database with all the foods they filled out (both manual and scanned) while the app was still in the beginning and growing. I've been using this app for quite a few years and now i regret i've even downloaded it in the first place.. If only i had known that they would charge us for simple scanning of the food barcode.. Time to look elsewhere..

100% better the MFP and WW. It's much more user friendly and has better features. I upgraded to the premium because it was actually affordable. It allows you to break down calorie goals by meal which is exactly what I needed and I didn't even know it. Now I'm starting to eat smaller meals throughout the day and starting to feel better.

Loved it until lately. Now I'm getting reminders to log even though I've already done it, and every time I open the app and start to log I'm getting taken across to a different tab partway through what I'm doing to try and force premium down my throat. I get that you need business but it's not going to happen. Please ease off!

I love this app. I have used it for more than 2000 days and have lost over 30kg. The only problem I have is when searching for something and you select that food and for some reason its not what you wanted it jumps back straight to the top so you have to scroll through everything again. I would also to have a filter option in the search bar to only show items with grams or ml.

Initially I was impressed with this app. Easy to keep track of your calories, protein, carbs and fat intake. Huge library of foods to make it simple. It gives you a daily calorie budget along with a target date that you should hit your goal. Simple calculation you would think. losing weight is all about a calorie deficit. I come in under budget every day and my target gets moved out every single day. It should be the opposite.

I would chose this app over MyFitnessPal and Simple Macro and the Fitbit app for calorie recording every single time. Tje database is vast and there are so many options for customisation and personal goal setting. This is not a weightloss app, its a lifestyle app. Even if you are fit, there are things in this app to benefit you too. The recipe datasbase for example, or even the health based DNA testing. This is a brilliantly helpful app.

This app is my favorite, I've lost over 40lbs and it continues to help me and keep me motivated, and it's fun! I was close to buying it when it was 50% but I'm just not into buying apps with recurring payments. Make a life time purchase option and I'll be onboard to support you guys. ♥

Great app, I use premium and its great. Only thing is when I scan a food item, sometimes the nutrition information is wrong, and when i go to change the mistakes, it wont save, so i have to create a whole new food. Gets a little irritating when im trying something new.

I've used the desktop version of myfitnesspal for years and did not like the free version of the app. This app has all the features I need and I really like the design. The notifications are helpful and not annoying. For me, they keep me on track. It's very painless to log, there is a streak counter, and badges. It really works for me, thank you!

What an amazing app!! I am trying the free version and counting calories have never been easier! It works perfect for a low calorie diet, and it allows you to enter the calories you burn through exercise as well. Besides the fact that it tells you how many calories to eat in each meal, it cannot be any easier. You can even scan the barcode of the food and it will tell you the calories in it. I love it!!!

Honestly I've already lost a couple pounds in 1 week of having this app I use the free part and it works for me . You can always write down your water in take and other stuff . I love that it has alot of food options already in the cache so it's not hard to put in . It even gives you the option to take a picture of the nutritional facts so you don't have to type then in . Last but not least the app gives you fitness ideas and there super easy to log in . Thanks so much lose it !!!

I was trying this app in order to switch from myfitnesspall but I found that barcode reading is far to inferior and also snap it doesn't work, It recognises the food correctly but it doesn't allow you to select it in order to add it in a meal. I like the UI better than myfitnesspall but the overall usability, stability and food database of myfitnesspall is far superior.

Using it for a couple of days, and still using it for the moment but it has a couple of problems I've noticed. 1) the barcode scanner does not focus the phone camera, so it can never scan any barcodes because the focus is always blurry. Auto-focus works on other apps, just not LoseIt. 2) the app is quite laggy just scrolling around, for some reason. Not doing anything special at all, just scrolling in the main screen. This should have no reason to be slow.

Great database, extra star for the bar code scanner. I tried the free version for a while and now I upgraded to premium. I'm on keto so tracking the net carbs was the useful thing. Their most recent update seem to have upset the net carb tracker, which hasn't worked since Wednesday or Thursday. I have written to the help desk, I hope to hear back.

I love this app as in my opinion it more motivating and supportive than my fitness pal. There's a social forum where everyone can share their weight loss progress and that motivates me to stay on track. I also like the scanning function to add food as it saves me so much time and the database is huge. Not to mention it syncs with my Withings Body+ scale and Google Fit nicely.

Love the look and the colors and how easy it is to use. Also great to use the scan code to svan products. However, lots of glitches. I can't change the calories to what I want unless I change it daily. I can't seem to set a new weight loss goal. I can't add exercises I do often to my list of exercises (nor does it add it automatically).

I love this app, but there is something glitchy going on. I have the premium version. I search for a food and select one to fully review the nutrition and serving info. Decide against that one so go back to choose a different one, but the list reset. I then have to re-type and re-search the item. Huge headache.

Recent changes to this app changed the free version from a decent tool to use, to a painful experience. The adds used to come after adding your food. Now you start to type a search and part way into a word, an add starts. I don't mind adds for the free version, but this is ridiculous.

I use the free version of this app and I understand there must be ads to support the work that goes into this useful app. What I don't like is being served ads (hello Carmax) that run longer than a major motion picture or ads in a foreign language (Facebook in Spanish) that will only close if you shut the app and restart it. It's very annoying for this to happen when you're trying to log your food. It ruins what is an otherwise excellent app.

Did well for a while but recently it's gotten wrong information and it's not tracking my calories burned from google fit. So frustrating because I really like this app, and I've used it for like a year but I don't want to upgrade and pay on an app that's got incorrect nutrition data saved and also is glitchy..idk whether to try a new app or wait and see if the issues get resolved.

This app is user friendly, connects to my fitness tracker fluidly (Google fit) The food log is essential! Has great tips, recipes, work out routines,the email articles are such an awesome tool, I tried Noom and prefer this one and at a quarter of the price! A must for anyone who want to track their health, and keep themselves accountable! Weight loss is easy with this app!

It's really been excellent for counting calories. But I don't understand why app keeps telling me it's tracking me but then won't give me a forecast. App keeps telling me I still haven't gotten to seven days to get a projected forecast (when I will lose the weight) when I've already been using the app for WEEKS. What's up with that?

If you think the often unskippable full screen ads are going to get me to buy a subscription you thought wrong. If anything it will make me use a different app. I won't give this app 1 star, it helped me lose over 100 pounds. It's very disappointing to see what was once an incredibly useful app go down such a dark path.

Used to be fantastic but just like YouTube, Spotify, and other popular apps these days you can't even open the app without seeing the same popup asking you to sign up for Premium. No means no... I don't need to be asked every day! Going to find a calorie tracker without the hard sell integrated

Lose It! is an easy to use calorie tracker with a huge existing data base and the ability for you to scan bar codes on products for immediate nutritional information. In addition to counting calories, it factors in how much you are burning through daily activity and calculates that into your daily caloric needs. I highly recommend this very useful tool!

I've been using this app on and off for years. One year I paid for premium and many of the features didn't even work after I paid. The app would just crash. I've slowly watched everything go behind a pay wall. Now even the barcode scanner is behind a pay wall. I'd rather pen and paper track at this point.

A buggy mess, I regret buying premium. Crashes if the camera for scanning food is open for more than 3s. Fitbit integration: it gets wrong number of calories burned, 871 on fitbit, loseit got 1492?!? Also it did not sync exercise log. Fails to sync to Withings scale and doesn't download historical data or update when you weigh yourself, a lot of manual syncing required... Editing recipe doesn't update calories when adding to log until restart of app. Dashboard doesn't have a simple weight graph

Same as my fitness pal. Ruined behind a pay wall. Started great, with access to the barcode scanner and options, and now bombards with asking you to upgrade with nearly everything locked, barcode scanner included. The very reason why I started using this app in the first place... Moving on...

Tried other apps like MFP, Carb Manager, and Chronometer and the most easy to customize, add your food and scan Canadian bar codes was Lose It. You can log lots of extra stats as blood pressure info and body measurements! Such chest, hip, waist, hip etc. Very clean interface and cheaper than the other apps. The only con is that it doesn't connect to Samsung Health to get info, but it sync nicely with Fitbit.

I'm really enjoying the app. I love that I can do 16/8 fasting and calorie counting in the same app, and link my fitbit too! I have signed up to Premier membership, but it was a very reasonable price. I'm from UK and the database is fab. I would say this is the best cc app I've found so far.

This app is great for keeping on track with your diet. My only problem with it is that they need to update the restaurant foods periodically. What shows up in the app are a lot of outdated menu items, and I feel like I need to guess what might match the item I want to log. I still love the app and will continue to use. That would just be helpful.

After a decade of trying to lose weight by other means, I've now lost 35 pounds in just 4 months using Lose It! And I'm confident it will take me all the way down to my target. The barcode scanner is wonderful and the database of foods and calories it already has is very helpful and convenient.

Free app was very good 5 stars . My rating of 3 is based on the upgrade to premium. This is virtually same as free app but with lots of extra health conscious stuff but most of its readily available anyway. My gripe is the link to fitbit, it's weak to say the least. You have to force the sync, no auto. And the info like exercises isn't auto logged either. I personally would not have upgraded if I had trialled premium first. 😔

Great app but I have a constant glitch with the steps, it reads like thousands of steps over my Google fit app and there's no way of editing or fixing that so it automatically discounts calories from my day that I definitely did not earn. It kind of makes me feel like I'm cheating and is making me lose my motivation due to the inaccuracies. :/

Super easy to use with a lot of great options even on free including adding excercise. Finding food options is easy but is a little messy with how many different entries there are from others constantly entering. It could be cleaned up a little. There is a barcode scanner though and it tells you if something is a verified entry.

I really like this app. The only issue I have is when saving a recipe and then trying to use it, it gives me all the servings of said recipe instead of just 1 and then my calorie count is WAY up there when it should only show the 1 serving i actually had (ex: I made a tuna salad and saved the recipe into the app it came out to 1,742 calories for 7 servings. I went to log in 1 serving and it's loging all 7 servings instead of just the 1)

I have been using this app for a couple of months and have lost 16 pounds. The reason for the 3 stars is I just paid to upgrade to premium to access the the meal plans to reach my goals a little easier...however they arent working. I cant access them. It wont give me an option to update so I'm highly disappointed and feel like I just wasted my money. hope this gets fixed soon :(

So much better than my fitness pal. I like that it tells me how many calories I can scan food for free on this and it has an option of you paying for another part but you don't have to and you still get so many benefits from this and it actually tells you how many calories you should eat for breakfast, lunch and dinner and snacks like it's great to make sure that you're getting your calories properly. This is gonna be my favorite app. Honestly I picture myself easily losing weight with this

Great app, with just a few shortcomings: - Lack of integration with Samsung Health (currently using, as a workaround, a sync app to get my data to Google Fit and intergrating with that) - Wish I would be able to set some default preferences when searching for food (i.e. just don't show results that don't have protein or don't have grams as a unit) PS: Love the meal sharing option <3

I can't get Lose It to sync with Google Fit. When I try to contact support using the link supplied, an error message is returned ("not found"). I bought a Premium subscription thinking this would fix the problem but it didn't. The settings are correct for connecting Lose It to Google Fit. Almost ready to ask for a refund and use a different app.

great app! I really like it a lot. I would give it 5 stars, but something happened in the latest upgrade and keeps telling me it needs me to log 7 straight days in order to provide a more accurate estimate as to when I'll reach my weight loss goal, even though I've been using the app for about 2 months every day.

Have been using this for a several years and it was great up until the past week. Within the past week the barcode scanner stopped working. I rely on it several times a day & this a total bummer. This app helps me plan my days/weeks menus & keeps me on track. It is a great tool when it works. If they fix the scanner, this app will b upgraded to 5 stars.

Good luck sorting through thousands of options for the exact same food item because they won't control that s*** and let anybody post their own items to the list. Infinitely better than my fitness pal still, but you're honestly better off just reading labels and applying common sense to your portion sizes. This is too much time and effort with needless bloat based on outdated nutrition science and motivational bulls***.

So I was using "MyFitness Pal" prior to "Lose It!" and I gotta say...happy I made the switch! It's all about user-friendliness from me, and this app outshines that one in almost every way in that category. The only reason it's missing a star is because I miss the way MyFitness would give me a little nutrition alert when I logged a food if a food was really good, really bad, helped me hit a goal or pushed me in the wrong direction. That added to the food logging would be AMAZING.

It Works ! Lose It, helps you to really think about and plan your meals. The best part is everything is on the menu. You can eat whatever you want, just in moderation. If you splurge a little, just eat lighter for your next meal to stay on track. I'm down 12 lbs in 3 weeks, trying to stick to around 1300 calories per day. My prior intake was at least double that. Exercise is also key, walking for 30 minutes to an hour 3 or 4 days a week helps to burn significant calories.

I love the app. But I've had the small problems that drive me crazy. All of a sudden every couple of days I no longer can get to my groups app it shuts off the app when I try to tap on it. Now my steps are not being automatically recorded. I'd love to know why that's happening. Cancelled the app and reloaded it and it still giving me a problem as far as the steps.

Really great app for recording food and keeping a count of calories, fat, protein and carbs. One extra that would be good is, if as well as each individual meal having a calorie count total there could be a count for protein, fat and carbs as well. Have not upgraded to the pay feature. ** thanks for reply and the tip, works a treat

I cancelled the trial on the 7th day but still got charged the annual fee. unfortunately I didnt find out I never got my refund til a month later. Went online to find out why and turns out if you paid via google play, you need to cancel at least 24 hours before the trial is supposed to end. So if you dont want to get charge, you need to cancel on day 6. That 7-day free trial is deceiving. Edit: I checked my order history again. Installed on Feb 3rd, got charge on Feb 9th.

Overall I really love this app. I have been using it for several years and it's had some really awesome updates. I just wish there was an option to be able to set different calorie goals per day because it would help with calorie cycling. Other than that this app is absolutely awesome and I have recommended it to multiple people I know. Thanks Lose It team! You all are awesome, keep up the great work!

App Glitching Since Last Update! App usually works great but since the last update, it has a glitch now. I have my calories set to a fixed budget of 1800 a day and as of today for some reason, the app automatically adjusted it to 900. When I go to settings to change it back, it's stuck at 900 and won't allow me to adjust it. There is obviously a bug with the update that I hope they address soon. I will change my review once they address this problem. Hopefully sooner than later.

This app is very intuitive. It is so easy to get started. I started by tracking what I was normally eating. Needless to say, I was a little shocked at what my average calorie intake totalled. Now I have the app set to help me lose 2 lbs per week and it's working! I enjoy the support groups as well. It's good to know that others are struggling with the same issues. I find that very motivating. I expect that I will be a longtime user of Lose It, even after I reach my goal weight.

Great app for beginners. Referred my friends. Wish I could track my period on it because it impacts diet, weight and mood. Mood is important for mindful eating. I've been using notes to track my period but a goal might be better to see over a period of time or something like that to track when you get it.

Love this app. So easy to find foods so that you can track calories. If you can't find a food they have a scanner you can use and the calories pop right up...so convenient. I also love that I can weigh weekly and it tracks my progress by date. It helped me set the correct amount of calories to eat. LOVE THIS APP!

I have used this app for years but in the last couple of days a bug has meant even when i enter a weight it will come up differently on the chart as well as on the wrong day. I cant set new goals as it keeps reverting back to whatever goal i was on before and it has become overall so frustrating ive cancelled my membership and uninstalled. Would re install if issues were fixed as i loved it

The app is relatively easy to use. There are many foods and food chains that are already entered, and you have the ability to add new ones as well. I just wish when you search for foods and click to find more information on one, that when you back out to the previous menu, you don't start back at the beginning of the list again. There are many foods with no or minimal nutritional content listed and I hate having to start back at the top of the list when I'm looking to add new foods.

Pretty nice interface BUT a lot of integration like joining fitbit information to LoseIt requires a subscription to their premium service. For $2.50 a month, that's not a bad deal however every time I click on the upgrade option it tells me there was an error on their end, so I can't subscribe even if I wanted to.

I tried to input my email to log in, got the wrong password. So I request a change, but no email to change was present. Try this three or four times, give up. So I use a secondary email and try to login with a made-up password. Would you look at the words on the screen and it says "Account already exist." That's strange because the secondary email never used the app or the company before.

The first week/couple of days I lost 5 pounds!! But I haven't been consistent either. If you are consistent l believe it Works. The program is AWESOME! I just like my wines too much...not an Alcoholic but I drink too much wine to be totally committed. I will continue to Us the application because I can still watch my calories on foods. ☺

The app typically works well and does as it's designed with little hassle. However, it's frequently prone to bugs. Currently, the barcode scanning function just shuts the app down repeatedly and every time, not registering food item and necessitating relaunch of the app. Makes logging new foods inconvenient, as you have to then manually search after reopening app. Fix the bug, I'll fix the rating.

Switched from MFP when they started charging for the scanner. I don't know why I didn't switch sooner! The only feature from MFP that I do miss is importing recipes. Love this app! The DNA upload tool doesn't seem to let you upload the file anywhere so hopefully they get that fixed soon.

It's a really great app for tracking calories and weight, if you get the premium which I think is a fair price it tracks your macro and micro nutrients as well, and it gives reasonable expectations for your journey. Pair this with a fitbit and a plan from a nutritionist and theres nothing you cant do :)

Update: I used the paid version and this app is beyond amazing. Yesterday the app did go haywire. It started forcing closed everytime I tried to open it then the day tracking defaulted to zero and I got very very flustered. Aside from these two issues that the developers are fixing, I do love this app. I lost 20 pounds, left the app feeling accomplished for about a year, and came back and already have lost 5 more pounds in a week. It gives you habits that stick with with. I recommend 100%.

This is such a great app! It is an all-in-one app and is very user-friendly. My only complaint is the email notifications. It would be fabulous if you could get in-app notifications instead so that you do not receive a hundred emails in a week. --------------------------------------------------------- Unfortunately the above is still an issue

I have used both MFP and Lose It and prefer Lose It because I think it has a better interface, is easier to log, and has nice motivating features like logging and graphing your own data like blood pressure, body fat %, and other custom things you can enter yourself. MFP feels like a singles hangout sometimes. Lose It does not.

I wish there was a way to combine scans of foods. Like if one you make a recipe you can scan in the ingredients or input the ingredients instead of have to add the stuff up outside the app and then inputting the final nutritional values. Other than that the app is great at keeping me accountable and making sure I log in everyday.

This app makes it simple to monitor your calorie intake as well as exercise for the beginner. Its great because you really can eat what you want as long as you stay below your budget. Lots of great tools in t know is app even if weightloss is t your goal and you just want to eat healthier.

This app is great! I am totally taken by the awesome features this app has, like tracking exactly how many calories you are taking every day, setting up a goal for you and syncing your exercises seamlessly with google fit. Another exciting feature is the barcode scanner that makes calorie tracking easier than a breeze! Its my first week using this app and I am already in love! Great job, developers, for understanding precisely what I needed!

I was hesitant to take the leap and start tracking at first. Especially when the reviews of other apps said they kept pushing the premium version. This app does not pressure you at all. Sure there are features only available with premium but if youre just after a simple calorie tracker and arent after syncing it to a fit device this works perfectly. 5 stars

awesome application helps alot and can find any food you can imagine or u can scan the barcode of the food item to import its nutritional info which is amazing. one note i have is that sometimes when i add calories with inserting the food type, i cant label it with a name, I wish this small adjustment is done! otherwise, its awesome

Please stop the popups. Just please stop. I understand you guys need money to eat and survive or whatever else, but I am not interested in your upgraded services. I understand that if I ever need your paid services, I know where to find them and pay for them. But please just STOP with the constant f***ing reminders and popups. This would be a 5 star app if it weren't for the constant reminders, but as a result if I ever need the paid services I'll be going to a competitor instead. STOP BEGGING.

I want to give a full 5 stars, and I will once the issue is fixed. I've been using Lose It for about a year now and love it. It's so easy to track food and keep within your daily goals. But as of yesterday, the app crashes every time I try to open it. I've uninstalled and reinstalled the app, and nothing helps. Please fix!

Very easy to use, has helped me maintain my weight and helped my other friend drop 2 pounds a week! The app is also very supportive with notifications. Logging food is extremely easy since they have everything I've scanned in there (including Wegmans Ultimate Chocolate Cake). Very impressed overall.

Worked great at first, so great I decide to buy a year of premium but then before the end of the first month it randomly broke. Now the app crashes on start, I've tried update, restarting my phone and even resorting to reinstalling which seemed to have fixed to issue at first, but as soon as I log into my account, the issue reimerges.

Great free app to manage calorie deficit for weight loss and weight maintenance IF USED IN A HEALTHY WAY. Do not use the exercise option. It adds calories back and any good nutritionist will tell you that's not how it works. Doesn't make sense anyway since it asks for amount of exercise as part of calorie calculation at the start. It also suggests daily weighing which is a no no. That's just asking for an eating disorder. I've lost that last stubborn 5 lbs and will now use this for maintenance.

Leaving money on the table by not offering a monthly pay option. if its $20 a year with current offer maybe offer the monthly for $2.99? Alao maybe offer a 7 day trial of premium. put me on the team!

So far the best thing that has helped me lose weight. This app has every food and its nutrition. What I like, if for some reason the food isnt there you can customize it. What has helped me lose weight is that I will put in the ingredients to the dish im making for my meal and I then I will make it so I know exactly the calories I am consuming every meal. Honestly wish I can give one hundred stars, I have lost 30lbs and its proof looking at my history! Just have to stay dedicated,Thank You!
Best Calorie Tracking App I've ever downloaded. My experience has been so successful. I love the reminders when I forget to track. It certainly keeps me on track.
Finally! A database of calories for foods. Now I look at food differently; I find myself asking if I really want to spend my calories on that, or save them for dinner.

New goals tab is a horrible layout. I've been using Lose It! for 3 years and the main goal - weight - used to be shown with an extrapolated line to visualize your goal date. Now the goal page is redesigned and the default showing you the week vs year vs plan greatly diminishes the appearance of progress. You also are now told number of days until goal vs a goal date. it's been 1 month and I've lost 30 pounds... granted I'm super fat and started at 430 and really ignored what I consumed. I haven't felt this great in years. this app is a must have if you want to lose weight and get better.
It was good before the update. Now you can't set a custom calorie goal :/ otherwise the food search is really good. It's the one app that has a really great interface

Love this app, I have been using it since 2012. I bought the premium a few years ago. Love the DNA option too! I have never had problems with it. The only thing is I don't care much for the lastest up date to the app, not as user friendly. I still give 5 stars though!
This is by far the easiest app to use. Easy tracking of the food you eat makes it easier to stay motivated! I have been using g it for 10 days and lost 7 pounds. Highly recommend this app!

it's starting to work. I am starting to feel the difference. I set my goal to 1.5 pounds every week but couldn't commit. now my appetite is starting to change. i drink so much water (1/2 gallon a day) for the cravings, and I'm full faster. for about a week now I haven't been able to finish regular sized servings. about 3 days ago I weighed myself and I lost my first pound. it is ON! i combine this app with another for HIIT.
