I wish there was a way to edit those products or at least flag them to tell the developers that they are wrong instead of making a new entry. The water tracker (paid feature) could use a weekly report as well, like macros have.

Negligent BMI calculation. This app adds an extra calories to your Basal Metabolic rate for sleep. BMI already includes a full 24 hours. This is costing the users who don't know any better, time and effort because of over eating based on a rediculous calculation that should never have happened. Do the simplest of research and you will know that BMI has no time input in the calculations. Its set for a 24 hour period by default. How can you make a calorie counter app with an error that big.

The app is useful for tracking your numbers, but only if you fact check beforehand. It commonly provides inaccurate or missleading information in most recipes and meal plans. For example, the "High Protein, Low Carb" meal plan has significantly more carbs than protein. Chickfila meals show calorie counts far higher than what they actually are, which is inexcusable considering how the nutritional information is readily available.

New FatSecret user. I'm pretty satisfied with the app but is there a way to customize nutritional content? I'm making cannellini beans and I'm adding no salt at all. But the database in the app shows that dry cannellini beans have 300+ mg of sodium. Is there a work around? The app is a little clunky and not intuitive. Such as, I want to edit my nutritional goals. I'd expect that to be easy to find, like a main menu choice. Instead go to Reports and click the target icon.

This app tracks your daily meals, exercise and weight and provides detailed reports. The food database is quite comprehensive. While there are similar apps, this one doesn't require excessive permissions. However, two flaws detract from an otherwise very good app. The database search function is very literal and cannot find items that are even slightly spelled differently. It is too easy to delete an entry by accidentally swiping left due to the lack of a "confirm delete" function.

I can't add custom food, so this is pretty much useless unless you eat popular packaged food 100% of the time. I tried to make a recipe to add custom food and they don't have all the ingredients I used.🤷🏽‍♂️ When I search help topics in Chrome and click, it automatically tries to open up in the app but then fails, so I can't read help articles at all. You can't search for commands or help, you can only search food. I liked the data display, but overall unhelpful, I'm switching apps.

I like how fatsecret offers stuff you would have to pay for with my fitness pal, but inputting food in the daily diary is not as easy. It doesn't automatically or quickly bring up the foods I commonly eat when I start typing so I have to search as though I never ate the food before. Also, there is less of a selection when scanning barcodes or typing in foods. So I ended up just not counting calories at all. Fatsecret should see what is different when doing searches compared to MFP.

Tried my fitness pal but was really turned off by the ads and social media aspect. Fatsecret was exactly what I wanted, no nonsense easy to use calorie counter and weight tracker. Lost 26 lbs so far, this app rocks. UPDATE: have used this calorie tracker, stuck to it, and lost 103 lbs. definitely the way to go.

Easy to download install and use. Wonderful community. I love the reports and reminders. Great pictures of healthy food. Nonjudgmental support regarding what diet you choose. It picks up my activity from my current app so I don't have to enter it twice. Con- There's no visible option to opt out of a conversation I don't like. I'm trying the meal planning. Can you please allow the camera function in that function????

So time consuming looking for food choices, sometimes not finding some choices at all after an exhausting search for 20 to 30 minutes of searching only to come up empty. Should alphabetize choices so that they can be quickly found and if choice is not on the list would know right away without searching farther to input manually because it's not on the list Hope that makes sense.

I installed this app to track my daily carb intaken. Everything is good but when I add food to my diary sometimes the same item doubles up. It's like when I want to add '2 eggs' to breakfast there is '2 eggs' and another '2 eggs' It's really annoying because when it adds up the daily calories it messes up everything. I wish it can be fixed. After couple of months the problem I mentioned above is fixed. Now i am enjoying this app with no problem!!

DO NOT UPDATE... that is if you don't want ads for signing up for premium constantly shoved down your throat. Used to be 5 stars, but I updated (never should have) and there are two big blocks for custom meals and water tracking on my diary log. It makes the normal display cluttered and junky. And of course you can't hide or turn them off. Much like other great free apps, they greedy company is going to tank it by making slowly making it all premium. Epic fail of a great app.

Quite a fun experience! And so many details one can choose to add... (Also: I suppose it can help a lot for those who need community support--because it looks like there's some of that, too.) I'm really impressed with this, after having thought, "I'm not getting a calorie-counting app. What's the point? I'll just Google everything and use my calculator..." And then a YouTube star mentioned it once and piqued my interest. And, well, I'll be! It's a little confusing... but DELIGHTFUL!

Really user-friendly and it provides what you ask for. No constant notifications and reminders! You *can* ask for the reminders, but I love that it is a thing you select. It also has a good (and reliable, I've double-checked a few) crowd sourced set of foods and exercises, and it's very easy to add to.

App is clean, easy to navigate, and provides an excellent database of foods. Knocking down to 3 stars for one glaring issue: the difficulty in changing portion size. Example: chicken breast is portioned at 4oz. Well, the piece I have is 5.5 oz. I should be able to just override the 4 with 5.5 to have it calculate the calories, but no. I have to do the calculation in my head (5.5 is 1.375 of 4) and enter a fraction of the 4oz portion size. Renders the app mostly useless.

Fantastic app. Great layout, and very intuitive. I've never really "dieted" before but was curious about my caloric intake. Turns out I was eating way more than I thought I was, which completely explained my consistent weight gain. The simple act of journaling my consumption and seeing it graphed out is very motivating to me. Now consuming literally half the calories I was before.

Great app for counting calories and macro nutrients as well as tracking calories burned during activity. I was really impressed by all the food that's already categorized in the app with nutrition info. I just use the free version. I have specific questions about dieting and workouts. I tried posting to the feed but no one responded so I wish there were dietary professionals that would moderate the feed and answer questions, even if it cost money.

I love this app. Scanning food items by bar code is genius. Counting calories makes you hyper aware of what you are putting into your body. There are people from all over the world using this thing. If the premium version had a better user interface and translation API that would be wild. The community behind the simple tracking is what makes this app magic. That is where the value-added skyrockets. Make connecting with others easier and more fluid and if you go public, I'll buy.

I think it will be an OK food diary. My complaint is that it's frustrating to add your own recipes since almost all the food is measured in single serving amounts instead of giving the choice for large amounts (that is without a lot of calculations - like how many teaspoons in 3 cups) for a full recipe for a family. If you don't want to add your own family recipes it would probably be fine.

It's really good so far, the free version doesn't have weird limitations or intrusive ads, it's an easy interface to use with a large food database, the only thing I'd add to it is recommended macro percentages but hey, for a free app? I'm not complaining. It still shows you your macro intake. Best calorie counting app I've used yet.

I'd rate 5 stars but lately it's been randomly duplicating food items in my daily diary. I use the widget on my home screen, so I'm not sure if it's a syncing issue or what but it's frustrating. Aside from that, it's been great. I've set up my most common meals so that I can add them super easily, and keep track of protein/carbs.

Cannot say enough good about this app. Killer feature isn't a even highlighted in the summary - this app places hundreds of restaurants menus With their nutrition data at your fingertips and fully integrated. Easy to eat out and make good choices, and easier to keep track of what you're eating. Calculates your daily calorie allowance including your physical activity and weight loss goals and has a simple graphic interface to help you keep track of how you are doing daily against that calorie

Easy to navigate, this is a great calorie tracking app! I have used many, from Weight Watchers to Noon to MyFitnessPal. This one is very intuitive with easy access to what you need without going through too many steps. It's very easy to look up foods using the camera and their database so far has not let me down. And it is nice that I can sync my Fitbit. Very pleased!

Ugly name, great app. Everything can be set to private, there are next-to-no advertisements cluttering up the screen, you can create foods (the feature is hidden in Search,) create recipes, and create meals. The database of existing foods is quite extensive, and it even counts calories for exercise and sleep. There are other features, such as community, journaling, reports, recipes, etc. The people who run this are prompt to respond to queries. A pro version exists ($.)

Really like FatSecret. It is easy to use. There is a great community feeling. You can share as much or as little information as you want. There are challenges you can pick. You can enter your fitness info. I use it on the laptop and Android phone. Also, I like the visual breakdown of what you've eaten. You can see if you eating too much or too little carbs, fat, calories etc. whatever diet your following. I enjoy putting in my data, it keeps me motivated! Thank you !

Great tool just to use as a diary. Adding daily energy use and then allowing exercise input can be very misleading to users. As a professional, I have advised my clients not to use that function. There are a lot of foods not present or with incorrect data, I have taught my clients how to correct this but they do occasionally get stumped by it. I really like the daily summaries. The ease of use is excellent. Overall a really helpful ap which is helping me help people reach & maintain health.

It is a very easy to use app. What I really like is that it has localised packaged food. For instance, you can easily add packaged food you butly from New Zealand stores, making easier to record your calories intake. Also allowed to enter your own food. It would be great if you were able to edit your custom food and if you could set calories target for each meal. Currently the target is only for the day. Workout tracking is basic, but still does the job.

This app has opened my eyes to how much I consumed on a daily and it's a lot. I have improved a little and I'm gradually learning and adjusting to a calorie limit. Even with fasting I was still holding weight, because I wasn't mindful of the calorie content or sugar etc. This takes a little used to, logging your life and all, but try it out.

Many improvements have been made since I last reviewed FatSecret 2 years ago. The app is now more robust and responsive. However, what stops me giving it a 4 or even a 5 is the fact that it is only useful if you have an internet connection at the time you need to make a diary entry, or see, for example whether or not the snack you are about to eat will break your macro allowance. The option to store recently eaten foods and the recent history of all inputs on the Android device would make this app great, rather than good.

Fantastic app. Made it super easy to keep track of how many calories and macros I'm eating each day, as well as my weight. You can look up whatever brand of whatever product you're using to cook your meals, this app has it. The only thing I would request is perhaps to include a photo of each product in its description, because sometimes you're not sure what you're looking up, and a photo would make it a lot easier. I know it may be complicated to implement that, but I know it's possible

So far has been greatly helpful to me and already lost less than 3kgs in less than 3 weeks! I've been using only the free version. I hope that the full version would supply all the necessary nutritional food data needed especially the bar code scanning function. A lot of brands are not yet recognized by the app. Maybe coz I'm using only the free version. So for several times, I manually uploaded my own food intake with nutrition values. But all in all a great app! Thank you.

fitness pal, which I enjoyed, stopped working for me so I went looking for am alternative free app. I experimented with a few apps but found Fat Secret to be my next best option. It's good. My only real complaint is that their food database isn't as full as I'd like so I often have to enter foods that are "close enough" to what I was eating. I know you can add foods to the database but I can never quite seem to remember how to go about that process. other than that it's a great app.

I really like this app,but since November I can not see any notifications. I see other members who I follow,but no support for me which is very strange. The weekly summary had changed to worst,because doesn't show how many miles/km I walked just the average,so is no point to call summary then? If this 2 things will work,I would be very happy.

First, let's get this out of the way: the name is atrocious. Get past that though and it's a good app. Doesn't bombard you with ads, solid privacy policy, easy to use. However, I don't think food I add to the app becomes available for other people, and you can't edit incorrect nutritional info for food through the app, only on the site. Would also be good if your calories burnt factored in to calories remaining so you have a true figure.

This app is just brilliant. So easy to use and it gives you a great visual of not only the calories but the ratios of macronutrients too. Whether you use it for weight loss, weight gain or to maintain your current weight; It gives you very manageable options and overall is very easy to adapt to. There are so many varieties of foods to choose from and if what you plan to eat is not already in the app's search engine, you can add your own foods along with their nutrition. Truly a great tool!!!

I love using this app but since the update, the serving sizes seem to be broken when you add a new food. Doesn't matter if you choose 100g/ml or a serving, when you go to add the food it only shows 1 serving. Also the recipe function is good but I would prefer if it listed all the ingredients in the diary like a saved meal in case you need to adjust weight values or using other branded food. It would also be useful to flag foods as having the wrong values so they can be archived.

Insanely good app. Super easy to use, and super easy to put in new foods. I use in conjunction with some scales (both food and personal scales). It already has a knowledge of heaps of NZ foods which is really useful, and it's a pretty light app compared to others out there, so it's super quick to use. It also links to my Samsung health app to track burned kcals. I'll be getting the paid version not because I need it but to support the developers. They've done an awesome job

Quite good. Best thing is that you can log and have some visual reports without paying. Things to improve: => Food search - the search algorithm is mediocre and it seems it is only based on 'tags'. It doesn't even consider some words which are clearly there in the actual food name. => Past food search - the food we eat in one meal won't appear in history of another. => Custom macros: an option to enter an arbitrary food with arbitrary macros should be available

Makes it so easy to be aware of our daily calorie intake, and also the cumulated nutritional values (!) of the food we eat during the day. Possibility to make custom recipes which will then be counted and added to the meals according to portion size. Seriously, this app is awesome! So simple, but so great ..it can save you a ton of time if you're just starting out to eat consciously.

Really helping me keep to my targets and goals. Large database of food, easy to enter quantities and/or edit. I like the barcode scanner, saves time. Any unknown foods can be entered as a new product too. Graphs allow you to see your balance of proteins, fats and carbs. Weight graph allows you to see your progress over a period of time. You can add exercise which will give you an approximation of calories burned and add this to your daily allowance so that you can see if you are in deficit.

Doesn't contain accurate information on all the foods, so a waste of time to get, since this is specifically what it as made for! To all those who are giving this app a 4 or 5 star rating, you have quite obviously not checked the accuracy of the information contained in this app. Please do so by simply getting a few grocery items, entering the stats in the app and check to see if the same stats come up. You should discover that the stats are off.

App is very easy to use! However, it is not worthy to buy any premium meal plan as all the food seems to automatically added to your meal plan, item by item, say, cooked pasta, cooked vegetable, you dont need to cook, it is not from recipe at all, all you need is to collect your single item to make a meal! It is totally unprofessional! I feel so disappointed! Plus its food bank dada is very general, you have to create your own food or products, very labor intensive! !

Great app with nutritional information about a very extensive list of food items. I am on a calorie controlled diet and the app is invaluable in keeping track of what I consume. I've been using the app for 3 months now and have not encountered any problems. I'd like to see two improvements: 1) Always having the option of selecting grams or millilitres when entering the serving size (often there is no choice of ml even if the item is a liquid); 2) Include saturated fat in the daily summary.

I only use this to record what I eat and my weight, but it's really good. The only niggle I have is that your limited to the number of meals you can have on the tracker, as the plan I am currently on I eat 5 to 6 small meals a day. So I have to merge them together when tracking but for the average 3 meals a day person it's fine. I like the reminders for if you haven't input a meal yet after it's due time. It can be synced with the Google fit app so it record your steps and calories burned.

Fairly easy to use. Not sure if there is a manual way to enter calories. Everything is in one spot eg weight reports, meal plans, goal calorie allotment per per day, reports, weight loss/gain trends. I think I finally figured out the max calorie RDI and still lose weight. You can add a nickname. Has brands for different countries. You can link this app to Google fit, pedometer which is great. Not sure how well it works.

great little app...very easy to use and log your weight loss journey . searching foods is easy and the bar code scan is handy . you can also save your meal to use another day . I have the same breakfast pretty much every day so the saved meal i use alot . you can uncheck individual items in your saved meals if you change things up a bit . I'm still learning a bit but so far so good .

I have used this app for 8 years. It's great to see that after all this time the team is still making improvements to both the UI and the user experience. The strengths of the app are its simplicity and the ease of adding foods you regularly eat. The downside is that editing your diary can be a bit of a pain. Items need to be deleted one by one. And it's not possible to drag and item from one meal to another. But overall, it's a solid app and very usable.

There are many items that aren't in the database compared to MyFitnessPal, but I like the freedom to enter it yourself so you can track exactly what you're consuming. Issues: 1.RDI extremely high due to rest amount is unchangeable and stays at 24 hours, however you can set your own RDI value 2.Can't enter values for calcium, iron, vitamins, etc even though it's displayed 3.Search engine sometimes finds items, even my own when searching for very specific tags, but barcode scanning works fine

2016 - Never counted calories before coz I thought it would be hard. This app has made it so easy to do it. I've lost 1.5kg in 2 weeks just by being aware of the nutrients in my food and portion sizes. Highly recommended. 2021 - still using this app as I've been thru some ups and downs since I first used it. Still awesome, in fact so much better than when they first started. Had an issue where I couldn't edit my recipes and they stayed in touch while they fixed it. Wish I could give more stars!

The app and the website are both great tools. I found that if I put all the meats, rice in the breakfast spot and then all fruits and veggies in the lunch spot... The bulk of what I eat is easily found for recording. I love that I can add food, too. Saving meals is so convenient. The charts are great, Tracking the Macros is easy and lots of other info

The app helps me to realise how much I eat, and that is really helpful along the way to fight overeating and losing control over my habits. I would like to see more options to choose from in my own region. Right now I have set it to the UK area, because the choice of foods and brands there is richer. Still, this is a great application with a great web platform, too.

Simply the most effective mechanism for losing weight and getting fitter there is. Eat less and move around more. You can't beat having the numbers, I love all the charts and stats and this was a real motivator for me. Track your inputs (food) and outputs (energy expended) and if your input is less than your output you lose weight. 3500cal = 1lb fat. Simple. Just read about the changes to the app planned including the new "me page". Good grief. You know if it ain't broke don't fix it.

Super easy to use, intuitive and clean interface. Food library is massive especially if you live outside of the US (like in South Africa, It has everything). If I had to mention one downside is that even though it does track net carbs and you can add the column for it on the mobile, it doesn't feature everywhere like in your reports/graphs. Because of the food database though I still use it for keto over specialised keto apps.

It's generally a good app, I can scan most foods and it has the facility to add recipes BUT my big bug bear is that it won't let you add a portion of recipe into your meal plan. I.e. I will save my recipe which might make 4 portions but when you go to add that to your meal plan it only let's you add in the whole recipe so you then have to physically divide the calories of each ingredient by 4 with a calculator and manually change it yourself - very time consuming and other apps I've used have this facility!!!!!! Please change it! I don't want to stop using this app as it's got all my data in it from the last couple of months but this lack of a feature is really starting to get tiresome!

I love this app, it does so much more than count your calories. You can track your macros, set macro targets for different days of the week, track your exercise, saves your favourite meals & much more. I really like that it recognises a lot of Australian foods as well, most other apps don't. New foods are also easy to put in. Way too many features to list! Not just for people who want to lose weight, I used it initially for that, but now I'm in the gym it's even more helpful.

The only app that really worked for me, and it keeps improving in terms of functionality and database. I also like it's web version. I have been using this app for the past 5 years. No annoying ads. It is convenient for tracking foods, macronutrients, weight. Food search is amazing, it includes global search and also recently eaten and most eaten foods list, I can also add my custom foods and even meals to the database.

A superior calorie counting app. It is far faster and more organized than MyFitnessPal. The desktop site is also superior. The display is organized for better view of data. Unfortunately, a few features are missing, such as the inability to rename meals or set add or subtract meals, which is a bit silly. The catalogue of barcodes is smaller to due to a smaller install base. That said, I find it still faster than competitors and far more pleasant to use. Highly recommended.

This app has really helped me control my eating. I have lost weight steadily since I started using it. I love the way I can add a food, save a meal & add a recipe. But it is frustrating not to be able to edit a recipe as soon as I have saved it. So many times I've realised that I've forgotten an ingredient or made a mistake with the quantities. I would also like to be able to import recipes. Occasionally the app freezes, but it works if I close & re-open it. Despite these drawbacks, I recommend

I have tried many an app to track my diet and calories but this one beats them all hands down. The app is easy to use & quite intuitive. The UI can be improved, but it it looks great! Syncs seamlessly with the web version of the service. The best part is that all the core features are available free of cost. You only pay for water counter & custom meal planner. Highly recommended!!

Tried out several food and fitness tracking apps over the past years and this one so far is the best I have tested. I especially like that there are country specific foods and communities available depending on which country/language you have chosen. I travel a lot and I simply change it to the country I am visiting and type in the name of the food. Could be better, if all foods were available in all languages but tracking is really easy and I get a lot of statistics which is great for tracking progress!

I compared several similar apps, and while there was much to like about this one, in the end its limitations got to me.  Initially it recommended far more daily calories than other apps, although you could manually change it if you knew wanted, but the biggest con for me was how often I scanned items and they were not in the database.  This happened far more often than in the other apps, and entering the data myself quickly got old. I also did not like that it was harder to navigate between days and copy items between days.  The detailed nutritional info available was great though, if you like having all the numbers at your fingertips then this app gives it to you.  If they expanded the database and make the "diary" easier to use and navigate it would be a winner.

This is the best calorie tracker on the Play Store. It easily allows you to fill in food and create meals. Critically, it allows you to view a weekly summary for any period you choose. The app also allows for data export. Other calorie apps paywall your own data, which is ridiculous. Here the only paywalls are for coaching, which is understandable. Once again, this is the only usable, fully featured calorie counter that works out of the box. The developers have done a great job.

You may not find every food, but you can usually substitute a similar food. Once you learn your way around you can make and save your own recipes. This makes it quicker to add food to your diary. Shows the important info regarding daily intakes and percentages. Shows progress in a graph which is important to keep you motivated. It's also fun creating and adding your own recipes. The paid version would be good for people that need more support and motivation. For now I'm very happy with free one.

For the most part I liked it, but there's one thing that is extremely annoying and has happened way too many times: you can delete a diary entry from your list by "swiping" it left, with no confirmation, and no undo button. It's also on a hair trigger and really easy to "swipe" an entry when you are just trying to scroll around. It's easy to notice, but without an undo button you have to guess what it was that you deleted. Either add a confirmation dialog or an undo option when deleting via "swipe".

I think this app is very good if you need to count calories & monitor weight changes. It has a lot of products in the list to chose from, so I almost all the time capable to find variations of what I ate. What I would add: more homemade options. I cook at home and from scratch and I am not sure if homemade food has the same amount of calories as shops variants.

Good calorie counting app. Enough features in free mode to make it useful without needing to pay immediately. Food database is easy to add to, but seems mainly user generated, you do need to double check, and there can be multiple differing entries for the same food. One bug bear, it would be nice if you could alter quantities/portion size on a saved meal. Save a meal for 4, you can only add it as a meal for 4 and not a portion for 1.

I like this app since it's easy to use. I would like to be able to click on my weight and see what I ate that day rather than having to click a lot of buttons to navigate through the pages. It would make me able to see everything in one spread which is easier for me to process information. I also would like to just input the name of my resume and calories associated with it rather than create recipes in the index.

If you found this app then don't look for another one because this is the best for whatever goal you wanna achieve, losing weight, gaining weight, listing or just tracking food you eat. Sometimes I don't find the nutrition value of a food but I could just add it there. I never made any app review but quite thankful to the devs as I am healthier than ever.

Ok so honestly it's been easy to use I like the lay out things are clear and I like that you can share meals and see how others are doing theres a nice community. However I wish the app would add a scanner to make things a bit easier. To be able to scan packets of food or boxes and cans, would just be easier on getting the right amount down. But otherwise I like this app and think its worth trying out.

Eating out? No problem. Select the restaurant, choose your meal. Making your own dish? No problem, add it to your cookbook and FatSecret will do all your calculations for you. Just serving up food? No problem, select from a huge array of individual items. My only qualm is the individual items do not always state if it is the raw or cooked state, so you use the same readings. You can also connect your fitness device to fat secret so you can compare calories in/out

I was looking for a free calorie tracker just to help me get back on track. I was pleasantly surprised to see how many foods and brands are listed and how easy it is to change from metric to Imperial when you want. It is easy to add food, especially with the use of bar codes. I do find it odd that the water tracking is only in the premium model, but I don't need to worry about tracking my water as I have water bottles to do that. Overall, it's a great app that's easy to use! Thank you!!

A great excellent app for keeping track of your calories, makes you think in what to eat!...there is a vast amount of info & places to look & check on just about any kind of food out there...Certain foods I couldn't find tho I love the app, it seems to be helping me...I recommend this app to anyone out there who wants to lose weight & also have some at the same time

Fantastic Ap that records food and weight. Most of the food is in the food database but if it isn't it's easily added once you know nutritional values. I can also add pictures and record thoughts which are date stamped (although these can't be edited which is a pain!). Another cool feature is the receipe thing where you enter ingrediants for a favorite receipe and it calculates the nutritional value. You then select how much you ate and viola - the stats appear in your food diary.

Overall, it suits me very well...it is easy to keep track of both food and exercise. It has helped me lose 15kg over 4 months. Nice and steady. However, the way it handles saved meals and recipes is terrible, forcing data entry (like preparation time) that I neither want nor need. The user interface is also unclear...I was saving a meal and found I *had* to give it a name three times. Maybe there is some underlying reason, but tbh it just pissed me off and made me give up on it. All I wanted to do was enter a homemade soup with calories and protein per ml...my need was simple, the app was uncooperative.

Your app asks for my activity level at my job, and that's it. You can't base your calorie math only on that, there are other daily activities other than work. Gym, jogging, how many tikes a week, intensity, all that should be taken into consideration. Until then, the app is pretty useless in giving advice on calorie intake.

Really helps to keep track of what you actually eat during the day. Barcode scanner works well Edit : Since the last update, recently eaten foods are not grouped to specific meal times. This means when choosing foods for Dinner you now have to scroll though Breakfast and Lunch items to get to what you want. This used to be an excellent app, but this latest update is a backward step, making it much slower and frustrating to use. Downgraded to 3 stars

I am comparing free versions. Same interface as My Fitness Pal, just different colour. Positives: Fewer and more reasonable privacy and permissions requested. Negatives: You can't add exact calories burned in exercise, you are given set calories for an exercise and you can adjust the time to change the calories but it's obviously not an accurate record. Also, the app also doesn't add calories used for exercise to the daily quota. If you exercise more, you need more cals.

This is a free app that provides you with everything a paid app would. It's honestly amazing. I don't write reviews very often at all but I feel this one deserves it. There's community boards, personal food log, statistics that show your eaten macros and no constant nagging about buying any kind of premium version. My only minor complaint is that the UI is a little unintuitive sometimes but once you know it, it's easy to use.

This is a great app with a lot of free functions you can't get without paying on most other cal/macro tracking apps. My only problem with this app though, is that many foods and products aren't 'verified' for their nutritional info. For packaged items, I have to almost always check the nutritional info because often the macros are wrong or calories are off by a bit. As someone who needs to count macros more than cals, this gets to be a bit annoying & then I always need to re-enter products

Scrolling can delete eated items (swiping sideways) without possibility of undo, constantly adds eated items multiple times on its own without user input, and defining own recipe portion size is stupid. Recently eaten foods list is too short. Yet of all the apps of this type I have tested, this is easily the best. In the end this gets thing done, even if it is awkward.

Ok if you go with the unpaid option. The additional meals you get through premium membership are buggy as hell and it's even not worth the price at all momentarily. The most important thing which is really annoying is the food history list. Currently the list is limited to 20 entries. If you wanna quickly add some food you haven't eaten recently, Hm, too bad...

I am using the free version of this app. I find it to be quite easy to use and navigate around in. I like this app much better than the myfitnesspal app (used the free version of that one too) as it gives you more indepth overviews of calories, macros and nutrients. The graphs and charts make it easy to see at a glance how balanced your daily/weekly calorie intake is. Fitbit can be synced to it, but you can also manually add exercise too.

Best app for maintaining weight loss! I've been using this for the better part of 5 months and when used consistently, the calorie track functionality is possibly the best on the market. I use this perhaps obsessively to count what I've had daily and even plan out potential meals. The database of foods is vast and intuitive. If you have a missing item, it can be added. I can't press just how amazing this application is.

Excellent on ever level. I'm just lazy but I will get there. This has everything you need. For free. You can upgrade for recipies etc if you want. But the calorie counter and food appendices is the most comprehensive, my advise don't waste your time, Forget the rest. But! as with any weight watching, loosing programme, you have to be committed. I can't explain how,but this makes you want to do that. Especially how you monitor you daily weight loss/gain. Very clever. Excellent app.

I really love this app, I've only been using it for a short time of period, but the only thing bothering me is that it automatically gives me a 16 to 24 rest... And because of that it will calculate that I have to eat more calories. If that bug is fixed or explained to me how I can turn it off (maybe I'm the problem), then it's a solid five star...

The app is nice and has all the core features for a calorie tracking app. There a a few improvements that can be made but i believe those will come in time. Edit: the developers started pushing the premium subscription in a very intrusive manner with "ads" for custom meals plans and daily water intake in your daily journal and if you accidentally click on any of those, the whole premium advertising spiel starts.

This is a great app to have as i dont eat as much as i should. This is set out really clearly and is easy to use. You can search food or drink to put in your meal diary and if its not there then you can easily add it yourself. You set how many calories or weight you want to and it shows you how close you are to that goal. I havent used the premium feature yet as its pretty good on its own.

Pretty solid; you often have to enter the various branded foods and sauces yourself, but the own recipe section is pretty handy if you don't mind putting in the data yourself (we cook a lot). Definitely gives an excellent tracker for your macros, nutrients, and food intake. Overall brilliant, but for some reason when we add foods in, they're only added in locally and not online (both my wife and I have the app, and have both had to add in foods rather than one adding and one finding online)

I really like that it has South African food to choose from. I just wish an entire restaurant's menu was uploaded instead of just parts of it. Also, it only has the option to log weight. It would be useful to log cm's as well. Sometimes weight loss is very small, but when you can see how the cm's are dropping it is very motivating.

while I love the fact that fat secret offers so much without annoying ads or pushes to Go premium, I don't see a way via the app to find friends that are also using the app and connect with them. The website has a huge community with lots of great conversations. But none of that seems to be accessed by the app, including the challenges etc.

Makes you more aware of how much calories are actually in things & what we perceieve to be a "Serving" is actually a lot different in sizes than what we assume so it's fantastic to keep track of how far/close you are too your goals & definately create a better understanding when you are honest in your diary about food consumption. It also is great to maintain your weight so you don't ruin your progress & achievements.

I had never tried other programs before like this one, so I managed to use it and found that there were a lot of tools that helped me to lose my waight vary short of time. I have given five stars as I liked this program very much. The one thing I would only want to ask from program developer to add step counter by the distance that someone walks and counts calories that they lose during their walk.

I love how visible the macros are. Very easy to use, the food list is very comprehensive and adding additional foods and recipes is easy. I would have given it 5 stars if I could vary my calorie/macro targets from day to day/on a set cycle rather than a fixed target as I Carb Cycle. But other than that I love it!!!

Good application for food and ccal tracking. Has big database of food for most of the regions and provides to add missing food as well as own recipes. Drawback of the recipe is that you can only produce and consume portions, but it would be better to enter actual weight of the dish. Also I would like to sync it with Mi Fit directly without being forced to use Google Fit.

I was looking for a calorie counting app, which I suppose this does, but it also recommends how many calories you should be having. I only want to lose some excess Christmas weight, but this app has decreased my recommended calories by 25%. Quite excessive imo My husband who needs to lose 8st was recommended to eat 600 calories more than the recommended daily intake for men. Something is wrong with the calculations. We both tried it for a few days, but it didn't work for us.

I've downloaded 4 cal and macro counter apps this is by far the easiest to use and my fave. One thing I would love if it had a quick add option and just add the cals, fat, protein and carbs that would be handy other than that it's the best out of them all. *Edit Found this option under food search to add your own food item. Changed my review to 5 stars!

This app contains the most important functions to track your diet including meals, macro, nutrient info etc. Usage is pretty straight forward. There's also a bunch of store products that are easily recognized by scanning their barcodes. You can upgrade to a premium version which offers nice to haves on top of the critical components the free version offers. I chose this app over its competitors (e.g. MyFitnessPal) because of the complete/extensive info the free version offers. Good job devs!

professional, fully functional app and it works... the app and logging for healthy weight loss. so much better than Noom, which I used on their paid model for 1 year. FatSecret has superior functionality by long way ... and foods I log are available immediately! on Noom I logged the same foods for a year and they were never added to the database. also far prefer this way of community support... much more active and responsive.

Problem with putting grams. I like this app but recently there is some mistake when adding product, it does let you choose per 100 grams or per portion. I choose grams But once you save it is showing wrong as a portion again. It is complicated to keep counting it then, could you check on this please - i thoughtvit is my phone but i read more people experienced it ..:(

I've lowered my rating. Since last update app is much less useful. The change to nutrition label format no longer shows the specifics of what you ate - only the full label. Also doesn't show alternate serving so I have to go back to package to figure how many of something are in X grams. I'm really disappointed because this app helped me lose 20lbs, but it is not helping me figure out how to maintain. Changes based on design, not function are rarely good. Please revert.

I have found this app excellent for keeping track of my food intake. And break down of carbs,fats and proteins. You are also able to alter the serving size, either by grams or percentage, e.g. instead of a 1 whole pizza, change to .5 or .3 Doesn't add in your exercise, but I was ok with that as using the app to better understand where I was going wrong with my food intake. Overall it has helped me.

The app is quite OK. It helps with measuring your caloric intake among other things and does it quite well. Not so good: it doesn't communicate with my Mi Band 4. If you select Belgium as your region you end up having only Dutch, no French option? I am fluent in 4 languages, else I would not find all the foods I want to add. Also I would love to set gram as my default unit. And after editing and saving a food quantity it should just add it to the diary without having to tap the check mark.

Im really happy with the app so far, its helping me to lose weight in a steady and manageable way. Some apps suggest incredibly restrictive calorie intakes. My only suggestion for improvement would be to add multiple of the same food items (i input all my instant coffees later in the day) and i wish you could just enter a calorie amount. Im not interested in keeping a food diary as such, i just want to track cals.

Simple to use. Creates greater awareness of daily nutritional needs, & varying diet more. Mini complaint only...l decided to add Bulk Nutrients chocolate into the food selection lists & accidently entered too many calories. Unable to reverse entry maybe due to using free version? l found others on google who had the same problem too. Apart from this the app is very reliable, offers a daily % tally of calories, fats, protiens, carbs, sleep & daily exercise calories used plus weekly weight entry.

I like it because it isn't pushy and it doesn't set unrealistic goals of several pounds a week. It Also is a great way to track things like protien or fiber if those are areas you are concerned about. I originally started using it to track my fiber and then decided it was so easy to use I went from maintaining weight to losing weight. You can go as in depth or as casual as you wish. And you can still eat ice cream and cookies. It just makes you be more efficient in your eating

This is a good app I really love it, the fact that it has most South African food is best. However, there is room for improvement. Please include a section for drinking water, like food intake water is equally important. Also include exercise time (type of exercises), burned calories (after workout) and lost grams (based on the calories burned and weight).

I find this app really easy to use. It has comprehensive lists of food (UK) and displays extra info like protein, carbs, fibre. You can add exercise easily and it's easy to review data. I found the monthly diet calendar and summary view useful to see where things had gone well (or not).

A good app really that helps get a perspective on the impact of what you eat and snack on a daily basis, but some functions are too impractical, for example when you make a dish for dinner and eat leftovers for lunch the next day, you have to choose all the ingredients from scratch. Another thing that annoyed me is you can't find a lot of standard meals such as takeaway pizza or kebabs, but predominantly supermarket products. Also, you can only add 100g data to the database and no portions data

The app is great except it keeps doubling the food I enter. I enter my calories and close the app and open it again and things will be entered in twice doubling my calories. Kinda broken for a calorie counting app. Im probably going to stop using the app soon cause it is annoying. Also it doesnt work offline, which is completely stupid for a calorie tracker. Everything else is really top notch. One of the best calorie trackers ive used and ive tried dozens. Please fix the issues devs.

Love it! It has an array of menu's to choose from based on where you live. It always reminds me how many calories I have left. There is also a counter for calories burnt. It is easily customisable. For instance, I consumed half a cup of rice. So I'll just add the menu '1 cup rice' and change the amount to 0.5. Its amazing!

I use this every single day. It's helped me achieve a much healthier and balanced lifestyle. I use it mainly for the calorie tracker. However, the estimation for calorie expenditure is nuts. I'm a 30yo male, 5'8", 230lbs, wanting to "lose weight fast" was given a target goal of 2500 calories per day. This is to lose weight "fast". Not maintain it. Do not use the feature in the app/website. Best do a quick calculation over at any google search you find for "TDEE" total daily energy expenditure

I find it nice for tracking but I wouldn't reccomend using the generic entries as the nutritional values are way off. Especially on the woolworths items. I always have to edit the correct nutritional values. Most of the values are undercalculated which means you could actually be eating more calories than you think. I will say just always double check the values of the packaging and make 100% sure when selecting food items

I'm loving the app so far, there hasn't been one food yet that hasn't been on the app and I love how you can create your own recipes and the app works out all the nutrition advice for it. Really fantastic! I love how you can enter the exercise you've done each day to see how many calories you burnt! The only gripe I have is I can't figure out how to update my profile and add a picture of myself so people can see who they're following.. other than that I definitely recommend it!!

Hey there! Thanks for an amazing app. I've been using it for a couple of days now and the experience is only getting better. A quick question (recommendation): Is there any way to add some notes to the day? It would have been really great to be able to add some personal notes to each day, besides all the info regarding the food intake and exercise & sleep data. Also, is it possible to synch this app with the AmazFit? Overall, the app is exceptional Many thanks to decelopers!

I love Fatsecret so much!!! I can track everything here and it allows me to see all the progress I'm making. I wasn't using the journal much, but since I started writing everyday, it gives me a great insight on what I did and how I felt on the days I lost most weight. So I go back to what I ate that day and it helps me to shrink more... What not to love about this app?? I can find ALLthe food I'm looking for unlike the other apps.. I plan my meals in the morning and enter them in Fatsecret.

I've tried loads of different weight loss programmes and always end up quitting. I have just been counting calories using this ap, as I enjoy bread and crackers and find if I quit those I tend to cheat massively. This ap is easy and so far in around two months I've lost just over a stone. Slow and steady. I don't feel like I'm doing without. It's more the calorie counting but this ap helps a lot.

Generally the app work very well and truly gives you freedom to eat foods during holidays, etc while still staying on track with your macros. The only thing I dislike is that there are many food entries for the exact same item, but each entry has different macros. Eg there is chicken breast (no skin) , chicken breast meat and chicken breast (skin not eaten), all with slightly different macros.

Pro: you can scan many products and get the nutritional info added to your meals. Decent size database. Con: constant storing and synchronization issues. Meals either do not get stored and are missing the next day or certain foods double counted in the meal. Mobile and desktop versions do not sync properly. A lot of glitches. Would not buy a paid version and am considering switching from the free one...

the app is amazing and covers pretty much anything you want to track calories, weight and get inspiration, great work! i only have problem with deleting items accidentally from the meals (without any confirmation) and choosing not some specific meals but generally meals, for example i couldn't find a generic chicken steak and had to pick a chicken steak from the store, which is different from self-made steak. Other services offer such functionality

I have been using it for years. Monitors my food in take daily. Monitors my weight as well.I know my limits and especially my carb intake. The app is easy to use. Most foods we consume are already on it. You can also add on foods if you cannot find it on the App. Many other features are in there.

I like but there are some things I would like to see implemented: - Please let us sort and add more than one snack. Having it all snacks together created confusion. - if I have a saved meal, I would like to see if as a group, not all together. - I only use the daily report and every time I get to the report tab it switches back to weekly. Please male the tab remember my position. - Having thumbnail when adding meals would make easier and nicer the selection process.

Recent update made me write this review and give it 1 star. 1.It's become impossible to add new product because you can't add any tags to it, you select them, but they are not added. 2.When you open the product that you've added to your diary it shows the nutritional information per portion in both upper and lower part, not per eaten amount and per 100g 3.Deleting item from diary with a single accidental slide it quite annoying. Needs confirmation!! 4.Cookbook entries need to be counted in grams

It's perfect and made me stick to the diet and tracking calories thanks to its user friendly interface. The one thing I wanted to be included is an easier way to add my customized meals (a lot of my mediterranean recipes are not existing in the app so I have to calculate it in some online platforms then add them to the app)

This is a great app! As a first step, it worked out how many calories I need each day to reach my weight-loss goal. It lets me store meals I eat regularly, works out their calorie composition for me, keeps track of my calorie consumption over the course of the day, and lets me know how many more calories I can eat to reach my chosen daily intake allowance. I am using it together with an intermittent fasting app to make sure I eat enough every day and it is perfect!

Best calorie counter I've used. Tries 5 or 6 different apps and was dissatisfied and unhappy due ads or constantly pushing the premium version. After trying FatSecret, I'm absolutely completely happy. The free version covers my needs so I haven't used the premium version. Best feature is that this app doesn't constantly remind me about the premium version. A close second is the searchable database that makes it so easy to add food without needing to enter macro information. A+ with extra credit

Great app for tracking calorie output and intake, as well as intake of nutrients. Many national grocery stores and restaurant chains are pre-programmed with nutritional information in the app. I only wish their were an easier, quicker way to enter the caloric intake from less popular brands and chains.

It's a great app,indeed. It helped me to lose 11 kg within 3 months,so I highly recommend it. The spectrum of products is wide and calories are precisly counted in both food and activities. Another plus is that one can actually tweak the nutritianal information(fibre,sodium and so forth) of a product(not always but in most cases)which I found quite useful. Thanks a lot for creating such a lovely app)

It's good it does what it says out of the box. The best thing in my opinion is that most foods cooked or raw that we buy in South Africa is on the list. So you don't need to calculate things. Suggestions I cannot find a way to add saved food without adding food to my diary then going to saved food. A way for us to upload photos of a label and add new products that just came out and it can be curated somewhere by an admin and added to the app. An example would be the new skinny food sauces.

The app is pretty simple to use, though saved meal modification and management requires using the website. The searchable food database is nowhere near as good as MyFitnessPal's, but the privacy and less bugs with FatSecret make it a solid alternative. Offline support of diary entries would be nice (for at least previously used items).

The idea is great but it's lacking some very very basic features, or I'm too blind to find them. If I can't find an Item in your database but I have the nutrition table infront of me, please just give me an option to simply enter it manually instead of having to find a close match from your database. Without this, the app is litteraly useless since it's impossible to accurately count my calories.

Works okay. Food database is decent. App isn't too slow or cluttered with ads, unlike competitors. But water tracking requires a pro account (lol really?) and while I can export my food diary, I can't export the data about my body weight. Feels like three quarters of an app.

So far so good! No pay walls or ad walls. Runs smooth. Logs good data and easy to find foods. I like the weight goal graph aswell. I only wish that there was a way to change the daily meal options to accommodate for intermittent fasting. And there doesn't seem to be much canada exclusive brands in the database.

So far, so good. I am finding new things in this app everyday! I like the format, good form and function. Not flashy, you don't get distracted from the main purpose here. The food data base is very good. Better than some of the paid apps and programs. I like it a lot, and I feel like I'm grounded in a plan with this app. Very adaptable to your own personal goals and methods. *I am am upgrading this to a "5". The ease of the barcode scanner is very good. It has read everything I've put in front of it so far. Also, the ease of the recently used foods list is also a huge plus. Much better than any app I've used.

Nice app with brilliant idea of a Barcode scaning. One of the problems is that there are still a lot of supermarket products to input, especially in eastern europe. And the most annoying fact is that you can not "re-edit" the product wich you added already in the app!!!!

Item lookup limited, add more items as barcode lookup works one in 10.. really? I have to eyeball with a similar item until the cals re equal to what I'm consuming yet the macros are all screwed up.. if you want your app to be well rounded id sort this out and get to work on getting more items in your database for lookup.. for example.. can't add banana by grams.. can't look up - plant based yoghurt. Can't find - protein + oat milk can't find eggs XL , L or by weight singular.. it goes on..

On the whole a great app. A small glitch needs fixed. When u alter the daily recommended calories (to a deficit), at the start of a new day the app defaults back to the default recommended calories. To fix this I need to toggle thru reports & weight tabs, close, then re-open the app. A minor annoyance each day but stopped me giving it 5 stars. Also please enable the app to sync directly with Mi band 3. ATM I have to sync the band with Google fit which updates fatsecret.

Great app. I first downloaded MyfitnessPal app and it was a hard app to get used to and was riddled in ads and asking you to sign up to premium. I then found this one and I was used to it within a day of using it. Its very easy to operate. Only thing is, I find it doesn't recognize alot of barcodes and food you type in.

I like the app it's easy to use for keeping track of my weight and what I eat. One thing keeping me from giving it a perfect rating though...when I add custom exercises and I punch in 1 hour fixed amount of cals burnt, I can't switch it to say 5 hours with it not calculating 5 hours of that specific activity. Anyway it's a great app. 70 lbs down woooooo

Amazing to track calories and macros!! I honestly will never use another app. And im not even trying to hype it up i just love it that much. There are some meal plans they lay out for you that you have to pay for. But i havent needed any of that so its been all free and no adds 🥰🥰 this app has kept me on track on my cut.

Takes a little getting used to, it has so many features that it CAN look a little bit complicated for the first few days TOTALLY WORTH IT. this app is a GAME CHANGER for me Some people dont need to track calories Most of us do. Most of us dont The minute I did? I got back on track with in a week I'm extremely performance orientated at the moment and I am BLOWN AWAY by how tracking a few variables can suddenly turn into a game, & then becomes both easily visible, managed and enjoyed. EPIC!

Missed something to be a great app. Ok for calculating calories, daily meals, but reports (pdf or csv) are not working. Would be interesting to have ready recipes and workouts for the PRO version. Without, has no sense to get and pay it. I did it for three month, but I cannot see a great difference, no such an extra value.

User friendly, intuitive and specific to purpose! I have used this app for a while now and it is one of the best weight-waitching applications out there. Granted it doesn't have any actual tips to help lose weight but constantly measuring what you are intaking is a good step in getting healthier. The only one issue is the measurements. The measurements are sometimes horrifically bad. With bread being measured through one loaf or biscuits in 100 grams. It's silly. But otherwise great app.

Just started using this app today and so far I am really impressed. Very easy to set up and use. Taking a picture of a product or it's bar code that I am eating is very helpful! I love there are no ads. The only thing I don't like is the preset number of an item. Example: I want to enter the number of saltine crackers I am eating and it has a preset value of 5 so I can enter multiples of 5 but I only ate 17 so my value is entered wrong, I can only choose 15 or 20. Breakdown of food eaten great

LOVE this app! I thought I would hate counting calories, and yes, ok, I do, but this app is really helping me see how the food I'm eating is broken down by protein, fat and carbs. I can even monitor my fiber and water intake. I wish they had more Snack placements so I could log a morning snack and evening snack without them being lumped into one Snack category because I'm trying to monitor my after dinner calories, but that's just me. All in all, it's great!

So far I'm loving it. Very easy to add foods. Links with fit bit. Tracks weight. You can add a recipe and it will calculate calories per serve. You can choose a percentage of a food. E.g. choose 1 apple, then select 0.50 of it. Would love to be able to scan foods though.

On and off I've been using this app for a couple of years now. It's great to see the forum section is more active and people can support you. I'm glad the cook book option is now working properly. However there is no way I will ever upgrade to premium to track my water intake when there are so many free apps that already do that!

love this app. options for choosing common foods, and entering your own. also can track weight. has reminders. very useful. three improvements though; 1) search in quick pick would be very helpful 2) stay in area of quick pick after item selected (i.e., don't make me restart after one item) 3) add my self-entered items to quick pick so i can find them again

Very useful app. Saved meals, recent foods, breakdown of intake by day/week. Sync mine with samsung health app but FS doesn't send the food information, it only gets strps from samsung health app nit sure if fitbit does any better. Also If you can export more than one day at a time then this would be perfect. Tracking everything I eat certainly made me think about the occasional snack

It let's you record the foods you eat, either by choosing from their exhausive database, or manually; ditto for exercise; and your weight. It then tallies the calories and compares to your goal, and has a weight chart too. Plus it's fun and easy to use. I can't think of anything else this app needs. My thanks to the app developers. 👍

It's a great app for logging what I eat in a day and my weight. Use friendly and easy to add food nutrition where not listed. I've tried other apps that only let you scan barcodes for foods but the nutrition isn't what's found on the label. I do wish there was a place to track water, and more exercise options to offset calories

it's a bunch of information and an unfocused social platform where people post more or less random food related thoughts and photos in a stream that you can't really control. I ignore that feature. my big disappointment with fatsecret is that you get no AI generated feedback on your data. None. You can see charts/lists galore. I use this because of the database of foods for calorie and nutrient counting. But it would be nice if Google were to expand Fit to include a food-tracking functionality.

It seems to be a very good app for keto except that being in Canada seems to mean that not as many foods come up with the bar scan and food search, which is a super important feature for me so I bought another app. I was disappointed that it didn't work out since it was easy to use and had a nice clean layout.

This app is fantastic and easy to use. Most items are prepopulated and readily available in the search! Even if you have to pull a meal/snack together manually, it takes about 1 minute as the search function for ingredients is so easy. This app is keeping me on track and is not burdensome at all!

It is a great app,I can see how much macros I eat in a day and I can even stay on my calorie intake. I can save meal with their pictures also. The engagement platform is also great,u get motivated. If a certain product is not in the search index,u can add it yourself then it will be calculated for you.

Great app for tracking calories , carbs and fats as well as some other nutrients . Once you get in the habit of tracking it makes weight loss easier . A great database for foods as well as a space to add your own favorites to database . Love This App !! Have been using free version for the last 4 months considering paid version , it can only get better .

I've used this app for years and like it and would encourage others to use it for possibly the same reasons. The app is simple, allows you to search for what you are eating, and if you eat the same things regularly, it remembers. You can also add whole meals you can save & label to your day as well. It also allows you to enter goal calories and macros, which you can change on a day to day basis, which works very nicely for me and which days I train heavy or do more cardio based training.

This is the best calorie counter ever! No need to figure the number of calories...just search any food item and Fat Secret will tell you the number of calories for the food item. The barcode scanner is my favorite feature, as it provides the complete nutritional value of the food item scanned.

I think everyone does better when they're held accountable for what goes in their mouth! This program makes it easy to add convenience foods and exercise, but I've experienced difficulty adding healthy recipes that I've found and use regularly. My sister uses MyFitness Pal and really likes it... I suppose it has a lot to do with what you start and continue to use and are familiar with.

Great app. It's great for tracking food and exercise. I don't have the paid version but it does everything you need and has a great bank of food to make it easier to stay on track. You can add your own recipes and it will work out the calories for you and add any food by entering info. The chat section is brilliant for support and advice, if you need it. The most important thing is that it helps you keep the weight off when you've lost it and soon becomes part of your journey. Love it!!!

Excellent app with a huge database of foods and a supportive community. Good trackers for macros, easy to add personal items or update products, and it doesn't push the Premium aspect. Fully recommend for weight or food related goals. Could use more interactivity with fitness apps is the only thing knocking this down a star.

I've tried them all, this is the most functional and lets me control what I want to do without overcomplicating things 👍 Still the best one out there for counting calories and ease of use. Quick look up for calorie counts in the dairy, flexibility in how to use it, and virtually no learning curve for the tech aspects. Well done 👍🌟

pretty darn awesome- give yourself a day or two to learn how to use it and it becomes very easy and gives terrific reports and makes it easier to stick with your plan. sets realistic goals for calories based on current weight and your chosen timeline to lose but you set the goal. it records proteins and records intake of sodium fat carbs, everything. Best of all it saves previously eaten food in easy to use lists, as well as having just about every commercial food already in their database.

For a free fitness app this is very impressive. It let's me track my weight and calories intake/use easily and accurately. Most common foods are pre-listed in the app and can be entered by scanning their barcode. It's also easy to add more by hand. You can save common meals for rapid entry and the app remembers recent entries too.

I love this app. There's so much that I want to say about it and the way it helps me😁 but there's not enough space!! So I'll just say that this app has helped me to lose a staggering 6 stone 3lb so far and I am very near to my goal weight. Not only is at brilliant at counting calories in a simple way it also helps me with my carbohydrate intake and being a type 1 diabetic this is invaluable to me. I would definitely recommend this app and give it at least 10/10 😁😁😁

Really great app! I can track my weight and it shows you how you're doing on a graph. It has meal plans. You can look up food items or recipes to see nutritional value. You can create your own recipes too and it breaks down how many calories, etc. are in the meal. Tracks your macros. Literally does everything!

Database is just much smaller than similar apps. And not being able to see the brand when you search for an item is a really dumb design flaw. Edit: actually the database isn't so small, the app just has the worst search function I've ever seen. Edit: down to 1 star. What's the point of spending 5 minutes adding a new food to the database if it's gone the next time you search? It's a shame, but these flaws make the app basically unusable.

When my prior app of 20+ years decided to deplatform, I looked around for something that would allow me to easily do what I enjoy which is tracking my intake. I also wanted something that would allow me to easily add foods, group them, and copy them. This has been great!

Overall it's been a great app and has helped me lose weight (12 lbs so far) but there are a lot of very commonly eaten items that aren't listed and adding them myself can be a bit time consuming. The only other two things I wish were included were "saved items" along with saved meals, and maybe a period tracker included for women who use this app because that affects weight tremendously due to water weight so being able to track that along with my weight and calorie intake would be helpful.

I don't use all the features like the recipes and social aspect but it serves its purpose for tracking food intake. Pretty easy to set up and use. Lots of pre-established food options to choose from. I only wish it had a water tracker as well as I wouldn't need 2 separate apps.

It's a good app. The feature to add custom food is a plus. If this was some how synched to google to search out the custome food and add it to our list if confirmed would, be good. It is understandable that you keep nutrition suggestions as paid only. As you are already deriving different nutrition that we are having daily and also compare it with the expected, it would have been better to incorporate the value in the same page where we enter daily food intake...

The exercise and sleep tracker is an issue. I can't get the records to reflect properly no matter how many times I try edit it. One day I can't have more tham 5 mins sleep, the next I apparently slept for 23hrs! Very annoying because it messes with the overall calorie report! Logged a report so lets see what they say.

Fatsecret app has made me more conscious how much food, I put in my mouth. As a result my weight is coming down again at last. This App has made me more aware too, of what sort of foods and the quantity I eat as it can spike my glucose readings, eg higher carbs. Today, my blood glucose readings came down the lowest, in long while. I am excited because this has been achieved by diet and exercise alone. Its only my second week, and I am already getting better outcomes. Feeling hopeful!

Provide ambiguous and unclear information. For carb, I think it should separate fibre from total carb that can actually make calories. And I counted calories by myself based on macro nutrition facts on app. Guess what. It totally was wrong. Generally it shows over 10 per cent differences from calculated figures. I am not sure everything is wrong, those 10 things I tested was not right.

This is the first time im using this app and I am not disappointed at all, tryung to lose weight and this app helps me stay on track. Best part about it is its free and I don't get any ads while using the app. Has 95% of the food that I eat. Odds ones are not there but it is easy to enter the facts if u have the chart thats on the back of the item that u r eating.

I've had this app before and the data base is quite good. Hoping that now I've reinstalled it, I'll get back on track. My only gripe is the limited variety of devices you can connect to it. I wear a garmin watch but can't connect it to the app. This really needs updating as FitBit is not the only smart device out there any more.

Very good app, still having a few problems syncing to my fitbit account, if for instance it syncs at 9pm, and not again until after midnight, then you would only get readings until 9pm, it doesn't sync data from the day before. Would it be possible to add a button to make the app sync on command or to download the fitbit data from the day before

Happy after just two weeks of using and "adapting" to it. In a month it will be almost "native" to use, I guess. :) I saved some recipes, I contribute to extend the database by uploading one barcode (product) a day. Thank you, guys; you did a great job with this app!

Easy to Use, Versatile Love this app. Incredible versatility and functionality. 4 star because they keep changing it and I keep losing ingredients etc...keep having to add things back in. It's a HUGE nuisance. Otherwise it would be 6 stars if at all possible. Also they want to charge a subscription service. If the app was a one time fee I would have already bought it. Never gonna pay a subscription.

On some food items I can amend or change the value/weight etc in my food tracker. But I seem to be getting more and more messages saying there is an error, and I'm unable to even delete the food in question. Basically rendering the app useless.

This is the best app out there. It gives you all of the information you need to be successful. I'm on the Atkins diet, & this app is much more accurate. Also, I haven't found a food barcode that it won't scan to give you all of the information about that food. Atkins won't find anything by scanning. Their app is really bad. So glad I have this app. Also, this app keeps a record of recently eaten food, so you don't have to re-enter the information, just check the box. Keeps up with weight too.

Overall very good but the diary doesn't always default to the current date, and the calendar uses an unconventional layout (Monday through Sunday) so I have often entered food data for the wrong date. Also the food scanner sometimes misinterprets the barcode and thinks you're scanning something different.

Was very enthusiastic at the beginning but after trying to use it I found that I simply can't. If I want to add a meal that is not in the database or ingridients are unknown to the app then I'm stuck. I didn't find any obvious or simple way to create a custom product with some generic protein, carbs and fats content. I have to search through a random protein powders or other comercial products. I found that annoying. I want to create my custom template otherwise there is no way I can keep track.

I love this app, but I wish there was a way to insert food that's not on the list. Not as in the cook book, but rather food already prepared like granola bars, a certain kind of chips ecc. I don't know if there already is that function, I haven't found it. Really happy with the app still!

U need to improve the seeach engine in this app. I'm indonesian. And some indonesian dish are already in the food catalog. But the search engine is not helping in finding the food that's already in catalog. Eg: i want to input otak-otak (indonesian fish cake) in my food diary. But when i type it..the menu didn't show up. the search engine still not get it..

I am so happy about this app! I gave it 4/5 stars only because I haven't used another app to compare it with. I have never counted calories before because it was always a pain. The app is so easy to. I have found most specific brand foods I eat and it is accurate. It makes it a quick, easy entry! I am dairy-free, gluten-free and am routinely amazed my foods and brands are listed. I also haven't weighed myself daily prior, but this lists your ups and downs it's easy to see your progress!

Great app the only downside side is your not able to copy similar food items and just adjust the nutritional values.Instead you have full new entries. Also the app can leverage ai image recognition of nutritional labels to pull data, much like how currently credit card information can be pulled from physical using the same ai, since nutritional labeling is standardized. .

Used to love this app and used it daily but within the last 8 days, I can no longer go back and add in my weight for previous days. Used to be able to go back and add them if I didn't have time to document them the same day but now will only do the current day. FRUSTRATING! Going to start only using my Fitbit app instead because I can add my weights later with that one! Please fix the problem FatSecret!

Minus one star because the app has limited sync capabilities (unlike MyFitnessPal which can even sync w/Garmin Connect) I have used this site since 2010 and it is the most inclusive, precise, customisable, and reliable app with an online profile I have ever used. It relies on user submitted nutritional labels, scans, and item weight measurements to calculate every entry in g, oz, mL, LB, or fl oz. Extremely helpful when tracking macros & nutrients.

Helping me visually see what portion control looks like. I had downloaded two other apps before this and I could not find many foods I ate. I shop a lot at Trader Joe's and this app has all trader Joe's brands. I love that if I don't eat a whole serving of something I have the option to adjust the amount. To visually see where your calories are going and how you need to adjust your meals so that macros are proportionate to your needs is so easy and convenient on an app. Highly recommend
