App. surprisingly great. Has everything I was looking for to track weight loss. *Best feature in my opinion is the way to log food and meals. It uploads the actual food item(s) and all the nutritional contents. *Weight can also be logged with the option to Journal notes without limitation of characters like other apps do.

Easy to use with most foods found. Only issues: 1. Burned exercise calories are not added back to the calories used for consumption. The more you exercise the more you can eat without breaking your goal. This will show you broke your goal regardless how much you exercise. 2. It does not give an estimate weight lose based solely on the entered data. It only indicates the weight you enter, so it is difficult to gage how accurate your estimating is for food consumption and exercises.

Have only just downloaded this, but the amount of branded food, restaurants and supermarket brands look brilliant. If this cannot help me, nothing will!!🤣😂 Thanks x Been 2 weeks now and love the app. Best thing I have ever found and makes things easier. 2 was in and 5lb down. Love it x

Barely using it and still losing weight! I'm also pretty sure that I have not discovered the application's full functionality ito is utility on my war on weight yet, but I'm looking forward to the continued journey of discovery. ADDING massage roller methods might b good 2.

I used this app for one item and ended up deleting. The information on calories for the item were completely wrong. The calories were for the packages item not as it was prepared. I have tried so many apps and so many have this same problem. I end up gaining weight more than I lose and it makes you give up. I'll be looking for an app that has correct information on food.

This app is very useful for keeping track of calories consumed throughout the day with its food journal. The foods are searchable by brand, variety, etcetera. The app is able to calculate how many calories one needs to consume to lose, gain, or maintain body weight according to current weight, weight loss goal, and activity level. I have seen results on the scale by using this app as a tool to help reach my goal.

Extremely helpful for people who want to count calories!! Pros: -Food item list is extensive(both for Western and Indian cuisine) -Allows to set own weight loss and calorie goals -Calorie consumption reminders -Shows average calorie intake -Tracks weight loss progress using a graph -Allows selection of food quantity in almost all available units(g, ml, oz, cup, pieces etc) One star off only because a few food items I eat are off the list. Still the best calorie counting app with an intuitive UI!

Probably the easier to understand calorie counting apps. Only issue I found is that it's always disconnecting from my Samsung Health app and even my Fitbit app, automatically connecting to Google Fit, which I don't use nor have downloaded. I always have to go back and adjust it but it immediately moves back to Google Fit

Needed a calorie counter after my recent type 2 diabetes diagnosis, and the app made it readily apparent that I was eating too much, so it helped me adjust my intake. It's also valuable in sorting my macronutrients, and tracking sugar and fibre. Minor irritants: incorrect or duplicate nutrition labels in the database, not being able to switch from volume to mass measurement for some items. Units also don't indicate Imperial/Metric variations. But otherwise I'm happy with the experience.

When I 1st started using it, I would have given 5 stars easy. However, removing the restaurant portion dropped you big time. Last night, I had no clue how many calories I consumed in my meal. I'm disabled & need that option free. Either put it back or I'll have to find a new calorie tracking app.

Best Calorie Counter Ever! I've installed and uninstalled so many apps, this one is the best I've found so far. Although, I wish the daily calorie goals showed in the diary when you have a different calorie goal for each day. I can see it in the daily reports but not in the diary.

Issues: When creating recipes you can't reorder ingredients and, after entering them in twice, the app will apparently only save 8 steps under the directions. Getting to the cookbook is also a pain with it only accessible when entering entering what you are eating. There should be a dedicated shortcut from the hamburger menu.

Personally, it's been perfect for me. I enjoy being able to log things in for today and update yesterday's if I forgot to in my busy schedule! I personally don't enjoy the "news feed" but that's because I am a private person and don't enjoy the interaction. I'm too insecure for that. But definitely a great feature which is optional! Plus it's free so it's got that added bonus. Surprised tbh with the quality! It's super easy to use and you can alter it to fit you perfectly

This app is very easy to use and it syncs with Samsung health app to record my exercise. The only thing I would like to see is being able to scan bar codes when creating a recipe in the cookbook section. The free app is enough for me, but if you want to pay, the app does offer meal plans and water tracker.

Awesome app. Way better than the MFP data miner. The interface here is much cleaner. Very easy to input and there's excellent nutritional information. Food library is very very good, sometimes items don't show when scanned, but I'm sure that's getting better all the time. I've tried a ton of these apps and this one is the best. You cannot beat the free version either. Nice work developer people!

Living in Europe, a lot of the food I consume is not in the database. I don't mind entering, but the inability to create a custom portion for an existing item is frustrating. (E.g. there's nutritional information for 100 grams of biscuits, I can't add the weight of a single biscuit and let the app calculate the amount I've eaten)

1st time calorie counting & tracking macros... what a revelation. Downloaded MFP, but found it too busy, super happy with FatSecret. Love the attractive & intuitive layout, ease of use & community interaction. Finding food common to Aotearoa has been a relief & I've even added some recipes. Wishlist for extra features would include: Ability to search usenames (to follow friends), ability to add & track measurements (e.g. waist), ability to add new ingredients when entering a recipe.

Had always refused to count calories bc it seemed too laborious, but this app is life-changing! So easy to use and it has been mind-blowing to realize just how many calories are lurking in the sauces and condiments, especially. I'm addicted to this app and don't see myself ever quitting the use of it.

I find this incredibly easy to use - the best yet - it seems to have every food on it and I like that you can save frequently eaten meals like breakfast. The one down side is you can't enter calories eaten you have to use a food that is already on there but its not a massive problem. Definitely reccomend

I really like the relative ease of finding foods you eat or at least a caloric equivalent. I have found that my portion sizes have really decreased with the use of this app. However, I absolutely hate the social media aspect and pictures of what other people are eating.

I went ahead and paid for a 3 month membership because I was impressed immediately by the way it determined your calorie intake and a goal date but I'm only giving this a 4 star because it could be better. for example I'm finding it difficult to eat the amount of calories per day it suggested with out going over on the carb and protein percentage per day. it would be nice if it would give me examples of things I can eat to reach my calorie per day goal without goin over protein and carb precent.

I read in the What the Fat book that this app may be better suited to my country than MFP, which I have been using. FS is very "pretty" to look at, nice amd clear and simple enough to use. However i am disappointed that basic features in MFP arent available here unless you pay for them. I am missing the wealth of expert advice, interesting articles, and ability to set my own nutirent goals..eg sugar that i can easily edit in MFP. Also this food database is considerably smaller. Nice layout tho!

I've used various apps to track my calories, macros, and micros in the past but they felt like such a burden to work with and not very user-friendly. This app is much better at allowing me to input my food. The "saved meals" functionality is so convenient and allows me to tweak that meal easily. It's not realistic to eat the exact same serving of every item at every meal so this is very helpful. I'd give it 5 stars but it behaves oddly when trying to add a saved meal as of late.

Love being able to manage what I'm putting into my body and tracking macros. The first time I've felt I control of reaching my fitness goals. Love the search and bar code features. Also , the saved meals. Only wish we could create our own schedule of snacks and meals since I'm eating every 2 to 3 hours.

I'm really loving this app! I've never tried counting calories or tracking macros, but this app makes it so much easier than I imagine it would be! I can start typing in an entire meal and it breaks everything down for me. It's amazing! I've only had it a couple of weeks but I've lost 6 pounds already. I didn't even know I was overeating. Life-changing!

So far so good. Some things are hard to figure out. It calculates calories you should eat per day based on age, height, weight, and activity level. It uses that as your goal for the day. I understand that but I would like to be able to put in a calorie goal that I want. My doctor gave me a target amount of calories he would like me to stick to. I had to play with the weight in the calculations to get it to this. If there is a way to enter this I haven't found it. Otherwise it is very good

It's working I'm definitely loosing wight. (3 pounds in the 4 weeks I've been doing it. I chose slow weight loss) Also every food I've looked up was already populated in the app, with its nutrition facts and all. A lot of them are 5-10 calories off (up or down) from what the packaging says, but I don't think that will really make a difference in the long run.

Great app but improvements could be made. Difficult when you buy groceries in several countries, have to change country to search, no short cuts. Can only save total meal, not 100g, and then say you ate 150g. + much more. More inconvenient than real big issues.

The app is very helpful, but it can also be better. Searching for food would be faster when the shown list contains only the entered key-word. Delete of entry (eaten items) happens accidentally very often.. because the app doesn't ask for confirmation.. So delete happens.. Thank you for good job!

Please fix that bug which occasionally doubles food entries that was already added before... ( Also, switching reports from "this week" to "today" every time when i'll opening it is annoying... And ofcourse program's obsession to translate all my food amounts from decimal values in gramms to that dumb multiplier x100 system drives me insane ))

Great app, love the social media posts, and love how, unlike other counter apps, this one has no ads (that I've seen) other than the premium version! One common bug for me is that it doubles my meals sometimes after inputting one. If that's fixed, then it'll be perfect!

FatSecret is making it easy for me to make close to accurate estimates about my calories consumed and burned. I love the database of foods that comes handy when entering food types. I think it takes one a week or two of using the app to figure out servings that are within one's intended plan, intuitively. The greatest part is the partnering with Google Fit, that makes this a true MASS BALANCING tool. It is so wonderful! I am hoping for an offline version/libraries of the FatSecret app.

A few small issues like cals rather than kj here and there. I'd like to have my own complete list of foods (favourites) that I can manually enter. You'll find it helpful to toggle between app and website sign in. I'm only using the free basic version which serves my needs for my own personal record keeping. For those that like the community aspect, it appears there is lots of support.

This was a great app and I liked using it everyday to keep track of my food intake. I had a question about why my steps weren't correctly syncing from Samsung Health and was told I should uninstall and reinstall to see if that fixed it, but now I can't get back into the app and I've tried contacting the creators more than once but they won't respond to any of my messages. It's a great app and I'd like to be able to continue using it but it won't let me back into my account.

This app is great for those who are trying to be healthier whether it's losing, gaining, or maintaining weight. So far FS has helped me lose 8kg. (+) -You can track your calories so easily by just looking up the food you ate. -It has a community sharing feature that motivates you and gives you recipes -It has few healthy recipes built in the app (-) -Alot of indonesian foods can't be found through the search engine in the app.

Amazing app that has instantly changed my life. Feeling so much better and controlling what I eat is so easy. I just wish I could change the serving size of things that I add myself. For example I added a 330mL drink but I can't change the defaut serving size from 100mL to 330mL. Other than that everything is super easy to use.

This is by far the BEST calorie counting app!! I cant recommend this app enough. You can post your food, progress, recipes on here. Its like a little social media platform you can communicate with others on, while also counting and logging your meals. The amount of support on here is unmatched. Whether youre trying to gain or lose, people show support because we all want the same thing...happiness and health within ourselves. So many features I love about this app. Yall did a FANTASTIC job!

Guys I'm going to be brutally honest. I've tried apps like MyFitnessPal, weight loss guides and more, and tell you the truth, FatSecret is the best app to calculate calories, fitness and much more. You can find all types of traditional foods listed in this app that you've consumed that aren't found in other apps. 100% deserves 5 stars 10/10

This is BY FAR the best weight loss app I have ever used. I have had this app on my phone for many years. Whenever I find myself serious about dieting, I turn back to FatSecret. I have tried hundreds of different dieting methods, and a great many dieting apps, but this one provides the perfect tools for the task of losing weight.

I have been using this app for just over a week and am impressed with how helpful it has been. The daily meal diary is easy to use. The food search is fairly simple, helpful and accurate. Sometimes I would prefer if I could simply scan the food bar code to get the product. The Statistics and Reports are useful. I have chosen a 50C-30F-20P approach and rarely feel hungry.... 🍀

Very user friendly. Haven't explored the comments section yet but I love the food diary and the breakdown of your food into main components. Easy to understand. I use mainly the diary and reports tabs. Love the tips as well. Functionally haven't had any issues at all.

This app is really great. All problem I find is when adding a new product or food when you are busy adding photos of the product and you are done it just takes you back to your diary sceen for seaching food. Please give attention to this. It's really frustrating to try and add food over and over.

Amazing app easy to use. If you lost track on a busy day you can go back and enter your previous meals. The search items are very vast and you can adjust the portion sizes to what you actually had. It also measures how much % protein carbs and fat you consume and it draws a graph of your earing habits. This app is perfect!

Was great until latest update. Loved this app until a few days ago. Its been a great way to track my daily calories and weight loss. Since the update though, it seems to have a problem with adding my meals. When I try to adjust the quantities it doesn't work properly. A real shame as it was a great app. Hopefully the next update will fix it 🤞

Very smooth and smart app, but you can't set your macro goals, or even calories now?! It 'calculates' that for you, but what if you want to set your own calories? Not a chance! Would be nice to have a barcode scanner for tracking food as well.

Nice app, well laid out and easy to use. Unfortunately, in the UK, the food database appears to be nowhere near as comprehensive as MyFitnessPal. Trialled for a day but 30/40% of my food wasn't recognised by barcode. I'd like to come back to this app off that improves.

This app is awesome! I love how it does the percentages of fat/protein/carbs per day. I have no problems. And if I can't find a food I can simply add it. I love being able to scan foods to know I'm recording that exact item with X fat or cal. It's perfect for me! Still love it 5 years later!

I enjoy the ease of use and the database is quick. It is great that you can set your own daily calorie intake without annoying alert messages. I am following Fast800 by Dr Michael Moseley and getting great results. I would like to record water intake/goals separately in the Daily Diary and the TIME at which I ate - to reflect Time Restricted Eating (TRE) goals. Mine are 16:8. An app that keeps up to date with science and medical research would have both of these attributes.

Great app. I have been tracking my consumption and weight successfully. It is also community based so you get to chat withother people and share tips and motivation. The food list is extensive when you log in your meals. Happy about that. Currently on the freemium package and it is amazing. Can't wait to try the premium package. Well done.

Really good app. The only thing I'd complain about is it's tricky to add custom foods. If a particular food isn't in the database you have to find something close and adjust the portion to hit the correct calories. No big deal, but kind of a pain. This doesn't happen very offend though. And you get the hang of it after a few days.

I've been using the app for about 4 weeks and i like it so far. I started with the free app and was using it side by side with your major competitors and after a few days I realized that their were more features available to me without having to pay extra. I have since upgraded and continue to use its features to my advantage.

Used this app once before and got frustrated but I've decided to give it another try. It keeps me on track and I've seen great results in just a short time. Easy-to-use. The trick is to make sure you add all the food you've eaten and pay attention to portions. I can plan my meals for the day and enter them all at once. Good luck with your journey.

I love this app. All the food that you can imagine is listed on this app. I can easily track my goal calories for the day. If I feel like a cheat, I check the calories and then avoid the cheat. I need to lose 10kg and this app is making it easier. In 3 days I have lost 800g. If you count calories you will lose weight

I absolutely love it! I love that it has an extensive food list where you find almost anything. And you can even see the carbs, protien, calories in a nutritional label format which is pretty cool. You can also take pictures of your food for your diary and save the meals you log too. You can also track weight and it has recipes and special meal plans you can do. Keto, vegetarian, and others. 👍😁

I love this app. 14 lbs off in 2 weeks. Great conversations & ideas with fellow calorie busters. I really like being able to log my meals by searching & adding all at once instead of one at a time like other fitness apps. Great work. It's free but going to subscribe the instant I have the money to. Thank you developers.

It kept doubling the amount of calories I entered in my diary out of nowhere, so I had to manually correct them again. In general it works and you can keep track of your meals thanks to the app; but this bug kept happening so I had to delete the app. Hope it resolves in future.

Easy to use as my go to app for my transfotmation. Readily shifted from MFP to this app and am quite happy so far. Update 10/31/2020 The app often finds itself unable to connect to the Internet and states to try again later. Yet other apps to include MFP are able to connect and maintain a data link with no problem.

It's a really good app, has a lot of features and makes it super easy, only thing keeping it from 5 stars is that not a lot of foods are added (when you cook your own or when you buy something from the grocery store/fast food chain) so you have to make the own calculations, but with more users it makes it easy. Over all I love this app and it's really helping me keep track of my eating!

Great app. Talking half a star off for the name 'fatsecret' as could be quite dangerous for those suffering ED and half off for (unless I'm missing something) the fact that you can't choose to have your end of day calories marked as a net deduction of exercise minus cals. Thank you for a great free app!

TERRIBLE POLICY!! You can't cancel your premium account without emailing them directly and it takes a day or more just to have them respond. I've never had this experience with another app. I feel I should have the freedom to unsubcribe when I choose as it is my money and I shouldn't have to get "approved" for a cancelation.

I love this app, so easy to use. Really helps me track my daily calories and weight loss (or gain). I didn't realize how many calories I consumed until I started keeping track with this app. Now I'm making better food & portion decisions and seeing real progress in my weight loss journey.

I like the app it has lots of food that's already been entered in and for the most part it's just a matter of me to select either the same or something with similar calories. Provided the information that was input with the food is correct it gives you a great deal of information about what you're eating.

For the first time in reviewing any app, it's that awesome. Really easy and if u don't find any food already in their database you can actually add them. Make ur own meals and count the calories. For the first time I stayed loyal to any calorie counter app and I'm absolutely able to lose weight. Just go for it!!!

I love turn on certain items I can scan barcodes I also love that it connects to my Google Fit keep track of my steps and I feel like it's just an all-around good app for keeping track of calories and carbs. The only thing I don't like is it doesn't show your net calories but I can live with that.

OK for calorie counting, although the database search seems poor. The meal plans feature is terrible. You have to individually swap out every instance of a food you don't/can't eat. The shopping cart feature is worthless. Even using the default plan, they've used different measures for the same thing so you end up with multiples of one item, and they aren't sorted in any way. I also noticed it didn't list all items on the plan. The plans did not offer recipes for things like "Cooked Vegetables.

I have been using it for over a month. I found the layout logical and very intuitive. The content is up to date and relevant to your country based on type of food stores. I love the graphs and stats which keep me honest and also teach me about what I consume at nutrient level. And...it is free.

I have used this app for years. It works reliably and is really easy to use There is already a huge database of foods on it. Which is great cos its a pain adding new stuff when you don't know the sodium content or the amount of fat per gram. Overall though I love this app. They don't constantly change the user interface either which is another plus

Easy app to enter your calories weight and goals . There is a feature for meal's menu for everyday. I do not use it but for someone that would be wanted to have a set menu this would be very good . You have menus for Keto, Californian diet , Atkins etc.... And u can add your fit bit progress to the exercise part. I have been using this app since 2017 and really enjoy it if u like sample and efficient this is the one you want.

I'm really enjoying this app! It's makes my weight lose journey easy to track and I love that the weight lose display not only gives your current weight, but also reminds you of where you started, and how far you have to go to reach your goal! Also, the price is very reasonable! I was using a very popular psychology based weight lose app and they charged me quite a bit more than what I was quoted. I pay my bill monthly on this app and it is tacked on to my Verizon phone bill. Join FatSecret!

This is a fantastic app that really helps you break down what you're putting in your body. My only criticism is that it isn't easy to group homemade meals into portions, and it's not always easy to do certain restaurant meals unless they're major chains. overall, a wonderful app I highly recommend.

The app was suggested by a friend. It s very easy to use , intuitive and it has a lot of features that really help you to monitor your progress and plan your meals. It s also easy to find products of known brands with all their nutritional information already available without adding it manually. Recommended!

Easy to navigate. Frustrating when Calculating. I use a scale to weigh my food. This app makes it difficult when trying to add in food that have been weighed precisely. The app has pull down options for measurements only on SOME foods, tthe others go by quantity- which is not always accurate.

I understand a lot of users want the premium features and have a hard time finding them. That's no excuse to create a daily pop-up asking to join premium. There could be options like "remind me later" or "never show again." The plan is to lose all users that don't convert to premium. The company is making very poor decisions lately. Will not recommend this app to anyone anymore. BTW, the premium features are largely unnecessary if you utilize new foods, the cook book, and saved meals features.

Have used this App on and off for years in between my weight going up and down. Quite simply it is the best, and I have tried many. So simple to use; Can track your Calories and Macros easily and lose weight easily if you don't cheat. Those who complain about this App havent learnt how to use it or use it's full potential. It's awesome.

For a free app, there is all I need to monitor my calories. A big library of food, especially for USA people. One good thing is the ability to upload food product stats if they are not in the library and add custom meals as well as save your favorite meals. Well done and very useful

Ok but a bit fiddly. Copying previous meals from yesterday for ex. You need to navigate to the previous day via the calendar (at the start of a month, even more awkward), then save the food as a meal, then go back to the original day and add that recently created meal. A "copy yesterday's breakfast" button would be better. Food weights and units aren't remembered. if you usually eat 10g of butter then you have to select g then put in 10 every time. My alternative for if MFP continues worsening.

It tells what our calorie goal is to acheive certain target weight, but doesn't say the duration over which the target weight will be acheived if we maintain the calorie goal. Other than that it's useful to keep track of how much calories and nutritients we ingest and a well developed app.

Couldn't afford noom after trial period, found this great app that has even better libraries, camera function and data storage than noon. And of course this great app is free! Have easily lost about 8 pounds in a couple of weeks. Must be honest in recording the food you eat but after getting used to it, it's easy!

The app is ok, I just wish there was an option to add more meals than just breakfast/lunch/dinner since I prefer eating multiple smaller meals opposed to 3 bigger ones... Also the exercise like walking & cycling has limited options for tracking since you can enter how long your activity lasted but not how many miles/km you walked/cycled

I haven't used any other calorie counter but this one does everything i need and more. Highly recommend it for ease of use and its comprehensive food/brand database. I've lost 6.6% of my body weight in about 5 weeks. My only small peeve is that when the units are set to kilojoules the weekly report is still in calories.

Very useful for keeping track of your meals and calorie intake. A basic UI. Cross device syncing is good. And the connecting with the Google fit is very good for also comparing how many calories your have burnt. If it had a better offline function, I would give five stars.

I am finding it useful. although, I would like to have a little more control over the portion sizes. currently, I find they only list "suggested portions" and I find myself having to guesstimate the size of my portions, to keep an accurate count of my calories.

I have tried almost every free and trial based tracking app that is popular and widely available in the US. This app is by far my favorite. You get full features without paying. Showing that a price is not being put on the ability to track ones well being. It is very accurate as well. One of my favorite parts is the non-judgmental social features. This app really is for everyone. Wheather you are losing, gaining, or maintaining weight. It is great accountability for yourself. Great data as well

This app is brilliant. It has all the features I need and is very easy to navigate the app. The only issues is they are lacking in home exercise options when you want to enter your workouts and they are lacking a few popular restaurants on their food list. Still one of the best health apps I have tried.

Love the interface. Very intuitive. Not a big database of food but adding items is super easy. I like that I can set my macros since I usually follow keto with carb cycling. Only complaint is I haven't gotten the barcode reader to work when searching for food (but it works fine when adding new items?).

I love the look and ease of use. I've tried several ways to track my food to loose weight, but I really think, for me tracking calories works best. Oh and it's the only app I have found that integrates with Samsung Health, so it automatically tracks my exercise /steps. Love it!

This is genuinely a great app and definitely preferable over other calorie counting apps. However, the name is frankly horrific. Was telling my friends about it and they genuinely laughed at the name FatSecret. I'm not fat and I keep healthy so it just is out of touch with what it's needed for.

This is a very useful tool. It has helped me loss weight and be aware of my negitive weight gaining habits. It offers a lot of features for free. Its enough just stay on the basic features but the upgrade is significantly cheap than other weight loss apps and is worth it. I love that there is journal feature, you can follow people and use their stories as inspiration. I have already recommended this app to my friends and they are happy with it too. Give it a try you won't be disappointed.

Great application! Helps so good in counting calories. One minus is that it's impossible to 'complain' and change some foods, as sometimes calories there are indicated incorrectly (some of the users just made mistakes). But overall love it and use it every day:) thank you!

This is a very helpful app, I really enjoy the community aspect of it. I thought calorie counting would suck but really it just takes the anxiety of eating/eating healthy and makes it into something manageable. As long as you are consistent and realistic about your goals this app will work for you.

Really great for a free app. It has a huge food catalog with a barcode scanning option to quickly track the foods you're eating. It also breaks down the percentage of proteins, carbs and fats you eat. Only flaw is it randomly doubles my inputs and if I'm not extra careful, it can mess up my eating for the day.

Good app, but unfortunately you can't change language.So as my phone is set to English, I can't search Dutch food. Annoying and on their forum they are laughing at users making the same remark. Totally respectless!  EDIT: I do not want my phone to be in Dutch. All dev tools, reviews, tips & tricks and online support articles are in English. Most app translations are crappy in non-English. The language of a phone OS is not the same as the "locale" behavior it should show including metric system, 24-hour time support, and in this case: having apps support geographically correct information, although the phone is not in the countries native language. Do not mix CONTENT with INTERFACE.

Trying to add a recipe to the cook book, and it only saves a single ingredient. Edit: it only shows a single ingredient, but saves the rest when you save overall. If you can't remember if you recorded something or not, you can't see from the editing screen.

Pretty good although I don't have experience of any other competitor app. I am able to find some food but I invariably have to guess others due to limited options. It would be nice, for example, if I could enter nutritional info with minimal details required. Some websites such as the BBC give the key nutritional info but I'm not willing to spend ages filling in all points of information they want captured presumably so it's added to the database. I do like the macro and pie charts displays

I used to drop weight before competitions easily by just not eating bread, then I had to switch to intermittent fasting. Now I feel more naturally in charge of my diet. I can have a cheeky sausage sandwich and thanks to the visual calories and macros indicator know where I have to cut myself off in the day - this app doesn't lose the weight for you- you do the work, I learned to stop lying to myself because a little chocolate after dinner adds up, with the milk in your tea, tuna in mayo etc

Been using this for 2 weeks and have seen an 8 pound loss! Really easy to use, makes you think about portion sizes, eating correctly, and what not to eat. Meal ideas on it too! Best thing is, I can still have a couple of cheeky beers as long as I stay within my daily calorie allowance. Thank you creators.

I really like this app for tracking my carbs and protein. I am a diabetic and i have a digestive disorder called gastroparesis, and so its really a balancing game for me and this app really helps. I would have given 5 stars but I liked the older version better. I was able to do more for free. Now they want me to pay for some features and with my medical bills and prescriptions each month, I can't really afford any luxuries.

This is an app I would recommend my friends. User-friendly interface, no ads(!), awesome features and I really love the "add your custom entry" option, so if you don't find some foods in search you can add it manually. App not only counts calories, but % of protein/carbs/fats etc. and nutrients as well, thats amazing! Big thanks to the developers and good luck everyone for reaching their goals ☺️❤️

I've been using the website since forever and the app just made things a lot easier to track things as time went on. The app is intuitive and useful and I'd happily recommend it to my friends and family. I've been able to reach a lot of my fitness goals by tracking my food intake on a regular basis through the app.

Update...Found out that you can edit foods entered on the website,so wrong entries can be corrected. You can do the same with recipes in cookbooks. Also, the website allows you to print you weekly meal schedule in pdf. I still wish for this could be done on the app. I wish the proforma for nutrition would have an option to include include vitamins, iron and calcium count.

I love the ease of entering my meals. It's a bit rough at first but once you get them in, it's one click and done. Plus, it has all kinds of restaurant. One of my favorite features is how it calculates my carbs, fats and other levels so I can adjust properly.

Good while it lasted. Something terrible has happened to the search results. Items that were always on top are now buried or completely gone from the app entirely. A search for "yellow american" always gave me yellow american cheese as the first result, now it's #14 under something called cheese loaf. I've recommended fatsecret to dozens of people over the years but I can no longer do so in good conscience.

Great resource, very useful, brilliant in so many ways. However all reports and overviews consistently revert to arbitrary percentages instead of useful information such as grams, it's the same with weekly instead of daily figures. And no dark mode. These basic preferences would make it a 5 star app, but without them it is quite frustrating.

The best food app I've used. Gives many features that others apps do not, such as showing a breakdown of macro nutrients and which meal meals had which macros. The barcode scanner works great and has had food item I've so far scanned. I'd like to see more widget options (such as a 3x1 size that shows cals eaten and total macros)

Easy to use. Good food database, easy to adjust to amount eaten. Can also add own recipes for calories per portion to be calculated. Really interesting to see a nutritional breakdown of what I've eaten. Makes me more aware of what I'm eating.

it was a great app and had a great database , clear of wrong info and all of the entries have a lot of standard units. but unfortunately, I can't use it since the last few days and it crashes on Android pie when I try to add an entry to my food diary.

This has been helpful to me in better understanding what I'm eating (calories, carbs, protein, fat) and the ability to track my intake more accurately throughout the day. It's also helps track sodium intake which, as I have hypertension, is extremely helpful.

Good app. However, it severely lacks exercises, even the most common ones. No pushups, planks, crunches, for example. Also, accidentally swiping a food item to the left will delete the food item without confirmation and no undo option is available, which is annoying.

Free, easy to use, allows you to set targets for each macro, tracks calories, macros, and a few micronutrients (such as potassium). The entries for most products are correct. Definitely helps you to see where you stand ib terms of nutrition.

Free! Simple to use. Wish could just enter food type and calories. Spend a lot of time trying to find an item/calorie match. Also with could keep diary type entry explaining why chose certain things. Otherwise I really like it. Nice charts too.

Despite the stupid name, this is the best dieting/calorie counting free app. It's really easy to use and has tons of functionality. I found it particularly helpful on a low carb diet as it clearly shows the balance of carbs/protein/fat in a table and pie chart for your daily intake. Highly recommended.

Fantastic app, every food I've searched has shown up. It works out calories, proteins and fats for me. I can link it to my fitbit so it also tracks my exercise. I have no faults at all with it even my friends have started using it. For a free app it's amazing it covers everything Thank you

Absolutely love this app! It helps me keep track of my weight, caloric intake, exercise, macronutrients and my sodium! It also has a community board to post comments, pictures, etc. I love the scanner especially. Just scan what you are eating and voila! The information is there for you to track on your food diary. I highly recommend it!

USE A DIFFERENT FOOD APP!Had to reinstall. I absolutely HATE new updated version!!! Tries to force food survey participation every time I open app, no way to disable. Pay diet options constantly scrolling across top hogs screen. New layout is awful making it difficult to find posting buttons. And where is the "QUICK" pull down for restaurants, grocery stores, popular brands, etc to help find specific item?

I use this app because I have recently been on a prediabetic programme. This has really helped me to monitor my calories, fat and protein intake. It's very user friendly as you can track the type of foods with the amount of calories in each food. Plus a daily diary to monitor your daily intake of calories. I found this app to be the best I have tried and would recommend.

I can't take it anymore 80% of the foods I scan it gets WRONG and I have to make a new food and put in all the nutrition facts! If wanted to do that I could go back to writing everything in a damn note book. This app is completely useless. It gets three stars because it's easy to use, well made and has nice settings options.

I love that I can plan my meals for the next day, but I've had some issues integrating data from other apps. It doesn't sync with Samsung Health even though all the permissions are on and it doesn't import the exercises from Google Fit, only the steps.

Very good app, useful features and a very usable interface. Database is good and in multiple languages, would just like to see a more flexible way of recovering foods you have already eaten, right now you have to search them with almost the exact words or it won't find them but overall very good experience.

The app is very easy to use. I really like the graphs in the reports. I can see how many carbs I eat and protein too. I have used other programs but this one just gets me. And it's free!!! Thank you so much for that. Losing weight is hard enough without it also bring hard on your wallet.

I don't think this app is safe for everyone. Although I am eating even less than what the app suggests and I am reporting that I am losing weight, the app keeps sending messages suggesting I could cut even more calories. I think those messages are irresponsible and the app could at least include a disclaimer that the use might not be safe for people facing mental health issues. This could lead people to develop eating disorders and I think this must be considered by the developers.

It's a great app, would be nice if you could copy meals without having to save the whole meal as a favorite (like if I'm just having leftovers). Love that it even shows net carbs. Also the option to add multiple foods on a smartphone would be great!

I had no idea I was not eating enough protein until Fat Secret showed me. I was also surprised at how many calories I can eat based on my height/weight stats. More than I had ever eaten before on a diet and still lose weight and feel like I can stay with it a long time.

Tracking of Calorie intake is great does not sync with all health trackers though. For example I have a Huawei watch and cannot sync steps etc with the app so the calories burnt isn't always accurate, it also doesn't allow you to add steps manually although you can add other excercises.

I just downloaded this app this morning because it was one my health insurance app could sync with. I chose it based on the 4.7 rating. This is a misleading rating! When I tried to link the two apps your app would not move past the sign in page. The password IS correct and does not need to be changed! It doesn't even indicate the password is wrong on anything else. I downloaded the Fitness Pal app (which was another option for my insurance app) and it linked perfectly. I will delete your app now

I love it and will always use it. It helps me out so much. After a while i realized i eat the same foods over and over but, I just keep it within the count, Im down 8 pounds within 22 days. Im just waiting to get to the point of maintaining. Thank you. Tip: If i know I am going to have dessert or a snack, I make sure that i save those calories for the end of the day. I be so happy when it says I have calories left and its bedtime. I have told many about this app.

It gives a clear picture of my weight loss progress. I can see my daily calorie intake, number of times and length of my exercise. I also like that it has an extensive list of food products to choose from so I can get an accurate calorie count. But I wish there was a way to put in home made food. Overall though this is a great app.

very helpful to reach your goals and the barcode scanner is a nice feature. exercise values for burned calories is pretty accurate as well. Only issues are editing some food facts is only available on desktop and sometimes people add the wrong details and you can't report them

what's good: 1. large crowdsource base with different food(with elaborate but short flow to add  entry by yourselves) 2. meal sets 3. planning meal ahead(paid version only) 4. works fast  what's not so good: 1. it seems searching for food in DB by the same query depends on system's language(say the same query "пюре" returns dramatically different results set for phone with English as default system language and another one with Russian - same app version, same region; I strongly believe it should depend on current region _only_) 2. you can input exercises but reports are just for meals - no way to control input-vs-output ratio 3. app lacks swipe interactions - you need to tap a lot 4. if you try focus on concrete protein-ch-fat values you may meet a bug in this flow(as well as highlighting "enough/not enough yet" is possible only through reports but not in Diary mode)  I'm rather satisfied but hope to get it fixed some day.

I moved across from another app from a request from my PT. I was hesitant at first because I've been so used to the other. Took me a while to get used to this app. Its good, has a lot of features I like, however it is limited on the app and has more features on their website. I would give it 5 if the features on the website could be accessible on the app. Community, editing the recipes etc.

Overall this app is perfectly functional, and I think a bit easier to use than my fitness pal. Plus, it seems to be more practical. MFP has a whole lot of content I am not at all interested in, I just want the functionality. The only knock against fatsecret is it doesn't have as comprehensive a catalog of foods as my fitness pal. Also, what is up with the name? If I am fat it is no secret, and there is no secret as to how to become fat.

Such a handy app to track calories, I like that there are South African products listed and that you can drill down to macro details and see what nutrients/macros you're eating too. If you are not sure how to start a calorie deficit diet, start with tracking what you eat with this App!

I have been using this app since 2012. It has always given me caloric goal that is most beneficial for my weight and goals. This app has helped me when I was 150lbs , and is helping me now after 4 kids and 212lbs. I've been using the app once again for 2 weeks and it's helped me lose 6lbs so far. The app also tracking Macros for free is another plus.

I decided to try this app after using Myfitnesspal for years and I'm glad I did! This is a big improvement. There are more free features. I'm able to analyze my micros and macros better. And it feels like a tighter and more encouraging community of people. It doesnt have articles or recipes for free but I will take the exhange any day. I love this app!

Works very well. Easy to use once u get the hang of it. I only wish it could track some other things like BP and take pill reminders. The people behind this have been very responsive with help and questions. I reccomend using this if you want to get a good evaluation of you food habits with the caveot....ya gotta be honestbwith you entries. 'Nuff sed.

Good app, can recommend without a doubt. Only downsides I have encountered are not being able to edit nutrition information on existing foods, not being able to add serving sizes to existing foods, and the lack of generic food stuffs without any brand (i.e. what you buy from a coffee shop).

I used to Love this App, now its ridiculous to try and work out..I used to be able to add products I was using and now I can't even find where to. I don't want other people's recipoes I want to be able to calculate the calories on my own recipes. and products I am using aren't even in this app and the ease of chaging meansurements to cups or spoons or grams has gone. So sad that is is no longer an outstanding app

The app is nice, with a community that will support you, I feel easier to do a fit challenge. But as Indonesian, the list of foods are not enough to me, I need to count the calories in better numbers which is not in this app. I hope fatsecret can add bunch of foods list to the app

This is a nice app once you get used to it and made using it a habit. Thats what I have done. I think I will give it another star when its a bit easier to use. I am still abit fat but I love being able to see how my weight drops over time. I also need to tell you that after using this app for quite some time now, they havent told me the fat secret yet. Maybe they will tell my when I rate it five stars. Not sure.

Over 14 days ago my account suddenly and mysteriously vanished quite completely. I reached out to customer support for help and received exactly two emails that first two days. The first apologised for the inconvenience, the second asked me to verify my username and email they had on file but the fields were blank. Since then no response whatever to any of my multiple emails asking for help getting my account back or at least give me my data back. The utter lack of customer support is upsetting

For an app that is marketed as 100% free, the premium plan was very quick to show up (about the 3rd menu item I clicked). The app is quite similar to others but it lacks the option to set your macro targets and to add new recipes which is what I was looking for.

Started my food dairy journey with FatSecret 1 Nov 2020. It's any easy apps to utilise. Love the option to link food and photo. Having the breakdown on Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and snack great idea. Report in breakdown of food intake wonderful. Help me to check on amount of intake for Carb, Protein n etc. Choice of food information for Asian food is extremely limited. Link to watch pedometer is also limited. I would for sure recommend this apps to my friends.

3 stars because it drives me crazy that when I click on reports, it automatically shows the weekly report. NOBODY wants to see the weekly report for more than once a week whereas you need to check the "today" report multiple times a day to check how many macros you've left! Please change that at the next update, as I'm thinking of changing apps because of this. Other than that, the app is better than other similar apps

I love how this app let's you know the breakdown of what you're eating. You simply enter what you have eaten and it does it all for you. It also tracks your calories you've consumed and how many you have let. I'm just getting started with it as I have only been using it for a few day however it's easy to use.

I was looking for an easy way to track what I was consuming each day in order to lose some weight. Counting calories is easy with FatSecret! Easy to keep track of the weight your losing by setting your own personal goals and view a graph of your progress each day. You can also share recipes with others who are also using the app.

I wish I could give this app 5 stars, but too many little things keep bothering me. The two that stand out most to me however are the inaccuracies I frequently find around unsaturated fats and the lack of other information like vitamins showing up in reports. This is a great app I'm just suprised these are issues.

Years ago, website only times, you could copy down and share recipes with the community more freely. I miss that. I understand that they need to charge for meal plans, but it would be nice if you could create your own inside the app if you don't want to buy them. It's a great app though. There is lot you can do in the free version. It's great to be able to enter breast feeding in the daily activity section.

Great way of tracking what you eat and how much calories the food contain. Once you have your favourite meals/food recorded in your library it is enough to feed them into the diary. But even if you come across something new it is quite likely contained within a general database provided.

Why the hell now everytime I add a meal for example DINNER, then choose SAVED Meal and pick what I already saved before, it goes into BREAKFAST, unless I change it to dinner which is redundant because I tapped the PLUS sign on dinner section before that. It often messes up my breakfast list by adding stuffs that should go into dinner, please fix that.

I'm not happy with the latest update of Fat Secret. It used to flawlessly integrate with my Diabetes-M app and made it easy to mark things as "favorite" that I ate all the time. I don't have a need for calorie counting etc in FS because I already have that in the Diabetes-M app which I pay for every year. Now, I can't so much as "star" my favorite almond milk in my other app. It says it has to access my FS account (where my favorites are stored), no problem, I say yes. Goes back to the same screen and I click yes again and it closes out what I've entered and pops back to the main entry screen. I realize this problem is an integration problem but I suspect it has something to do with the new premium feature which allows menu building... and "favorites" must count as part of that. If someone has a fix for this, I'd love to hear it because as it stands now, while I appreciate the use of the calorie etc database, Fat Secret is pretty useless in making my life easier as an adjunct app for controlling my diabetes.

An easy to use app for keeping a food diary. There is enough to keep you informed about your daily eating habits for no extra cost, but I am intrigued out the premium options. Maybe one day I'll take the extra step. NZ food information is also good.

This is a great app to keep track of your calories and to lose weight. Last year when I used it I lost 18 lbs in about 8 weeks. You can customize serving sizes. Keeps track of your breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks calorie intake for every day. It ask for your weight and how much you want to lose. It reminds you of how many calories you could have daily.

Very good app. Very stable. Has a number of great features including the ability to get nutrition info on menu items from restaurants. I like that the app provides macro nutrient data and not just calorie info. I would update to the premium version but I do not want an annual subscription.

Very good application. I've been using it since August to count all my calories. The only reason I give it 4 out of 5 is because of the community section. I have introduced this app to one of my colleague at work and I was bummed out when finding out that I couldn't search for his username at all to follow him and follow his weight loss progress. Also, the priority of the feed, when put to everyone, is always refresh when people like or comments so posts like mine gets lost and unseen by people

I love this app. I love how detailed the reports are. They have a huge library of foods and the scanner works very well. My only complaint is that it doesn't sync with a galaxy watch. I use my watch to track my steps and exercise and and would love if everything was in one place.

I like this app it keeps my calories on track. One of the best things is that it lets you save meals you eat regularly, for example I drink coffee every day with cream and Stevia. Another example, homemade things, like chicken salad, you can save all the ingredients for the next time you eat it.

Recently started using this app and so far so good. I must say I really hate the name of this app. It's very embarrassing to have something called Fat Secret on my phone.. It sounds more like a closet eaters app then a weight loss app. Like, it's an app for people to find new and innovative ways to secret eat or something. Consequently, I keep the app hidden.

I can only describe it as awesome! It reminds you to workout with build-in alarm. FatSecret's food catalogue is complete, you should be able to find most of your meal. People's feed also brightens my day with their activity. Recommended app for you who wants to live healthily! (edited August 2019)

Actually a pretty good app. Even an amateur like me who simply wanted to lose some weight with counting calories, due to simple and self explanatory interface and functions, can sound professional when explaining what it does and how it helps achieve goals to others :)

Absolutely so easy, just put in what you've eaten it finds it very accurate and FREE .. soo many apps lie and say free but after a day or when you wanna keep track or enter info then it pops up oh look you gotta pay if you want help .. but this I am so happy with and it's easy and I highly recommend this app .. I've already lost over 5 pounds no excercises just keeping track.

I have tried a lot for weight loss, and counting calories is the healthiest way for me to lose weight suprisingly fast. Laat year I tried to lose weight by working out and TRYING to mind what I ate, but far secret really helps me keep a routine, avoid eating too unhealthy and avoid eating too much. It absolutely amazes me how much counting calories help, and this is the best app I can reccomend for that.

comprehensive easy to use food calorie and macros database. save your common meals and instantly know the calorie, fat, carb, protein content of your meals. Great for meal planning or deciding what you can eat that's in your meal plan at a restaurant. Easy to use and great for people just getting started at meal tracking or planning. cant recommend it enough.

I know this app for few years and developers still don't want to add "change language" option. I don't see any reasons for buying pro version cause it wouldn't be useful for me. And also I cannot see any simple morning exercises in examples. Another features is ok.

I used this app years ago and it was great. I stopped using it for some time but came back to it this year. It's as great now as it was back then but has more features. By far the best health app that I've used - it's easy to use, gets me to my health goals and keeps me on track 🌟 The only improvement I'd love to see is the ability to log historical weigh-ins (it's nice to see progress over a long period). Other than that, it's awesome 👍

Unlike the other so called Free apps this one works well even if you don't buy the premium options. It's helping me lose weight at my own pace and I'm delighted with the result. It's been wonderful to find such a supportive community and so many French products listed.

A great way to record your weight and diet. To be able to see what nutritional information you've had means you can see where you need to improve. It lists popular brands in the UK and you can add some if you know their nutritional values. I also like that you can record any exercise/activities so you have an idea how many calories you burn.

Great app, but please add a dark theme/mode! Also allow us to custom-add calories/carbs/protein to a meal without actually creating a new dish, or at least make the dish be private. Also, add an undo button when swiping (deleting) an item from our diary.

1st time using the app, sync nicely with google fit but NOT with samsung health. Inputs the food intake fast and accurate but the exercise part there is some inputting problem, like when you manually enter an exercise, it doesn't show up. I had to go to the webpage to check😥.

AN OUTSTANDING APP Very easy site to navigate once learned and with simple steps to calculate food intake. Alot of foods are in memory on this site to transfer to your intake. Also you can customize a meal or daily intake (ex:egg/oatmeal/juice, etc) for each category of breakfast, lunch, or dinner. This way you tap your specialized meals and it uploads automatically in to your macro intake. Each item can be customized, added, or deleted separately. AN OUSTANDING APP

Love Fatsecret, unbelievable what you get for a free app. no annoying adds as well, HUGE plus. My favorite app without a doubt. Changing my life one day at a time! I never rate anything but had to for the value this app brings to my life daily. After the headache of MyFitnessPal, Fatsecret is a complete dream!

The food diary is simple and effective. The weight tracking is basic and useful. It does what I wanted it to do with very little effort on my part. The surprise is how great the user community is. I am finding not simply an effective weight management tracking tool but also an encouraging and motivating community. I read the posts much more than I expected and I believe that unexpected feature is part of my success.

Tries to guess the meal waight, instead of reading it from the scale. Ok, I'm ready to enter the weight and calories manually, but there are no adjustable fields. Devides meals to breakfasts and lunches while multiple diets (mine also) have multiple similar intakes.

The best thing about this is the large database of items. Most of what I eat has already been added so it's a simply click away to teach what I've been eating. I wish it integrated with my scale to also track weight loss but manually entering it weekly isn't that big of a deal.

It actually has a lot of food input choices and the ability to add ingredients for those not listed that you have prepared. I am a bit disappointed in the exercise choices, a lot are not listed. But for a free app you can't beat it!!!

Why do i need an internet connection to make entries? This app is useless on devices i want to keep offline or if my connection drops or if im on wifi only. Also, the RDI for the weight goals is definitely wrong. Please fix all these easy-to-fix things and ill give 5stars. Might have to switch to a different app as is

This app has changed a lot. They took away preset exercise names suggestions. Also cannot find a way to enter custom nutrients label. It's all so complicated. Good enough. I could not find a way to directly add calories, you must add only foods. Which is annoying if you prepare a dish and you know how many calories it has but it has a lot of ingredients. So if I want to add 500 kcal, I find something in the app that has 10 kcal, and add 50 of those.

USE CRONOMETER APP INSTEAD! The user interface for FatSecret is *REALLY* terrible. Swipe to go back to your main screen? Oops, it deletes your entry, irreversibly. Adding new foods is a royal pain, looking for foods you've added is a royal pain. Seriously, devs, give your competitors a try and you'll get lots of good ideas. Just because there is a way of doing stuff in your app, doesn't mean it is comfortable to do them.

Really good app, helps a lot. The only disadvantage is that I can't chose exactly how much food I eat sometimes. For example there is only a quantity of the product, but the calories have to be entered manually. App is really amazing, I like it a lot, but this one minus is a little irritating

Fast,works great! I've been using this for a while and it fully meets my needs. Every time i read about weight loss by calorie deductions or macro goals, the suggested numbers on the app are almost exactly what the external source suggests. You can tell that the developers know what they are talking about

This is a great app!! Only one thing bothers; you can only choose 1 region, but sometimes the item you search can be found in another region and you have to go back and forth. Why is it necessary to choose a region at all? Can't all items be searched in one place?

This has been the most helpful app I've tried for counting calories and losing weight. It's very easy to use and has so many options in the food lists that I always see exactly what I've eaten down to the brand of product. Thankful!!

Great! Everything is fine but I wish the sleep recorder wasn't so difficult to use (I have no idea how to use it!) So I wish that you instead logged in when you went to bed and when you woke up (or sync with samsung health with the sleep recorder instead/with step counting??)

Really good app for free. Once you work out how to navigate the menus (excuse the pun) very easy to keep a full record of what you eat and drink. Sleep and exercise logs also useful. Three weeks in and still shrinking! Many thanks.

This app makes it so easy to track your calories because they have all sorts of food options in the search field. At a glance I can see everything from calories to carbs to protein intake. I have recommended this app to family and friends!

Awesome! It tracks your calories, sleep, exercise, and weight very easily. You can set goals for yourself and get notifications to keep you on track. They also suggest the perfect meal plan for you. All for free! Definitely recommend!

This app is easy to use and has many helpful features especially for being free. It's not time consuming and I actually enjoy using it. It has helped me track foods and lose weight for a few weeks now ! I'm not a consistent person but this has helped me stay on course.

this app has been instrumental in my weight loss over yhe last year. it is easy to use and has damn neer every food you can imagine. obviously what it doesnt have you can add yourself. Only thing i would change is a way to track fasting.

I love this App. It's like I have discovered a whole new world. I've lost over 10lb, safely, in two weeks just by becoming aware of counting my calories and re learning healthy living. It's brilliant and so easy to use. I don't pay for the extras but I bet they're worth it too 🙌

I love this app! Best app I have ever used for nutritional info, calorie counting and exercise tracking. Easy to use recipe builder. The only thing I would like to have in the recipe builder is to choose the serving size, as it defaults to 100g.

i love this app, better than fitnesspal. on fitnesspal you will not find many foods to track your daily calories intake. even if you find it you will still face trouble tracking the serving size. in this app you can track your calorie intake very easily and conveniently. i strongly recommend this app for people on keto diet, losing weight or gaining weight. good luck

I love this app. Makes calorie counting and portion control a breeze for this extra busy working mum. hello!! please, help me with this one issue I have with your app. here's the thing: the summary shows that I've consumed 28 grams of fat, 116 grams of carbs and 44 grams of protein, which makes it 892 calories in total (160×4+28×9). but somehow the total amount of consumed calories due to the app is only 855. how's that possible? am I doing something wrong?

Love it! The app has a decent database of food already, with an option to add your own. Keeps track of calories and macros, and lets you know how many more calories you have for the day (if you're doing calorie restriction). The community is kind and supportive, and generous with encouragement.

Nice to have and easy to use, especially with saved meals and customized dish info input. They have a chinese version with chinese dishes, which can be imported to the app very easily, but not savable to the English app, which is annoying. Why not provide all dishes?

I've used this app about 3 weeks now, and I love it! One thing I'd like to see is a tab that shows all foods logged regardless of which meal and how long ago. Otherwise, great database and no in your face ads or prompts to subscribe to anything.

After canceling my Noom subscription, which was great by the way, I was looking for an app that would help me keep track of my calorie intake. FatSecret fills the bill and in some cases it is easier to use than the Noom app. I like it!

Using app to track calorie intake. It's helping me maintain my weight. Good to have all the food and their calorie info in app! If they don't have a food in their database, you can enter it and it's nutritional information yourself and it will be saved into their database for others to utilize and for later use...

Almost perfect, especially considering how fast it is in comparison to one very well known competitor... And how good is it's database. What really could be improved though is adding an ability to easily copy meals from one day to another.

Great app! I recommend it to all of my personal training clients. The selling point for me is being able to enter my macronutrient ratio by grams instead of just percentage. In other apps, I've had to upgrade and pay for this feature.

A calorie counter app that doesn't let you enter calories? How can this possibly be? If you eat a fruit salad that you know the calories of you can't just enter "350", you apparently have to search for each ingredient individually and adjust the serving size of each. 45 minutes later you'll have that 350 value if you're lucky.

It's my first time to maintain and be conscious about my calorie intake.This app helps me to check and know how many calorie,did i consumed already.Also this app have a community where you can post your meal.The only con here is that their are recipes that aren't present but they made a option,where we can illustrate/write the unlisted dish to their listed Dishes.Last,Consistency Doesn't mean Never Messing Up,it means Never Give Up.

Excellent app. Allows me to track absolutely every calorie. I can add foods that I find from the grocery store or I can search where other people have already added it very easy to use very happy to use I won't go anywhere else it's that good.

Great App that keeps track of the important things, like daily caloric intake, exercise, weigh-ins and photos. Easy access to the community posts too! The food list doesn't have much variety as others I've used before but otherwise, so far so good!

Basic calorie counter for free. Works well for food on the intake side but it doesn't count correctly on the exercise side. If I sleep 6 hours and work 8 hours and exercise 1 hour, it will still add 16 hours of resting calorie burn and you can't alter it so you end up with too high of calorie burn numbers.
